experiences.title: Metal Art Class Experience in Sitka
experiences.description:
The Salty Sitkan offers visitors Sitka’s most unique fish experience in Alaska. Visit the only metal art workshop along the inside passage open for classes to visitors. 

Mike is a 3rd generation high school shop teacher with a decade of experience making students and teachers alike successful in all types of creations. 

Mike will start this fast paced class by making the sparks fly on a state of the art CNC Plasma cutter to supply you with a flat metal animal blank in the shape of a variety of alaska creatures such as Sockeye, Coho or King Salmon, halibut, grizzly bears, dungeness crabs, bald eagles, pacific octopus and more!

You will get a unique chance to see inside a working cnc workshop and learn some of the tricks of the trade for turning dull, crusty steel into spectacular one-of-a-kind Alaskan keepsakes.

experiences.title: Guided Hike in Sitka, Alaska
experiences.description:
Want to get away from the crowds and enjoy the peace and tranquility of nature? Our guided small group hiking tours are unlike any other excursion offered. With local, professional guides, your experience is sure to be a highlight of your visit to Alaska.

Your guides will provide information on the local culture, flora and fauna, and history of this special place. You'll get to explore the best kept secrets of Sitka on foot! 

This tour is best suited to adventure seekers and those who like getting off the beaten path. Hiking in Sitka is challenging with rugged terrain and steep climbs. This tour is not recommended for those who simply want a photo - we are situated in a rainforest where weather and wildlife sightings are NOT guaranteed. What we can guarantee is a meaningful small group experience in the beautiful Alaskan wilderness. We can't wait to share it with you!

experiences.title: Focus on Haines Private Nature / Photography tour
experiences.description:
The Focus on Haines Private Tour is tailored to my guests' interests and will offer you the opportunity to see the best Alaska has to offer.away from the ships & shops. Whether you are a photographer or just want to get out into the quiet corners of America’s last frontier, you will find Haines to be the Alaska you came to experience.

At each stop I share the stories of cultural and natural history that makes each location special.

If your interest is photography, I strive to cover the basics of your camera's technical functions. I offer instruction how and when to use the camera's various modes to optimize the photograph you would like to save as a real keeper. Additionally, I offer tips to optimize your opportunities for successful wildlife photography. I can discuss the best composition considerations when framing your shots so you come home with an award-winning photograph. 
For people who want an extended tour, additional time can be provided for at the time of the tour.

experiences.title: Electric Moose Studios Aurora Adventure W/Portraits & Hot Pizza!!
experiences.description: Nathan is a professional portrait photographer by trade, which is something you’d be hard pressed to find on any other Aurora tour in Fairbanks. He was a full time wedding photographer for 10 years before becoming an aurora portrait photographer, which he's done for over 7 years. Other tours offer “free portraits” but not to the level of expertise that Nathan provides. He uses controlled supplemental studio lighting to achieve unmatched quality and sharpness, using techniques he developed over 7 years of practicing aurora portraiture. We also provide complementary gear to help keep you warm and safe: hand/toe warmers, headlamps, water bottles etc. What everything boils down to is great photos and a personal experience. The photos speak for themselves and we want to get you some of your own. Not only will you have a top tier photographer as a guide but Nathan also has more than 20 years of Alaska artic wilderness survival skills and offers expertise in all things Alaska adventure.

experiences.title: Backcountry Eats & Foraging Treats
experiences.description:
Looking for a tasty tour that has a little of everything? Then spending time hiking, foraging and cooking with us is your go-to option. This is a great pick for families with younger kids, as pizza could be on the menu. On this one-of-a-kind daytrip, you’ll learn how to forage wild Alaskan edibles, experience world-class hiking, and learn the art of backcountry cooking. This tour is available in either Talkeetna or Anchorage!

Highlights:

• Experience a unique Alaskan activity with a skilled forager and guide!
• An enjoyable experience for everyone! Great for families with children.
• Partake in a past-time shared among all cultures.
• Learn about Alaska's foraging potential. Try wild greens, fungi and berries.
• Learn how to cook backcountry-style using fresh-foraged ingredients!
• Eat whatever we find!

NOTE: We'll show you what to pick, but guests must pick their own food.

Ready for a unique tour that you can savor for day to come? Come forage and cook with us today!

experiences.title: Half-Day Three Canyon Six Mile Creek Whitewater Rafting
experiences.description: Challenge yourself on Class V rapids on this three canyon rafting adventure on the Six Mile Creek. Paddle through towering canyon walls and cascading waterfalls on this 5-hour guided rafting trip. Descend the scenic river, passing through healthy salmon runs and crystal clear water. Find adventure while safely navigating precipitous drops on this 3-canyon run starting near Hope, Alaska, located just 90-minutes south of Anchorage.

experiences.title: Prince William Sound 26 Glacier Cruise and Coach Package
experiences.description:
We make it easy to see it all in one day! Relax on the coach as you enjoy the beauty of Turnagain Arm. On the cruise get ready to view one of the largest concentration of glaciers in Alaska. Weather, ice conditions and wildlife activity changes daily and our captains may adjust the route to provide the best cruise experience while keeping your safety and comfort a top priority. We take pride in ensuring that your time with us is an enjoyable memory that becomes a favorite highlight of your Alaska vacation.

We operate first-class catamarans. Due to their dual hull design, these powerful high-speed catamarans are extremely stable and able to smoothly navigate through the narrow fjords and passages that lead us to the face of massive glaciers. By operating safely and efficiently, Phillips Cruises & Tours provides a comfortable cruise and our No Seasickness Guarantee assures nervous cruisers the confidence that they will enjoy our cruise without any unpleasant effects.

experiences.title: Prince William Sound 26 Glacier Cruise, Self-Drive
experiences.description:
For guests with their own transportation, this 5.25-hour cruise brings you face-to-face with dynamic glaciers and a variety of wildlife, surrounded by the pristine wilderness of Prince William Sound. 

The cruise route covers 120 miles in Western Prince William Sound while being surrounded by the Chugach National Forest. Your friendly and attentive crew will strive to make this cruise a favorite highlight of your Alaska vacation. 

Our industry-exclusive No Seasickness Guarantee assures every guest will cruise in comfort while enjoying your cruise. All cruises are operated on first-class high-speed catamarans that provide an extremely stable cruise and can smoothly navigate through the narrow fjords and ice flows to reach the face of massive glaciers.

experiences.title: AK Sourdough History and Brick Oven Pizza Making
experiences.description: Experience a delightful combination of private transportation and dining at the Eagles Nest Restaurant, where you can soak in stunning views of Downtown Ketchikan. Guests will have the chance to explore the fascinating history of sourdough and will receive a sourdough starter kit to take home. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to create your own personal-sized pizza using a variety of traditional and Alaskan-themed ingredients. Enjoy one alcoholic drink from the menu, which features locally crafted beer and wine, or opt for non-alcoholic beverages such as soda or water. To round off your meal, treat yourself to a delectable Cape Fox Cannoli for dessert.

experiences.title: Experience Incredible Marine Wildlife Tour
experiences.description:
I (Captain Matt) along with my crew member take our guests out for an incredible experience on the waters in and around Sitka Sound viewing the breathtaking scenery and enjoying diverse wildlife encounters! You may see many if not all of the following wildlife, Humpback whales, Sea Lions, Sea Otters, Harbor Seals, Ravens, Bald eagles, shearwaters, cormorants, 2 types of puffins, and many other sea birds too numerous to mention. 

Bears are regularly viewed in the late summer early fall, and occasionally viewed in the spring.

As I have had a long career commercial fishing in Southeast Alaska, I give unique insight into the local fishing industry. Both my crew and I will also enlighten you on local history and life in Sitka. 

To ensure your experience is genuine, my crew is always either one of my family, or a local hire that truly knows Sitka. We live it year round!!

experiences.title: Fish Tales & Ales - 90 minute Historical Walking Tour of Fishing Fleet and Bars
experiences.description:
Enjoy a guided historical walking tour of Creek Street and the Fishing Fleet, book ended by drinks at the Fishermen's favorite watering holes. Learn about the colorful events that have shaped Ketchikan, The Salmon Capitol of the World and Alaska's First City. After a round at the "Shipwreck Bar", we'll stroll through town to Creek Street then down to the docks to learn about the world famous fishing fleet and see the boats and crews up close preparing for their next catch. We'll finish at the infamous Potlatch Bar for more drinks and stories.

You will be guided by a Fisherman who lives on the Fishing Fleet’s Dock in Ketchikan. Your guide has first hand knowledge of the Fishing Fleet and their favorite watering holes. Fun, entertainment, drinks, history and a few tall tales make this a “must do” tour while visiting Ketchikan! 

As a bonus, your guide will also be your photographer along the scenic walking tour so you can share and enjoy the memories for years to come!

experiences.title: Bears & Beers Tasting Tour out of Anchorage
experiences.description:
Explore Alaska's stunning wildlife and natural beauty on this immersive tour. Visit the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center to see bears and other native animals, then journey through the scenic Portage Glacier area with high hanging glaciers , perfect for capturing breathtaking photos and, during certain seasons, witnessing the salmon spawn. Afterward, relax in Girdwood with a local brewery tour and tasting at the base of Alyeska Ski Resort. At the brewery they have some great food trucks. Seasonal highlights may include spotting Beluga whales or the captivating Bore Tide. 

- Wildlife viewing at Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center
- Scenic drive through Portage Glacier with photo stops
- Brewery tour and tasting included (staff permitting)must have an ID for alcohol.
- Snacks and water provided in the van, with hotel pick-up in Anchorage

experiences.title: Chena Hot Springs Tour: Relax in Natural Mineral Waters
experiences.description:
Discover the serene beauty of Chena Hot Springs, a top destination for both locals and visitors. This tour offers a scenic drive filled with chances to spot wildlife, leading you to the famous rock-lined hot springs pool. Unwind in the soothing mineral waters or enjoy a unique appletini inside the Ice Museum. You can also take a guided tour of the facilities to learn about their sustainable food practices. Engage with knowledgeable guides on the return trip to satisfy your curiosity about Interior Alaska.

- Scenic drive to Chena Hot Springs with wildlife viewing opportunities
- Relax in the natural mineral waters of the hot springs pool
- Visit the Aurora Ice Museum and enjoy an appletini
- Learn about sustainable food and energy practices during a guided tour of the facilities

What to bring:
-Swimsuit
-Towel
-Flip-flops or water shoes, especially useful in the locker-room/pool area
-Two quarters if you want a locker, lockers are $0.50

Must be 18 or older to enter hot springs

experiences.title: Mendenhall Glacier Lake Canoe and Brew Adventure
experiences.description:
Discover Juneau's breathtaking landscapes and vibrant culture in a single day packed with adventure and flavor. Begin with a narrated drive through historic Juneau, showcasing stunning fjords and towering peaks. Then, gear up for a guided canoe trip across the glacier-fed waters of Mendenhall Glacier National Park, where you'll paddle towards the majestic glacier and Nugget Falls, spotting wildlife along the way. Afterward, savor Alaskan-inspired beverages at a local brewery, paired with delicious bites that reflect the region's culinary heritage. This tour concludes with a scenic drive back through Juneau, wrapping up an unforgettable Alaskan experience.

- Guided canoe adventure at Mendenhall Glacier National Park
- Narrated tour showcasing Juneau's history and stunning fjords
- Curated tasting of local Alaskan beverages and bites at a brewery
- Scenic return drive offering breathtaking views of Auke Bay and Admiralty Island

experiences.title: 1.5-Hour Beer and Puppies Guided Experience in Fairbanks
experiences.description:
Meet and interact with our Alaskan husky puppies and enjoy chatting with our local authentic mushing guides while enjoying local Alaskan brews (non-alcoholic and alcoholic). 
On top of the puppy play time, casual conversations with local mushing guides, we offer a presentation and walking kennel tour where guests get to see the rest of the kennel, meet our adult long distance sled dogs and hear more about the kennel's history and the dog mushing lifestyle and culture.

experiences.title: Alaska Forest & Feast
experiences.description:
This is more than a sightseeing tour. Alaska Forest & Feast is a small group experience designed to help you slow down and experience Southeast Alaska through its forests, shoreline, stories, and flavors.

You’ll explore the temperate rainforest while learning about native plants, seasonal foraging, traditional uses of the forest, and the deep relationship between local cultures and the land. Along the way, you’ll take in beautiful glacier and mountain views before arriving at a quiet beach for a mindfulness experience surrounded by ocean, forest, and mountains.

The experience ends with locally inspired food that brings the flavors of Alaska into the journey, connecting what you have seen and learned in the forest with what you taste at the table.

With a small group, a slower pace, and a focus on connection rather than checking off attractions, this experience offers a more personal and meaningful way to discover Juneau.

experiences.title: Historical Hatcher Pass and Palmer Ale House
experiences.description: Follow the story of the Mat-Su Valley from mountain pass to hometown streets on this relaxed heritage day trip. Travel from Anchorage into Hatcher Pass to explore the preserved Independence Mine and hear how mining and early settlement shaped the region. Then return to downtown Palmer to slow down over lunch at Palmer Alehouse, with an included tasting flight (or a non-alcoholic option). With scenic views throughout and time to enjoy each stop, this tour blends history, landscape, and local flavor in one easy day.

experiences.title: 3-Hour Small Group 9-Hole Self-Guided Fairbanks Golf Experience
experiences.description: Golfing at the northernmost USGA golf course in the USA is a one-of-a-kind experience! At this arctic golf course, golf and permafrost coexist creating an exciting game. This is truly Alaskan golfing, with our course offering natural challenges and hazards unique to our arctic climate. Each of our 18 holes offers its own taste of Alaska. Moose and fox frequent our course as well as many arctic birds. Come enjoy the game immersed in nature.

experiences.title: Small Group 18-hole Golf Experience in Fairbanks
experiences.description: Golfing at the northernmost USGA golf course in the USA is a one-of-a-kind experience! At Midnight Sun Golf Course, golf and permafrost coexist creating an exciting game. This is truly Alaskan golfing, with our course offering natural challenges and hazards unique to our arctic climate. Each of our 18 holes offers its own taste of Alaska. Moose and fox frequent our course as well as many arctic birds. Come enjoy the game immersed in nature.

experiences.title: Icy Strait Village Tour and Crab Feast
experiences.description:
Join us for an Alaskan village tour and crab feast! Our locally owned and operated tour is your chance to form a deeper connection. 

We will teach you how we catch, cook, and crack our delicious local Alaskan dungeness crab. We will also take you around the village and to our favorite foraging spot to show you a little of how we survive and thrive in this remote paradise.

experiences.title: Distillery Tour and Signature Bottle Infusion Experience
experiences.description: On this tour you'll enjoy a rich history briefing of the historic fire station, the process of distilling our local spirits, tastings of our house spirits, followed by a hands-on class of how to blend your own custom infusion. All botanicals, herbs, and spices are included in this experience. Once your signature creation is complete, create a custom label and enjoy your bottle back home with friends and family!

experiences.title: Whales and Lunch! Ketchikan's Premier Marine Mammal Viewing Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the breathtaking waters of Ketchikan on this intimate whale watching tour. With a small group led by knowledgeable locals, enjoy personalized service as you search for humpback whales, orcas, seals, and more. This 3 to 3 and a half-hour adventure aboard a stable catamaran features heated indoor seating and panoramic views, ensuring comfort in any weather. Savor a complimentary locally sourced lunch of your choosing between five different options, while taking in the stunning Alaskan scenery. If no marine mammals are spotted, a $100 cash guarantee awaits you at the end of the tour.

- Small-group tours led by local experts for an authentic experience
- 3-3.5-hour duration on a high-speed vessel reaching prime wildlife hotspots
- Complimentary lunch included 
- Marine mammal sighting guarantee with cash refund if no sightings occur
- On time for cruise ship departure guarantee

experiences.title: Matanuska Glacier Hike with Lunch Summer and Winter
experiences.description:
Join us for an unforgettable journey to the breathtaking Matanuska Glacier! Your adventure starts in downtown Anchorage, where you’ll board our comfortable van for a scenic two-hour drive north. Enjoy stunning Alaskan views and insightful commentary from your guide along the way.

At the glacier, we will meet our expert guides who will lead you on approximately a two-hour trek across ancient ice, showcasing its incredible features. Learn about the glacier’s history and impact on the landscape. The moderate hike requires good balance, sturdy knees, and proper footwear. We provide all necessary glacier gear, including helmets and microspikes.

After the trek, warm up with a hearty lunch at a nearby lodge with stunning glacier views. Snacks and water will be available throughout the trip.

Conclude the day with a comfortable ride back to Anchorage, with drop-off at major downtown hotels. Our passionate glacier guides rely on tips to continue providing these exceptional experiences.

experiences.title: Hump Island Oyster & Kelp Farm with Tasting
experiences.description: A unique opportunity to not only witness one of the most picturesque locations in the state, but also affords you the chance to cruise the North Tongass waterways in search of wildlife en route to Hump Island Oyster Farm. Guests will also receive a narrated city tour en route to the vessel.

experiences.title: Full Day Kenai Fjords National Park Northwestern Cruise
experiences.description: Travel to remote areas in Kenai Fjords National Park on this full-day adventure cruise. Ideal for photographers, birders, and whale-watching enthusiasts, this 8.5 hour cruise explores the untouched area of Northwestern Fjord in Kenai Fjords National Park. This cruise travels with a smaller group for a more intimate cruising experience, providing the best opportunity for up-close views of wildlife and glaciers. A full day on the water allows the captain plenty of time to seek out the best wildlife viewing opportunities in the area, home to humpback whales, orca whales, Steller sea lions, harbor seals, sea otters, and many types of seabirds. You will spend time in front of the impressive Northwestern Glacier, an actively-calving tidewater glacier. A deli lunch is included.

experiences.title: Fairbanks Ice Fishing Expedition in a Heated Cabin with Fish Cookout
experiences.description: Go on an ice fishing expedition on a frozen lake outside North Pole. This is the ideal Fairbanks Alaska ice fishing experience as you will fish inside a heated cabin with electric! You will be warm and cozy as you fish through holes in the floor that go down to the ice. Sip hot cocoa as fish tug on your line.  Experience this Alaskan tradition guided by a professional. Afterwards we will grill the fresh fish you catch!

experiences.title: Taku Lodge Feast & 5-Glacier Seaplane Discovery
experiences.description: Leave behind the hustle and bustle of Downtown Juneau as you depart the waters with Wings Airways en route to the Juneau Icefield and the historic Taku Glacier Lodge. With a guaranteed window seat for all and audio narration, sit back and enjoy the 25-minute flight as you soar by five massive glaciers including the largest in Juneau, the Taku! Enjoy approximately 2 hours on the lodge grounds feasting, exploring and relaxing before your return flight. With the combination of classic - 10 passenger - deHavilland Otter aircrafts, pristine glaciers, true wilderness, frequent black bear sightings, fresh Alaskan Salmon and Juneau’s only glacier view dining, this the ultimate all-in-one, 3 hour excursion and a must do!

experiences.title: Wilderness and Wine Tasting out of Anchorage
experiences.description:
Embark on a captivating journey along the Turnagain Arm scenic drive, where opportunities to spot Dall sheep and Beluga whales abound. Capture stunning photographs as you immerse yourself in the beauty of Alaska's landscape. Visit the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center to encounter and learn about remarkable Alaskan wildlife. Continue to Portage Glacier Lake for additional scenic views and potential surprise stops for lunch. Conclude your adventure with a delightful wine tasting experience back in Anchorage before returning to your hotel. 

- Scenic drive featuring potential wildlife sightings along Turnagain Arm
- Visit the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center for a close encounter with local wildlife
- Photo opportunities at Portage Glacier Lake and surprise stops along the route
- Tour duration is approximately 5-6 hours, with longer options for wildlife sightings

experiences.title: Turnagain Arm, Wildlife Center & Glaciers: Small-Group Tour
experiences.description:
Six hours, one unforgettable road. This small-group tour (14 guests max) trades the big motorcoach for a comfortable Mercedes Sprinter and a born-and-raised Alaskan guide who's been driving Turnagain Arm his whole life.
Heading south from Anchorage, the Seward Highway squeezes between the Chugach Mountains and the sea. We pull off at Beluga Point to glass the water for beluga whales and the cliffs for Dall sheep and bald eagles. Then it's on to the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center, where rescued bears, moose, bison, caribou, and muskox live in big natural enclosures — your best shot at photographing all of Alaska's icons in one afternoon.
Lunch happens like a local: Girdwood Brewing Company, in a mountain ski town, with rotating Alaska food trucks. We finish in Portage Valley with views of Explorer and Byron Glaciers and a short walk through mossy rainforest before heading home.
Small van, real Alaskan, flexible stops when wildlife appears. Come see the Alaska between the postcards.

experiences.title: PRISTINE - Wilderness, Wildlife, Glacier Experience in Anchorage
experiences.description:
Experience the Big Outdoors and Portage Glacier Cruise!
See the amazing beauty that surrounds Anchorage.

This special tour does not follow any set route. Nor does it follow a time table. 

Use your time wisely by going into the wilderness to see wildlife and view glaciers. Summer only: an option, on a 80 ft. cruise ship. (available 11am departure only thru OCT 5th.

We follow the sun, the wind and our hearts to navigate your vacation towards the most scenic locations capable for the day of your tour. 

The Wilderness Wildlife Glacier Experience includes entrance into the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center. During summer you'll have an option to include a glacier cruise on the mv Ptarmigan.

Learn about our rich history and see the Ring of Glaciers. This award winning tour can not be replicated by any other service or shuttle. 

The Wilderness Wildlife Glacier Experience offers highly trained Guides who's sole purpose is making your vacation memories last a lifetime.

experiences.title: Captain's Choice Kenai Fjords National Park Tour from Seward
experiences.description: NEW for 2025! Maximize your adventure aboard this flexible seven-hour Kenai Fjords National Park cruise. Explore the day’s most spectacular sights as your captain selects their route based on current conditions, wildlife reports and expert insights. More time on the water and more freedom means more opportunities for costal Alaska magic, from breaching whale sightings to moments spent marveling at calving tidewater glaciers.

experiences.title: Craft Brews & Epic Views: Juneau's Brewery & Sightseeing Tour
experiences.description:
Tap into the best way to see Juneau - a brewery & city tour serving up a uniquely Juneau, uniquely Alaskan experience, nothing watered-down here! We’ll hop across town, pairing sips with the stories and sights that make Juneau one-of-a-kind. With a small group, you’ll tap into three distinctly different breweries in three different corners of Juneau, and along the way, taste the flavors of Alaska with Barnacle Foods’ kelp salsa.

We’ll explore stunning scenic stops - Brotherhood Bridge with its epic Mendenhall Glacier backdrop, and Juneau’s iconic Whale on the waterfront - perfect for photos that capture the scale and beauty of the Last Frontier.

We visit Alaskan Brewing Company, and Forbidden Peak Brewing on every tour! We alternate between Harbor Mountain Brewing and Devil's Club Brewing.

This tour is a fun and social experience. The minimum number of guests per trip is three.

experiences.title: Wildlife Center with Lunch and Local Beer Sampling
experiences.description:
This experience, is carefully designed to showcase some of the best sights, flavors, and wildlife encounters Alaska has to offer—all in one unforgettable day.

Your adventure begins with a scenic drive along the Seward Highway, known as one of the most beautiful drives in Alaska. Along the way, we make scenic stops with opportunities to spot Dall sheep, moose, beluga whales, bald eagles and more

The highlight is a visit to the Wildlife Conservation Center, a nonprofit sanctuary for orphaned and injured native Alaskan animals. This center offers meaningful, up-close encounters with bears, moose, caribou, musk oxen, and more in a spacious, natural setting focused on conservation and education.

Also included is a visit Girdwood, where lunch is served from a rotating lineup of local food trucks stationed at Girdwood Brewery. There, you'll also have the option to enjoy a curated beer tasting featuring small-batch Alaskan craft brews—a perfect taste of the local scene.

experiences.title: Alaskan Lodge Adventure and Seafeast
experiences.description:
Experience one of the most unique seafood excursions in Ketchikan, combining Alaska wildlife, rainforest exploration, and an unforgettable Alaska seafood feast. Cruise through the scenic waterways surrounding Ketchikan aboard our enclosed, heated boat, where you may spot whales, bald eagles, seals, sea lions, and other local wildlife.

Step ashore at a remote Alaskan lodge and stroll through the heart of the Tongass National Forest, the world's largest temperate rainforest, along a comfortable raised boardwalk surrounded by towering trees, lush moss, and breathtaking natural beauty.

Complete your adventure with a traditional Alaska seafood feast featuring Dungeness crab, shrimp, clams, and mussels served in a classic seafood boil with corn, potatoes, pearl onions, and roasted garlic. This authentic Ketchikan shore excursion offers the perfect blend of wildlife viewing, rainforest discovery, and fresh Alaska seafood, creating memories that will last a lifetime.

experiences.title: Full day Northwestern Glacier & Wildlife Tour from Seward
experiences.description: Massive blue glaciers, narrow fjords and abundant marine life are just some of the reasons that Kenai Fjords National Park is at the top of many outdoor enthusiasts’ bucket lists. Cruise through the fjords while learning about the region’s fascinating natural history on this 8-hour trip. Floating through Alaska’s pristine waters is the best way to see this stunning national park, and this is the only daily tour that visits the magnificent Northwestern Fjord, home to three amazing tidewater glaciers and numerous alpine glaciers.

experiences.title: Seward Shore Excursion: Pre- or Post-Cruise Kenai Fjords National Park Tour
experiences.description: Make the most of your time in Seward with a pre- or post-cruise shore excursion through Kenai Fjords National Park. Enjoy a six-hour voyage on Alaska's most popular wildlife and glacier cruise, coasting past alpine and tidewater glaciers amid the fjords of Harding Icefield. You’ll view migratory seabird rookeries in the Alaska Maritime National Wildlife Refuge, and keep your eyes out for whales and other wildlife viewing while aboard the boat. Enjoy complimentary lunch and onboard commentary from the captain as you take in the magnificent sights!

experiences.title: Anchorage Sightseeing and Food Tour - Available All Year Long!
experiences.description:
We have 98% Five Star Reviews! Check out our profile!

Satisfy Your Hunger and Curiosity on this Anchorage, Alaska 4.5 -5 hour Tour!

Get a tasty sampling of Alaska on this food and sightseeing city tour of Anchorage! You’ll be led by one of our local certified guides who has a passion for sharing the history and tales of this unique town with travelers. 

You will taste fantastic foods, learn about the history of this great state, see incredible vistas around the city, and hear incredible survival stories from all over Alaska.

If you have any questions prior to booking, please feel free to get in touch.

experiences.title: Downtown Anchorage Food and History Walking Tour
experiences.description:
The Only Anchorage Tour for Foodies!

his Alaska culinary tour kicks off when you join your engaging professional guide at a meeting point in downtown Anchorage. They’ll take you on a 3-hour guided walking tour through the heart of the city at a relaxed pace, with plenty of tasty stops along the way.

During your tour, you’ll visit some of the best locally-owned and operated small businesses in Anchorage and have the opportunity to try a wide range of regional and local favorite foods, drinks and treats.

You’ll get a feel for the city as you walk between the restaurants and shops we visit and each stop will last about 15 to 20 minutes. Rest assured as there’ll be plenty of chances to sit and relax as well. After soaking up the atmosphere of this one-of-a-kind city, picking up local insights and stories from your homegrown guide, and filling your bellies with local fare, this tour will finish just a few blocks away from the meeting point at a local eatery.

experiences.title: Alaskan Cultural, Culinary and Lumberjack Show Experience
experiences.description:
From Alaskan history and native culture to a culinary tasting, enjoy all aspects of what makes Ketchikan unique! Begin your tour with an action-packed performance at the Great Alaskan Lumberjack Show where these world champion athletes wearing spiked boots and hard hats, compete in 12 athletic events that utilize seven-pound axes, six-foot razor-sharp saws, tree climbing gaffs, and souped-up chainsaws. 

Join us in Saxman Native Village for a culinary experience to learn all about Alaskan ingredients and their uses in a modern cooking environment. The culinary tasting will offer a unique setting to enhance your culinary knowledge and expand your palate with true Alaskan ingredients. The culinary demonstration is complemented by a cultural showcase of Alaska Native art.

This tour also includes a scenic drive throughout Downtown Ketchikan. The Driver will point out historic sights and popular landmarks.

experiences.title: Kenai Fjords National Park Glacier and Wildlife Tour from Seward
experiences.description: Hop aboard one of Alaska’s most popular wildlife and glacier cruises, and take an extraordinary six-hour journey through Kenai Fjords National Park. This must-do tour from Seward offers the chance to view whales, birds and other wildlife as you cruise past alpine and tidewater glaciers among the fjords. You’ll visit seabird rookeries in the Alaska Maritime National Wildlife Refuge and enjoy lunch as you listen to onboard commentary from the captain!

experiences.title: Alaska Crab Feast
experiences.description: The Harbor Haus at Thomas Basin will be your destination to experience the most pristine Dungeness Crab feast. While looking out over the harbor filled with commercial fishing boats, watch as the daily catch is brought to the docks. Your meal includes salad with Asian style dressing, all-you-can-eat Dungeness Crab, baby red potatoes, and delicious carrot cake! After the meal, you are within downtown Ketchikan, surrounded by totem poles, Creek Street, jumping salmon and shopping.

experiences.title: Taste of the Wild: Chocolate and Wine Pairings in the Alaskan
experiences.description: Our Alaska Made Wine & Chocolate Tour stands out by offering intimate access to the heart of Alaska's culinary scene. It uniquely combines wine and chocolate tastings, providing a deep dive into local craftsmanship and flavors. This experience is enriched by stunning Alaskan landscapes, personal stories from our knowledgeable local guides, and a focus on sustainability and supporting local businesses. It's not just a tour; it's an immersive journey into Alaska's culture, history, and breathtaking beauty, designed to connect you with the local community and its traditions. Join us for an unforgettable exploration of Alaska's culinary delights and natural wonders, crafted for those who seek a deeper, more authentic travel experience.

experiences.title: Northern Lights & Arctic Circle Tour
experiences.description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure from Fairbanks to the Arctic Circle, traveling one of the world’s most remote roads through Alaska’s breathtaking wilderness. With an expert local guide leading the way, you’ll explore stunning natural landmarks, learn about the iconic Trans-Alaska Pipeline, & witness the magic of the Northern Lights.

This 12 to 14-hour guided tour offers an immersive small-group experience in the comfort of a climate-controlled van. Along the way, enjoy storytelling, scenic stops, & a deeper connection to the untamed beauty of Alaska.

PLEASE NOTE:
You are eligible for a full refund up to 7 days before your tour.

experiences.title: Best of Juneau: Mendenhall Glacier, Whale Watching and Salmon Bake
experiences.description: Come face-to-face with a glacier, marvel at huge humpback whales and top this excitement off with a scrumptious meal featuring wild Alaskan salmon grilled over an alder wood fire. You'll call this combination amazing; we call it the Best of Juneau®.

experiences.title: Half day Spring Resurrection Bay & Wildlife Tour from Seward
experiences.description: During the spring months spot the annual Gray Whale migration with a special tour to the mouth of Resurrection Bay. California Gray Whales, travel over 5,000 miles from Baja California to the nutrient-rich waters of Alaska's Bering Sea.

experiences.title: Lumberjack Show and Harbor Haus Crab Feast
experiences.description: Ketchikan is now the home of the most dynamic experience in Alaska combining culture, history, excitement, and cuisine! This tour is in scenic downtown Ketchikan in the Thomas Basin historic district, home to the Salmon Fishing Fleet and Crab Fishing Boats. You will be hosted at the Great Alaskan Lumberjack Show Arena and Harbor Haus Pavilion, landmarks of industry, food, and entertainment. Your tour starts at the historic site of the Spruce Mill, once the largest Sitka Spruce Mill in the World and now the home to the Great Alaskan Lumberjack Show. This world-famous Lumberjack Show has World Champion athletes in a rowdy, no holds barred competition with twelve events such as chopping, climbing, sawing, axe throwing, and log rolling. Hang on to the edge of your seats for a rowdy good time! Just a few steps away, the Harbor Haus will be your destination to experience the most pristine Dungeness Crab feast. Enjoy an all you can eat Dungeness Crab feast!

experiences.title: Skagway Shore Excursion: Liarsville Gold Rush Camp, Gold Panning and Salmon Bake Combo
experiences.description: While in port in Skagway, discover what Alaska’s exciting Gold Rush era was all about on this unique two-hour tour. In the historic village of Liarsville, you will dine on authentic Alaskan fare (including wild Alaskan salmon), visit authentic gold-mining exhibits and learn how to pan for gold – keep everything you find! Full of charm, Liarsville Camp gives you the chance to go back in time to an interesting period of Alaskan history.

experiences.title: Private Juneau Food Tour: Local Alaskan Food & Drink Tastings
experiences.description:
Discover the flavors of Alaska on a private food tour in Juneau. Explore local seafood, fresh produce, and artisanal treats while learning about Juneau's rich culinary history. Perfect for food lovers seeking a personalized and immersive experience.

1. Taku Smokeries: Smoked king salmon
2. Tracy's King Crab Shack: King crab bisque, crab cake, and a roll
3. Taste Alaska!: Smoked salmon dip, smoked salmon caviar, kelp salsa & chips, and spruce tip jelly
4. Deckhand Dave's: Dave's famous rockfish tacos, and beer pairing
5. Harbor Spice & Tea: Alaska made Ice Cave blue herbal tea (not available in the evening tours as the tea shop is closed)
6. Crystal Saloon: Halibut Ceviche & Denali Brewing Co. Blueberry Mojito (or non-alcoholic beverage)
7. Taste Alaska! Signature chocolate bar from Theobroma

experiences.title: Montgomery, Selma Area Multi-Attraction Pass
experiences.description:

experiences.title: Creative Camden Scavenger Hunt
experiences.description:
Our very unique, immersive adventures are the only ones of their kind. We, unlike other companies, provide your very own remote, interactive, live host to assist and encourage you along through your phone. We are an Austin, TX-based global custom event design company offering scavenger hunts and other events in 300+ cities in North America and beyond. Our specially hand-crafted adventures are equal parts tour, creative challenge, detective hunt, and social experiment! 

Guests get to discover in an alternate reality our favorite hidden gems off the beaten trail and creatively interpret fun art, history, and culture clues - for points! They get to enjoy fame and glory while appearing on our website’s international leaderboard, no matter what their score. They get to essentially race other teams in other cities, even if they don’t have competitors who have signed up in their city that day. Get ready to discover unusual oddities, laugh out loud, and make the experience your own!

experiences.title: Walking Food Tour of Downtown Fairhope
experiences.description:
Explore Fairhope on a Guided, Walking Food Tour! 

Indulge in dishes from some of the most beloved restaurants in the downtown area, favored by locals and visitors alike. Learn about the founding of Fairhope and the culinary culture that makes it a must-visit destination.

Our tour will take you on a journey through six stops, where you’ll enjoy delicious tastings over three hours. Discover the stories behind the food and the restaurants that created them, adding a whole new layer to your culinary adventure.

With plenty of opportunities to mingle with other locals and guests, our tour is perfect for those who want to have fun while enjoying great food. 
Book now and experience the best of Fairhope’s food scene on a tour that’s sure to leave you with a lasting experience of Fairhope!

experiences.title: Downtown Mobile Food Tour
experiences.description:
Ready for a delicious adventure? The Downtown Mobile Food Tour is your ticket to tasting the Gulf Coast’s most iconic dishes while exploring Alabama’s oldest city. Perfect for first-time visitors, out-of-towners, or anyone craving a fun afternoon exploring Mobile’s culinary and cultural scene.

From crispy fried green tomatoes to sweet beignets, you’ll enjoy a variety of flavors that define Mobile. With six stops, this tour doubles as a full meal – no need to plan lunch or dinner!

Stroll the state’s oldest streets and uncover Mobile’s rich past, from its Mardi Gras roots to historic landmarks like parks, churches, and hotels.

Our passionate guides don’t just lead the way – they share captivating stories, answer your questions, and offer personalized recommendations for where to eat, shop, and explore next in Mobile.

**Visit our website for full information, to see more dates, more tours, to add on the cocktail package, and include allergy information. **

experiences.title: Sip-n-Cycle Pedal Cruise in Montgomery
experiences.description:
Come aboard the only cycleboat in Alabama. This one-of-a-kind BYOB party boat is centered around a 12-station cycle bar and lounge in the bow of the boat. Passengers bring their own beverage and food, as we provide a Sip-n-Cycle Souvenir Cup. 
We have a sound system for song request to keep the party rock'n. 

Your 90-minute cruise heads up and down the Alabama River and if you stop pedaling, no worries, we have a USCG Captain and First Mate to keep the party Roll'n on the River.

experiences.title: Experience Birmingham - The Historic Highlights
experiences.description:
Discover Birmingham’s story of iron, fire, and civil rights on a half-day tour of the city’s most iconic landmarks and hidden gems.

See the best of the Magic City in just half a day. This guided 3–4 hour driving tour blends Birmingham’s most iconic landmarks with hidden gems only locals know.

Begin at Vulcan Park, home to the world’s largest cast-iron statue, then explore the city’s early days at Arlington House, Birmingham’s only remaining plantation home. Discover the cultural heart of downtown with the Alabama and Lyric Theatres, and stand in the Civil Rights District at 16th Street Baptist Church and Kelly Ingram Park, where pivotal moments of history unfolded.

Along the way, enjoy stories of iron and industry, sports legends at Rickwood Field, and Southern flavors from tucked-away food stops. The tour is flexible, with time to tailor stops to your interests — from civil rights to architecture, sports, or local cuisine.

experiences.title: Tuscaloosa Bar Golf Pub Crawl
experiences.description: This 2-hour bar golf pub crawl is a recreational drinking game involving a selection of six bars, creating a "course" to be played golf style. It's your traditional pub crawl transformed into a friendly golf game.  See if you and your friends can master the gentleman's game, we call it round these parts and putt your way through Tuscaloosa's best beer establishments.

experiences.title: Auburn, Opelika, and Alexander City Multi-Attraction Pass
experiences.description:
Do more as you experience a selection of the best attractions in Auburn/Opelika, Alexander City, all on one money saving ticket. This ticket contains 4 ticketed attractions and information on attractions that are free to the public.

What's Included:

- Chewacla State Park

experiences.title: Zombie Scavengers Game - Montgomery, AL
experiences.description:
Zombie Scavengers tests your ability to survive after a Zombie Apocalypse. The game leads you through the city, where you will have 60 minutes to collect survival items for your colony.
The Setting:
Small colonies of the living are doing all they can to survive. You and your team have been tasked with scavenging for survival supplies for your colony. You’ll only have 60 minutes to figure out which items you'll need and find as many items on the list as you can. 
Your Mission: 
With 1 hour and your team of up to 10 people, you will use your smartphone to search the area for much needed food, supplies, and shelter. Along the way, you will be asked to do some challenges or answer some trivia questions. The goal is to score at least 4000 points in 1 hour in order to survive the zombie apocalypse!
PS. Our game is family friendly, no actual zombies are involved in the scavenger hunt.

experiences.title: Half-Day Private Guided Mountain Bike Tour in Bentonville
experiences.description:
With 300+ miles of trails (and growing), the trails network offers unlimited opportunities for every discipline of mountain biking.

The hardest part is making the most out of your time. Our local guides can lead you straight to the best trails for your riding style, making sure you maximize your saddle time.

With years of bike mechanic experience, they will also ensure that your ride doesn't get cut short due to unexpected flats or other repairs.

experiences.title: Wine making fun - Art or Chemistry? Date night fun west of Little Rock
experiences.description: This is great fun for individuals, bachelorette parties, Bridal Parties, or just a romantic date for a couple looking for something fun to do in the Little Rock area.

experiences.title: Bites and Sites of Bentonville
experiences.description:
Bites and Sites of Bentonville is our brand-new guided walking food tour, and it's a love letter to the High Southern food scene that put our town on the culinary map. You'll stroll through the heart of downtown Bentonville, from the square to the A Street Promenade at a comfortable pace while we serve up multiple mouthwatering stops, plenty of local stories, and exactly zero boring moments.
Now, we can't tell you where we're stopping. (A little mystery is good for the appetite.) But we can tell you there's pimento cheese we'd marry if it were legal, burnt ends that'll ruin all other burnt ends for you, and a dish from a James Beard-nominated chef that will make your skirt fly up. And yes, there will be dessert.
Everything is locally grown, chef-driven, and seasonal, so the menu changes as the good stuff comes in. All food is included, and we'll keep the water flowing while you walk. Feeling festive? Add a cocktail pairing for a little extra.

experiences.title: Grand Canyon Sunset Hiking Adventure Deep Below The South Rim
experiences.description:
Grand Canyon's real views are deep below the Rim. Getting away from the crowds and having a real adventure is what we have planned for you! Classic temple views, pastel colors, giant drop-offs, world class 360 views and some of the best hiking on Earth await you. First timers and experienced canyoneers are welcome. From the best food (above or below the rim) to the best equipment, we have you covered. All inclusive ,next level guides, and professional gear ensure your visit to Grand Canyon will be an experience of a lifetime. Let us pick you up at your Northern Arizona hotel and leave the day to us. We will get you that insane holiday photo and you can cross Grand Canyon off the bucket list!
 All hikes are private and tailored to you to make a unforgettable experience. Your guide will explain the history and geology of the canyon while we eat delicious snacks and wonder through the rocks. I take great pride in making sure your adventure will deliver dreams!

experiences.title: Make your own Glass Beads in Sedona
experiences.description: A unique experience for everyone in a state of the art studio. Learn to play with fire and make colorful art that you can wear.

experiences.title: Camelback's Hidden Gems - Hike & Yoga with a View
experiences.description:
Camelback Mountain is one of the most popular hikes in the entire Phoenix area due to its breathtaking views of the valley.

What truly sets our hiking adventures apart is your guide/instructor – a perfect blend of enthusiasm, knowledge & experience (with a mild obsession of nature facts). 

They're not just about showing you the trail; they're about helping you connect with nature, with each other and with your inner warrior. 

Though this can be a challenging hike, those who enjoy a challenge, a sense of adventure or who are looking to add some outdoor fitness to their vacation, bachelorette party, team retreat or unique date, this is the perfect option. 

Combining the endurance and strength needed for hiking plus the stress-relieving, stretching yoga session with a view makes for not only a balanced experience but a memorable one. 

You and your group will you have the most unique photos and you’ll learn a lot about the area while having fun!

experiences.title: Amazing 2-Hour Guided Hiking & Yoga At Papago Park
experiences.description:
While you're in town, it only makes sense to see the beauty surrounding the Phoenix and Scottsdale areas!

We offer a unique way to experience the nature surrounding our cities. I offer yoga classes outdoors at some of the most popular destinations! Each location offers amazing views, trails nearby, and restaurants to fuel up after class. Come explore the beautiful Sonoran Desert. Our hike is a great way to see what the city offers, and our yoga class at the end is the cherry on top! You do not need to have yoga experience for this. I can help all levels feel confident and comfortable!

experiences.title: Easy Desert Hike & Yoga with Stunning Views
experiences.description:
What Makes This Tour Unique:

 Immerse in Papago Park's Beauty: Discover one of Phoenix's most expansive parks, an urban oasis in the Sonoran Desert.

 Unique Scenic Path: Stroll a beginner-friendly, one-mile trail featuring spectacular views and hidden gems.

 Iconic Landmarks: Visit Hole in the Rock, Four Peaks, Hunts Tomb, and spot the Phoenix Zoo along the way, with perfect photo opportunities.

 Local Insight: Learn fascinating facts about the area’s flora, history, and unique geological features from knowledgeable guides.

 Rejuvenating Yoga Finale: Conclude with an all-levels yoga session, soaking in panoramic desert views for the ultimate relaxation.

 Seasonal Experience: Available exclusively from November to April, offering the best weather for desert exploration.

experiences.title: Artisan Bread Baking Class in Phoenix (Star & Braided Loaves)
experiences.description:

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Enriched yeasted dough for versatile breads
- Pull-apart pesto star bread filled with sunflower seed pesto and Pecorino Romano
- Black and white seed braided bread topped with sesame and poppy seeds
- Sunflower seed pesto for dipping or spreading

You’ll learn kneading, shaping, and filling techniques while gaining confidence to recreate these breads at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy as they bake and share their creations in this 2-hour class.

experiences.title: Grand Canyon Private Below the Rim Hiking Tour from Flagstaff

experiences.title: High-End Japanese Sushi Class in Tucson (Includes 5-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Take part in a 5-course sushi-making class in Tucson, hosted through Cozymeal. This 2.5-hour workshop blends traditional and modern Japanese flavors while teaching hands-on rolling techniques.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Dessert: Miso butter cookies

Enjoy your creations in a small-group setting and bring wine or beer to complement the meal.

experiences.title: Exquisite Italian Pasta in Tucson (Includes 5-Course Meal)
experiences.description:

- Main course: Butternut squash ravioli with sage brown butter cream sauce

experiences.title: Private Guided Yoga Session At Papago Park
experiences.description:
While you're in town, it only makes sense to see the beauty surrounding the Phoenix and Scottsdale area! Yoga With April offers a unique way to experience the nature surrounding our cities. 

I offer yoga classes outdoors at some of the most popular desintations! Each location offers amazing views, trails nearby, and restaurants to fuel up after class. Class time(s) range from 6am-7pm. If you're looking for a sunrise or sunset hike, I have you covered!

experiences.title: Quiche Lorraine French Cooking Class in Scottsdale
experiences.description: With the help of a french chef you will be crafting your own Quiche Lorraine. You will be learning how to make the Quiche dough from scratch and choose what are the traditional topping that make the Quiche Lorraine so famous

experiences.title: Scottsdale Horseback Riding and Horse Country Estate Tour
experiences.description: Ride in a lovely Mercedes van or Range Rover to embark on a scenic horseback ride in the Arizona desert, tour a world class horse boarding facility and horse country estates. Please make arrangements for pick you up at your hotel or residence by calling Mercedes Van Tours by Laura Hanson in Arizona

experiences.title: Discover Downtown Phoenix's Best Craft Beer & Hidden Gems
experiences.description:
The Downtown Phoenix Walking Brew Tour offers guests the ultimate small group craft beer experience—on foot! Covering approximately two-thirds of a mile, this guided tour takes you through the heart of Roosevelt Row, where you’ll visit a mix of iconic taprooms and exciting new breweries that are redefining the Phoenix beer scene. Along the way, you’ll enjoy expertly curated beer tastings, insider stories, and plenty of local flavor—all within a fun, easy walking route perfect for groups, date nights, or beer-loving friends.

-Exclusive access to 3 Downtown Phoenix breweries. Skip the lines and maximize the fun.

-Expert guide keeps the energy high with stories, tips, and laughs

-Up to 12 tastings plus a gourmet snack to complement your craft beer journey

-Fun, social, and interactive — a walking adventure full of surprises and flavors

experiences.title: Wine and Cheese Pairing Workshop in Arizona
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in a delightful 90-minute Wine & Cheese Workshop led by a certified sommelier in Arizona. This interactive session features five exquisite wines paired with artisan cheeses, each showcasing the nuances of aging and regional diversity. Discover the art of pairing with wine and food. Ideal for couples, groups, or special occasions, this workshop promises an engaging blend of education and enjoyment.

experiences.title: Glassblowing Experience in Sedona
experiences.description: The Melting Point is a new, state-of-the-art facility featuring a fine art gallery, a lamp working studio and fully equipped hotshop. We eat, sleep, and breath glass, and it's our delight to share this passion with the community. Our staff is as diverse as the beautiful Sedona desert landscape. Coming from a broad range of educational backgrounds, our glassblowers can tell you everything you would ever want to know about the science and art of glass.

experiences.title: PRIVATE Antelope Canyon/Horseshoe Bend Experience
experiences.description:
Why Book With First Class Charter Tours?

We specialize in private experiences designed around you. Unlike crowded bus tours and shared group excursions, you'll enjoy your own vehicle, your own local guide, and the flexibility to explore at a pace that fits your group. With door-to-door pickup, personalized service, and more than 400 five-star reviews, we focus on creating memorable Arizona experiences that are comfortable, informative, and stress-free.

experiences.title: Guided Kayak Adventure on the Verde River
experiences.description:
This scenic Verde River Kayak Adventure is the perfect mix of relaxing, refreshing, and just exciting enough. Paddle a beautiful 3.5 mile stretch of the river with Class I (Beginner) water features, gentle ripples, desert scenery, and plenty of room to enjoy the ride. Our team helps make the experience easy from start to finish, with guided support, river shuttle service, and quality gear included.

This tour typically spends about 2.5 hours on the water. Professional grade soft shell single and tandem kayak options are available. They are great kayaks for families, couples, groups, and first time paddlers. Whether you are visiting from Sedona, staying in Cottonwood, exploring Jerome, or looking for a cooler Arizona adventure, this is one of the best ways to experience the Verde River!

Clarkdale Kayak Company is one of the top rated outdoor experiences in the Verde Valley with a 4.9/5 star rating because of our friendly guides and our well maintained, high quality equipment.

experiences.title: Self-Guided Audio Driving Tour in Grand Canyon South Rim
experiences.description:
Don't miss a thing as this tour takes you on an incredible journey through the Grand Canyon South Rim. 

Along the way you'll be guided to all of the park's famous highlights as well as lessor known gems including an architectural masterpiece and numerous canyon overlooks along a 23-mile scenic drive. 

Download and discover more about the Grand Canyon with fascinating behind-the-scenes stories, local tips and directions play automatically along the route. 

Enjoy the freedom to explore offline at your own pace so you can spend more time at places that interest you, and bypass any that don’t.

✅ Stories, tips and directions play automatically based on your location
✅ Travel at your own pace
✅ Tours work offline using GPS, no cell service or WiFi needed
✅ Save time on trip planning with in-app tips and itineraries
✅ Suggested itineraries & tips for half, full or multi day use
✅ Buy once, use forever! No expiry, includes free updates.

Purchase one tour per vehicle.

experiences.title: Half-Day Lower Salt River Rafting Tour
experiences.description:
Float down the Lower Salt River on a guided flatwater rafting trip and discover a scenic and relaxing desert oasis just outside Phoenix and Scottsdale. Swim, play, or just relax on the river and soak in the scenery. This is a family-friendly activity with options to please everyone. A little paddling is required, but your guide will steer the boat and provide fascinating information about the surrounding Sonoran Desert. A reliable source of water, the Salt River attracts a variety of wildlife, making it common for us to enjoy close encounters with animals in their natural habitat

Tours take about four hours including the drive to/from the river and the duration of the tour. Bottled water and snacks, raft/paddles, a life jacket, dry bags, round-trip transportation and National Forest entry fees are included in this trip. 

Alternative time available, see Sunset tour listing or call our office.

experiences.title: Guided French Crêpes Cooking Class in Scottsdale
experiences.description:
Please before booking read this! Only book for two people or more, I do not accommodate classes for parties of 1, thank you!

Learn & enjoy the traditional art of making crêpes from someone born & raised in France. During our authentic French Crêpe Cooking Class you will have the chance to spend some time with a real French & enjoy the sound of his strong accent! For 1 hour you will learn exactly how to create your own batch of home made crêpe batter from his Scottsdale home. You will have the chance to eat as many crêpes as you wish & we will send you back home with your own batch of batter. We look forward to sharing the culture of both Phoenix & France with you in one relaxing experience

experiences.title: Phoenix Art Heist: Mural Mystery Exploration Game and Tour
experiences.description:
Phoenix explodes with bold color and world-class murals, but someone is turning beauty into chaos. You’re Dynasty Fleck, the city’s most renowned art collector, on the hunt for stolen masterpieces hidden in plain sight.

As you walk through downtown Phoenix, you’ll solve clever puzzles, spot subtle artistic clues, and navigate real murals to expose the forgeries scattered by the elusive thief, Indigo Salazar. Your phone becomes your detective toolkit, guiding you step-by-step through this interactive, story-driven quest.

What makes this tour unique? It transforms Phoenix into a living art gallery, blending storytelling, local culture, and visual exploration into a game you can play at your own pace.

Great for couples, families, and curious minds, this adventure combines art, mystery, and movement, turning every step into part of the story.

experiences.title: French Bistro Cooking Class in Tucson (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Take part in a 3-course French cooking class in Tucson. This 3-hour workshop guides you through bistro classics while practicing timeless techniques.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: French onion soup en croute
- Main course: Sous vide New York strip steak with pommes frites and vegetables
- Dessert: Apple tarte Tatin

Enjoy your creations in a relaxed setting as you learn French methods like caramelization and sous vide. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to share.

experiences.title: Sedona Stargazing Tours LLC
experiences.description:
Sedona Stargazing is a TripAdvisor Hall of Fame company, honored with the prestigious TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence for 18 consecutive years and backed by over 2,000 five-star reviews.

For more than 24 years, our family-owned and operated team has delivered what many guests call the finest stargazing experience in the world. We combine world-class dark skies with state-of-the-art telescopes and an intentionally small-group format — limiting each telescope to just six guests. 

Our professional astronomers are both deeply knowledgeable and engaging, making the universe accessible and exciting for guests of all ages. Using precision green laser pointers, they guide you across the breathtaking Sedona night sky, revealing planets, galaxies, star clusters, nebulae, and the Milky Way in extraordinary detail.

To ensure your comfort under the stars, we provide comfortable chairs, cozy blankets, and warm parka jackets — so you can relax and fully enjoy the wonder above

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Phoenix
experiences.description: Enjoy an evening of sushi in this hands-on cooking class with Chef Greg in Phoenix! This interactive experience will teach you how to create three distinct sushi rolls while sipping on expertly paired wines. Begin by learning the techniques to blacken ahi tuna for a flavorful sushi roll, then roll up a spicy shrimp and cabbage roll for a delicious kick. Finish with a crispy Asian vegetable roll packed with fresh ingredients. With Chef Greg’s expert guidance, you’ll master essential rolling techniques, knife skills, and ingredient pairings. Whether you’re a sushi enthusiast or a first-timer, book your spot today for a unique sushi experience in Phoenix!

experiences.title: A Taste of Tradition the Southwest Green Chile Experience
experiences.description:
Hosting in my home allows me to share not only recipes, but also the stories and hospitality.
I offer small-group, hands-on cooking classes hosted in my home kitchen.
I have years of personal experience cooking traditional Southwestern Spanish home-style dishes, especially green chile–based recipes. I have entered several chili cooking-off competitions and have won first-place awards and overall crowd favorite. My expertise comes from generations of family recipes and hands-on practice, family-style cooking, and hosting others in my home. I focus on practical techniques, safe food handling, and clear instruction so guests of all skill levels can confidently recreate the dish at home.
I have years of experience preparing traditional dishes, especially pork green chile. 
My home is a comfortable, clean, and welcoming private residence with a well-equipped kitchen designed for small-group cooking. The kitchen has ample counter space, seating, and suitable for hands-on instruction.

experiences.title: Chocolate Making Class With a Local Chef in Phoenix
experiences.description: Walk into a relaxed brewery setting and prepare to make the chocolate bar your snack drawer has been waiting for. You’ll begin with milk and white chocolate, learning how to melt and temper each one for a glossy finish and satisfying snap. Once your chocolate is ready, you’ll customize your bar with roasted nuts and dried fruit, playing with contrasting flavors, textures and toppings as you create your own combination. Chef Arbi brings more than 20 years of pastry experience, including training in France and work in kitchens across several countries, while keeping the techniques easy to follow. Finish by decorating your bar, letting it set and enjoying your handiwork. Beginner-friendly, hands-on and delightfully chocolate-heavy, this is one kitchen lesson where nobody minds a little mess.

experiences.title: Handmade Sourdough Pasta Workshop in Scottsdale for up to 10
experiences.description:
Step into a warm, hands-on workshop where sourdough meets pasta in the most delicious way. From flour to fork, you'll craft, cook, and connect in an unforgettable culinary experience.

Sip a welcome drink and taste some sourdough baked good:
Enjoy a refreshing beverage as we get to know each other.

Meet the sourdough starter
Get to know my 19-year-old sourdough starter, the base for our pasta dough — full of history, life, and flavor.

Make the dough
Mix flour, eggs, and sourdough starter as I guide you through the perfect pasta dough texture.

Rest, roll, and shape
Learn how to let the dough rest, then roll it out and shape it into pasta.

Cook and plate
Watch the magic happen as we cook the fresh pasta and prepare a homemade sauce to go with it.

Eat and enjoy
Sit down for a cozy shared meal with the pasta you just made — fresh, flavorful, and deeply satisfying.

Get inspired
Ask questions, learn sourdough tips, and discover how to recreate the experience at home.

experiences.title: Paddles To Pints Kayak the Verde with Drink
experiences.description:
This scenic Verde River Kayak Adventure is the perfect mix of relaxing, refreshing, and just exciting enough. Paddle a beautiful 3.5 mile stretch of the river with Class I (Beginner) water features, gentle ripples, desert scenery, and plenty of room to enjoy the ride. Your team helps make the experience easy from start to finish, with guided support, river shuttle service, and quality gear included.

This tour typically spends about 2.5 hours on the water. Professional grade soft shell single and tandem kayak options are available. They are great kayaks for families, couples, groups, and first time paddlers. Whether you are visiting from Sedona, staying in Cottonwood, exploring Jerome, or looking for a cooler Arizona adventure, this is one of the best ways to experience the Verde River!

This is one of the top rated outdoor experiences in the Verde Valley with a 4.9/5 star rating because of your friendly guides and your well maintained, high quality equipment.

experiences.title: Phoenix Fun Dumpling Making Class at a Local Brewery
experiences.description: Dumplings taste even better when you’ve made every little fold yourself. At a casual Phoenix local venue, you’ll follow step-by-step guidance to prepare homemade Asian dumplings from scratch, starting with the filling and dough before moving into the fun part: folding, pleating and sealing each dumpling by hand. You’ll learn how to handle wrappers without tearing them, portion filling properly and cook your dumplings for delicious texture and flavor. Then comes the best part — sitting back and enjoying the meal you created. The pace is friendly and beginner-focused, so imperfect pleats are completely welcome. Bring your appetite, your curiosity and maybe a little competitive energy; store-bought dumplings are officially on notice.

experiences.title: Private sourdough bread workshop for up to 10 people
experiences.description:
Discover the magic of sourdough in a cozy, hands-on workshop where ancient tradition meets modern charm. Learn, taste, and connect in an unforgettable baking experience.

Sip a welcome drink
Enjoy a refreshing beverage as we get to know each other.

Meet the sourdough starter
Learn about my 19-year-old sourdough starter and how it works.

Mix and feel the dough
Watch and participate as we mix flour, water, and starter to begin the bread-making magic.

Stretch and fold
Try your hand at sourdough folding techniques that build strength and structure.

Shape and prep
Learn how to shape your loaf and place it into a proofing basket.

Taste and learn
Enjoy a tasting of fresh-baked sourdough bread with a selection of dips.

Get inspired
Discover how to bake sourdough at home and troubleshoot common issues.

Take dough home
Leave with your own dough ready to bake and the knowledge to recreate it yourself.

experiences.title: 5-Star PRIVATE LUXURY Sedona Wine Tour
experiences.description:
PRIVATE LUXURY Sedona Wine Trail Tour: Discover and experience the Verde Valley and Sedona vineyards and area interests with our knowledgeable and experienced guides, all in the comfort of your Private Luxury vehicle. Our tours can also be adjusted and customized to your schedule and desires to maximize your enjoyment. Avoid time crunches from non private bus tours by going with Sedona Tours and Transportation, private and customizable.

You can also take in other sights, Jerome, Az, Chapel of the Holy Cross or other iconic landmarks of the Sedona area. Your tour can be improvised and tailored to include as much as you may want to visit, as this is a private tour. 

We create a lasting impact on your Sedona vacation showcasing the beauty and history of Sedona and The Verde Valley Wine Trail

experiences.title: Private Wine Tour, Voted best in town, Tastings Included!
experiences.description: We specialize in creating FUN filled ELEVATED experiences. Our guides pride themselves in making sure you really enjoy your day. On our Sublime Vine Tour your knowledgable guide will show you around the vineyards and will even be your personal photographer for the day. Elevated tours are catered to your tastes and never rushed. If you want to, mix it up with vineyards, breweries or a distillery, the choice is yours. Tours include flights from 3 award winning AVA designated Wineries and or breweries, per person. Our tours are customized to you, so you are in control. All tours are PRIVATE, so once we pick you up we are off to the vineyards. While onboard our vehicle we have plenty of non alcoholic drinks provided. This is one of the best tours you can do in the Sedona area! Our passion is to pamper you and create a memorable day. TRAVELING WITH FIDO? WE ARE PET FRIENDLY! Book now to reserve your next wine tasting tour.

experiences.title: Taste the Southwest: Tucson Chef Led Foodie Tour
experiences.description: Tucson is the 1st city in America named by Unesco as a City of Gastronomy. This walking tour showcases the unique fusion of Southwest flavors that made this designation possible. The walking tour an explosion of flavors and stories told by a professional chef and storyteller.

experiences.title: 2.5 Hour Off-Road Adventure East Rim Grand Canyon No Crowds
experiences.description: Have a scenic peaceful picnic at one of the seven wonders of the world. Tables and chairs are provided and will be set up for you. bring your own food and drinks, water is provided. A professional Navajo guide explains the history of his people and the rock layers of mother earth. Tour areas of the Navajo Nation restricted to the public for a private, peaceful tour with no crowds. Tour location is close to many major attractions such as The Grand Staircase, Lake Powell, Zion, Antelope and Bryce Canyons, Monument Valley, Escalante and many more beautifully scenic areas of the Grand Circle.

experiences.title: Pedal Bar Crawl Tour of Downtown Phoenix
experiences.description: Book up to 14 seats on this two-hour pub crawl of Downtown Phoenix, where your certified party bike pilot will bring you and your merry band of companions to three of our partner bars, where you'll receive exclusive drink specials! And with BYO legal on our pedal pub, all eyes will be on you as you're raising your cans and solo cups while pedaling and partying at the best that Phoenix has to offer!

experiences.title: Phoenix Brewery Tour: 12 Beer Tasters & VIP Access at 3 Breweries
experiences.description: Phoenix's Original Brew Tour offers guests the ultimate way to experience the Valley’s thriving craft beer scene. Sit back and relax as we take you on a guided journey through some of the best breweries in Phoenix, Scottsdale, and Tempe—from longtime local favorites to the newest innovators brewing up bold flavors in the desert. You’ll savor carefully selected tastings, get a behind-the-scenes look at each brewery, and share plenty of laughs—all while traveling comfortably between stops. You'll also enjoy a tasty snack to soak up all those delicious suds. Note: This tour does not include a full meal

experiences.title: Self-Guided Audio Driving Tour in Petrified Forest National Park
experiences.description:
Download GuideAlong’s self-guided audio tour to discover a captivating landscape of otherworldly beauty in Petrified Forest National Park. Along the way, hear stories on the geological wonders and unique sights play automatically as you cruise this ancient world. From petrified logs sparkling with crystalline quartz to the brilliant hues of the Painted Desert’s badlands, there’s breathtaking vistas at every turn. Unearth the park’s incredible history, filled with prehistoric creatures, early human inhabitants and fascinating fossils.

Enjoy the freedom to explore offline at your own pace, spending more time at places that interest you.

Stories, tips, and directions play automatically based on your location
Travel at your own pace
Tour offline using GPS. No cell service or WiFi needed
Suggested itineraries for half, full, or multi-day use
Buy once, use forever! No expiry, includes free updates.
Like having a tour guide along for the drive
Purchase one tour per vehicle.

experiences.title: Spirits With The Spirits, Haunted Pub Crawl Of Downtown Flagstaff
experiences.description:
Experience Flagstaff's haunted history with a drink in your hand. Our Haunted Pub Crawl is Flagstaff’s best night out for groups, date nights, and anyone who thinks a normal bar crawl could use a few ghosts. Led by the same award-winning guides behind Flagstaff’s original ghost tour. 21+ only. Drinks not included in ticket price.

1,000+ five-star reviews. Voted Best of Flagstaff 2023, 2024, and 2025. There’s a reason people keep coming back and a reason certain guests say the ghosts followed them home.

This isn’t a rushed bar crawl with a spooky theme stapled on. Every story comes from co-founder Susan Johnson’s original research, the same historian and author behind Wicked Flagstaff, Haunted Flagstaff, and The Walkup Family Murders. Your guide is a local storyteller, not someone reading from a script. 

We trust our guides to curate the best experience, so bar locations may rotate based on availability. Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks are available at each stop.

experiences.title: Scottsdale Sunset Dinner Tour
experiences.description:
A food tour is the perfect way to explore the culinary scene and history of any city. Let Arizona Food Tours show you the way with our famous Scottsdale Sunset Dinner Tour! 

Locally owned and operated, and recently receiving the USAToday readers choice award as the #5 ranked food tour nationally, we are now celebrating our 18th year as Arizona's original food tour company!!

This guided walking tour takes place at sunset in the "West's Most Western Town", visiting 4 locally owned establishments for a progressive dinner experience with drink pairings! 

We believe there is nothing better than sharing in the experience of delicious food and drinks, by bringing new friends together, while relishing in the culinary wonders of beautiful Scottsdale. Come hungry!

Arizona Food Tours has over 1,300 5-star reviews on Trip Advisor and a 5.0 Google rating. Led by local foodie enthusiasts, we are committed to providing an entertaining, fun, and fulfilling experience for any occasion! Cheers!

experiences.title: Tucson Food Tours Locally Owned Sonoran Flavor Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the bold flavors that define Tucson on our 2.5-hour Sonoran Flavors Food Tour, created for guests who want an authentic taste of the region in less time. This shorter route features 4 locally owned food stops showcasing the dishes, ingredients, and traditions that make Tucson a UNESCO City of Gastronomy. Guests will enjoy handmade tacos, world-famous Sonoran hot dogs, blue corn empanadas, and a refreshing Sonoran raspado—each stop offering a true taste of the region’s culinary heritage. 

Unlike our longer walking routes, this experience includes fewer history pauses, making it perfect for travelers with tight schedules. Your local guide will share insights into the roots of Sonoran cuisine and point out hidden gems along the way, but the heart of this tour is simple: come hungry and savor Tucson’s most iconic flavors in one unforgettable experience.

As for all our tours for the lowest price, book direct on our Tucson Food Tours website!

experiences.title: Halloween Party Bike Bar Crawl in Old Town Scottsdale
experiences.description:
Hop aboard our festively decorated Halloween Party Bike with adult beverages in hand, where your party captain will lead you through a series of spine-tingling bar stops in Old Town Scottsdale, enjoying a lively and boo-zy experience with your friends!

Your ghostly tour includes a thrilling stop at 50 Shades, renowned for their Halloween pop-up experience. Immerse yourself in their haunted ambiance and enjoy the seasonal festivities before hopping back on the party bike and visiting two other decked out Halloween partner bars.

Whether you’re a local or a visitor, the Haunted Pedaler Halloween Party Bike bar crawl in Old Town Scottsdale offers an unforgettable blend of spookiness and fun. Don’t miss your chance to pedal through the paranormal and make this Halloween season one to remember!

experiences.title: Half-Day Arizona Wine Country Tasting Tour
experiences.description: Taking a wine tour from Bisbee or Sierra Vista to Arizona's picturesque wine country of Sonoita-Elgin makes a fantastic day. The tour includes a local expert providing historical and geographic points that highlight the beautiful and unique Sky Islands of the Southwest.
