Continue on to visit three wineries to enjoy flights of wine at each in a setting that is both tranquil and distinctive amid the rolling hill landscape. Your return trip offers new scenery to take in and includes a tour of Bisbee's unique neighborhoods that are often missed. A great addition if you are visiting Bisbee to expand your fun!

experiences.title: Full-Day Grand Canyon Private Tour from Sedona
experiences.description:
We provide private tours of the Grand Canyon South Rim to make this an experience of a lifetime. Guests will travel with our highly knowledgeable tour guides in the privacy of a climate-controlled vehicle. Guests will learn about local flora and fauna, Native American and early european history, and the local geology as they explore the canyon and take in awe-inspiring scenery for breathtaking views and photos while taking the worry of travel out of the equation. Let us do the driving to maximize your experience.
We customize the food and drink to your individual tastes. There is no other tour in the area with as much attention to detail.

experiences.title: Stretch Limo Party Cart - Custom Bar Crawls, Wine Tastings, Night Clubs & More
experiences.description:
Meet your personal Scottsdale Party Cart Captain and hop in our brand new fleet of lifted stretch limo golf carts complete with booming sound systems, LED lights, lift kits & mud tires for the experience of a lifetime! Perfect for bachelorette parties, birthdays, date nights, friends, or any celebration!

Design your own customized bar crawl, from VIP bottle service and nightclubs to romantic wine tastings, tequila flights, and dive bars, Scottsdale Party Cart knows how to party! Feel like a celebrity as your party cart captain and personal chauffeur takes your group on fully customizable night to remember. Your party cart captainn will serve as your personal photographer, food runner, driver, DJ, and and hype man! Experience Scottsdale nightlife, like a true VIP!

experiences.title: Scottsdale Private Food Tour of Hidden Gems with 6 Food Tastings
experiences.description: Join our Food Tours on a food tour through Downtown Scottsdale. You'll dine in a number of locally owned restaurants, trying some of their signature dishes. Learn the story of a city that started with mere citrus grove and became the leading destination for luxury resorts and fine dining. At the end of your Scottsdale food tour, you'll have sampled some of this city’s most unique dishes that shaped the southwest and gained a better understanding of its culture and history.

experiences.title: Sip & Go: 2 Verde Valley Vineyard Wine Tasting w/ Charcuterie
experiences.description:
Explore Verde Valley's exquisite wine country with Sedona's premier wine tour provider but don't have all day? Sedona Vineyard Tours is now offering an express Vineyard tour. Enjoy 3-4 hours of wine tasting at award-winning vineyards, all while soaking in the stunning landscapes of Sedona. This personalized tour features visits to two distinguished vineyards, where you can indulge in a gourmet charcuterie lunch and benefit from exclusive tasting discounts. With expert guides sharing their local wine wisdom, every moment is filled with education and enjoyment. Perfect for both wine aficionados and newcomers, this tour combines luxury transportation with unforgettable experiences.

- 3-4 hours of wine tasting at award-winning Verde Valley vineyards
- Enjoy a gourmet charcuterie lunch and refreshing bottled water
- Expert guides provide insights into local wines and vineyards
- Exclusive discounts on wine tastings at each vineyard visited

experiences.title: Pedal Bar Crawl of Old Town Scottsdale
experiences.description: Book anywhere from one to 14 seats on this two-hour pub crawl of Old Town Scottsdale, where your certified party bike captain will bring you and your merry band of companions to three of our partner bars, where you'll receive exclusive drink specials and cut-the-line access! And with adult beverages legal on our party bike (available at our on-site booze store), all eyes will be on you as you're raising your cans and solo cups while pedaling and partying at the best that Scottsdale has to offer!

experiences.title: Scottsdale's Original Food Tour
experiences.description:
A food tour is the perfect way to explore the history and culinary scene of any city. Let Arizona Food Tours show you the way with our famous "Scottsdale's Original Food Tour"!

Locally owned and operated, and recently receiving the USAToday readers choice award as the #5 ranked food tour nationally, we are now celebrating our 18th year as Arizona's original food tour company!

Offering a BRUNCH TOUR at 9:30am or LUNCH TOUR at 11am or 2:30pm, this walking tour visits 5 locally owned establishments highlighting signature food tastings along with 2 drink pairings.

Arizona Food Tours has over 1,300 5-star reviews on Trip Advisor and a 5.0 Google rating. Led by local foodie enthusiasts, we are committed to providing an entertaining, fun, and fulfilling experience for any occasion! 

We believe that there is nothing better than sharing in the experience of delicious food and drinks, bringing new friends together, while relishing in the culinary wonders of beautiful Scottsdale. Come hungry!

experiences.title: San Francisco Cooking Class: Dumpling Making from Scratch
experiences.description:
Learn how to make your own Shanghaineese dumplings from scratch in this interactive cooking class in the heart of San Francisco. 

Make dumpling dough using Chef Edmund's family recipe, and master the art of folding with precision as you create delicious dumplings filled with your choice of an American Wagyu, local organic pork or tofu stuffing. No pre-made skins will be used and you'll take home a recipe guide at the end.

Afterward, experience umami by tasting Chef's favorite sauces and creating your own secret dumpling dipping sauce. Savor a delicious three-course meal, featuring your handmade dumplings and local ingredients. Perfect for food lovers and those looking to connect over a shared culinary experience.

experiences.title: Charcuterie Board Making (and Eating!) in South Lake Tahoe
experiences.description: If you've ever wanted to be the host or hostess with the mostest and impress your guests with Insta-worthy charcuterie boards and grazing tables, then this is the class for you! If you just want to relax, have fun, chat with a well-traveled Tahoe local and eat delicious charcuterie, then this is also the class for you! I'm happy to accommodate food allergies and custom orders.

experiences.title: Easy and Elegant French Cooking Class with Wine near Laguna Beach
experiences.description: Experience a unique French-Californian cooking class in a stunning Southern California coastal home with Ann and Rick. This warm, food-loving couple brings a wealth of culinary knowledge from travels and training, blending classic French techniques with fresh Californian produce. Savor the joy of cooking and dining with locals who love to entertain in style, just minutes from the Ritz Carlton and Waldorf Astoria in Dana Point.

experiences.title: Food, History, and Resistance: A Self-Guided Audio Tour
experiences.description:
Explore San Francisco's historic Japantown at your own pace on this self-guided audio tour. Japanese-American local Kristin Eriko Posner will guide you through the neighborhood, sharing little-known stories on how history shaped the food, culture, and landscape of the oldest Japantown in the U.S. This geo-tagged audio tour is best between 10:30am - 3:30pm on Wednesday-Saturdays, when all of the businesses on the tour are open. However, it can be taken at any time, on any day. Most stops are open until 6pm.

The tour is ready whenever you are and the audio plays automatically at exactly the right time and place using your smartphone's GPS and the VoiceMap mobile app, which also works offline.

experiences.title: Private Palm Springs Cooking Class with Chef Stephen in La Quinta
experiences.description: Join your host in their Coachella Valley home for a cooking class and in-home dining experience. Learn about life in the Coachella Valley and enjoy cuisine that reflects a mix of cultures as you cook delightful Southwestern recipes and eat a delicious meal prepared by a trained chef over wine or beer. Leave with new recipes, friends, and lifelong memories.

experiences.title: Best Italian Pasta Class in Los Angeles (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the art of pasta-making in an intimate Los Angeles kitchen guided by a top-rated chef. Limited to a small group, this class blends approachable recipes with authentic Italian techniques.

The menu you will prepare includes:
- Chef-prepared appetizer
- Handmade spaghetti and fettuccine with sauce pairings such as ragù, tomato, mushroom-sausage or sautéed vegetables
- Chef-prepared dessert celebrating Italian traditions

With hands-on guidance, you’ll knead, roll and shape pasta while exploring both classic and seasonal flavors.

experiences.title: Asian-European Fusion Class in San Francisco (With 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a San Francisco kitchen and explore the fusion of Asian and European cuisines, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, this hands-on class with an esteemed fusion chef highlights bold flavors, creative plating and seasonal ingredients.

The menu includes:

- Starter: Bamboo dumplings with dipping sauces
- Main: Philippine chicken adobo with garlic, soy and vinegar
- Fusion dish: rotating options like garlic noodles with sausage or noodle soup with bok choy
- Side: Basmati rice, saffron risi e bisi or garlic rice
- Dessert: Caramelized fruits with ice cream and citrus zest

Learn dumpling-making, simmering and plating skills for restaurant-quality results. With its small-group format and relaxed setting, this workshop is ideal for couples, friends or anyone eager to explore fusion cuisine.

experiences.title: Private Cooking Demonstration of Indian Fusion Cuisine in San Diego
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private and authentic cooking class in a local home with host Nenu, an avid traveler and a self-taught cook. This is a perfect experience for anyone looking to connect with local culture over food. Your cooking demonstration will take place in a local home kitchen where Nenu will teach you how to make 2-3 traditional Indian fusion dishes from her family recipes that she puts her unique twist on. After cooking, you will enjoy your meal together in your host's beautiful Californian home.

• Cooking demonstration in a local Californian home
• Introduction to American culture and Indian-inspired cuisine
• 100% private activity
• Experience Indian-American hospitality in a Del Sur neighborhood residence
• Vegetarian and vegan options available

experiences.title: Seafood Sushi-Making Class in San Jose (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Immerse yourself in Japanese culinary traditions with a hands-on sushi class in San Jose, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to a small group, this workshop with an esteemed sushi chef teaches you the essentials of seafood sushi-making.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Spicy sesame edamame
- Sushi rice preparation for rolling and shaping
- California roll with real crab, cucumber and avocado
- Spicy tuna roll with sriracha and fresh tuna
- Nigiri with shrimp, tuna or eel (market availability)

Learn knife techniques, rice preparation and plating while creating a complete sushi menu in an intimate, interactive setting.

experiences.title: Italian Pasta Making Class in Southeastern Sacramento (4-Course)
experiences.description:
Experience authentic Italian cooking in Southeastern Sacramento with this hands-on 4-course pasta-making class, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, this intimate workshop explores fresh flavors and traditional methods.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Lightly fried vegetables with spicy lemon aioli
- Fresh citrus salad
- Handmade pasta with Calabrian chile tomato sauce
- Classic tiramisu

Over 3 hours, you’ll practice pasta-making techniques, sauce preparation and plating skills, leaving with recipes and confidence to recreate these dishes at home.

experiences.title: Thai Cooking Class in Southeastern Sacramento (4-Course Menu)
experiences.description:
Immerse yourself in the vibrant flavors of Thailand in this interactive 4-course cooking class in Southeastern Sacramento, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, this workshop blends traditional Thai ingredients with practical cooking skills.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Green papaya salad
- Green curry
- Chicken and shrimp pad Thai
- Mango sticky rice

In 2.5 hours, you’ll learn techniques for balancing sweet, sour, salty and spicy flavors while mastering essentials like lemongrass, galangal, tamarind and palm sugar.

experiences.title: The Escape Game LA: Epic 60-Minute Adventures in Century City
experiences.description:
The Escape Game LA is located at Westfield Century City in Los Angeles, conveniently close to shopping, entertainment, and delicious dining options. Our top recommendations for a meal before your game are Tocoya Modern Mexican, Eataly, and Ramen Nagi. Of course, no night out in Hollywood would be complete without some dessert. We suggest getting boba at Wushiland!

The Escape Game LA features 4 one-of-a-kind escape rooms, including one of our newest games, The Depths. Each immersive escape room holds up to 8 players.

These adventures offer a one-of-a-kind premium experience. Follow clues and solve puzzles to complete your mission together. We offer the best escape rooms and the fastest customer support. Come see why our escape rooms win awards.

experiences.title: The Escape Game at Westfield UTC in San Diego
experiences.description: Our San Diego location is at Westfield UTC, close to a vibrant selection of dining and retail options. This is the perfect spot to escape with friends or family before then grabbing a bite to eat! Nearby food and drink spots include Eureka, Blue Ocean Sushi and Grill, Quin West Noodle, and Bazille.

experiences.title: Thai Cooking Class in Monterey
experiences.description:
The ONLY Thai cooking class in Monterey!
Fun & Tasty Party + Memorable Experience
Plan your special holidays, surprise date night, birthday, bachelorette parties, company retreat, team building and family reunion events with Thai cooking class or just want to have fun learning about Thai cuisine.

Tantalizing Thai food--Learn how to cook delicious and nutritious meals in no time!

The class can be held with two people but expand up to six. It is a fun activity for everyone. We operate rain or shine!

The class begins with learning the basics of Thai herbs and spices and what utensil and ingredients are typically found in a Thai kitchen. We will cover a wide assortment of famous Thai recipes and then proceed to learn to cook two of them and of course, enjoy dining together.

experiences.title: Macaron making with a Master Chef - Carmel-by-the-Sea, CA
experiences.description: You will be baking macarons with a macaron master who has been featured on the Cooking Channel. You will receive hands-on training and all the techniques, tips and tricks to create these gourmet treats at home!

experiences.title: Farmers Market Tour & Hands-On Cooking Class in Long Beach
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private and authentic market tour and cooking class in a local home with host BA, a public health professional. BA is a passionate home cook and baker, who loves trying new and healthy recipes. She is well travelled and has lived in a few cities, so she loves mixing international flavors with local, seasonal produce. Also, accommodating dietary needs is her specialty! As she is lactose-free, her son is vegetarian, and many of her friends are gluten free.

Buy fresh, seasonal produce at the market and then join BA in her home kitchen for a 2 hour hands-on cooking class. After you cook, join BA and her sons (if they are home) at the dining table to relish the meal you helped prepare. 

• Guided visit of a local Farmer’s Market in Long Beach, CA
• Hands-on cooking class in a local's home in Long Beach, CA
• Introduction to American culture and cuisine
• 100% private activity
• Experience a farm to table experience
• Lactose free, gluten free, vegetarian and vegan options available

experiences.title: Make your own Chocolate Bars & Chocolate Box
experiences.description: Here at Menchaca Chocolates we'd like to think we are adventurers continuing to re-define an ancient Pod found 150 miles from the equator. So we decided that to truly understand this magical bean you have to experience it through all your senses: taste, touch, smell, cracking and visual transformation. We developed these Chocolate & Art Workshops to do just that. You will get to know the possibilities and have a chance to make a custom unique Chocolate product and if you choose, design a label or Box to package it in. You can also learn exactly how we make our chocolate in Mr. Menchaca's Micro- batch Chocolate Factory Tour!

experiences.title: The Escape Game San Jose: Epic 60-Minute Adventure at Valley Fair
experiences.description:
The Escape Game San Jose is located at Westfield Valley Fair, right in the heart of Silicon Valley and nearby various shopping, entertainment, and delicious dining options. Our fave places to grab a bite pre- or post-game include The Cheesecake Factory, Ramen Nagi, and Shake Shack. We highly recommend celebrating an escape room win with ice cream from Gelato by Patrizia!

The Escape Game San Jose features six completely unique escape rooms, including one of our newest games, The Depths. Each immersive escape room holds up to 8 players.

These adventures offer a one-of-a-kind premium experience. Follow clues and solve puzzles to complete your mission together. We offer the best escape rooms and the fastest customer support. Come see why our escape rooms win awards.

experiences.title: Biryani and South Indian Classics Cooking Class
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant world of South Indian cuisine with Chef Rajeswari in this engaging cooking class. Learn to create iconic dishes such as the spicy Chicken 65 and aromatic Chicken Biryani, layered with fragrant spices and herbs. This hands-on experience allows you to participate in the cooking process, making delicious accompaniments like refreshing cucumber raita and sweet mango lassi. Share the joy of cooking and savor the flavors of India, all while enjoying the warmth of Chef Rajeswari's hospitality in a communal kitchen setting.

experiences.title: Chicken Curry Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Sacramento
experiences.description:
Discover how to balance sweet, savory and spice in a comforting Thai classic.

In this interactive class, Chef Lina breaks down the essential techniques behind restaurant-quality Thai chicken yellow curry. Start by learning how to properly bloom curry paste and build layers of flavor before adding chicken, potatoes, carrots and onion. Then, stir in creamy coconut milk and adjust the seasoning with palm sugar and fish sauce for perfect harmony.

As your curry develops depth, prepare jasmine rice to complement the bold sauce. Chef Lina offers personalized guidance throughout, ensuring you leave confident recreating this vibrant dish at home.

With hands-on instruction, premium ingredients and a full meal included, this Sacramento cooking experience delivers both technique and unforgettable flavor in every bite.

experiences.title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With a Local Chef in the Bay Area
experiences.description:
Turn a viral dessert into a skill you can recreate anytime.

In this interactive class booked through Classpop!, Chef Rajeswari walks you step by step through making Dubai-style chocolate bars from scratch. Start by tempering chocolate, learning how temperature control creates a smooth, glossy finish and clean snap.

Then mix pistachio cream with crispy kataifi to build a filling that combines creamy and crunchy textures. Assemble and mold your bars with guidance from Chef Rajeswari, picking up practical tips on structure, flavor balance and presentation.

Set in a lively Bay Area venue, this experience is perfect for anyone looking to try something creative and delicious. Leave with your handcrafted chocolate bars and the confidence to make them again at home.

experiences.title: Fun Cupcake Decorating Class With a Local Chef in Sacramento
experiences.description:
Step into a world of color, creativity and buttercream bliss in Sacramento.

This hands-on cake decorating class with Chef Birdie transforms a simple mini cake into your own frosted showpiece. You’ll begin with a behind-the-scenes look at how to make rich, fluffy buttercream frosting using heavy cream, powdered sugar, vanilla and just the right pinch of salt. Chef Birdie shares practical tips for achieving smooth texture and stable structure — secrets that elevate your cakes at home.

Next, it’s time to decorate. Using pre-baked mini cakes, you’ll practice crumb coating, piping and layering techniques before finishing with bright sprinkles, playful candies and eye-catching designs. Throughout the session, you’ll receive personal guidance in a relaxed, social setting at a trendy local venue in Sacramento. All ingredients, tools and your completed cake are included, making this creative experience both delicious and confidence-boosting.

experiences.title: Fun Gnocchi Making Class With Local Chef in Sacramento
experiences.description:
Think gnocchi is too complicated to make at home? Think again. In this interactive class with Chef Maggie, you’ll master the Roman-born pasta that’s low-cost, filling and endlessly satisfying. Start with potatoes, flour and a pinch of seasoning to form a soft dough, then roll and cut it into delicate dumplings. As they cook, whip up one of two classic sauces: a nutty basil pesto with Parmesan or a rustic marinara with tomato, onions and peppers. Chef Maggie makes the process approachable and fun, so you’ll leave with the confidence to add homemade gnocchi to your weekly dinner rotation — no restaurant required.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Fun Pad Thai Cooking Class With a Local Chef in San Diego
experiences.description: Good news: pad Thai is not nearly as complicated as your takeout habit has led you to believe. Better news: Chef Krong is about to prove it in the most delicious way possible. In this fun, beginner-friendly cooking class you will learn to make Thailand's national dish from scratch, the whole thing, start to finish, with rice noodles, tofu, bean sprouts, cilantro and lime coming together into something that tastes like it took way more effort than it actually did. Chef Krong walks you through every step with the kind of enthusiasm that makes you wonder why you waited this long to learn. By the time you plate up your finished pad Thai you will be equal parts proud, full and slightly annoyed at every mediocre takeout order you ever settled for. San Diego deserves better. So do you.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Local Bar in San Diego
experiences.description: Transform your culinary skills in this hands-on pasta-making class at a trendy local bar, led by a talented local chef. You’ll mix, knead and roll fresh fettuccine from scratch while learning the secrets behind authentic Italian flavors. Then, whip up a bold marinara sauce with tomatoes, garlic, and a hint of Calabrian chile pepper to perfectly complement your handmade noodles. With craft beer flowing and good company all around, this flavorful experience blends technique, taste, and a fun night out you won’t forget.

experiences.title: Fun Ramen Making Class With a Local Chef in Sacramento
experiences.description:
Forget sad instant noodles. You’re making a ramen bowl with serious personality. At an easygoing local venue, you’ll learn how simple ingredients can become a rich, aromatic meal packed with umami, crunch and a little chili-fueled attitude.

Begin with a vegetable broth featuring miso, ginger, garlic and mushrooms, learning how to layer flavors and create a satisfying base. Then sharpen your knife skills while prepping mushrooms, cabbage, carrots and scallions. Build your bowl with ramen noodles and finish it with sprouts, mint, soy sauce, sesame oil and chili crisp, adding contrasting textures and flavors with every topping. You’ll learn useful cooking techniques while keeping the pace relaxed and beginner-friendly. Whether you’re a longtime ramen fan or simply hungry for something different, you’ll finish with a steaming homemade bowl and skills worth bringing back to your own kitchen.

experiences.title: Fun Wonton Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Sacramento
experiences.description:
This hands-on cooking class with Chef Lina transforms simple ingredients into a restaurant-worthy bowl of wonton noodle soup. You’ll begin by preparing a savory pork filling, blending Chinese seasonings for depth and balance. Then, learn the proper folding technique to seal delicate wontons into neat, flavorful parcels.

As your dumplings rest, you’ll build a fragrant broth and prepare fresh components including egg noodles, bok choy and julienned carrots. Chef Lina walks you step-by-step through timing and assembly, showing you how to layer textures for a vibrant, nourishing finish. Finally, simmer your wontons to tender perfection and ladle everything together into a steaming bowl.

Hosted at a trendy Sacramento venue, this beginner-friendly experience includes all ingredients, professional tools and a complete meal you’ll prepare and enjoy yourself.

experiences.title: Hillcrest: LGBTQ+ Pub Crawl with Local Drag Queen
experiences.description:
Explore the diverse and colorful sites of Hillcrest, home of San Diego’s largest LGBTQ community, on a hosted walking bar hopping experience.

Unlock the ultimate Hillcrest experience with a bar crawl. Join the only bar crawl in town and enjoy free entrance and discounts to bars and clubs, VIP experiences, and shots. Meet new people and make the most of your time in San Diego.

Start your night with an exclusive pre-party at our local bar. Meet your queens and get ready for a night of fun. Enjoy 5 venues, shots, and VIP entrances, and a pre-drink ticketed event.

Head to 1010 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92103 (University Ave & 10th Ave). You will find us in the courtyard area between Ike´s Place and Nishiki Ramen.

Get free entrance all night long and enjoy a free shots start your night. Get access to the biggest club in town and party until the early hours of the morning.

experiences.title: Japanese Gyoza Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in LA
experiences.description:
You walk into a laid-back South Bay brewery expecting a drink, but end up learning to build little pockets of flavor from scratch. Chef Darren keeps things fun and simple enough that you don’t overthink a single fold.

You start with the filling: ground pork, cabbage, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onion, mixed until it already smells like you know what you’re doing. Then you move into assembly, spooning filling into gyoza wrappers and learning the pleat-and-seal technique. It’s easier than it looks, addictive, and you get better with every dumpling.

Next, you pan-fry your gyoza until the bottoms turn crispy and golden, then splash in water to steam them until tender inside. While they cook, you whisk a dipping sauce of soy, rice vinegar, and chili oil that pulls everything into a sharp, addictive bite.

It’s relaxed, social, and a little messy in the best way. You’re in a brewery, folding dumplings, thinking… yeah, store-bought gyoza is officially on notice.

experiences.title: Make Japanese Sushi at a Local Venue in Los Angeles
experiences.description: Roll with it in this unforgettable sushi fusion class at a local Los Angeles venue with Chef Cici, You’ll get hands-on as you learn the art of sushi-making, starting with perfecting seasoned rice and mastering those iconic nori wraps. Then, create two flavor-packed rolls: a classic crab roll with avocado and fish roe, and a crispy sweet potato roll with cream cheese and avocado for the ultimate sweet-savory combo. Whether you're a sushi-rolling pro or a curious first-timer, this relaxed, beginner-friendly class serves up good vibes, great bites and maybe even your new favorite roll.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Local Brewery in San Diego
experiences.description:
Put down the boxed pasta and get your hands into the dough. At a laid-back local brewery in San Diego, you’ll learn the satisfying basics of handmade Italian pasta while enjoying a relaxed setting where you can bring beer or wine to sip along the way.

Begin with flour, eggs and extra virgin olive oil, mixing and kneading until you have a smooth pasta dough. You’ll learn how to roll the dough thin and cut it into fettuccine, building practical techniques you can recreate at home. Then turn your attention to fresh marinara, combining canned tomatoes, garlic and dried Italian seasoning into a rich, savory sauce. Toss the freshly made noodles with the sauce and dig into your finished meal while the satisfaction of making pasta from scratch sinks in. With Chef Adriana’s 18 years in the culinary industry behind the instruction, the class stays approachable, hands-on and genuinely fun!

experiences.title: Private Cooking or Baking Class with a Cordon Bleu Chef
experiences.description: Cook alongside Nicole, a vibrant Le Cordon Bleu-trained chef with 15+ years of experience in French and Italian cuisine, and a personal chef to LA’s elite. In her welcoming home kitchen, you’ll learn hands-on techniques for preparing Mediterranean-inspired dishes—or opt for a baking class featuring scones and macarons. Whether you’re searing steak, perfecting vinaigrette, or mastering delicate macarons, Nicole shares expert tips and warm hospitality. Enjoy your meal with wine or beer, and leave with new skills and unforgettable memories. Vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and lactose-free diets are all welcome—just note preferences when booking!

experiences.title: Rainbow Pasta Making Class in Sacramento
experiences.description:
This is not your average pasta night. In this playful cooking class with Chef Maggie, you’ll make fresh rainbow pasta from scratch at a stylish local venue in Sacramento. It’s colorful, hands-on and much more exciting than opening another box of noodles.

Start by mixing pasta dough with flour and olive oil before creating natural colors with turmeric for orange, spinach for green and beets for magenta pink. Chef Maggie will teach you how to knead, roll and cut the dough into ribbons before cooking it to tender perfection. While the pasta boils, you’ll make a bright farm-fresh tomato sauce with garlic, basil, olive oil and Parmesan. By the end, you’ll sit down to enjoy a homemade rainbow pasta feast that tastes as good as it looks.

experiences.title: Sophisticated Sushi Cooking Class
experiences.description: This immersive sushi experience celebrates where tradition meets innovation. Guided by your host, you’ll dive into the fundamentals of authentic sushi-making while exploring the fresh, vibrant ingredients that define California cuisine. Together, you’ll craft beloved West Coast–style rolls that respect Japanese roots while embracing California’s adventurous palate.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in San Diego
experiences.description: This beginner-friendly sushi class at a local brewery offers a unique blend of hands-on learning and laid-back fun. You'll kick things off by prepping perfectly seasoned sushi rice, then dive into rolling a classic California roll with crab, avocado, cucumber, rice, and scallions. After mastering your roll, you’ll switch things up with a refreshing cucumber and ginger Oriental salad dressed in tangy ponzu — the perfect light and zesty side. Guided by a professional chef, you'll learn sushi-making techniques in a relaxed setting surrounded by the casual buzz of a brewery. Expect plenty of laughs, opportunities to get creative with your plating, and the chance to sip a local craft brew while you work. Whether you're flying solo, coming with friends, or planning a date night, this class delivers a memorable experience full of flavor, connection, and culinary inspiration.

experiences.title: Vegan Italian Cooking Class in San Diego Cucina Migrante
experiences.description: An evening cooking class invites culinary enthusiasts to create authentic vegan Italian dishes from scratch. Collaborate with skilled chefs as you dive into a custom menu curated to fit your dietary preferences. Start with delicious vegan appetizers and chef bites, then work together to craft two seasonal main dishes before indulging in a signature dessert. Welcome drinks set the tone for a relaxed communal dining experience where you'll enjoy the fruits of your labor with fellow food lovers.

experiences.title: Beverly Hills Food Tour with Gourmet Tastings and Drinks
experiences.description: You don’t need to be a tourist to enjoy this exclusive glimpse of Beverly Hills. Whether you are from Tokyo, Nashville or even nearby West Hollywood, you’ll savor our highly curated experience through private rooms and secret bars. Over 3.5 hours, 4 generous food tastings, and 2 adult beverages, you’ll walk, wine & dine like the locals in cinematic settings from "Beverly Hills Cop" to "Pretty Woman" and enjoy unique access t9 world famous Rodeo Drive. Come for the food, savor the experience!

experiences.title: Los Angeles Walking Food Tour with Six Taste
experiences.description: We are the only local LA family-owned food tour business. We curated the original Downtown LA food tour back in 2009. A fun, passionate, and knowledgeable LA native will be your tour guide and fellow foodie friend for 3.5 hours as she/he takes you through LA's oldest public open-air market for delicious tastings at two of our favorite food stalls. Then, you will head out to historic Broadway for some incredible sightseeing of hidden landmarks such as the Bradbury Building before entering a gorgeous Italian osteria for a lovely sit-down feast of homemade pastas. Guests continue to eat their way through LA with a stop at the Last Bookstore before chowing down on some tacos and then finishing up with a decadent dessert. Guests will visit a total of 5 local eateries with tastings equivalent to a full meal, walk and sightsee around Downtown LA, receive a free tote bag for leftovers or shopping, and bond through this unique and authentic food tour experience.

experiences.title: Venice Beach LA Food Tour
experiences.description:
See and taste the best that Venice Beach has to offer on a one-of-a-kind Sidewalk Food Tour!

Our food tour includes five unique stops showcasing the best of the neighborhood’s renowned food scene. Our expert guides have done extensive (and delicious!) research to offer you the ultimate tasting tour of the Venice neighborhood of Los Angeles.

Sidewalk Food Tours is built on a deep love of food, history, and the unique stories of different neighborhoods within each city in which we offer tours. You’ll feel as if you’re exploring the city with a close friend who wants to show you all their favorite local spots.

We look forward to having you join us on a Sidewalk Food Tour of Venice and can’t wait to show you the sights!

Buen Provecho!

experiences.title: An Art Walk Through the Barrio
experiences.description:
Discover the neighborhood of Barrio Logan, the hidden gem of San Diego, while eating and drinking your way through one of San Diego’s best kept secrets. In between tastings your local tour guide will give you a chance to explore a neighborhood that is loaded with incredible street art, one of a kind boutique shops and some of the best food and drinks in San Diego. It’s time to eat some killer food and understand the foundation of San Diego. 

-Discover the eclectic variety of food and drinks and art in the Barrio Logan area 

-4 Tastings at some of Barrio Logan’s best restaurants 

-Alcoholic drink pairings 

-Local Tour Guide

-Explore the largest collection of Chicano murals in the world

-Learn about the history of this epicenter of Mexican American Culture 

-Visit local art galleries and boutique shops

-Immerse yourself in a world of creative energy 

-No tours are the same

experiences.title: Chocolates and Cheers Chocolate Making and Optional Wine Tasting
experiences.description:
Indulge in a delightful chocolate-making with an optional wine or craft beer tasting at The Wine Experience on Cannery Row, Monterey. Under the guidance of Carrie Griffin, a seasoned wine curator turned chocolate enthusiast, learn to temper chocolate, craft truffle shells, and fill them with smooth ganache. This two-hour hands-on class ensures you leave with a beautiful box of your own decadent creations, perfect for sharing or indulging yourself. Whether it’s a romantic date night or a fun outing with friends, this experience is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth.

Two-hour chocolate truffle-making class at Cannery Row
Optional tastings of four Central Coast wines or craft beers
Led by Carrie Griffin, a passionate host with years of wine expertise
Group sizes up to 10, perfect for couples, friends, and private parties

experiences.title: San Diego Gaslamp Quarter Walking Food Tour
experiences.description: This tour takes you on a mouthwatering journey through San Diego's diverse food scene, from crispy fish tacos and authentic Baja-style tacos to a classic California burger loaded with fresh, local produce. Finish things off with a scoop of handcrafted ice cream from a beloved neighborhood shop. Each stop reveals the flavors and stories that make San Diego's culinary culture so unique. Please note that food offerings are subject to change based on restaurant availability.

experiences.title: Santa Ynez Valley Biking and Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Experience Santa Ynez Valley Wine Country in a truly immersive way.  Pedal comfortably on a Rad Power E-bike or challenge yourself on the hills with a Poseidon sport bike through quaint  farms, idyllic Valley towns and stunning vineyards. Enjoy the fruits of those vineyards upon completing the course with two thoughtfully selected tastings at the featured wineries.  Accompanying your estate winery experience is a locally sourced gourmet picnic lunch. . 
 • Two wine tastings and olive oil tasting are truly representative of the region from venerable local producers.  Your guide has over 20 years of sommelier level wine experience. 
 • The wine country picnic is thoughtfully presented and a perfect pairing to the local wines.

experiences.title: San Francisco Whiskey Cocktail Class with Bay Views | Gold Bar
experiences.description:
This experience blends hands-on mixology, local history, and iconic Bay Area views into one memorable San Francisco outing.

Hosted inside a historic 1930s Art Deco distillery on Treasure Island, guests enjoy sweeping views of the Bay while learning the craft behind classic whiskey cocktails.

During the class, guests shake and stir three iconic drinks — the Old Fashioned, Whiskey Sour, and Paper Plane, while discovering how different whiskeys shape flavor, balance, and aroma.

One of the moments guests love most is tasting the first cocktail they’ve made themselves. Even those who say they “don’t usually drink whiskey” are often surprised by how approachable and delicious it can be.

Getting here is easy, including a scenic six-minute ferry ride from the San Francisco Ferry Building.

Gold Bar Whiskey is the Official Whiskey of the San Francisco 49ers.

experiences.title: #1 Sonoma Walking Food, Wine Tasting & History Tour (Public Tour)
experiences.description:
Discover the best of Sonoma on this award-winning small-group food, wine, and history tour through the iconic Sonoma Plaza. Skip the crowded bus tours and experience Sonoma like a local as you explore the town’s vibrant culinary scene, historic landmarks, and charming architecture on a guided walking tour designed for food and wine lovers.

The Sonoma Food Tour is a 3-hour immersive tasting experience that combines local cuisine, wine tasting, cocktails, and Sonoma history into one unforgettable afternoon. Stroll approximately 1 mile through the historic Sonoma Plaza while enjoying a progressive lunch featuring hand-selected tastings from locally owned restaurants, specialty food shops, and artisan producers.

Enjoy California Mexican cuisine, artisan cheeses, olive oils, handcrafted chocolates, ice cream, one curated wine tasting, one seasonal cocktail. All food, beverages and guide services are included in the tour price — there are no hidden fees or additional tasting charges.

experiences.title: Healdsburg Small-Group Food and Wine Walking Tour
experiences.description: Discover what makes Healdsburg one of Sonoma County's hottest destinations on this 3.5-hour food and wine walking tour of Healdsburg. Your local guide will share great food, wine, and a cocktail as you dine through this chic wine country town. You'll get an insider's view of this top foodie destination, eat at well-loved restaurants, and meet local artisans and winemakers along the way. Learn about Healdsburg's rich history and enjoy the gourmet side of this top foodie town as you indulge in delicious food and wine, much of which is local and organic. It’s the perfect way to enjoy a wine country culinary experience.

experiences.title: Taste of Little Italy in San Diego
experiences.description: During this tour, you will learn about the rich history, culture, and architecture of the area from one of our highly trained guides throughout the way. Taste samples and enjoy specially created dishes at locally owned restaurants. The tour lasts 3 hours long.

experiences.title: Midtown Sacramento Arts and Food Tour
experiences.description:
Known for its art, each wall in Midtown tells a story.

Midtown Sacramento is a most vibrant part of the city! Among other things, tour guests will learn the intriguing history of murals in the city, while experiencing Sacramento’s current art scene. Guests will also try dishes from some of midtown’s finest menus, in an area of the city that has exploded with restaurants in recent years.

Along the way, we’ll pop into venues with farm-to-fork ingredients and farm-to-glass libations, all sure to tantalize your palate while filling your belly. Our culinary concierge will guide the group in and out of eateries while pointing out the sights and sounds of midtown in between.

Local Roots Food Tours limits the group size of each tour to no more than 14 individuals. Special dietary needs can be met with prior notice. Senior, military, and children discounts are available.

experiences.title: Downtown Food and Drink Tour: Libations on the East Side
experiences.description:
Discover San Diego’s most evolving foodie neighborhood the East Village. Previously a warehouse district, the East Village is now home to an array of eclectic eateries, award winning restaurants, breweries, and cocktail bars. Now bordered by the bay and unified by the famous Petco Park the East Village is becoming one of the best neighborhoods for worldwide local cuisine. Throughout this tour you will learn about the evolution of San Diego’s culinary underground and how an area loaded with warehouses and factories like Wonderbread became the “new downtown” in San Diego, while eating and drinking some of the best booze, food, and brews San Diego has to offer. 

-Walk into 4-5 local restaurants, cocktail bars, and breweries

-Eat an eclectic variety of cuisine from award winning michelin restaurants, cocktail bars and unique breweries

-Sip on multiple libations 

-Local Tour Guide 

-Learn how an area filled with warehouses and factories turned into the hot spot for local eateries

experiences.title: The Ultimate LA and Hollywood Photo Tour
experiences.description:
We will see & photograph the highlights of LA & Hollywood, old & new, with some unique twists not offered on any other tour! I'll help you get amazing, personalized, & shareable photos of a lifetime!

We start & end the tour in the heart of Hollywood by the Dolby Theater, Chinese Theater, & Hollywood Walk of Fame. Then you'll get to explore & strike your own pose at the incredible public art, including "Angel Wings". You get to be a star in Beverly Hills at its sign & world-famous palm-lined streets. We'll visit the historical foodie destination that is the LA Farmers Market. Traveling past famous movie studios, we'll go to the BEST PLACE FOR PHOTOS of the iconic HOLLYWOOD SIGN. Bring out your creative side & make this a day you'll never forget!

Private transportation is provided from start to finish.

Please CONTACT ME if you want to arrange a different date or time than posted or have a larger group, & I'll make it happen!

experiences.title: Metal Embossing Class in Estes Park
experiences.description: This project is a fun introduction into the many different uses for metal as an art medium. It's an usual project, but a lot of fun!

experiences.title: Ultimate Chocolate Experience
experiences.description: Start with our proprietary blend of chocolate and signature confections then specialize them to your group's tastes, preferences and allergies to take home your own hand crafted delights.

experiences.title: Tie-Dye Art Class in Estes Park
experiences.description: This awesome throw-back art form is sure to bring out the kid in everyone! Participants leave with a t-shirt, longsleeve, or apron that is dyed and ready to be washed out and worn. The shirt comes with wash & care instructions. Create a shirt as unique as you are!

experiences.title: Kayak Gorgeous Upper Colorado River - half day
experiences.description:
This section of the Colorado River offers scenic views including meadows, valleys, rolling ranch lands, and steep canyon walls, and wildlife including bald eagles, deer, beavers, and big horn sheep - always something to see. 

You can paddle to a sandy shore to greet families of geese, to the edges of huge cliffs, or around smaller obstacles, wherever your curiosity takes you. Go double with a friend, or enjoy solitude in a single-person ducky.

Upper Colorado River Rafting provides mild Class I-II rapids and occasional Class III rapids at higher water flow. If big, exciting water is what your group is looking for, then the high-water season is the best time to come. Mid-June to early July is traditionally the high-water season. When rivers run at their peak, it can make for a big ride. Pick a big line or choose to skirt it in your own ducky!

experiences.title: Inflatable Kayak Adventure Colorado River: Half Day Guided Tour
experiences.description:
This section of the Colorado River offers scenic views including meadows, valleys, rolling ranch lands, and steep canyon walls, and wildlife including bald eagles, deer, beavers, and big horn sheep - always something to see. 

You can paddle to a sandy shore to greet families of geese, to the edges of huge cliffs, or around smaller obstacles, wherever your curiosity takes you. Go double with a friend, or enjoy solitude in a single-person ducky.

Upper Colorado River Rafting provides mild Class I-II rapids and occasional Class III rapids at higher water flow. If exciting water is what your group is looking for, then early summer is the best time to come. Some years the river is a gorgeous winding float. When rivers run at their peak, it can make for a big ride. Pick a challenging line or choose to skirt it in your own ducky!

experiences.title: Italian Pasta Cooking Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming Denver kitchen and explore the flavors of the Italian Riviera in this interactive cooking class hosted through Cozymeal. With a maximum of 8 guests, this intimate session highlights authentic Italian techniques and fresh ingredients.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Cheesy stuffed mushrooms with fresh herbs
- Main course: Handmade fettuccine with Ligurian walnut sauce
- Dessert: Golden bombolini filled with Nutella or fruit jelly

Guided by your local pasta chef, you’ll learn to balance flavors, perfect textures and bring regional Italian recipes to life. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy with their freshly made dishes, making this both an educational and indulgent culinary evening.

experiences.title: Buena Vista Family Rafting Adventure Arkansas River
experiences.description: Get ready for a splash of adventure on the Buena Vista Beginner Family Rafting Trip! Cruise the famous Arkansas River's 'Milk Run', surrounded by the towering Sawatch Range and endless mountain beauty. Perfect for families and first timers, you'll enjoy gentle Class I and II+ rapids with excitement and amazing views at every turn. Our knowledgeable guides share fun stories about the area's geology and wildlife - keep an eye out for Mule Deer and Bighorn Sheep! Your small group adventure includes all required equipment, wetsuits, and a convenient round trip from the meeting spot. With about one hour on the river and guided support every step of the way, this is the perfect way to dip your toes into rafting fun and make Colorado memories together.

experiences.title: Colorado Inspired Inktense Painted Stocking or Tote Bag Class
experiences.description:
Inktense Blocks are a fun, vibrant new art medium that are very easy to use and incredibly versatile! In this class, you will learn how to apply them to a cotton reusable tote bag to make them color fast, as well as learn how to layer and blend the tints and shades to create depth and visual interest to your painting. We provide Colorado inspired stencils and tracing materials for you to layer in a variety of ways to create a bag as colorful and unique as you are! 

All tools, materials, and instruction are provided. Drop-In or Book ahead

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With Local Chef in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
Bring Italy to your kitchen in this pasta-making class with Chef Juwanza, hosted through Classpop!. You’ll craft fresh pasta from scratch using semolina flour, eggs and olive oil, learning how to knead, roll and shape dough into ribbons of fettuccine and strands of spaghetti. As your pasta cooks, whip up two classic sauces: a silky Alfredo with cream, garlic and Parmesan, and a rich Bolognese with ground meat, tomatoes, onions and carrots. Chef Juwanza keeps the class fun, approachable and hands-on, so you’ll leave with new skills and recipes you can recreate anytime. End the night by enjoying your pasta two ways — creamy, hearty and 100% homemade.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Intentional Flower Frame Workshop in Denver
experiences.description:
Why Book This Experience 
• Combine mindful practices with hands-on creative expression 
• Work with affirmations and natural elements to design something deeply personal 
• Take home a flower frame that’s both art and a meaningful reminder of your intentions 
• Perfect for personal growth, special occasions, or group outings with heart

experiences.title: Wire Wrap Pendant Jewelry Workshop In Denver
experiences.description: In this engaging workshop, participants learn the art of jewelry making through hands-on experience with wire wrapping techniques. Choose from a selection of vibrant gemstones and receive step-by-step guidance to craft a stunning pendant that showcases its natural beauty. By the end of the session, you will not only have a unique piece of jewelry but also the foundational skills to continue your jewelry-making journey. This workshop is perfect for beginners or anyone looking to refine their skills while enjoying a creative day out with friends.

experiences.title: Bamboo Fly Rod Building Workshop Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the timeless art of bamboo rod-making at PJ’s Fine Bamboo Rods in beautiful Pagosa Springs, Colorado. Renowned for their heirloom-quality fly rods and handcrafted landing nets, PJ’s is more than just a shop—it’s an experience for fly fishing enthusiasts and curious visitors alike.

Join our free workshop tour and watch skilled craftspeople transform fine Tonkin bamboo into exquisite rods, each crafted with unmatched precision and passion. Want to dive deeper? 

Before you leave, browse our retail area featuring premium bamboo household products and fishing gear. Whether you're a seasoned angler or simply looking for a unique experience, PJ’s Fine Bamboo Rods combines heritage, craftsmanship, and hands-on exploration in one unforgettable visit.

Book your workshop tour today and connect with the art of fly fishing!

experiences.title: Floating in Crested Butte: Hammock Yoga, Sound Healing & Reiki
experiences.description: You will enjoy the nature, music, and stretching. You won't experience anything like this anywhere! This practice is unique because it combines elements of traditional yoga with the supportive and freeing sensation of aerial hammocks. The floating aspect of the practice allows for deeper stretches and positions that are not easily attainable through ground-based yoga. Additionally, this approach integrates various holistic elements such as meditation, sound healing, and reiki, providing a comprehensive mind-body experience. The focus on chakra alignment and the inclusion of light touch techniques further enhances the overall therapeutic effect, making the experience distinct from conventional yoga sessions.

experiences.title: Beginner Mixology Class
experiences.description:
Have you ever wanted to learn how to craft cocktails like an international Mixologist?

We offer a hands-on experience in muddling, shaking, stirring, and sipping!

Other skills learned - how to balance a cocktail, how to create sour mix, some with egg white, Simple syrups, infusions, muddling skills, speed and accuracy. 

We are now offering smoked cocktail classes! 

We offer a real bar, real bar equipment in a comfortable space in Downtown Denver! 

Examples of what we Teach -

Espresso Martini
Egg white cocktails
Smoked Old Fashioned
Spicy Mango Margarita
Rum Coconut Daiquiri

experiences.title: Felting Hummingbird Ornament Class in Estes Park
experiences.description: Learn how to sculpt simple shapes from core wool, and then add bright embellishing colors to bring these sweet little creatures to life. Every participant will leave with at least one finished piece they are proud of and is ready to be hung in their home (if there is time we can create a second hummingbird). Create a beautiful reminder of spring that you can have year round! All materials and tools required for the class are provided.

experiences.title: World Cuisine Classes in the Base of the Mountains
experiences.description: Come to the land of the mountains in Twin Lakes, Colorado. We will be cooking out of a casita in the foothills of Twin Lakes. We will be preparing food that is local and derived from this area and region. Come learn new techniques and enjoy some quaint atmosphere and lovely food.

experiences.title: Royal Gorge Half-Day Rafting Trip
experiences.description: Experience world class whitewater at Colorado's Royal Gorge! Incredible scenery and epic whitewater blend to make this one of North America's premier rafting destinations. This 3-hour excursion is led by a local guide, and is a perfect way to spend a half day. Your adventure awaits!

experiences.title: Clear Creek Adv/Int 2h 30m Rafting Trip - Idaho Springs, CO
experiences.description: Embark on an exhilarating 2.5-hour whitewater adventure on Clear Creek, just 30 minutes from Denver. This intermediate rafting trip is perfect for adventurous first timers and seasoned paddlers alike, offering a thrilling ride through continuous Class III–IV rapids. Navigate challenging sections like “Nomad,” “Fall River,” “Deliverance,” and the grand finale, “Outer Limits,” as you descend through the scenic Clear Creek Canyon. The steep gradient and technical maneuvers require active paddling and teamwork, making for an adrenaline filled experience. Our professional guides provide comprehensive safety briefings and all necessary gear, including personal flotation devices, helmets, and wetsuits. After conquering the rapids, enjoy the historic charm of Idaho Springs, a town rich in Colorado's gold mining history. This trip is ideal for those seeking a dynamic and memorable rafting experience close to Denver

experiences.title: Raft the Colorado River through Glenwood Springs - Half Day Adventure
experiences.description: Say ‘yes’ to a perfect day on the Colorado River! This ‘Half-Day Adventure’ offers a scenic, whitewater experience which is a must for water enthusiasts of all ages. Get on board with the professional guides to enjoy all the adventure of the class III ‘Shoshone Rapids,’ then slow it down and soak in the scenery of stunning Glenwood Springs Canyon as you play and paddle your way through class I-II whitewater. Each trip is about 3 - 3.5 hours long (total trip time) and departs and returns from 152 W 6th Street, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601

experiences.title: Create Your Own Hydro Dipped Tumbler, Mug or Flask in Estes Park
experiences.description: The Hydro Dipping Art Experiences will be held outside in our Inspired Art Experiences tent. Hydro Dipping is so much fun, and every piece is completely unique! Your instructor will guide you through the process of choosing colors that compliment each other, and guide you through the process and techniques of dipping your tumbler or flask to create your design

experiences.title: Pyrography Wood Burning Class
experiences.description: Pryography is an art technique that involves using high temperatures to 'draw' designs and patterns in to wood, and also add shading and texture to the working surface. In this Inspired Art Studio class, participants will learn the basics of this art form while creating 4 different wood art pieces, using Colorado Wildlife and the Rocky Mountain Landscape as inspiration. These pieces will then be assembled into a wall hanging or mobile art piece that can be hung in the creators home to as a souvenir of their time spent in the Colorado Rockies.

experiences.title: Half Day Shoshone Rafting in Glenwood Springs
experiences.description: Raft through the heart of Glenwood Canyon on the Colorado River, where dramatic canyon walls, playful Class II–III rapids, and calm scenic sections come together for a well-rounded on-water experience. Located just minutes from Glenwood Springs and an easy drive from Vail and Beaver Creek, this half-day trip blends excitement with incredible scenery. It’s our most popular option for a reason—offering just the right mix of splashy fun and relaxed floating, making it a great fit for all ages and experience levels.

experiences.title: 2-Hours Glenwood Springs Short and Mild Family Raft Trip
experiences.description:
Looking for a rafting trip the whole family can enjoy? Set in the heart of the Colorado Rockies, this Glenwood Springs Family Float is a relaxed, scenic two-hour adventure designed with all ages in mind—from young kids to grandparents.

The route follows a calm stretch of river with easy Class II and mild Class III rapids, featuring gentle waves, light splashes, and plenty of opportunities to laugh and play along the way. Guests can paddle, relax in the sun, or even hop in for a refreshing swim, creating a flexible experience that feels both fun and easygoing.

Along the way, kids stay engaged helping paddle, spotting wildlife, and splashing through small rapids, while guides keep the trip safe, interactive, and enjoyable for everyone. With a laid-back pace and just the right amount of excitement, it’s a memorable way to spend time on the water together.

experiences.title: Alcohol Ink Light Boxes
experiences.description: This class is a fun and relaxing introduction to learning how to use Alcohol Inks. It's great for families and special events as well as those just interested in learning something new. Easier to work with than watercolor and incredibly vibrant, every participant will leave with a finished, framed piece they are proud of and is ready to hang or set in their home.

experiences.title: Hydro Dipped Hummingbird Feeder
experiences.description:
This Make-&-Take class gives participants the chance to design and assemble their own Hummingbird Feeder! Experience the cool art medium of hydro dipping! At this class, you will learn the techniques involved with this unique art experience and pick out your favorite colors from our wide selection of spray paints to create a beautiful, one-of-a-kind Hummingbird Feeder that is sure to attract those amazing little creatures. You will also learn some basic macrame knots to create the hanger for the bottle.

The Inspired Art Kits include all of the instructions and materials needed to create your one of a kind piece, and can be created either in the studio or the kit can be taken with and created where ever and whenever the participant would like to create!

experiences.title: Chinese Cooking Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Three classic Chinese dishes, all made from scratch – this hands-on cooking class in Denver, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, is held at your local chef's home venue and covers spring rolls, char siu bao and mango pudding in one satisfying experience.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Authentic Spring Rolls with fresh vegetables
- Char Siu Bao with pork, honey, soy sauce and Chinese five spice
- Dairy Free Mango Pudding with fresh mango

You will leave with three classic Chinese recipes and the confidence to make them at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Chocolate and Wine Pairing Class at The Chocolate Therapist
experiences.description:
The Chocolate Therapist makes handcrafted, all-natural chocolate on site. We are a clean-ingredient company. There are no dyes, preservatives, artificial ingredients, soy, or corn syrup in anything we make. Because of this, our chocolate pairs particularly well with wine and spirits, and our classes have been highly popular for many years. We also have a full-service coffee bar and a self-serve wine bar, so you can come in and order wine and a flight of chocolate and create your own pairing, even if you're not taking the class. The Chocolate Therapist is a completely unique experience, and it's nestled in the heart of a charming historic downtown area, filled with restaurants and one-of-a-kind local shops. We have customers who land at the airport and head straight to our shop for their first stop. We'd love to see you too!
We are new to Viator, please see reviews on Facebook, Google and Yelp.

experiences.title: DIY Watercolor Workshop and Tea Tasting in Pagosa Springs
experiences.description: Discover a unique blend of creativity and relaxation in an uplifting studio environment in downtown Pagosa Springs. This creative cafe and casual teahouse offers a DIY art menu where you can sip on carefully sourced loose-leaf teas, wine, local beers, or refreshing mocktails while creating something to take home. The space is designed to inspire both beginners, seasoned artists, lovers of tea, those new to the world of tea, or anyone looking for their next great afternoon! Your booking includes all materials, choice of DIY watercolor tutorial, and a tea tasting.

experiences.title: Fresh Pasta and Tiramisù Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the heart of Italian home cooking in this Denver pasta class hosted through Cozymeal. This 3-course experience combines rustic recipes with essential skills for making fresh pasta from scratch.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- First course: Tomato and basil bruschetta on crisp toasted bread.
- Second course: Handmade tagliatelle or gnocchi with fresh tomato-basil sauce.
- Dessert: Classic tiramisù with mascarpone, cacao and espresso-soaked ladyfingers.

Your local pasta chef will guide you through dough texture, kneading and shaping while sharing tips for a lively tomato sauce. Finish by assembling tiramisù with clean layers and balanced flavor. Bring wine or beer to enjoy as you cook and dine.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
In this hands-on cooking class, Chef Juwanza brings authentic pasta-making techniques to a trendy local distillery where guests can relax, learn new skills and enjoy an elevated social night out in the heart of Colorado Springs.

Your experience begins with crafting fresh pasta dough from semolina flour, eggs and olive oil before learning how to knead, roll and shape pasta completely by hand. While the pasta cooks, Chef Juwanza will guide you through building two rich homemade sauces: a velvety Alfredo with garlic and Parmesan and a slow-inspired Bolognese layered with tomatoes, onions, carrots and savory ground meat. Finish by pairing your pasta with the sauce of your choice and enjoying the homemade Italian meal you created from scratch. This beginner-friendly class includes all fresh ingredients, professional cooking tools and approachable guidance designed to make every guest feel confident in the kitchen.

experiences.title: Homemade Manicotti Pasta Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Celebrate regional Italian flavors in this Denver cooking class hosted through Cozymeal. Across three courses, you’ll explore the contrast between creamy filled pasta, vibrant produce and a light frozen dessert.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

 - First course: Bruschetta with fresh toppings and balsamic glaze.
 - Second course: Homemade manicotti with a garlicky ricotta filling.
 - Dessert: Lemon raspberry granita with a refreshing crystalline texture.

Learn how to balance acidity and sweetness, assemble filled pasta and create a smooth ricotta mixture that holds its shape. Your local chef will also demonstrate the scraping technique that gives granita its signature texture. Bring wine or beer to pair with the menu.

experiences.title: Learn to Bake Tea Room Delicacies
experiences.description:
These tea room delicacies are delicious and easy to make.

They look complicated and fancy - so you can impress your family and friends!

No special knowledge of baking, cooking, food preparation or measuring is required.

experiences.title: Make Fresh Pasta With a Local Chef in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
Fresh pasta has a way of making an ordinary day feel a little more Italian. Hosted at a Colorado Springs wine bar, this hands-on cooking experience puts you in front of the mixing bowl instead of the takeout menu. Under Chef Juwanza's guidance, you'll learn pasta-making from scratch, starting with a dough made from semolina flour, eggs and olive oil.

You'll practice kneading, shaping and preparing fresh pasta while learning techniques that build confidence in the kitchen. Then you'll transform your handmade pasta into two classic dishes. Simmer a hearty Spaghetti Bolognese with ground meat, tomatoes, onions and carrots, and prepare a creamy Fettuccine Alfredo with butter, garlic, heavy cream and Parmesan cheese.

Expect flour on your hands, incredible aromas in the air and plenty of hands-on fun. Chef Juwanza keeps every step approachable, whether you're new to pasta-making or looking to sharpen your skills. Leave knowing exactly how to recreate pasta night from scratch.

experiences.title: Mosaic Picture Frame Art Kit in Estes Park
experiences.description:
This Make & Take class is so colorful and relaxing. If you manage to stop by Patterson Glass Gallery before you come to the class, you can get one of their glass pebbles and add it to your frame! Each participant leaves with a piece that is uniquely theirs and is a great project that makes a wonderful souvenir of Colorado!

The Inspired Art Kits include all of the instructions and materials needed to create your one of a kind piece, and can be created either in the studio or the kit can be taken with and created where ever and whenever the participant would like to create!

experiences.title: Pizza Cooking Class in Denver (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Great pizza starts with great dough. This hands-on cooking class hosted through Cozymeal in Denver, teaches you how to make it from scratch – and how to top it, bake it and serve it alongside a fresh Caprese and a sweet Nutella finale.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Caprese Salad – fresh mozzarella, tomato and basil
- Homemade Pizza – freshly made dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella and customizable toppings
- Nutella Pizza – freshly made dough and Nutella cream

You will leave knowing how to make great pizza from scratch – a well-developed dough, a balanced topping combination and a sweet finish. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the class.

experiences.title: Manitou Springs Morning Tasting Tour Flavors and Springs
experiences.description:
Discover the culinary gems of Manitou Springs on this delightful morning tasting tour. With five unique culinary tastings and the chance to sample three ancient mineral springs, this tour offers a perfect blend of local flavors and rich history. As you stroll through the charming streets, you'll experience the artistic culture that defines this unique town at the base of Pikes Peak. Ideal for those seeking a leisurely start to their day, you’ll also enjoy exclusive discounts on any tempting souvenirs along the way. Our knowledgeable guides, affectionately known as "Taste Buds," can recommend lunch spots to round out your experience.

- Enjoy five culinary tastings and three ancient mineral springs
- Stroll through the historic streets of Manitou Springs
- Perfect for a relaxed morning experience before lunch
- Exclusive discounts available on souvenirs during the tour

experiences.title: Spirits and Spirits Bar Crawl
experiences.description:
Unlock Denver's Spooky Side: Spirits & Spirits Bar Crawl

Dare to sip where specters linger? Smile High Tours invites thrill-seekers to descend into Denver’s haunted heart during your chilling Spirits and Spirits Bar Crawl. Over three unforgettable hours, you’ll tread cobblestones steeped in tragedy while clutching a cocktail… because courage tastes better with bourbon.

Why This Crawl Haunts Your Imagination: 
- Ghosts AND Drinks: Paranormal tales paired with stops at historic bars—each pour comes with a side of lingering souls. 
- LoDo’s Dark Landmarks: Explore Union Station’s phantom travelers, Oxford Hotel’s infamous Room 320, Market Street’s violent past, and Larimer Square’s restless shadows. 
- Chilling Storytelling: Your guides blend verified history with bone-deep lore—no cheesy jump scares, just visceral, unsettling truths. 
- Socially Supernatural: Bond with fellow skeptics and believers as you toast to Denver’s dead… *if* you dare lift your glass amid whispers.

experiences.title: All Inclusive-Twilight Ghost Tour with a Boozy Twist
experiences.description: This is not a pub crawl. It is a fun, entertaining, and engaging ghost tour, including two bar stops, along the tour route. We take great pride in customer service. We limited the number of people on this tour, so that we can provide the best experience possible. In this experience, we are providing one complimentary drink, at each of the two bar stops. Note: you will be given a special menu, which will include wells, select wines, and drafts. We ask that you don’t order an additional drink, or order anything outside of the special menu. Please do not order food or appetizers. Please do not arrive on the tour inebriated or under the influence of a substance. Due to the liability risk, you will not be allowed to participate in tour experience. Please use common sense. Note: You will not receive a refund, if you violate this policy. We only allow 12 people on each tour, so this tour tends to sell out quickly.

experiences.title: Private Vintner's Wine Tasting Experience in Colorado
experiences.description: Our Winery produces award-winning Colorado and California wines, putting us in a unique position to share our knowledge and experience with you on the difference between our local industry here in Colorado and the larger wine country in California. Taste through multiple different products to expand your wine horizons.

experiences.title: Denver's Beer and Graffiti Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Come separate yourself from the buzz of downtown to mill around amongst the craft culture of the River North Art District (RiNo). During this tour we will guide you through brewing process, cider making, as well as discuss the amazing stories of the businesses and street art on our route. 

Join us as we taste the beers made here, explore the neighborhood, experience the local outdoor art and murals, and introduce you to the hottest and fastest growing neighborhood in Denver.

experiences.title: Stranahan's Distillery Tour and Tasting Experience
experiences.description:
Step inside Colorado’s first legal whiskey distillery since Prohibition and discover how Stranahan’s American single malt whiskey comes to life. Located in Denver, this immersive tour follows the handcrafted journey — from distillation to barrel aging to bottling. Along the way, enjoy exclusive tastings of award-winning whiskeys and receive $10 off a select bottle of your choice.

Tours are offered daily and include:

-Guided distillery walkthrough led by a Stranahan’s whiskey expert
-The story of Stranahan’s founding and its place in American whiskey history
-Tastings of four award-winning Stranahan's American single malt whiskeys

Perfect for curious newcomers and devoted whiskey fans alike.

experiences.title: Panoramic Peak Tour (Wildside 4x4 Tours)
experiences.description:
Embark on a unique 4x4 photo adventure amidst the majestic Rockies, offering unparalleled views at a leisurely pace. Our guided safari tour follows an authentic 1860’s wagon trail through Roosevelt National Forest, leading to our private panoramic viewing tower boasting vistas stretching over 100 miles!

Feel the thrill as you glide over water bars in our highly modified 4x4s, complete with stadium seating and open tops for an immersive experience. Rain gear is provided, including full-body suits called Frog Toggs, ensuring your comfort regardless of the weather.

Take a break at our private pavilion for restroom facilities and indulge in a relaxing food and beverage interlude. Capture unforgettable moments of "The Mummy," "The Bear Tree," and ancient Aspens along the way.

Whether you're a seasoned photographer or a nature enthusiast, this adventure promises cherished memories for the whole family. Don't miss out on this unforgettable journey into the heart of Colorado's wilderness!

experiences.title: Guided 3-Hour Fort Collins Old Town Food Tour
experiences.description:
Old Town Food Tour offers an experience like none other, as you enjoy opportunities provided by many local restaurants to sample their unique cuisines. You will also be connected with an experienced tour guide who will not only assist in showcasing each restaurant, but also will give you the opportunity to learn about what makes Fort Collins one of the fastest growing cities in America. Restaurant partners include:

- Slyce Pizza
- The Still Whiskey Steaks
- La Piadina
- Ginger & Baker
- Ace Gillett's
- La Boutique
- Hot Sauce Realm
- Sonny Lubicks
- Japango
- Nuance Chocolate

***Please be advised that during your tour, you will visit 4-5 of these partners***

experiences.title: 3 Hour Whiskey and History Tour
experiences.description:
Did you know Denver was founded over a barrel of whiskey? On this 3 hour Colorado Whiskey tour you will learn about Whiskies and their role in the founding of the city. On this walking tour you will visit Denver's oldest Irish Pub, a modern day saloon, and a local Denver distillery. Along the way you will sample different whiskies, learn how high altitude distilling is different than anywhere else and learn some light local history. VALID ID REQUIRED (Co. does not accept vertical ID's)

Stop 1: Nallen's Irish Pub - All tastings and samples are included in the ticket price if you choose that option. Distillery tastings are included

Stop 2: Seven Grand - 750 types of Whiskies, Bourbons and Scotches.

Stop 3: Mile High Spirits - Distillery tastings are included with all ticket options (a $40 value)

Tour needs 4 guests to operate, if there are not enough guests to run the tour you will be 100% refunded.

experiences.title: Denver Cocktails & History Tour
experiences.description:
Visit some of the best cocktail bars in Denver on this roving adventure through the heart of downtown.

From a light and crisp spritz to a smooth and serious Butter Pecan Old Fashioned, there's something for everyone on this boozy Denver cocktail tour.

Visit three of the best cocktail bars and restaurants in the city and sample four cocktails paired with small plates at two stops. 

You’ll start at the iconic Union Station, heading next to the city’s oldest hotel. You’ll end on the Dairy Block, one of Denver’s newest, coolest micro-districts. At each stop, you’ll sample a craft cocktail (or two!), learn about Denver’s growing food and cocktail scenes and mix and mingle with fellow foodies.

Your experienced local guide will share fun cocktail history and stories about Denver’s prohibition days as well as our recent culinary renaissance, putting Denver on the map for foodies and drink enthusiasts across the country.

experiences.title: Denver RiNo Arts District Food Tour
experiences.description:
On this three-hour walking food tour, taste some of the best dishes the RiNo Arts District has to offer while exploring a cool, industrial neighborhood.

You’ll meet your experienced local guide at Los Chingones, a fusion spot run by a prominent Denver chef. Over the next three hours, you’ll visit five award-winning local restaurants to taste delicious dishes with the option to add alcoholic drink pairings. 

You’ll taste house-made ricotta gnocchi, Mexican street tacos, specialty sourdough pizza, Bavarian pretzels made with local beer cheese and seasonal ice cream.* 

In between tour stops, your local foodie guide will share interesting stories about Denver’s growing culinary scene as well as the colorful murals that cover the streets and alleys of the RiNo Arts District.

*Tastings are subject to change

experiences.title: Downtown Denver Food Tour
experiences.description:
Discover Denver one bite at a time on this three-hour walking food tour through the heart of downtown.  You'll visit 5 award-winning local Denver restaurants for delicious tastings.
