You will taste authentic Neapolitan pizza certified by Italy's AVPN, award-winning from-scratch Colorado green chile, fluffy baked empanadas from a family-owned shop, Southwestern fusion cuisine on the brand new Dairy Block, and a sweet treat from a James Beard award-winning chef inside the historic Union Station.*

In between tastings, your experienced foodie guide will share stories about Denver's rich history and architecture. From secret tunnels to world-famous bordellos, learn just how wild the west was in the city's early days. You'll visit historic sites and landmarks like Coors Field, McGregor Square, the Dairy Block, the oldest hotel in Denver and the iconic Union Station.

*Tastings are subject to change

experiences.title: Denver Graffiti Tour
experiences.description:
SAT + SUN 10am — March 15th to Nov 30th
SAT + SUN 12pm — December 1st to March 14th

On this top-rated two-hour walking tour of Denver’s graffiti and street art, discover the cultural underground hiding in plain sight. We live right here and personally know the artists + art. So you'll learn the real stories about the art, artists and neighborhoods, including how Denver has changed and how that’s affected the art and the people who live here.

This is a class on street art -- both educational and entertaining! 

Whether visiting Denver for the first time or a Mile High native, you'll see the street art and this neighborhood in a new light. 

Plus, we end at the Denver Central Market, a gourmet food hall where you can eat or drink at one of the 10 eateries -- or easily explore the other incredible bars, restaurants, shops, art galleries.

* We also offer custom times via private tours. Inquire by email.

experiences.title: Classic Food Tour in Colorado Springs
experiences.description:
This classic and casual walking tour features food, drinks, local art and historical storytelling! You’ll visit four or five of the most loved restaurants, hole-in-the-walls, and artisan food shops in downtown Colorado Springs (enough for a full meal!). Get a behind-the-scenes look into downtown’s blossoming culinary scene and see downtown from a true local's perspective.

Enjoy historical storytelling of Pikes Peak, the gold rush, the railroad, and more from your expert local Tour Leader. Upgrade your ticket to include a drink package (Colorado craft beer, cocktails, wine or non-alcoholic options) for only $21.99. The itinerary provided is a sample and may be completely different than your actual tour. The tour covers 1-1.5 miles and does not make a complete circle.

experiences.title: Saturday Guided Distillery Tour and Whiskey Tasting
experiences.description: Go behind the barrels with your Signature Guided Tour and Tasting. This exclusive experience takes you into the heart of our distillery, where you’ll walk the working floors, explore your casks, and learn the art of whiskey-making from the experts. Discover the tradition and intention behind your process and see why we are America’s first dedicated Single Pot Still whiskey distillery. It is an immersive blend of education and flavor, designed to give you a deeper appreciation for every pour. Join us for a unique look at the craft behind the glass.

experiences.title: New Haven - It Zip It Adventure Indoor Ropes Course
experiences.description: The world's largest indoor ropes course awaits in New Haven, CT, offering an exhilarating challenge for adventurers of all ages. Navigate through four levels packed with over 100 unique obstacles, including the thrilling Sky Rail® zip lines that send you soaring above the course. This all-weather activity ensures a perfect blend of fun and fitness, making it an ideal outing for families or friends seeking to test their limits together. Get ready for an unforgettable experience that keeps your adrenaline pumping.

experiences.title: New Haven's Ghost Walk
experiences.description: Go inside the Grove St. Cememtery, find out about the phantom of Geronimo, and try not to sink in New Haven Harbor. Let us see if we can scare you with stories of ghosts, scandalous tales, and stranger things.

experiences.title: Explore New Haven with a Scavenger Hunt by Zombie Scavengers
experiences.description: Zombie Scavengers takes you on an adventure in New Haven to survive the zombie apocalypse! Use our app and some strategy to find a list of items needed to survive, in any order you'd prefer, around the city. Find the survival items to get points and do fun zombie themed challenges for points as well. Contrive a plan to get your survival team the most points in order to survive the apocalypse! Your remote host will follow along virtually and provide support if you need it. Can you survive the apocalypse in New Haven?

experiences.title: New Haven City Scavenger Hunt Excursion by Operation City Quest
experiences.description: Explore New Haven with Operation City Quest! Our scavenger hunt takes you around the city to find items in any order you want and perform exciting tasks for points. The scavenger hunt is done using an app and you'll be able to check the rankings feature anytime to see how you rank. Our scavenger hunt has a remote guide that will help along the way via chat. Let's get exploring in New Haven.

experiences.title: New Haven Scavenger Hunt Adventure
experiences.description: Get ready to uncover the secrets of New Haven! Known as the “Cultural Capital of Connecticut,” this vibrant city is full of discoveries. Wander through Yale University, learn about the birthplace of George W. Bush, and dive into the city’s fascinating history. Take photos, solve clever riddles, and pick up fun facts—like Yale’s Hogwarts-style feasts. You’ll even explore the mysteries surrounding the legendary Skull and Bones society and try your hand at translating Latin inscriptions. An unforgettable New Haven adventure awaits!

experiences.title: Spirits of Mystic: Cocktail Pub Crawl
experiences.description: A Cocktail Pub Crawl with Seaside Shadows featuring locally cultivated cocktails -- some with spooky themes! - Join Seaside Shadows guides for a walk through some of Mystic's famous pubs featuring true ghostly tales and dark history of this bustling region of downtown Mystic and hear about the haunting tales of your favorite local pubs and taverns. This tour will feature stops at three local pubs/taverns allowing you to sample a different spirit at each stop along the way. The tour includes three drinks. (Tax and Gratuity included)

experiences.title: Paranormal Pub Crawl: Beer Tour
experiences.description: A Paranormal Pub Crawl with Seaside Shadows 3 local pubs/breweries -- Bank & Bridge Brew Pub with thematic local beers, Friar Tucks Tavern, with boards of beer choices and Captain Daniel Packer Inne -- a historic haunt with the DPIPA. Join Seaside Shadows guides for a walk through Mystic's Water Street featuring true ghostly tales and dark history of this bustling region of downtown Mystic and hear about the haunting tales of your favorite local pubs and taverns. This tour will feature stops at some of your favorite local pubs featuring Barley Head brews allowing you to sample a different flavor at each stop along the way. The tour includes a total of three beers! (Tax and Gratuity included)

experiences.title: Mystic Food Tour Taste the Best of Mystic CT
experiences.description:
Explore the vibrant culinary scene of Mystic, CT, on this guided food tour that takes you through downtown's top-rated restaurants and hidden gems. Sample six curated tastings that showcase the coastal flavors and creativity of local chefs while enjoying stories about Mystic’s maritime heritage and culinary evolution. This three-hour tour covers approximately 1.2 miles at a relaxed pace, making it perfect for food lovers and those looking to celebrate special occasions. Conclude your journey with a sweet treat overlooking the Mystic River, embracing the town's charming atmosphere.

- Duration: 3 hours with 6 tasting stops at renowned restaurants
- Suitable for ages 14 and up, with a maximum group size of 16
- Easy walking tour, approximately 1.2 miles through downtown
- Includes guided storytelling about Mystic’s food culture and history

experiences.title: Hard Rock Cafe Foxwoods
experiences.description: Treat your senses with a prix-fixe menu at the Foxwoods Hard Rock Cafe. Classic American cooking comes to the heart of Connecticut, where you’ll enjoy a 2- or 3-course meal with your choice of theme. Each option comes with a drink (coffee, tea or soda) and dessert. Expect entrees like the classic cheeseburger, a half-rack of hickory-smoked ribs, salmon, steak and even some vegetarian options. Love One - Serve All!

experiences.title: Gourmet Pasta Class in Washington D.C. (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover gourmet pasta-making in Washington D.C. during this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the experience highlights both unfilled and filled pastas in a refined three-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Seasonal vegetable salad with fresh herbs and vinaigrette
- First pasta: Garganelli with savory meat sauce or farfalle with vegetable ragù
- Second pasta: Tortellini or agnolotti stuffed with artisanal cheeses and herbs in cream sauce

Guided by your pasta chef, you’ll practice mixing dough, shaping varieties and pairing them with flavorful sauces while building confidence to recreate authentic recipes at home.

experiences.title: Sushi Masterclass in Washington D.C. (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Uncover the artistry of sushi-making in Washington D.C. during this immersive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop blends essential Japanese techniques with a diverse four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Tuna sesame salad with a light, tangy dressing

experiences.title: Private Hands On Biscuit Baking Class outside Washington DC
experiences.description:
Inspired by his love for biscuits and the joy of sharing food, your host Matt has spent years perfecting his signature recipe. A program manager by day and passionate baker by night, Matt channels his creativity into reimagining this beloved Southern staple. His wife told him that he created a biscuit so good, he had to share it.

In this private, hands-on 2.5-hour class, you’ll join Matt to learn the secrets to baking fluffy, golden biscuits from scratch. You’ll make classic Southern-style biscuits and try creative variations like cheddar-parsley or garam-ghee. Sip Turkish coffee or Japanese tea as you mix, roll, and bake in a welcoming kitchen.

After baking, enjoy your biscuits with sweet jams or go savory with hearty sausage gravy. Sit down to savor your creations with Matt and his wife, and take home any extras to share.

Whether you’re a food lover or planning a fun event, this delicious experience is a flavorful way to connect with local culture near the capital.

Add to all these a unbeatable prices, and a handful of trendy cafés and restaurants, and what you’ll get is one of the best shopping destinations in and around the Washington. After you finish your shopping you will be picked up and will be delivered directly to your hotel in Washington.

Discover the art of sushi-making and bring your culinary skills to new heights!

In this fun, hands-on social cooking class, you’ll learn how to spread, layer, tuck, and roll your way to sushi perfection. We’ll guide you through the essentials, including preparing sushi rice, selecting sushi-grade fish, and adding flavorful neta (ingredients) to elevate your creations. You'll make three different sushi rolls featuring fresh ingredients like salmon, tuna, and avocado.

No experience is needed! We provide all the equipment and ingredients, which are easy to find at local markets so you can recreate your sushi masterpieces at home. Your classes are designed to be casual, fun, and approachable—whether you're an enthusiastic sushi lover ready to dive in or a curious first-timer who prefers to observe and assist.

Please arrive 15 minutes early to check in. Class is 21+

experiences.title: Local Neighborhood Washington DC Food Tour by DrinkEatWalk Tours
experiences.description:
Drink•Eat•Walk small group evening food & drink neighborhood walking tours explore beyond tourist Washington in to the streets & places we DC locals hang out in, so you can experience the true flavor of the city. 

This local neighborhood Washington DC food tour dives into two of our city's most beloved areas — Dupont Circle's streets are filled with stately embassies, charming row homes, and fabulous people; Adams Morgan is DC's most eclectic neighborhood, bursting with sights, smells, and flavors from around the world.

We stop for eats & drinks in six different places, learning about the communities and culture that built and sustain DC in each one. In between, we'll walk the streets in a way that gives you a true feel for each neighborhood.

This tour is all about having a great group experience & solo travelers are definitely welcome. We'll get to know each other as we eat, drink, & learn our way into the night in this great city we locals call home.

Food tour DC like a local!

Along the way, you’ll sample authentic high quality baked goods, pastries, artisan chocolates, fresh coffee, gelato, and tea from 5 to 6 unique local establishments.

Experience Georgetown as it wakes up to a new day, and dive into the stories that have shaped this iconic district. Join us for “Cobblestones and Croissants”—a morning of tasty discoveries and unforgettable moments.

Note: Our selection of baked goods, pastries, chocolates, gelato, and beverages changes seasonally. We keep you moving to maximize the sites, but we utilize strategic, comfortable rest stops along the path. We recommend comfortable shoes and a readiness to soak in Georgetown’s lively atmosphere.

experiences.title: Small-Group History Tour Pub Crawl of Washington, D.C.
experiences.description:
This isn’t your 8th-grade field trip. On the Insider’s Pub Crawl, you’ll visit iconic D.C. bars and local pubs near the White House with an expert local guide. Uncover the unknown and hilarious history your teacher left out, from George Washington’s adventures as a master distiller to Prohibition bootleggers, scandalous spies, and parties at the White House. Laugh with fellow travelers from around the globe while the adults finally get their turn to learn history!

The tour lasts 2 hours and 15 minutes and begins outside Lafayette Square near the White House. Drinks are not included in the ticket price and are available for purchase separately at each bar, so you can choose exactly what you would like to enjoy. Buying a drink is never required. Walking is limited to just a few blocks, making the accessible for guests of all physical capabilities. 

 Ticket must be purchased in advance. Come laugh, learn, and experience the fun side of our nation’s capital. Cheers!

experiences.title: Washington DC's Best Donuts, Sweet Treats & Walking History Tour
experiences.description:
Recently voted one of TripAdvisor's top Food Experiences in the US.

Join us for a historic Donut adventure through our nation’s capital, Washington DC. Our tour begins in Western Market, which has a legacy dating back to 1802! There we will sample donuts made from a business that’s been in the same family for five generations. From there we’ll head downtown, where we’ll see a restaurant favored by a former President before passing by the White House itself for a perfect photo op. After soaking in some history at Lafayette Square, we’ll head deeper into DC to try some local fan favorite donuts from local celebrities. From there, we’ll head down Palmers Alley, the most instagrammable spot in DC, where we’ll end our adventure with delectable donuts with an international flavor. 

By the end, you’ll have made some great friends and enjoyed some incredible donuts and history. We hope you can join us today!

experiences.description: Ah, Washington DC. The capital of the United States always has something exciting to offer. experiences.description: The Little Ethiopia Food Tour will take you through historic U Street to 9th street as we visit the heart of the world’s largest Ethiopian community outside of Ethiopia. Your gastronomic experience will chronicle the intricate flavors, textures, and colors in Ethiopian cuisine, while recounting the history of the Ethiopian people.

experiences.title: Washington's Hidden Gems Food Tour with 6+ Tasty Dishes
experiences.description: Wisconsin Avenue is Georgetown's beating heart, and that's where your local guide will start. Your first stop is a neighborhood favorite from a Michelin-recognized chef, known for fresh pita and creamy hummus, and for a line that stretches down the block. Next, a longtime local butcher shop serves up Washington's famous handmade half smoke, a true D.C. classic. Along the way, pass the former home of Julia Child and hear how she introduced generations of Americans to French cooking. At the Georgetown waterfront, sink your teeth into a farm-to-table taco loaded with seasonal flavor. Stroll past the historic C&O Canal, catch a glimpse of the legendary Blues Alley jazz club, and see the Old Stone House, the oldest unchanged building in D.C. Save room for one of the city's favorite cupcakes from a beloved local bakery, plus our Secret Dish, a surprise bite that captures the true character of Georgetown.

experiences.title: Tastes of Georgetown Food & History Small Group Walking Tour
experiences.description: Georgetown is DC's oldest neighborhood, and Blue Fern Travel brings its history to life through food. Every booking gives back to the community we walk through.

Its roots are still very much alive and can be seen in the red brick town homes, and turn of the century factories that are found throughout the area. experiences.title: Adams Morgan Food Tour
experiences.description: Adams Morgan has been known for its diversity and ethnicity for most of the 20th century. The turn-of-the-century neighborhood has retained its historic charm while becoming the district's destination for both eclectic cuisine and nightlife. Join us and visit some of the most notable watering holes in the city of Washington DC, where politicians came to relax after a busy day of lawmaking. The only catch is that most of these politicians have long since departed this life. On select nights, come have a few sips of local spirits while hearing about the city's local haunted Spirits and while exploring the beautiful streets of DC. Join us on the new Spirits of DC Haunted Pub Crawl and visit the city’s historic haunts and ghostly pubs and enjoy booze and Boo's at some of its most infamous paranormal and tipsy hotspots.

experiences.title: Hands On Cocktail Class Experience in West Palm Beach
experiences.description:
Join us for a 90 minute cocktail journey where you become the star behind the bar! Guided by Vincent’s expert tips and charming French accent, you’ll craft 3 show-stopping cocktails that combine premium spirits, handcrafted syrups, and fresh ingredients.

- Start with the art of pouring and mastering pro-level techniques.
- Create three unique, signature cocktails designed to wow any crowd.
- Indulge in a curated cheese and charcuterie board as the perfect pairing.
- Includes a video montage and photos to recap all the fun—perfect for reliving the experience and sharing with friends!
- Leave with insider secrets that will take your cocktail game to the next level.

This isn’t just a class—it’s an unforgettable experience full of creativity, laughter, and incredible drinks. Reserve your spot now and shake things up!

experiences.title: Blow your own glass bowl hosted by Glassblowing in the Garden
experiences.description: Experience the art of glass in motion with Chihuly trained artist, Conrad Williams. His glassblowing classes are rated in the top things to do in Naples, FL and his larger works are collected nationally.

experiences.title: Beach Yoga & Tea Experience on South Beach
experiences.description: Yoga is as much a physical journey as it is spiritual. I help my students to develop their practices for deep healing, transformation and, most importantly, relaxation. Through mindful sequences that emphasize alignment and the synchronization of breath and movement, students of all levels are encouraged to find and express themselves with their practice. Our goal of inspiring others makes us extra-aware of the students’ different levels and needs, encouraging them with gentle adjustments. In addition to being an entrepreneur, I'm an earnest student of life aiming to expand my mindset and implement healthy thinking habits through learning mindfulness and aiming for excellence.

experiences.title: Rum Mixology Class and Craft Cocktails
experiences.description:
The Moonshine Mixology Class is an island-themed experience where you'll learn to craft 2 tropical cocktails using signature Moonshine. The class includes:

A hands-on lesson to make 2 signature cocktails
A tasting flight of 6 craft island rums
Led by expert mixologists, you'll discover the techniques and secrets behind making perfect island-inspired drinks.

experiences.title: Miami Perfume Making Experience - Fragrance Workshop 90 Minutes
experiences.description:
Discover a one-of-a-kind experience at Tijon, where creativity meets luxury! Unlike any other activity, our perfume-making workshop lets you step into the fascinating world of fragrance creation. You'll have access to over 300 unique oils to design your signature scent, making it truly personal and unforgettable.

Perfect for couples, families, or solo adventurers, this hands-on activity combines education, fun, and indulgence. Plus, you'll take home a custom-crafted perfume as a lasting keepsake of your visit. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply looking to try something extraordinary, this is an experience you won’t find anywhere else. Book now and create memories as unique as your scent!

experiences.title: Private Italian & Mediterranean Home Cooking Class in Orlando
experiences.description: This experience stands out for its personal touch and focus on traditional, family recipes, giving you an authentic taste of Italian or Mediterranean cuisine in an inviting, private setting. Led by David in his spacious Orlando kitchen, you’ll prepare three delicious dishes from scratch, gaining hands-on experience and valuable cooking techniques. The class offers a fully customized menu based on the season and your dietary preferences, ensuring a unique and memorable meal. Conclude the experience by sharing the dishes you’ve crafted together, with a wine pairing for the perfect finishing touch.

experiences.title: Key West Custom Perfume Making Class with Champagne Toast
experiences.description: Step into our light, island-chic fragrance lab on Duval Street to craft your own custom luxury perfume or cologne. Guided by an expert perfumer, you'll sample from a curated "organ" of over 300 premium oils, blend your signature scent drop-by-drop, and take home a full-sized 55ml bottle. Celebrate your creation with a complimentary Champagne toast in a beautifully air-conditioned sanctuary away from the Key West heat!

experiences.title: Traditional Greek Cooking Class in Naples Florida
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private and authentic cooking class in a locals beautiful home. George, a professional chef, learned to cook traditional Greek dishes from his family members and professionally trained Greek chefs. This is a perfect experience for anyone looking to connect with local culture over food. Your cooking class will take place in a local home kitchen where George will teach you how to make traditional Greek family recipes. After cooking, enjoy a traditional Greek meal cooked using recipes that have been carried down from George's great great great grandparents to him! Cooking, flying and boats are some of George's passions.

• Cooking lesson in a local home
• Introduction to Greek culture and cuisine
• 100% private activity
• Experience Greek hospitality 
• Vegetarian options available

experiences.title: Miami Perfume Making Experience: Express 45 Minutes
experiences.description: At Tijon Miami, our perfume creation experience is more than just making a fragrance. It’s a fully immersive, hands-on journey where you become a perfumer for the day. Each guest gets to explore high-quality raw materials, learn professional blending techniques, and craft a truly one-of-a-kind signature scent. Unlike typical workshops, we combine education, creativity, and luxury, making it a memorable experience for individuals, groups, and special occasions.

experiences.title: PRIVATE Traditional Cuban Cooking Class in Miami
experiences.description:
Cuban food is some of the most flavorful food you’ll try and being in Miami it is an absolute must try! Cuban cooking ingredients are simple, yet savory, and the style of cooking has been influenced by many peoples that passed through the island, including the Spaniards, the Africans, the French and the native peoples.

In our quaint private residence, meet your cooking instructor and take part in a hands-on cooking lesson to include making an appetizer, a main course, and dessert. Other sample appetizers and libations will be available for your enjoyment, too! You’ll also have the opportunity to take home a copy of the recipes to so you can make a Cuban feast for your friends back at home! (Note that depending on availability and time of year, classes may be done indoors or in our outside patio area.)

experiences.title: Luxury Italian Cooking Class in Tampa (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Immerse yourself in the elegance of Italian fine dining in this hands-on cooking class in Tampa, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to a small group, this workshop with an esteemed pasta chef highlights authentic techniques and elevated flavors.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Appetizer: Savini’s funghi trifolati with garlic, olive oil and parsley
- Main course: Handmade pasta with rich Parmigiano cream sauce
- Salad: Beef carpaccio with arugula, cherry tomatoes and white truffle vinaigrette
- Dessert: Classic espresso topped with fresh whipped cream

Along the way, you’ll refine sauce preparation, knife skills and presentation, leaving with recipes and confidence to recreate Italian classics at home.

experiences.title: Exclusive Key Lime Pie Show and Tasting in Key West
experiences.description: A quick culinary adventure awaits at the Exclusive Key Lime Pie Show in the vibrant heart of Mallory Square. In just 30 minutes, discover the secrets to crafting the iconic Key lime pie, from mastering the graham cracker crust to achieving that perfect, creamy filling. After the lively demonstration, savor a slice of the world-famous pie, made without any green food coloring. Plus, take home the official recipe card to recreate this delicious treat at home, ensuring your taste of Key West lasts well beyond your visit.

experiences.title: 1 Hour of Chocolate Pizza Making Class in Jacksonville
experiences.description: The art of chocolate tempering is not something many people can say they've tried! This class leaves the machines behind and YOU work with the chocolate. Guests will get to experience a tempering demonstration and learn about different types of chocolate Guests will then head to our second floor to pick out the most delicious mix of candies and chocolates to decorate their own pizzas. No pizza is complete without cheese so drizzle some white chocolate on top to finish it off!

experiences.title: 2 Hour Pasta Making Class With Local Chef in Fort Lauderdale
experiences.description:
Roll, slice, simmer and savor in this cozy cooking class with Chef Taciana, hosted through Classpop!. Learn the art of fresh tagliatelle, starting with a simple dough and turning it into long, tender ribbons. Then, create a hearty Bolognese sauce packed with flavor from beef, garlic, onions, balsamic vinegar and tomatoes. Chef Taciana will walk you through every step — from achieving the perfect pasta texture to balancing flavors in your sauce — so you can master this Italian classic in your own kitchen. Perfect for beginners or seasoned home cooks, this experience is all about good food, great company and pasta that tastes like it came straight from Italy.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: 75 Minute Jacksonville Candy and Cocktail Guided Class
experiences.description: Our expert candy makers will teach you how to make a candy and each guests will leave with chocolates/candies to take home. We will also demo how to make the specialty cocktail you will enjoy during the class.

experiences.title: Japanese Sushi Class in Fort Lauderdale (Includes 4-Course Meal)

- Side: Seaweed salad with wakame, cucumber and sesame dressing
- Main course: Spicy tuna roll and salmon avocado cucumber roll
- Dessert: Mango pineapple sorbet topped with raspberry coulis

With hands-on guidance from your local sushi chef, you’ll gain the confidence to recreate Japanese classics at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy with their handcrafted meal in a relaxed, small-group setting.

experiences.title: Mediterranean Paella Class in Tampa (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Embark on a Mediterranean journey in this hands-on cooking class in Tampa, hosted through Cozymeal. With expert guidance, explore classic techniques and bold regional flavors across a four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Gambas al pil pil, shrimp sautéed with garlic, olive oil and spice
- Main course: Mediterranean chicken with roasted vegetables and parsley

- Dessert: Classic tiramisù with mascarpone, espresso and cocoa

This immersive workshop blends Spanish, Italian and Mediterranean traditions, leaving you with cherished recipes and confidence to bring these vibrant flavors into your own kitchen.

experiences.title: Refined Japanese Sushi Class in Tampa (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the refined techniques of Japanese sushi-making in this intimate Tampa class, hosted through Cozymeal. Guided by your local sushi chef, you’ll master rice preparation, rolling methods and knife skills while enjoying a four-course menu.

- Starter: Miso soup with tofu, scallions and savory broth
- Main course: Temaki hand roll filled with cucumber, avocado, carrots and mushrooms
- Main course: Alaskan roll with smoked salmon, cream cheese and scallions
- Dessert: Japanese double-baked sweet potato with a creamy, delicate sweetness

Enjoy your creations in a small-group setting while building confidence to recreate authentic sushi dishes at home.

experiences.title: Private Crab Island Charter with Amenities Included
experiences.description:
One of the key advantages of booking this charter is the availability of our knowledgeable guides with huge local expertise. All of our guides are well versed in navigating the emerald coast waters, they are also knowledgeable about the area's history, marine life, and hidden gems. This allows you to unlock the full Crab Island experience, all you have to do is sit back and relax.

Our charters also include an array of amenities. You can use our inflatable paddle boards to explore the various food vendors and activities on the island, hang out on our roll out lilly pad, or even use our snorkel equipment to explore the ocean floor.

experiences.title: Wynwood Graffiti Golf Cart Small-Group Tour
experiences.description: Join us on an art adventure on our Wynwood Graffiti Golf Cart Small-Group Tour. Each of our tour guides has a unique relationship with the district and brings that perspective and passion to their tours. On this tour, you will ride in a golf cart and traverse the art district: block after block of larger-than-life murals, art installations, and more. Your driver/guide will make 6+ stops selected to showcase the most interesting murals. At each stop, you will have a chance to get off the cart for pictures and for discussion. Your guide will tell the group the backstory of the art district and explain various aspects of the art on view, from technique through biographical details of the artists and interpretation of the artwork. Along the way, the guide will point out various landmarks such as the Wynwood Walls and the Museum of Graffiti. The first company to offer graffiti tours from a golf cart, we have maintained consistently high reviews and think you'll love our tour, too!

He is a firm believer in preparing his meals with lots of love and care as everyone deserves great food and drink - it is good for the soul!

experiences.title: Private Winter Haven Chain Bass Fishing Charter
experiences.description:
Unlike fishing a single lake, the Winter Haven Chain offers the opportunity to explore multiple interconnected fisheries during one private charter, giving you access to a constantly changing variety of bass habitats and scenic waterways. 

Your captain customizes the experience based on current fishing conditions, moving throughout the chain to maximize your chances of success while sharing local knowledge and proven techniques. 

Beyond outstanding bass fishing, you'll enjoy peaceful Old Florida scenery, abundant wildlife, and a relaxing escape from the crowds. 

Conveniently located between Orlando and Tampa, the Winter Haven Chain delivers one of Florida's most unique freshwater fishing experiences for anglers, families, and outdoor enthusiasts alike.

The class concludes with combining the gnocchi and sauce for a delightful Italian feast.

Begin by transforming potatoes, flour and eggs into pillowy gnocchi from scratch, mastering dough mixing, rolling, shaping and cutting as you go. Every step is beginner-friendly, relaxed and easy to follow, so you'll spend more time enjoying the process than worrying about perfection. Expect plenty of laughs, irresistible aromas and the satisfying moment when your homemade pasta comes together. Store-bought gnocchi is officially on notice.

experiences.title: 1.5 Hour Southern Essentials: Biscuits and Pimiento Cheese Class
experiences.description: The Southern Essentials Cooking Class is a 1.5-hour culinary adventure in Atlanta that immerses you in the heart of Southern comfort food. Participants will get hands-on experience making flaky, buttery biscuits, a classic pimento cheese spread, and sweet iced tea. Guided by a knowledgeable instructor, you'll learn the stories behind these cherished recipes and their significance in Southern culture. This interactive class, perfect for all skill levels, provides not just delicious food but also insights into Atlanta's rich culinary heritage. Come hungry and leave with new skills and tasty treats to enjoy.

experiences.title: Hands-on Mojito Class with Taco Lunch at Speakeasy
experiences.description: Join a refreshing and interactive mojito-making class at La Aparicion, Savannah's unique Latin American Speakeasy. Savor a welcome cocktail as you indulge in a delicious taco lunch from Latin Chicks, then dive into the art of crafting the perfect mojito with expert guidance. This fun-filled experience not only teaches you mixology techniques but also immerses you in the rich history of Savannah's favorite cocktail. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply enjoying a day out, this class is a perfect blend of culinary delight and social fun.

experiences.title: 2 Hours Cocktail Classes at Speakeasy Plus Bites
experiences.description:
Step into the enchanting La Aparicion de la Muerte speakeasy for a hands-on cocktail-making class that combines history, technique, and the vibrant flavors of Latin American appetizers. Kick off the experience with a refreshing Mint to Be Mojito, before learning to craft one of the world’s classic cocktails under the guidance of a master mixologist. With a small group capped at 20 participants, you'll receive personalized coaching and discover advanced techniques while enjoying authentic bites. This class not only elevates your cocktail skills but also prepares you for future home bar adventures with expert tips on spirits and equipment.

Best 2 hours spent with plenty of value!

Includes - 3 cocktails, Latin American Bites, Access to the Speakeasy and an amazing learning experience on Mixology by one of the top Master Mixologists in the region!

experiences.title: Golden Isles Georgia Pop Up Tea Flight Tasting Experience
experiences.description: Experience tea in a fun and interactive way during this intimate 30-minute tasting session. Sample four carefully selected teas while learning about their origins, how they are crafted, and what makes each variety unique. Unlike simply enjoying a cup of tea, this guided experience introduces you to professional tasting techniques, proper steeping methods, and the distinct flavor notes found in every tea. Whether you're new to tea or already a tea lover, you'll leave with a deeper understanding of tea culture and the confidence to appreciate and brew tea like an expert.

experiences.title: 1-Hour Atlanta Spice Laboratory Spice Blending Experience
experiences.description:
This is a flavor-packed experience that you can take home with you!

Join Unexpected Atlanta, the city’s #1-rated tour company with over 2,400 glowing reviews and a decade of delicious storytelling for a one-hour journey where tasting and creating come together.

To understand the magic of spices, you’ll head into our Spice Lab for a hands-on session that’s part experiment, part creativity.
You’ll play with spices in a whole new way, exploring things like why cinnamon doesn’t mix with water, how alliums deepen and transform over time, and what actually happens when flavors bloom, toast, or rest during different guide-led spice experiments.
Then it’s your turn.
Using what you’ve learned, you’ll create two of your own custom spice blends to take home.
It’s relaxed, a little nerdy in the best way, and a lot of fun.

Conveniently located in downtown Atlanta near Centennial Olympic Park, it’s easy to fit this experience in before or after your visit to the main tourist sites.

experiences.title: Private Atlanta Cooking Class with a Fun Local Chef Naina
experiences.description: Enjoy a private and authentic Indian cooking class in Atlanta with your host Naina, with the option to enjoy your meal together, take it home, or add a market tour. This is a perfect experience for anyone looking to connect with local culture through food. Meet Naina at her beautifully designed home and kitchen in Decatur, 20 minutes from midtown Atlanta. Join her in her contemporary kitchen and sip on a refreshing drink as you learn to cook an Indian-inspired seasonal meal. Naina is a culinary entrepreneur, and teaching people how to cook brings her utmost joy! Her passion for food, cooking and spices has taken her on a mission to demystify the cuisines of India, Persia and the Near East. A warm and fun host, Naina is excited to share the joy of making chaat (Indian street food) and Indian-inspired Southern dishes. During this fun and interactive experience, you’ll get hands-on cooking instruction while learning about the flavors, spices and techniques behind the dishes you prepare.

experiences.title: Private Ayurvedic Vegetarian Cooking in Savannah with Ninoska
experiences.description: Enjoy a private, off-the-eaten path, Ayurvedic cooking class with your host Ninoska, who is passionate about healthy, plant-based cuisine. Ninoska customizes your menu based on your body composition so remember to complete the food quiz before your experience. During an extraordinary year living off the land on a permaculture farm, Ninoska learned the art of plant-based meals and fell head over heels for the nourishing and harmonious world of Ayurveda cuisine. She is excited to teach guests the joy of cooking and enjoying vegetarian cuisine at her home. Ninoska's cuisine is a celebration of flavors, from Indian to Caribbean. Her experience with the bold, flavorful dishes from her culture combined with her expertise in plant-based foods provides a really unique culinary experience. On days that she is available, Ninoska's partner Esther will join you for your experience. Her apartment is a third-floor walk-up that she shares with Esther and a little dog.

experiences.title: Make Your Own Perfume: Custom Fragrance Making Class near Atlanta
experiences.description:
This isn't a candle-bar version of perfume making. Tijon is a working parfumerie with roots in St. Martin's French Caribbean perfume tradition — and for 1.5 hours, the lab is yours.

Put on your lab coat and work beaker-by-beaker through a library of 300+ raw fragrance notes— bergamot, oud, jasmine, smoked birch, and hundreds more — building up to three complete trial formulas the way professional perfumers do: top notes, heart notes, base notes. Your perfumologist guides every step, helping you refine each blend until one smells unmistakably like you.

Then comes the best part: you bottle it. A full 55ml of your finished fragrance, hand-labeled with whatever name you give it. Your formula stays on file forever, so when the bottle runs out, your scent doesn't.

Guests have made anniversary scents, wedding-day perfumes, and bachelorette blends here — it works equally well as a date night, a girls' trip stop, or a solo creative escape from the Atlanta routine.

experiences.title: 1 Hour Guided Candle Making
experiences.description: As former teachers we love teaching others new skills! Candle making is a hands on experience where you will make a customized item and then get to take it with you!

experiences.title: Atlanta Braves Baseball Game Ticket at Truist Park
experiences.description:
While visiting Atlanta, catching an Atlanta Braves baseball game at Truist Park offers an unforgettable blend of American tradition, Southern hospitality, and world-class entertainment.
Home to one of the most historic and successful franchises, Truist Park delivers a lively, family-friendly atmosphere that appeals to visitors of all backgrounds. Located in the vibrant Battery Atlanta entertainment district, the ballpark is surrounded by restaurants, shops, and live music venues — making it an all-in-one destination for an exciting day or night out.
Perfect for solo travelers, couples, families, and groups, an Atlanta Braves game offers more than just America’s pastime — it’s a taste of Atlanta’s vibrant identity and a must-do event for any visitor.

experiences.title: Atlanta Spin Art – Create Your Own Masterpiece
experiences.description: Every canvas is one-of-a-kind! With custom spin tables no two masterpieces ever turn out the same making Spin Art a fun, surprising, and unforgettable experience for all ages.

experiences.title: Custom Lipstick or Lip Gloss Creation Experience
experiences.description: Unleash your creativity at Lip Print Beauty Bar, where you can personalize your very own lipstick or lip gloss. Guided by skilled Lip Artists, choose from an array of bases and pigments to craft a unique shade that reflects your style. Enhance your creation with special add-ons like scents and glitter, then finish by making your unique lip print and naming your masterpiece. This engaging experience is perfect for solo dates, girls night out, bridal showers, bachelorette parties, and birthdays, allowing you to indulge in a fun, memorable activity with friends. Transform your vision into a reality and let your lips be the canvas for your artistry.

experiences.title: Italian Cooking Masterclass in Atlanta (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Taste the Mediterranean in your own kitchen after this hands-on Italian class in Atlanta, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs. A homemade Caesar, fresh fettuccine Alfredo and house-churned gelato – three courses, all from scratch.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- Classic Caesar Salad with homemade dressing and Parmesan ribbons
- Homemade Fettuccine Pasta with Roman-style Alfredo sauce
- Homemade Italian Gelato with creamy espresso or lemon sorbet with biscotti crumbs

You will leave knowing how to make fresh fettuccine and a classic Italian dressing from scratch. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Yoga in Forsyth Park
experiences.description: Savannah is such a relaxing destination. Beautiful Forsyth Park offers an ideal atmosphere for a yoga class outside. This 60 minute yoga class is accessible to students of all levels and backgrounds. Teachers are adaptable and will assist in making the class suitable to your needs. Yoga mats are included but beverages are not so please bring a reusable water bottle or drink. Join a wonderful and fun class practicing yoga outside!

experiences.title: 2 Hour Historic Market Food Tour and Hands-On Biscuit Class
experiences.description:
You won’t want to miss this Atlanta food experience. In just two hours, you will try delicious tastings from 4 food vendors in Atlanta’s oldest market and become Southern cooks with a hands-on Atlanta cooking class.

You’ll learn fascinating Atlanta history and get a close look at Southern cooking and Georgia’s most famous foods, including peaches, collards, and pecans. And, you will love learning how to make the perfect Southern biscuit.

During December, you'll make fun snowman decorated biscuits!

experiences.title: Historical Electric Bike Tour and Keep
experiences.description: This tour is one of the most affordable and fun ways to see all of Savannah. Ride through beautiful historic sites with the guidance of our knowledgeable, fun, charming tour guides. See the city in style with our Class 2 Electric Bikes, perfect for a day on the town. Please note that riders in other parties may be using traditional bikes on your tour. During the tour you'll learn about the rich history, delicious food, and unique culture that make Savannah a city you never visit just once. We also provide you with everything you'll need to enjoy your ride after the tour, including a lock, helmet, and recommended route.

experiences.title: Cocktail Class in Congress Street Up
experiences.description:
Cocktail culture was born during Prohibition when alcohol was so potent and nose curling that bartenders and home brewers started combining mixers with the booze to make it more palatable!
We follow the tradition of those early mixologists and will help you learn how to make proper Prohibition Era cocktails. 
So come and enjoy a 2 hour "Intimate Cocktail Class" with award-winning bartenders at a 1920's "Speakeasy" in the American Prohibition Museum!

experiences.title: Old Savannah Distillery Cocktail Lesson with Tasting
experiences.description:
Push open the doors of Old Savannah Distillery and jump into a high-energy cocktail experience where every pour has a story. In just 30 minutes, you’ll shake, stir, and sip your way through Savannah’s spirited past, guided by expert bartenders who bring each drink—and its history—to life.

This isn’t just a class—it’s a hands-on, fast-moving session designed to keep things fun, interactive, and perfectly timed for your day. Whether you’re just getting into cocktails or looking to level up your skills, you’ll leave with insider techniques, a richer appreciation for what’s in your glass, and the confidence to craft impressive drinks long after you’ve left the bar.

experiences.title: Make a Custom Perfume! 2-hour Workshop in Alpharetta, GA.
experiences.description:
Discover the art and science of fragrance creation in our signature perfume making class—a 2-hour, immersive experience where you’ll explore the raw building blocks of fine perfumery and craft your own custom EDP.

Guided by a perfume expert, you’ll create a basic fragrance from a curated selection of professional-grade perfumer’s notes. Choose from citrus, florals, spices, and woods to create a personal fragrance that captures your unique character, mood, and style.

Along the way, we’ll discuss current trends in niche perfumery, how to confidently shop for, wear, and store your perfumes. We’ll also dive briefly into the biology and chemistry of scent.

Each guest creates a 30ml EDP, with the option to upgrade to our Luxury Package—a 50ml bottle and complimentary glass of wine/champagne to enjoy during the experience.

Whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned fragrance lover, this perfume making class is your chance to create something truly one-of-a-kind.

experiences.title: Explore Atlanta Winemaking Experience
experiences.description:
The Art of Winemaking Experience by Divine Libations offers more than just a tasting—it’s a hands-on journey where you create a wine that’s uniquely yours. Unlike traditional winery tours, we put you in control, guiding you through blending, bottling, and labeling your custom 375ml creation.

Elevate your wine with handcrafted simple syrups like Blueberry Peach or Habanero for a bold twist. Enjoy a complimentary glass of our premium wine, bring your own food (optional), and savor an unforgettable evening of creativity and connection.

This isn’t just winemaking—it’s a whole vibe.

experiences.title: Candle Pouring Workshop in Savannah
experiences.description: When it comes to creative experiences in Savannah, the candle pouring workshop offers something truly unique. We provide a welcoming atmosphere, expert instruction, and the perfect mix of fun and learning. Whether you’re a Savannah local or visiting from out of town, this workshop is a top pick for making lasting memories.

experiences.title: Perfume Making Workshop in Atlanta
experiences.description: Crafting your own perfume offers a unique opportunity to create a fragrance that reflects your individuality. This interactive experience allows you to select from an array of base, middle, and top notes, guiding you through the art of perfumery. Experiment with various scent combinations to discover your perfect blend, turning the process into a creative journey. This personalized fragrance not only serves as an expression of yourself but also makes for a memorable gift, evoking cherished memories and special occasions.

experiences.title: Ultimate Atlanta Walking Tour and Activities
experiences.description:
World class private tour, completely controlled by you! 
Come see the best sights in Atlanta, at your leisure! 

Commentary by Max Kantor, a local legend! 

Visit the sights that makes Atlanta the hotspot of the South! 

This tour of Downtown Atlanta will take you to some of the city's most famous attractions, all on foot! Have a fun day filled with history, food, and even some college football!

Don't worry about other people, this tour is completely tailored to you with the Pintours App

experiences.title: Dance Class to Empower Your Inner Dance Queen
experiences.description: A vibrant dance class designed for every woman looking to embrace her confidence and unleash her inner strength. We create a supportive community where participants can connect and empower one another through the joy of dance. No experience is necessary; it's about finding freedom of expression and transforming self-doubt into self-assurance. Witness your own growth as you learn to dance in heels, supported by a sisterhood that celebrates every move you make. This is more than a class; it’s a journey towards self-discovery and empowerment.

experiences.title: French Cuisine Cooking Class in Atlanta (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Sharpen your French technique in this hands-on cooking class, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs. A soufflé, a pan-seared duck breast and a silky mousse – each course is a foundational French skill that travels straight to your home kitchen.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- Cheese Soufflé with Gruyère cheese, eggs, milk, butter, nutmeg and lemon juice
- Seared Duck Breast and Dijon Cream Sauce with tarragon, shallots, white wine and butter
- Dauphinoise Potatoes with cream, Gruyère cheese, thyme and black pepper
- French Baguette and Butter
- Mousse au Chocolat and Fleur de Sel

Technique by technique, you will build the foundation to cook like a Parisian. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With a Local Chef in Atlanta
experiences.description: If chocolate is your love language, this class is calling your name. Led by Chef Amal, this interactive Atlanta cooking experience shows you how to make classic chocolate truffles from scratch with confidence. You’ll work with dark chocolate, cream and butter to create a velvety ganache, then shape and finish your truffles for a polished, professional look. Along the way, Chef Amal keeps things approachable, sharing techniques you can easily repeat in your own kitchen. The atmosphere is social, cozy and full of sweet rewards, making it an ideal choice for beginners, dessert lovers and anyone craving a deliciously memorable night out.

experiences.title: Fun Guacamole and Salsa Making Class With a Local Chef in Atlanta
experiences.description: Grab an avocado and get ready to make snack time a whole lot better. This relaxed, beginner-friendly cooking class shows you how easy it is to create fresh guacamole and salsa packed with bold, vibrant flavor. You'll start by mashing perfectly ripe avocados with garlic, lime, salt and pepper before moving on to fresh salsa made with tomatoes, onions, jalapeños, cilantro and garlic. Along the way, you'll practice practical knife skills, learn how to balance heat and acidity and experiment with mix-ins like mango, corn, green chiles or habanero peppers to suit your taste. The atmosphere stays fun, social and easygoing, making it just as enjoyable if it's your first cooking class as your fiftieth. Then sit down with crunchy tortilla chips and fresh vegetables to enjoy every scoop of the recipes you created yourself.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Wellness Café in Atlanta
experiences.description: Roll up your sleeves because dinner starts with dough at a laid-back Atlanta wellness cafe. You’ll combine flour, olive oil, eggs and sea salt, then learn how to knead, roll and cut fresh fettuccine into perfectly shaped noodles. Next, you’ll cook the pasta and prepare a flavorful marinara with fresh tomatoes, garlic, basil and red pepper. Toss the silky noodles through the homemade sauce and finish with Parmesan for a comforting Italian-style plate made entirely from scratch. You don’t need previous cooking experience to enjoy the process.

experiences.title: Make Your Own Candle at a Local Wine Bar in Atlanta
experiences.description: Looking for a fun thing to do in Atlanta that isn’t just another dinner reservation or crowded bar? This hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local wine bar with Instructor Charvi is a relaxed, feel-good way to slow down, get creative and make something you’ll want to take home. Perfect for both locals craving a fresh night out and travelers looking for a memorable experience in Atlanta, this beginner-friendly class brings together cozy vibes, custom scents and plenty of laughs. You’ll choose your fragrance blend, learn the basics of wax and wicks and pour your own custom candle from start to finish. Whether you’re planning a date night, solo self-care moment, girls’ night out or creative group activity, this candle making experience gives you a break from the daily stress and sends you home with a handmade souvenir that smells like your best decision of the week.

experiences.title: Sober Sips Non Alcoholic Cocktail Workshop
experiences.description: Craft exquisite non-alcoholic cocktails in this hands-on workshop. Under the guidance of Chef Camille, explore the art of mocktail-making as you learn to balance flavors and create stunning presentations. Over a cozy evening, you’ll whip up three signature drinks featuring roasted fruits and warm spices, paired with delightful light bites. Perfect for anyone looking to elevate their drink game without the alcohol, this beginner-friendly class promises a relaxed atmosphere and a chance to savor your creations with friends.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Atlanta
experiences.description:
This sushi-making class with Chef Jennifer offers a fun and flavorful culinary experience in a buzzing brewery setting. Designed for all skill levels, this hands-on class takes you through the step-by-step process of crafting delicious, homemade sushi in a relaxed, social atmosphere.

Chef Jennifer will guide you in mastering the fundamentals, starting with preparing perfect sushi rice before diving into essential knife skills to slice fresh avocado, cucumber, and mango. You’ll then roll a classic California roll with surimi, avocado, and cucumber, along with a colorful veggie roll packed with fresh, vibrant flavors.

Once your sushi is complete, kick back and enjoy your creations. To elevate the experience, pair your sushi with a craft beer from the brewery’s rotating tap list (available for purchase), making this an unforgettable foodie adventure. Perfect for friends, couples, or solo foodies looking for a hands-on, social cooking class.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Wine Bar in Atlanta
experiences.description:
This hands-on sushi-making class with Chef Jennifer offers a flavorful and fun culinary experience in a charming wine bar setting. Ideal for foodies, friends, or couples, this interactive class walks you through every step of making fresh sushi from scratch while enjoying a relaxed, social atmosphere.

Chef Jennifer will teach you how to prepare perfect sushi rice, slice fresh produce like avocado, cucumber, and mango, and roll two delicious sushi varieties. You’ll create a classic California roll featuring avocado, cucumber, and surimi, plus a colorful veggie roll packed with fresh, bright flavors.

Throughout the class, you’ll pick up expert tips for rolling and slicing, ensuring you can recreate your sushi-making skills at home. When the cooking’s done, dig into your creations and, if you’d like, pair them with a glass of wine from the bar’s selection (available for purchase) for the ultimate sushi and wine combo.

experiences.title: Savannah After Dark: A Haunted Donut & Sweet Treats Food Tour
experiences.description:
As twilight settles over Savannah’s Historic District, Savannah After Dark invites you to experience the city once the sun goes down. The crowds fade, gas lamps glow, and the streets take on a mysterious charm. This evening walking tour blends comforting sweets with Savannah’s haunted history for a cozy, slightly spooky, and genuinely fun experience.

Start with warm, pillowy beignets as your guide shares tales of Savannah’s past, from ghostly encounters to local legends. Stroll through oak-lined squares while enjoying a variety of sweet treats, from pastries to nostalgic Southern favorites. Along the way, hear stories tied to the very streets beneath your feet.

With a relaxed pace, plenty of tastings, and an unforgettable atmosphere, this tour is part dessert crawl, part ghost walk, and a truly unique way to explore Savannah after dark.

experiences.title: Reality ATL Restaurant Tour (Food Crawl)
experiences.description:
Are we celebrating a special occasion?! Let Chit Chat Atlanta Tours Celebrate YOU during our food crawl, "The Reality ATL Restaurant Tour"...

Craving more than history? Our food tour, "The Reality ATL Restaurant Tour" adds a flavorful twist—giving you a taste of the city's modern Black excellence through food. From viral bites to culinary gems featured on TV, this tour blends entertainment with every forkful.

Whether you're a first-time visitor or a curious local, Chit Chat Atlanta Tours offers more than sightseeing—it’s a journey into the culture, courage, and creativity that define the city. Let Atlanta tell you her story. You just have to taste it.

experiences.title: Private North Georgia Wine Tour – Your Day, Your Wines!
experiences.description:
Leave the crowds behind and discover North Georgia wine country your way! Enjoy a private, personalized wine tour designed around you and your group. Visit three carefully selected wineries while taking in beautiful mountain scenery and discovering both popular destinations and hidden gems.

From pickup to return, your day is relaxed and hassle-free. Your personal guide handles the driving, logistics, timing, and local knowledge, allowing you to focus on the wine and the experience. Unlike large group tours, I stay with you throughout the day—not simply drop you off and disappear.

Whether you're celebrating a birthday, anniversary, wedding, girls' getaway, couples' trip, or simply looking for a memorable day in the mountains, I'll tailor the experience to your interests whenever possible.

Come for the wine. Stay for the views, stories, people, and memories.

Your day. Your group. Your wines.

experiences.title: Savannah Sweet Treats Food Tour: Donuts, Pastries, History & More
experiences.description: Experience the Underground Donut Tour in Savannah—a fun and flavorful way to explore this charming Southern city! As you stroll along Broughton Street and visit historic Wright Square and Johnson Square, you’ll enjoy a variety of delicious donuts and sweet treats from some of Savannah’s best local spots. Along the way, our guides will share fascinating stories about Savannah’s rich history and culture. The tour wraps up at the lively City Market, making it a perfect outing for family and friends. With plenty of laughs, memorable moments, and Instagram-worthy photo stops, this tour is a must-do for anyone with a sweet tooth and a love for adventure!

experiences.title: 2.5 Hour Atlanta Local Food + Victorian Cemetery Tour
experiences.description:
Sink your teeth into Southern history on this unforgettable culinary adventure through Grant Park, Atlanta!

On this 2.5-hour food and history tour, you’ll indulge in 8 crave-worthy tastings, from soul-warming classics to bold new spins on Southern favorites, at 3 of our favorite local restaurants. Each bite tells a story, blending centuries of culinary innovation with the flavors that define the South today.

As you stroll through the picturesque Grant Park neighborhood and the storied grounds of Oakland Cemetery (one of Atlanta's top tourist destinations), your small group will explore the lives of the trailblazers and pioneers who helped turn Atlanta into the cultural and foodie capital it is today.

Led by one of our passionate local guides, you’ll uncover how food has fueled change, built community, and preserved tradition, proving that Atlanta truly is the city built on food.

Come hungry for history and ready to discover the delicious side of the South you never knew existed!

experiences.title: Ponce City Market & Betline Food, History, Street Art 2 hour Tour
experiences.description: Ponce City Market is Atlanta's coolest destination, tucked inside the city's hippest neighborhood on the BeltLine. Housed in a converted Sears, Roebuck & Co. building this curated food hall is packed with some of Atlanta's best restaurants. Along the way, you'll sink your teeth into an award-winning cheeseburger from James Beard Award winner Chef Linton Hopkins, plus a toasty Cuban sandwich from James Beard Award nominee Chef Hector Santiago the kind of bites locals actually line up for. Your guide will walk you through the building's fascinating history, from mail-order catalog warehouse to Atlanta's most-loved gathering spot, sharing the stories and quirky details most visitors never hear. Then you'll stroll along the Atlanta BeltLine's Eastside Trail, taking in the ever-changing street art scene that makes this stretch of the city so iconic. Part food crawl, part history lesson, part outdoor adventure this tour is the ultimate way to learn about Atlanta and eat like a local!

experiences.title: Atlanta Beltline & Historic Inman Park Food, Art & History Tour
experiences.description:
We've been hosting guests on our food, history, and street art tours for 11 years because we deliver 5-star service every single time. We partner with more James Beard Award-winning and nominated restaurants than any food tour in the state, so we're not the only ones saying our restaurants are the best bites. All our restaurants are locally owned and so are we. 

Booking with us guarantees your spot every tour runs, rain or shine. No minimums, no last-minute cancellations, no "we need two more people to make this happen." Just show up hungry.

You'll walk the BeltLine and historic Inman Park, taste your way through standout local spots, hear the stories behind one of Atlanta's most storied neighborhoods, and stop for the street art you'll actually want to photograph. Come for the food, stay for the city.

experiences.title: True South Lunch Tour
experiences.description: Discover Savannah through its food on a small-group, 3-hour walking tasting tour that connects Southern and Low country cuisine with the city’s history, architecture, and culture. Visit several local restaurants and foodie spots while sampling Savannah favorites such as shrimp and grits, fried green tomatoes, she-crab soup, beignets, and Southern sweets. Tastings add up to a full meal, and one alcoholic drink or non-alcoholic alternative is included. Along the way, your local guide shares entertaining stories about Savannah’s historic streets, city squares, landmarks, and food traditions, giving you a delicious introduction to the Hostess City beyond the usual sightseeing tour.

experiences.title: Haunted Savannah Booze and Boos Ghost Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Nightly Spirits Historic Haunted Pub Tours take a look at some of the spookiest places in Savannah while allowing time to really enjoy the "spirits" along the way. Our tours stop at several different haunted bars and give you a look into their haunted and historic past. Come try us out, this isn't your ordinary ghost tour and we are confident that you will love our pirate guides!
*Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
*All guests must be 21+ with Valid ID. Alcohol is not included.

experiences.title: True Crime Pub Crawl - the Original Savannah Murder Tour
experiences.description:
Savannah's original True Crime tour experience!

A twilight investigation through Savannah's murderous, scandalous, fascinating past, complete with serial killers, crimes of passion and compelling, unsolved cases. 

Visit scenes of notorious villains, discovering the secrets of the best true crime cases, all while visiting our finest cocktail bars and enjoying lovely 'to-go' drinks as we stroll through charming Savannah.

This is not another ghost-tour or a generic bar crawl. It is a dark, funny, researched, and atmospheric night out for travelers who want Savannah’s stranger side with drinks available along the way.

Mad Cat Tours created a unique, guided, adults-only walking tour that blends real murder stories, scandalous local history, and curated bar stops.

experiences.title: Battles & Brews Pub Crawl in Savannah
experiences.description:
Raise a glass to the past on Battles & Brews, Savannah’s only Civil War-themed pub crawl! Walk the historic streets where soldiers marched, generals strategized, and the city’s fate hung in the balance. At each stop, you’ll uncover gripping tales of espionage, occupation, and rebellion—while enjoying your favorite drinks in atmospheric pubs along the way. This tour blends bold history with cold brews, perfect for anyone who loves a great story with a side of spirits. Drink where history happened—and discover the war like never before.

If you have 10 or more guests in one group, please get in touch with the private & group sales coordinator with Ghost City Tours.

experiences.title: Atlanta Beltline Food & Street Art Tour with Cocktail, Chocolate
experiences.description: Discover why the Atlanta Beltline is one of the city's most exciting food destinations on this small-group Food & Street Art tour. Visit 5 locally owned restaurants and specialty food stops, including Krog Street Market, named America's #1 food hall by Newsweek. Enjoy Southern favorites, international flavors, a refreshing cocktail, and handcrafted chocolates from a local micro-factory. Along the way, uncover the stories behind Atlanta's largest outdoor art gallery and take part in a fun interactive street art experience. With less than a mile of walking and plenty of food, it's one of the most delicious ways to experience Atlanta.

experiences.title: Helen N. Georgia Private Winery Tour, Dine and Shop from Atlanta
experiences.description: Journey through beautiful and stunning North Georgia on this half-day tour from the Atlanta metropolitan area. Your private chauffeur will pick up your group from your hotel or private residence anywhere in the Atlanta metropolitan area, as well as drop you off at the end of the tour. Your group will visit a couple of amazing vineyards and explore North Georgia with an expert guide who handles all the driving as your private chauffeur, leaving your group free to enjoy wineries, shop and dine in downtown Helen, sit back and relax, and enjoy the incredible scenery. This tour requires a minimum of 2 and most seating is limited to 6 participants, so you can enjoy a more intimate experience of Georgia’s natural mountain landscapes. 7+ participants will be in multiple vehicles and/or a shuttle van.

experiences.title: North Georgia Wine Country Tour from Atlanta
experiences.description: Full-day trip from Downtown Atlanta to the North Georgia Wine Country. Admire the rolling hills and vineyards that make up Georgia’s premier wine region.  Visit three celebrated wineries for approximately 13 wine tastings. After the wine tastings we will visit Helen, GA for lunch, a re-creation of a Bavarian Alpine village, complete with cobblestone streets. Helen has more than 200 specialty and import shops offering everything from candle making and glass blowing to cuckoo clocks and quilts. A taste of Germany in North Georgia.

experiences.title: Southern Traditions Dinner Tour
experiences.description:
Flavors Food Tours is Savannah’s premier food tour experience, serving fresh local cuisine with an emphasis on Southern regional flavors in a small tour atmosphere. This adult-only tour is boutique and intimate, essentially dining with a friendly local who is going to show you around town.

Our food tour menu is both Southern and “of the sea," highlighting Lowcountry staples such as stone-ground Shrimp n Grits and farm-to-table oysters hand-picked off the Eastern coast. When it comes to seafood, fresh is best. Wash it all down with a drink from Georgia's most famed and award-winning English Pub, the Six Pence & you'll understand Southern Charm. 

In between bites & sips at multiple tasting spots your fun guide will share the authentic side of Georgia's oldest city: its quirky personality, rich cuisine & interesting history. 

You'll leave with context and the behind the scenes story as to why we eat what we do. Join us and say “I ate my way through Savannah” with Flavors Food Tours.

experiences.title: Savannah First Squares Culinary & Cultural Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
For the most complete calendar and more details, please visit our website directly.

Experience the diverse and distinctive cuisine of Savannah and learn about the city's history, architecture and culture on this 3-hour walking tour. Stop at several restaurants and specialty food stores while sampling regional favorites and surprising local cuisine. 

This tour is an ideal way for visitors and residents alike to learn more about Savannah while enjoying intriguing food samples that add up to a delicious lunch.

This small-group tour is limited to 14 people for a more intimate experience. Visit our website directly for the most up-to-date calendar and availability.

experiences.title: Atlanta Accelerated 3 Hr Bus Tour. History. Food & ATL Shopping
experiences.description:
Experience Atlanta through two powerful lenses—its historic roots and its modern-day rise. This hop on-hop off experience is a 3-hour guided tour that takes you on a journey through the city’s most influential districts tied to the Civil Rights Movement & leaders like Dr. King, Ralph David Abernathy, and Alonzo Herndon. We also present experiences introducing you to the new wave of creative experiences, entrepreneurs, and tastemakers shaping Atlanta today.

 As the tour unfolds, we focus on Atlanta stories that blossomed into million dollar concepts, the music scene, and the thriving food scene that is driving social media crazy and locals crazy. This tour includes Tyler Perry Studios or the famous Outkast mural—perfect for capturing the spirit of the city. More than just sightseeing, this tour creates space for real conversation. Don't miss out on this all inclusive city tour that only Hop'N Go focuses on.

experiences.title: Atlanta Sightseeing City Tour— Lunch Stop Chattahoochee Food Work
experiences.description: If you’re looking to experience the most of the city in a short amount of time, our 4-hour Roundabout City Tour has been carefully crafted to offer a fantastic insight into Atlanta. Our Atlanta City Tour condenses 3-4 days of independent exploration into a 4-hour tour. On this tour, you’ll see historical and cultural sites, high-rise towers, spectacular city skyline views, and beautiful Southern mansions, to name a few attractions. We understand that you want to experience as much as possible, and that’s why we tend to go further than any other tour company in the City of Atlanta. Rather than stick to one district, we’ll take you to Downtown, Midtown, and Buckhead to expand your awareness of Atlanta’s culture and history. Our tour allows time for up to three stops, so you can explore the destinations of your choice and take some photos. We'll take you to iconic spots such as MLK Jr.’s birth home, Underground Atlanta, The Varsity, for the perfect overview of our eclectic city.

experiences.title: Big Island: Craft Chocolate Tasting and Farm Tour in Hilo
experiences.description:
This is Hawaii's most in-depth chocolate experience. Our 1.5-hour chocolate tasting and our 3.5-hour guided farm tour at Honolii Orchards are both led by experts in the craft chocolate industry and offer an immersive journey through the world of cacao. 

3.5 hour farm tour guests will walk the orchards, explore every stage of production—from harvest to post-harvest processing—and learn how chocolate is made. No question goes unanswered; the tour adapts to your curiosity, offering a collegiate-level, educational experience shaped by your interests. The 10+ bar tasting is also included.

1.5 hour chocolate tasting guests will experience a condensed tour entirely in the tasting room focused on the 10+ bar chocolate tasting and a brief overview of cacao horticulture with much less time for questions. 

These tours offer a deep dive into the art, science, and soul of chocolate. For those who want more than a taste—for those who want to understand—this is Hawaii’s premier experience.

experiences.title: Corner Store Kauai Cooking Class
experiences.description:
This hands-on cooking class showcases the historical and cultural significance of 4 much-loved dishes enjoyed by Hawaii's locals. You get hands-on training from a professional, local chef. 

Guests learn to cut fresh fish for poke, make perfect rice, and balance flavors for four local sauces. 

We discuss the important differences between local dishes and Hawaiian dishes.

experiences.title: 4-Hour Kona Private Charter
experiences.description:
Perfect for all size of couples, families or extended families. Experience Kealakekua Bay, the best place to snorkel on the Big Island or find a totally new and secluded snorkel area. 

Choose whether you'd like to focus more heavily on world-class snorkeling, wildlife searching, or private spots.

After snorkeling, your captain has lunch and beverages for you. Hear all about the history of the area, the Captain Cook story. On the return trip, we hug the rugged coastline, and explore places Zodiacs with shallow drafts can get into! We show you natural blowholes, exposed lava tubes, and sea caves!

experiences.title: Maui Jewelry Making Class with Puka Shells and Pearls
experiences.description:
Join a hands-on workshop with celebrated Maui jewelry artist Mona Lisa and uncover the secrets of her craft. Set in the artist home studio atelier with a treasure trove of beads and jewelry creating an immersive experience that offers a fun and accessible introduction to jewelry making. You’ll learn about exquisite pearls—from Tahitian and Akoya to Keshi and Edison pearls—and the differences between freshwater and saltwater varieties. Dive into the fascinating history of this timeless Hawaiian tradition while picking up a few Hawaiian words as you bead your own necklace. 

Mona Lisa provides a prepared jewelry kit with all the materials you need—wire, beads, and supplies—to create one beautiful piece or multiple stunning designs. If you need extra materials, she’ll have options on hand to keep your inspiration flowing. 

Whether you're a beginner or a jewelry enthusiast, this workshop blends education, artistry, and aloha spirit into a truly memorable experience.

experiences.title: Two-hours handmade ceramic class, make your own souvenir Honolulu
experiences.description: Never tried working with clay? This is the perfect opportunity—especially while you’re on vacation! Our hand-building ceramic workshop gives you a hands-on introduction to pottery, guiding you from raw clay to a finished, functional piece you can truly use. You’ll learn how to form your mug, travel tumbler, bowl, or a set of espresso cups from scratch, understand the basics of clay structure, and explore simple techniques for adding texture and decoration. The best part? Your finished product will be fully food-safe, durable, dishwasher-friendly, and made to last for years. It’s a warm, welcoming environment designed for beginners—perfect for relaxing, getting creative, and enjoying a memorable experience during your stay in Honolulu. Join us for a fun, small-group class and a relaxing morning you’ll truly enjoy. Each session lasts 2 to 2.5 hours and is open to all ages and skill levels. If you’re unable to pick up your piece, we can ship it to you via USPS Priority Mail at cost.

experiences.title: Epoxy Resin Art and Craft Coaster Set Experience
experiences.description: You will create a set of 4 stunning coasters using resin, dried flowers, leaves, stones, and gold leaf in this unique and creative class. These coasters, crafted with food-safe resin, will not only protect your surfaces but also bring a touch of nature and elegance to your home decor. The combination of natural elements and metallic accents will add a magical and artistic flair to your living space. These handmade coasters are not only functional but also make for a thoughtful and personalized gift for friends and family. Join us in this workshop to learn the techniques and skills needed to create your own beautiful and one-of-a-kind resin coasters.

experiences.title: Baumkuchen Campfire Baking Class
experiences.description:
