Discover the city's iconic architecture and Prohibition-era charm while indulging in delectable local cuisine. From deep-dish pizza to hidden gems, savor the flavors of Chicago as a knowledgeable guide unveils the city's culinary secrets and fascinating history.

experiences.title: Haunted Chicago Booze and Boos Ghost Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Join this Chicago haunted pub tour which is a combination ghost tour and pub crawl that will take you on a walking tour to explore the fascinating history of Chicago and hear some of its most famous and creepy haunted stories. 

A costumed guide will lead tour goers on a 2.5-hour journey, offering glimpses into the past and revealing the stories of long-dead phantoms and specters who still call Chicago home. You'll visit several different bars and have time to enjoy a delicious libation (at own expense) as the guide tells them about all the spooky happenings and great history of this town!

*Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
*All guests must be 21+ with Valid ID. Alcohol is not included.

experiences.title: Chicago-Style Holiday Hike: Festive Food and Walking Tour
experiences.description:
There’s nothing more magical than downtown Chicago during the holidays. Bobby’s Bike Hike & Food Tours—internationally recognized for quality—presents the Holiday Hike, a 3-hour guided walking and food tour of the city’s top seasonal attractions.

You’ll sample Chicago favorites like deep-dish pizza, a Chicago-style hot dog, Italian beef, a chocolate brownie, and hot apple cider. Alcoholic beverages aren’t included, but holiday drink pairings can be added on-site.

Our local guides will fill the tour with festive stories—like how Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer originated in Chicago. You’ll see the classic holiday windows at the original Marshall Field’s, the Chicago Christmas tree, the Millennium Park ice rink, and enjoy VIP entry to the Christkindlmarket.

No other tour offers such a complete Chicago holiday experience!

experiences.title: Japanese Street Food Class in Beech Grove
experiences.description: Learn to make these Japanese Homestyle meals. Full of 'Umami" flavor and not too hard to make. You will receive recipes and know where to get your products to replicate a home.

experiences.title: Agafay Camel Ride, Pool & Lunch with Hotel Transfers
experiences.description: Escape the busy city and enjoy a relaxing day in the Agafay Desert. This experience combines a scenic 15-minute camel ride, access to a beautiful swimming pool, and a delicious traditional Moroccan lunch in a peaceful desert setting. You'll also visit a local women's argan oil cooperative to discover authentic Moroccan traditions. With round-trip transportation from Marrakech included, this is the perfect mix of relaxation, culture, and desert adventure in one unforgettable experience.

experiences.title: Top Shelf 14-Passenger Brewery Tour
experiences.description: We have excellent reviews! We know to treat people like we'd like to be treated. We are also very flexible.

experiences.title: 1 Hour Axe Throwing Experience
experiences.description: Located just minutes from the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway, we offer a thrilling arena where you can channel your inner warrior. With 20 axe lanes equipped with high-tech scoring systems, you'll receive expert guidance from seasoned coaches who ensure safety and technique as you learn to throw axes like a pro. Gather your friends or colleagues for unforgettable team-building events, birthday parties, or a fun night out. Enjoy a room for up to 16, and delight in a variety of games and refreshments available on site. Unleash your competitive spirit and forge unforgettable memories at this unique axe-throwing venue.

experiences.title: 2 Hour Axe Throwing Experience
experiences.description: Feel the rush of Axe Throwing in Indianapolis! Test your new targets with games like tic‑tac‑toe, bowling, alien invasion, and more. and more joy. A League‑certified coach shows safety and perfect form, then invites you to join a league. Axe‑throwing is the thrill you never knew you needed!

experiences.title: Indianapolis Mobile Pub Tour and Experience
experiences.description:
Experience Indy as a local!

Embark on an unforgettable journey through the heart of Indianapolis with our Dutch build pedal-powered pub tour, an adventure like no other! 

The first 20 minutes of your Experience starts at The Hangar where you will have the option to snag craft cocktails and local beers to-go, sign waivers, etc. From there, you'll takeoff on a 1-hour and 40-minute excursion through Indy, truly experiencing Indy like a local. 

We will take you off the beaten path. These are the spots that tourists rarely discover, offering an insider's look into the soul of the city.

Whether you’re a local looking for a new way to experience Indy or a traveler eager to see the city through a new lens, our mobile bar tour promises an exhilarating blend of laughter, camaraderie, and urban exploration.

experiences.title: Fountain Square Food Tour
experiences.description:
Fountain Square served as the southside's primary commercial corridor since the 1860's. Its laid back atmosphere, beautifully designed buildings and accessibility made it a popular neighborhood for decades. In the early 20th century, the neighborhood had more theaters than any part of Indianapolis, and became an important cultural destination. 

Fountain Square has recently seen a rapid transformation to a neighborhood with unique restaurants, and trendy art galleries located in renovated buildings. The Fountain Square Food Tour will give you an in-depth look at the area and its surroundings; from humble beginnings to grandeur, rapid decline to resurgence. We will enjoy food from long standing institutions, and hip new destinations.

experiences.title: Massachusetts Avenue Food Tour
experiences.description:
This Indianapolis food tour explores the commercial corridor bordering two of the earliest and most historic neighborhoods, Lockerbie and Chatham Arch.

Massachusetts Avenue is a prominent commercial boulevard crossing a grid of residential, commercial and industrial buildings that developed mainly throughout the 19th century. The area is also home to an expanding food scene, hosting nearly two dozen locally owned restaurants. The restaurants throughout the area are a combination of long standing local favorites dating back to the 1800's and new hot spots embracing the culinary traditions of the area.

The Massachusetts Avenue Food Tour will explore the advancement of Indianapolis cuisine over the past 150 years; from the traditions brought over by the city's original immigrants, to locally sourced progressive cuisine, all within a beautifully restored neighborhood.

experiences.title: Books, Bites& Brews - Noblesville Shopping & Foodie Walking Tours
experiences.description:
Hidden corridors. Overlooked spaces. Unexpected flavors.

Starting in North Alley, this story-forward route explores the lesser-seen paths that helped shape downtown Noblesville.

Guests will wind through side streets and historic corridors while hearing stories of early commerce, civic life, and the evolution of downtown neighborhoods.

You’ll visit a mix of off-main-path retailers and heritage shops, paired with a relaxed bite stop at a local eatery along the way.

Depending on the day’s route, the experience may conclude with a final retail visit or a casual beverage stop at a partner wine bar, taproom, or café.

What to Expect on Every Tour

• Comfortable pacing with built-in rest opportunities
• One seated stop per tour
• Less than one mile of total walking distance
• Small group size capped at 15 guests

Each experience is designed to highlight downtown walkability and support local merchants, especially during the Embrace Downtown construction season.

experiences.title: Glow Throw Special Axe Throwing Experience
experiences.description:
Experience the thrill of hurling an axe!

There is nothing in Indianapolis, Indiana, more fun and exhilarating than axe-throwing.

Your World Axe Throwing League-certified axe coach will go through safety and train you how to stick an axe like a pro! They will also likely try to get you to join one of your leagues because let’s face it – YOU NEED AXE THROWING IN YOUR LIFE, YOU DON’T KNOW IT YET!

experiences.title: Lawrenceburg Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the rich history of Lawrenceburg, Indiana, on this engaging guided walking tour that delves into the town's fascinating past along the Ohio River. Led by a local expert, explore the hidden narratives of commerce, resilience, and community as you stroll through historic downtown streets and the riverfront. Learn about the impact of river trade, floods, and the stories behind significant buildings that often go unnoticed. This tour focuses on human experiences, ensuring history feels relatable and lively.

- Approximately 1.5 hours of guided exploration through downtown and riverfront
- Small group size (2-12 guests) for personalized interaction
- Walkable terrain with frequent stops for storytelling and photos
- Ideal for history enthusiasts, couples, and visitors to local attractions

Liability Waiver Required
All participants must complete a liability waiver prior to the tour.
A secure link will be sent automatically after booking.

experiences.title: The Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery Show - Wichita, KS
experiences.description:
Now playing in Wichita, KS! The Dinner Detective is America's largest interactive murder mystery comedy dinner show! Solve a hilarious and engaging mystery while you feast on a fantastic dinner. Just beware! The killer is hiding somewhere in the room, and you may find yourself as a Prime Suspect!

Our show is very different from traditional murder mystery dinner shows. We will hide non-costumed actors in the audience that are pretending to be part of the crowd. This results in a much more social and interactive evening than with other shows. Our shows are set during the present day and take place in real time. Over the course of the night, our costumed Detectives will uncover clues, interrogate audience members that may or may not be part of the show, and help everyone get closer to solving the mystery.

experiences.title: Seasonal Cooking and Entertaining with The Mischief Maker
experiences.description: This is an intimate, host-led dining experience centered on seasonal cooking, thoughtful presentation, and the art of gathering. The experience can take place in the host’s private home or at the guest’s own home or Airbnb. Guests enjoy a beautifully prepared brunch or dinner while learning how menus are shaped by season and place, with an emphasis on relaxed, elegant entertaining rather than a formal cooking class.

experiences.title: Tasting Experience
experiences.description: Fresh Bourbon is the offering the newest, most unique Bourbon Tasting currently in Kentucky. We guide our guests through a full sensory tasting with food & aroma pairing, to help them explore and understand the complexities of Bourbon. You'll get hands on training from a professional local mixologists and build your own custom Old-Fashioned. Plus, historical tips, tricks and stories from the Bourbon world and an opportunity to explore more flavors through our seasonal craft cocktail menu. All of which are included in a dynamic tasting experience, in fact, the first Bourbon Tasting Experience in downtown Lexington, Kentucky!

experiences.title: Pour Your Own Candle Making Experience with Blending & Education
experiences.description:
Bardstown is known for their BOURBON.—but we want to offer experiences that differ slightly and will be fun for the entire group. We take a slight jaunt off the Bourbon Trail and offer an opportunity to craft your own handmade candle as well as enjoy Kentucky Made Wines and Beers. 

During your experience, you will be given a large variety of scents to choose from to blend into YOUR perfect scented candle. In addition, our large variety of candle vessels offer just the right finishing personalization for your aesthetics. As we embark on the candle making journey you will receive full education on how to label, wick, blend, make and pour your candle. Along the way we offer a variety of candle burning and safety tips that will make all future candle burning even more enjoyable. This will be the activity that everyone will be talking about when they go home.

experiences.title: Sound Bath Experience in Lexington, KY
experiences.description:
Sound baths are still rare in Kentucky, and The Sound Healing Center of Lexington is one of the only dedicated sound healing studios in the region. This isn't a yoga class with a singing bowl at the end. It's a full, intentional experience built around sound as the sole practice.

The studio itself was designed for this work, with acoustics, lighting, and comfort elements chosen to help your body settle quickly and deeply. Hammocks, zero-gravity chairs, and floor setups mean you find the position that works for you, not the one the room dictates.

Our rotating roster of facilitators each brings their own instruments and approach, so no two sessions sound exactly alike. You might encounter crystal singing bowls, handpan, gongs, rain drums, or rattles, and the combination shifts depending on who is leading.

If you've never experienced a sound bath, this is a welcoming place to start. If you have, you'll notice the difference a purpose-built space makes.

experiences.title: B&C Buffalo Trace and chuchill down
experiences.description:
Experience the perfect blend of Kentucky tradition, history, and craftsmanship with our Churchill Downs & Buffalo Trace Bourbon Tour. This carefully curated experience brings together two of the most iconic symbols of the Bluegrass State: thoroughbred horse racing and world-class bourbon.
The tour begins with a visit to Churchill Downs, home of the legendary Kentucky Derby. Guests will explore the historic grounds and museum, learning about the rich legacy of thoroughbred racing, the pageantry of Derby Day, and the deep cultural roots that make this venue world-famous.
From there, the journey continues to Buffalo Trace Distillery, one of the oldest continuously operating distilleries in the United States and a cornerstone of the Kentucky Bourbon Trail. During the guided distillery tour, guests will discover the bourbon-making process from grain to bottle, walk through historic warehouses, and gain insight into the craftsmanship behind some of the most renowned bourbons in the world.

experiences.title: 2 Hours Guided Culinary Adventures in Radcliff
experiences.description: Cleangoodeats cooking classes offer a unique farm-to-table experience, blending vibrant, fresh ingredients with creative, nutrient-packed recipes. Our classes are designed to inspire travelers to explore bold flavors, master culinary techniques, and create meals that nourish both body and soul. Each session is hands-on and interactive, giving you the opportunity to prepare delicious, healthy dishes while learning tips on how to source local, organic produce and grass-fed meats. The emphasis on flavor, health, and fun creates a one-of-a-kind culinary adventure you won’t find anywhere else.

experiences.title: James B. Beam, Heaven Hill and Lux Row Bourbon Tour
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

Join Mint Julep Experiences for this Friday bourbon tour, which includes guided transportation, 3 distillery stops for tours and tastings, and a local lunch. Guests will enjoy lunch at a local favorite, a tour and tasting at Lux Row, a Connoisseur tasting at Heaven Hill, and a tour with tastings at James B. Beam Distilling Co.

experiences.title: Louisville Bourbon Walking Tours
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

This immersive walking tour visits three iconic distilleries in NuLu, blending rich history, behind-the-scenes access, and curated tastings at every stop. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you’ll sample signature pours and unique expressions while learning how mash bills and barrel aging influence flavor. Between stops, the guide shares Prohibition-era lore, architectural highlights, and modern bourbon culture that shaped Louisville. Suitable for both bourbon enthusiasts and curious newcomers, the relaxed, walkable route finishes with local partner perks and insider recommendations.

experiences.title: Buffalo Trace Distillery Tour, Tasting, and Transportation
experiences.description:
Explore the iconic Buffalo Trace Distillery on this half-day tour from downtown Louisville. This convenient half-day tour includes round-trip transportation from downtown Louisville, the Distilled Tour & Tasting, time to explore allocated bourbons in the gift shop, and a return to the city by 2:00 p.m. It is an easy, exciting, and affordable way to visit one of Kentucky’s most iconic bourbon destinations—all for just $89.

- Convenient round-trip transportation from downtown Louisville
- Enjoy the Distilled Tour & Tasting at Buffalo Trace Distillery
- Free time to explore the gift shop after your tour
- Half-day tour, departing at 9am and returning by 2pm

Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

experiences.title: Distillery Tour at Second Sight Spirits with Spirits Tasting
experiences.description:
Experience the most future-favoring tour on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail Craft Tour®! Unravel
the mysteries of distillation, hear tales of circus life, and get the tall tale story of how two
childhood friends came together to build a distillery through luck, bartering, and Craigslist finds.
Tours always include a tasting of our Oak Eye Kentucky Bourbon, the ever-popular hazelnut
liqueur, our fine rums, and maybe even a couple of moonshines.

experiences.title: Germantown Sites & Bites: Louisville Food & History Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Get beyond downtown and experience Louisville through Germantown and Schnitzelburg, two neighborhoods that have been feeding, brewing and reinventing themselves for generations.

Historic shotgun houses and former factories sit alongside corner taverns, colorful murals, independent cafés, breweries and favorite local restaurants. Along the way, your guide connects what you’re tasting to the people and traditions that shaped these streets, from German immigrants and factory workers to today’s chefs and entrepreneurs.

Explore a side of Louisville many visitors miss
- Visit locally loved restaurants, bars and cafés
- Discover German heritage, working-class history and colorful local characters
- See shotgun houses, historic factories, murals and corner taverns
- Experience Louisville food, history and neighborhood culture together

experiences.title: Tour and Bourbon Tasting at KMAC Contemporary Art Museum
experiences.description: Visitors can expect to be immersed in a unique art environment while they are led through the flavors of our of featured bourbon, RD1.

experiences.title: Bites of the Bluegrass Cocktails & Bites Tour
experiences.description:
Embark on a spirited journey through the vibrant echoes of Lexington's East End, where each step reveals layers of history, culture, and intrigue. You'll indulge in expertly mixed cocktails and plates prepared by local chefs while your knowledgeable guide weaves a tapestry of captivating tales, transporting you through time.

Discover a fascinating connection between Kentucky and Japan, forged by visionary entrepreneurs. Hear the thundering hooves of black horsemen who once dominated the sport of kings on the sprawling track that once graced Downtown's East End. Unravel the mystery behind a vault laden with tear gas nestled within a local showroom, a relic of bygone days with stories waiting to be told.

With each revelation, you'll find yourself drawn deeper into the captivating narrative of Lexington's East End, a place where history and mystery intertwine to create an unforgettable experience.

All guests must be 21+ with proper ID.

experiences.title: Louisville Legends: 3Hr Whiskey Row Food & History Tour
experiences.description:
Eat your way through Louisville’s foodie "bucket list" with locally-owned Louisville Food Tours! Stroll down Whiskey Row and Museum Row tasting the dishes that define Derby City, including the famous Hot Brown sandwich, the original Derby Pie, chocolate bourbon truffles and modjeskas. You can also choose to add a 3-drink pairing of iconic Bourbon City drinks.

Along the way, your guide will bring Louisville’s history to life with stories of the legends who shaped the city. As you walk past cast-iron facades and historic buildings, you’ll trace the city’s evolution from a small river town to a bourbon powerhouse.

Stop for a photo with the world’s largest baseball bat at the Louisville Slugger Museum, stand beneath the gleaming gold statue of David in front of a quirky hotel/art museum, and discover Louisville's thriving culinary scene.

This tour is the ultimate way to discover the flavors and history of Derby City—just come hungry and ready to explore!

experiences.title: Haunted by History: True Crime Walking Dinner Tour
experiences.description:
We’ll begin the night with an Old Fashioned and beer cheese as we dive into Lexington’s limestone foundation — and the long-held belief that limestone can act as a portal between worlds. 

From there, we’ll walk through downtown Lexington hearing the stories that never made the brochures: serial killers who passed through town, the horses buried beneath our streets, unsolved murders, cholera graves, and the spirits that many believe still linger in our oldest buildings.

Along the way, we’ll stop for dinner courses at several downtown favorites — including burgers, tacos, pizza, and cocktails — paired with storytelling that ranges from scandal and crime to folklore and ghost lore.

This tour is not a ghost tour. This is a storytelling tour — and these stories are dangerously true.

Come hungry. Come curious. And maybe… don’t walk too far behind the group.

experiences.title: Private Louisville Food Tour with Food Tastings, Drinks & History
experiences.description:
Enjoy a carefully curated adventure through Louisville! Your exclusive private walking tour will lead you on an unforgettable journey filled with mouthwatering flavors, local stories, and a taste of Louisville’s soul. 

Choose from 3 meticulously crafted itineraries: vibrant NuLu, the Historic Highlands, or Phantoms of the Prohibition on Whiskey Row. As you stroll through each historic neighborhood, you’ll savor an array of mouthwatering dishes, from traditional Appalachian classics to culinary creations you’ll only find right here in Louisville. You'll sip bourbon, craft beer, and enjoy delicious cocktails as you learn the stories of Louisville's past.

Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you'll explore Louisville's most beautiful neighborhoods while diving into the city’s history and culinary heritage. Let the tastes and tales of this vibrant city unfold before you as you explore its culinary heritage on your private guided food tour of Louisville.

experiences.title: Distillery District Food & History Tour in Lexington
experiences.description:
Join us in Lexington’s lively Distillery District for a journey you won’t forget. This historic area was once home to one of the most important bourbon distilleries in Kentucky, founded in 1880 by legendary third-generation distiller James E. Pepper. Today, the district has been revitalized into one of Lexington’s most exciting gathering places — but the stories of bourbon, business, and big personalities still live here.

On this tour, we’ll explore the beginnings of bourbon, the drama and rivalries of early distillers, and the often-overlooked stories — including the women who helped build the bourbon industry. Along the way, you’ll enjoy great food, cocktails, and a bourbon tasting while experiencing one of Lexington’s most unique neighborhoods through storytelling.

Learn the stories you haven’t heard — and taste the district that helped build Kentucky’s most famous industry.

experiences.title: Bardstown Bourbon & Food Tour
experiences.description:
This is NOT a small bites food tour! Be sure to come hungry. Here's what awaits you:

Discover the flavor, history, and bourbon spirit of Bardstown, KY, on this guided downtown walking tour.

✔️ Stop at 4 local favorite spots

✔️ Enjoy samples of regional dishes and handcrafted treats

✔️ Sip local bourbon or bourbon-inspired beverages

✔️ Stroll through historic streets and landmarks

✔️ Hear insider stories of Bardstown’s bourbon and food culture from a knowledgeable local guide

A delicious way to explore the Bourbon Capital—one bite, one sip, and one story at a time!

Start Location:
Taste of Bardstown Market
212 N. 3rd St.
Bardstown, KY 40004

Parking:
There is a free municipal city parking lot at 112 W. Flaget St., Bardstown, KY 40004, across from Scout & Scholar Brewery. There is also free street parking on 3rd Street.

The Taste of Bardstown Tour is about one mile long and lasts about three hours.

Must be 21+ to participate.

experiences.title: Walking Food Tour Downtown Lexington
experiences.description: Learn about downtown Lexington's captivating history as we take a culinary cruise to five delicious stops all in one afternoon! Discover award-winning eateries, unique foodie items like the buzz button, freshly baked breads from family-owned shops, fresh Kentucky-farmed vegetables, and more! In between bites, learn about colorful characters from Lexington's history and pass through landmarks like Skuller's Clock, The Square, and Phoenix Park.

experiences.title: Woodford Reserve, Castle & Key, and Stitzel Weller Bourbon Tour
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

This Friday bourbon tour includes guided transportation, three distillery stops for tours and tastings, and a local lunch. Guests will experience Kentucky distillery tours with a tour and tasting at Woodford Reserve, a tour and tasting at Castle & Key, and a premium tasting at Stitzel Weller. Explore the heart of the Kentucky Bourbon Trail on this expertly crafted adventure.

experiences.title: Phantoms of Prohibition: Ghosts, Cocktails, & Bites Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Discover Louisville's Prohibition history on this haunted walking food & cocktail tour in downtown Louisville!

Travel back in time to Whiskey Row during the era of hidden speakeasies to savor handcrafted Prohibition-era cocktails paired with delicious small bites. Along the way, you'll unravel salacious true stories of Prohibition: ruthless bootleggers, Whiskey distillers, mobsters, the Louisville origins of the Great Gatsby, and even an axe-wielding temperance supporter. You'll also hear chilling ghost stories that have left their mark on the city's checkered past.

 Our expert guides will transport you to the days of secret bars and underground revelry in Prohibition-era downtown Louisville. One part ghost tour, one part Jazz-Age cocktail tour, this 3-hour immersive experience combines dinner and cocktails with spine-tingling ghost stories and a host of colorful characters from Louisville's bootlegging past. You'll leave with a taste of history- and perhaps a shiver down your spine.

experiences.title: Louisville 3-Hour Bourbon Trolley Tour with Distillery & Tastings
experiences.description:
Explore the heart of bourbon country on a 3-hour guided trolley tour through Louisville visiting the city's top bourbon destinations. Enjoy exclusive access to tasting rooms and tour a bourbon distillery. This small group tour, capped at 12 guests, is Louisville's most unique bourbon tour. As you roll through Louisville's vibrant neighborhoods in a climate-controlled historic trolley, you'll enjoy bourbon pours, craft cocktails, and delicious bourbon-infused samples. Stops vary each day, and every tour is a little different! This tour is perfect for both bourbon newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts looking to discover their next favorite bottle.

- Duration: 3 hours
- 4-6 stops including a distillery tour and bourbon tasting rooms
- Bourbon pours, bourbon cocktails, and bourbon-infused spice, sauce, and sweet samples
- Exclusive access and custom crafted experiences not bookable through anyone but us
- Discover under-the-radar bourbon brands
- Take-Home Gift: Louisville Icons Tote bag

experiences.title: Historic Walking Tour of Victorian Louisville with Food & Bourbon
experiences.description:
Escape the crowds in Old Louisville and experience a side of the city most visitors miss. Just five minutes from downtown and NuLu, the Highlands area is a local’s favorite, home to Louisville’s iconic Victorian architecture, the inventor of the Disco ball, and vibrant “Restaurant Row”. Brimming with with tree-lined avenues, opulent Victorian mansions, and quirky charm, this hidden gem is over 50 years older than Old Louisville — and far more delicious!

In the Original Highlands and Cherokee Park neighborhoods, you'll stroll tree-lined streets lined with colorful murals, blooming flowers, and grand historic homes; hear fascinating stories of immigrants, icons, and innovators; p ass the final resting places of Muhammed Ali and Colonel Sanders at Cave Hill Cemeter; and taste signature Louisville flavors at beloved local eateries you’d never find on your own.

This small-group experience includes everything you came to Louisville for: bites, bourbon, history, and charm!

experiences.title: Secrets of Louisville: 3hr NuLu Food & History Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Explore vibrant NuLu & historic Butchertown with locally-owned Louisville Food Tours on the original Nulu food tour to taste the flavors of Louisville! Over the course of 3 immersive hours, you'll visit local eateries and enjoy delicious bites that showcase Louisville's culinary heritage. Dishes include biscuits & gravy with roots in the foothills of Appalachia, Kentucky-style fried chicken, a Louisville BBQ dish, bourbon balls, a Prohibition-era Hot Brown gravy, and barrel-aged craft beer.

As you wander through the historic streets of two of Louisville's oldest neighborhoods, you’ll uncover the stories behind the city’s rich history, visit a historic home once occupied by Thomas Edison, sample a unique confection inspired by a Victorian actress, and trace the paths of the immigrants who shaped Louisville. 

This tour typically sells out. Reserve your spot early and come hungry!

experiences.title: B&C Bourbon Experience Tour
experiences.description:
Our Bourbon Tour offers a personalized and authentic experience in the heart of bourbon country. Guests can choose three of the finest distilleries, selected based on availability and personal preferences, where they will enjoy guided tours, tastings, and a deep dive into the rich history and craftsmanship of bourbon.

The tour can be arranged with private luxury transportation for a more exclusive experience, or with public transportation for groups of up to 11 people, always ensuring a smooth, comfortable, and well-organized journey.

Every detail is thoughtfully designed to deliver a memorable experience, combining flexibility, comfort, and exceptional service from start to finish. ✨

experiences.title: Beyond the Barrel: NuLu Walking Bourbon & Food Pairing Experience
experiences.description:
Uncover the secrets of Kentucky bourbon! Go beyond the barrel to dive into bourbon's storied history - and learn all the stories they won't tell you on a Kentucky Bourbon Trail distillery tour. 

Visit award-winning restaurants and intimate tasting rooms in NuLu, a neighborhood recognized as one of “The Best Food Neighborhoods in the USA”. 

Trace the origins of bourbon whiskey from its roots in the Appalachian foothills to today's thriving bourbon scene, and leave with a profound understanding of bourbon's cultural importance in Louisville, Kentucky and beyond. 

Unlock bourbon's surprising versatility and depth of flavor through paired bites, pours, and cocktails, and land a few coveted tables at some of the most hard-to-book restaurants in town.

Perfect for both bourbon newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts, this guided walking tour offers an experience that you won't find at any bourbon distillery. Reserve your spot early to experience the world's only walking food & bourbon tour!

experiences.title: Angel's Envy, Stitzel-Weller and Kentucky Artisan Bourbon Tour
experiences.description:
Come discover why Mint Julep Experiences is the leading expert on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail - with nearly 20 years of experience, over 1 million guests served, and more than 5,000 5-star reviews!

Guests will start the day with a tasting at Stitzel-Weller, enjoy a tour and tasting at Angel's Envy after lunch at a local favorite, and a tour and tasting at Kentucky Artisan (home of Jefferson's Reserve).

experiences.title: Cincinnati History & Sightseeing Bus Tour
experiences.description:
Our unique multimedia tour will not only tell you the rich history, but show you archived photos on 6 color monitors as it has evolved over the past 200 years. There's simply nothing that compares to this tour.

Whether you are a local resident, or just visting this amazing city, you will leave with a full understanding of how the area evolved, and the wonderful landmarks that stood the test of time. Our tour is chalked full of fun facts and the most notable historic buildings and places on both sides of the Ohio River. We just can't wait to tell you their stories! 

We are Cincinnati's only mobile tour Bus company that can show you this much of the areas history from the comfort of you seat. If you're planning a visit to Cincy, you'll want to take this tour first. By the end of the tour, you will have compiled a long list of things to do next during your visit.

Have a large group? call us to learn about Private tours for your outing.

experiences.title: Louisville Food Tour with 5 Local Authentic Tastings
experiences.description:
Downtown Louisville has a rhythm all its own, where river air carries the sweet, oaky scent of aging barrels and cast-iron facades on historic Whiskey Row tell the story of bourbon pioneers. This tour ditches the tourist haunts and gets straight to what makes Louisville tick: its food.
As we wander Museum Row and the riverside, you'll indulge in spirit-infused chocolates revealing deep notes of Kentucky's finest bourbon, bite into a Short Rib Grilled Cheese with braised short ribs, gruyère, provolone and caramelized onions on toasted homemade brioche, and dip warm pretzels into zesty beer cheese, a regional staple with deep Kentucky roots.
Because we keep groups to a maximum of 12 guests, it feels like exploring with a friend who knows all the best spots. We'll also stop at a family-run dairy churning premium ice cream since the 1800s, and pause for our Secret Dish, a savory, melted tribute to this city's legendary comfort food tradition!

experiences.description:
The Kentucky Bourbon Experience You’ve Been Looking For

Discover the authentic spirit of Kentucky on a carefully curated bourbon experience designed to maximize your day—not your time on the road.

✔ Visit 3 Kentucky bourbon distilleries

Perfect for first-time visitors and bourbon enthusiasts looking for more than a standard sightseeing tour.

experiences.title: Spirits Distillery Guided Tours and Tastings in Louisville
experiences.description:
Discover the art of crafting spirits near Nulu in downtown Louisville. This intimate 1000 square foot nano distillery invites you to explore unique Italian-inspired spirits and liqueurs through guided tours and tastings. Taste small-batch products that highlight the rich history and science behind distilling. Perfect for spirits enthusiasts seeking to expand their palate and learn about the distillation process in a cozy setting. 

- Enjoy guided tours at Kentucky's smallest distillery
- Sample exclusive small-batch spirits and liqueurs

experiences.title: Podcast Tour How Bourbon Resurrected Louisville
experiences.description:
Discover the intoxicating story of how a single spirit brought a city back from the brink. This immersive walking tour takes you through the heart of downtown Louisville, revealing how the booming bourbon industry didn't just fill glasses, but literally saved the city's architectural soul. From 19th-century cast-iron facades rescued from the wrecking ball to abandoned factories transformed into cultural beacons, you will explore the sensory, historical, and economic forces of the Bourbon Renaissance.

A 2.2 km self-guided tour with 6 stops over 87 min
Ideal for travelers interested in Foodways & Culinary Identity and History & Memory
Immersively told in a podcast style by experts and locals
Matching audio content, AI guide and navigation through the app

Finally, unleash your creativity at the DIY voodoo doll bar, where you'll dress & personalize your own doll. We then Baptize it, name it, and show you how to nurture! If you don't want a voodoo doll, try a metaphysical swag bag.
 This engaging experience lasts between75 minutes to 2 hours. And you can always upgrade your reading longer too!

experiences.title: Hands-on Cajun Roux Cooking Class in New Orleans
experiences.description:
The Mardi Gras School of Cooking does small, intimate hands-on classes in the French Quarter. Classes are more like a dinner party with friends. Feel welcomed into our kitchens by the Chefs themselves. From the moment you arrive until you roll out the door our Chefs are friendly, personable and entertaining. Not to mention their culinary skills are impeccable. 

Our minimum class size is 2 people. A solo traveler may join an already scheduled class. Call us to hear about the available classes. 

For parties of 8 or more, you will have to contact us directly to book. We have questions.

experiences.title: New Orleans Hands-on Brunch Class
experiences.description: Join us for a True New Orleans style brunch! The South is known for Brunch, so let us show you how it’s done in New Orleans. Bottomless champagne, mimosas, wine, beer, sodas, and water are included. In this hands-on class, we will be making some of our favorite recipes. You will work alongside of the Chef learning the best ways to cut and prep the Holy Trinity. We are the only Cooking School that does small, intimate hands-on classes in the French Quarter. Our class size ranges from 2 people to 10. Classes are more like a dinner party with friends!

experiences.title: Hands-on Cajun Traditions Cooking Class

The Mardi Gras School of Cooking does small, intimate hands-on classes in the French Quarter. Classes are more like a dinner party with friends. Feel welcomed into our kitchens by the Chefs themselves. From the moment you arrive until you roll out the door our Chefs are friendly, personable and entertaining.
