experiences.title: Asian Fusion Sushi Class in Baltimore (4-Course Menu)
experiences.description:
Discover bold flavors and hands-on techniques in this Asian fusion cooking class in Baltimore. This workshop explores both sushi traditions and modern fusion favorites.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- Starter: Sweet and spicy edamame glazed with honey, soy and chili
- Sushi: Classic California roll with sushi rice, crab, avocado and sesame
- Main course: Chicken fried rice packed with vegetables, egg and savory soy-based sauce
- Dessert: Silky coconut mango mousse topped with whipped cream and lime zest

With step-by-step instruction from a local sushi chef, you’ll sharpen knife skills, learn the secrets of sushi rice and discover techniques for balancing Asian-inspired flavors. Set in a relaxed Baltimore kitchen, this class combines gourmet learning with vibrant dining. Guests may bring their favorite wine or beer to enjoy alongside the meal.

experiences.title: Baltimore Mozzarella Cheese Making Class with Local Chef
experiences.description:
This hands-on class with Chef Jesse teaches the art of fresh mozzarella from scratch. You’ll start with simple ingredients — whole milk, salt and water — and learn how to transform them into tender, stretchy mozzarella using traditional cheese-making techniques. Chef Jesse walks you through heating, curd formation and the satisfying process of pulling and shaping fresh cheese.

Once your mozzarella is ready, turn it into a classic Italian dish. Slice ripe heirloom tomatoes, layer them with fresh basil and your handmade cheese, then finish the Caprese salad with extra virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze.

Hosted at a trendy Baltimore venue, this beginner-friendly experience includes expert instruction, all ingredients and a fresh Caprese meal you’ll enjoy at the end of class. It’s simple, authentic and incredibly delicious.

experiences.title: Cooking or Baking Lesson with a Maryland Local Karen in her Home
experiences.description:
Join professional chef Kelila in her kitchen for a hands-on experience, where you will get to cook right along with her. Kelila has been a professional culinary instructor for many years and will walk you through every step of creating a great meal. The cooking portion of the experience will last for 1-2 hours, during which you will learn to make a starter, a main dish, and a dessert. You will be cooking a seasonal meal that showcases local ingredients and flavors from around the world - Pacific Rim and Kiwi cuisine. A few dishes that you may try are Hawks Bay plum and manuka honey glazed lamb ribs, plov (rice and carrots cooked in a seasoned broth), grilled peach and avocado salad, or stone fruit pavlova. Kelila has a very charismatic and bubbly personality, and is keen to share her knowledge of food and different cuisines, so make sure you ask her heaps of questions!  

Don't miss out on this wonderful culinary experience with a welcoming local!

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Trendy Local Restaurant in Baltimore
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local restaurant in Baltimore. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Erica will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class at a Local Brewery in Baltimore
experiences.description: Skip the frozen aisle and discover just how fun dumpling making can be. In a relaxed culinary studio, this beginner-friendly cooking class breaks the process into simple, hands-on steps that make every fold feel achievable. You'll prepare a savory dumpling filling, learn how to fill and seal wrappers with confidence, and practice shaping dumplings using techniques you can recreate at home. Along the way, you'll pick up practical skills for portioning, folding and creating tightly sealed dumplings that cook beautifully. Finish by serving your handmade dumplings with a flavorful dipping sauce and enjoy every warm, satisfying bite. It's equal parts comfort food, creativity and a skill you'll be happy to show off.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class With a Local Chef in Baltimore
experiences.description:
Learn the satisfying art of dumpling folding in a lively Baltimore setting.

In this interactive cooking class, Chef Jesse guides you step by step through crafting delicious dumplings from scratch. You’ll start by mixing a savory filling of ground chicken or shrimp with napa cabbage, garlic and ginger, learning how aromatic ingredients build depth of flavor.

Then move on to the delicate technique of wrapping and pleating dumplings, transforming simple wrappers into beautifully shaped bites. Chef Jesse demonstrates the folding patterns that give dumplings their signature look while ensuring they cook evenly.

As your dumplings finish cooking, whisk together a sweet-tangy dipping sauce made from soy sauce, brown sugar, rice wine vinegar and lemon juice. Enjoy your handmade dumplings at the end of class and leave with skills you can recreate anytime at home.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class With a Local Chef in Baltimore
experiences.description: Discover the surprisingly satisfying art of homemade sushi in this lively cooking class with Chef Brandi in Baltimore. Hosted at a stylish local venue near some of the city’s buzzing dining and nightlife districts, this hands-on experience combines creativity, connection and practical culinary skills in a relaxed social atmosphere. Chef Brandi guides you step-by-step through the foundations of sushi making, from preparing fluffy seasoned sushi rice to mastering rolling techniques with nori and fresh fillings. You’ll build a classic California roll with surimi, avocado and cucumber before creating a vibrant veggie roll layered with mango, avocado and crisp cucumber. Throughout the experience, Chef Brandi shares approachable techniques that help even total beginners feel confident rolling sushi by the end of class. All fresh ingredients and cooking tools are included, and you’ll sit down afterward to enjoy the sushi feast you created yourself.

experiences.title: Fun Tortilla Salsa and Guacamole Cooking Class in Baltimore
experiences.description: Tortillas taste a whole lot better when you make them yourself. At a Baltimore brewery, you’ll start with flour, water and salt, then mix, roll and shape your dough into fresh tortillas ready for the griddle. Once those are cooking, you’ll make creamy guacamole by mashing ripe avocado with garlic, salt, pepper and bright lime. Then you’ll chop tomato, onion, cilantro, garlic and jalapeño to create a fresh salsa with just the right kick. You’ll pick up practical skills for handling dough, chopping ingredients and balancing flavors as you go, with Chef Brandi keeping every step approachable for beginners. The relaxed brewery setting makes it easy to settle in, get hands-on and enjoy the process. By the end, you’ll have a homemade spread worth repeating at home.

experiences.title: Italian Pasta Making Class for Beginners in Baltimore
experiences.description:
Join a talented chef for a hands-on cooking class where you'll master the art of authentic Italian pasta from scratch. Using fresh, high-quality ingredients and time-honored techniques, you'll learn how to craft silky, homemade pasta with semolina and eggs. A talented chef will guide you step by step through the pasta-making process before teaching you how to prepare a rich, creamy Alfredo sauce from scratch. Made with fresh cream, garlic, Parmesan cheese, and unsalted butter, this decadent sauce pairs perfectly with your handcrafted pasta. Finally, bring everything together with a beautiful presentation, garnished with freshly shaved Parmesan and a touch of fresh herbs.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.description: Craft a stunning mosaic lamp in a vibrant workshop located in Rockville, Maryland. Guided by expert instructors, participants will learn the rich history of Turkish mosaic artistry while creating their own personalized lamp designs. Using high-quality stained glass and decorative beads, you’ll be supported every step of the way as you piece together your unique masterpiece. Enjoy the experience with complimentary Turkish tea and sweets, making it a delightful outing for friends, families, or team-building events. No prior experience is required, making this workshop perfect for all ages.

experiences.title: Open Studio Sip and Paint
experiences.description:
Open Studio Thursdays at Neon Paint Place

Skip the guided steps and paint whatever's actually in your head. Open Studio Thursdays is Baltimore's only open-format art night, no instructor telling you what to paint, just a blacklight-lit studio, good music, and instructors on hand if you want creative direction or a nudge in the right direction.
Bring your own canvas in any size, or use one of ours, either way, all paint and supplies are included. It's BYOB (21+ with ID), snack-friendly (just nut-free, please), and genuinely fun for all ages, making it just as great for a family night as it is for a group of friends looking for something different to do on a Thursday.

Whether you're a seasoned painter or you haven't touched a brush since grade school, this is your night to make something that's actually yours, under glowing blacklight, with the freedom to create without rules.

 students with a valid college ID or student ID get discounts.

experiences.title: Pad Thai Cooking Class with a Local Chef
experiences.description:
Experience the bold flavors of Thai street food without leaving Baltimore. This interactive class with Chef Jesse focuses on crafting authentic shrimp Pad Thai from the ground up. Begin by preparing the essential ingredients — rice noodles, shrimp and fresh aromatics — before learning how to build a rich sauce using tamarind paste, fish sauce and peanuts. Chef Jesse demonstrates the proper stir-fry technique that gives Pad Thai its signature flavor and texture, showing you how to combine noodles and sauce quickly over high heat. You’ll also learn how Thai cuisine balances sweet, savory and tangy elements in every bite.

When your dish is finished, enjoy a plate of homemade shrimp Pad Thai and leave with the confidence to recreate this iconic recipe at home.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Class for Beginners in Baltimore
experiences.description:
With a degree in culinary arts from Le Cordon Bleu, this talented chef has honed his skills in some of the most renowned restaurants in the greater Washington D.C. area and built a stellar reputation as a personal chef. 

This sushi-making class in Baltimore offers a fun, hands-on experience, perfect for beginners to master sushi techniques in a vibrant, wine-centric venue. 

You'll start by learning the fundamentals of sushi rolling. Under the talented chef's guidance, you'll create two types of sushi: California rolls with rice, cucumber, surimi, avocado, and nori, and Vegetable Rolls with rice, cream cheese, avocado, cucumber, and nori.

- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
