experiences.title: Sushi Making Class With a Local Chef in Baltimore
experiences.description:
In this hands-on class with Chef Jesse, you’ll learn how to make fresh, colorful sushi rolls from scratch in a fun and approachable setting.

The class begins with perfectly seasoned sushi rice made with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Then you’ll layer, roll and slice two signature creations. First, make a spicy tuna roll filled with sushi-grade tuna, avocado and spicy mayo wrapped in nori. Next, create a veggie rainbow roll with cucumber, carrot and avocado for a fresh, crunchy finish.

Chef Jesse guides you through practical techniques for preparing sushi rice, rolling sushi, handling ingredients and improving knife skills. The atmosphere stays relaxed and beginner-friendly, making it easy to follow along.

You’ll leave with practical sushi-making skills and a plate of handmade rolls ready to enjoy.

experiences.title: Tipsy History Tour: 300+ Years of Annapolis Drinking History
experiences.description:
Explore Annapolis' vibrant past on this unique historical pub crawl. Over two hours, discover how drinking influenced the city and the nation while enjoying recommended drinks at each stop. From rebels to rum-runners, each location reveals fascinating stories paired with a drink that defines the era. Perfect for whiskey enthusiasts and history buffs alike, this tour offers a relaxed atmosphere to toast the past and enjoy the present. Dress comfortably as you stroll through downtown, rain or shine, and prepare for a fun evening immersed in tipsy history.

- 2-hour historical pub crawl through downtown Annapolis
- Discover how drinking shaped Annapolis' history
- Enjoy recommended drinks at each stop, not included in the price
- Limited walking involved; dress for comfort and the weather

experiences.title: Midtown Dining District Foodie Tour
experiences.description: A leisurely stroll through OC's famous local restaurant and bar scene, combined with history, local lore and fun fascinating facts about this coastal gem of a town and the family's who started here. Includes tastings at 6 local eateries. Come hungry and leave full. Walk, Eat, Drink, Learn... Repeat

experiences.title: Berlin Tasting Tour: A Delicious Walk Through History
experiences.description: Find out why the Smithsonian named Berlin one of the 20 best small towns to visit. Enjoy tasty treats from several restaurants and specialty shops while learning about the families who started here and the dishes that inspire them. See for yourself why Berlin was crowned the "Coolest Small Town in America".

experiences.title: Downtown/Boardwalk Foodie Tour
experiences.description: Learn about Ocean City and the family's who started here. You will learn how the inlet was formed creating Assateague island and how OC became the White Marlin Capital of the world. Taste your way through some of the top places while your local guide shares fun facts about this coastal gem of a town.

experiences.title: 2 Hour Chesapeake Day Sail on Catamaran Epiphany
experiences.description: Set sail on a 2-hour adventure aboard the modern catamaran, Epiphany, in the tranquil waters of St. Michaels, MD. Designed for comfort, this spacious vessel offers cushioned seating and panoramic views of the Chesapeake Bay. Glide through scenic vistas and spot local wildlife while enjoying a brief harbor tour, including the historic Hooper Strait Lighthouse. Whether you choose to relax or learn a bit about sailing, the friendly crew ensures an enjoyable experience for everyone on board.

experiences.title: Mount Vernon and The Millionaires, 2 hour walking tour
experiences.description: Mount Vernon Place: Considered the most beautiful of Baltimore neighborhoods, Mount Vernon Place was once home the more millionaire philanthropists than any other city in America and it shows. Marble churches, libraries, and monuments are filled with Tiffany glass windows and stories of the movers and shakers who built them. A real eye candy tour.

experiences.title: Heart of Savory Salisbury Foodie Tour
experiences.description: With its newly revitalized historic Main Street and Riverwalk, Salisbury is quickly becoming on of the most vibrant hubs in Maryland for art, culture, and dining experiences. Now is the perfect time to explore our small-town foodie scene on foot with this immersive culinary journey that will take you to taste food and drink at local restaurants, cafes, breweries, bakeries and more.

experiences.title: Harborside Orange Crush Cruise
experiences.description:
Try our new Harborside “Orange Crush” Cruise. Experience the bay behind Assateague Island in a unique way - with the original orange crush from the famous Harborside Bar! Even better, your orange crush is on the house when you purchase a delicious lunch to go along with it from the Harborside Bar. All this combined with the best view of Assateague Island you can imagine. This is a front row seat to the famous Assateague Island wild ponies, dolphins, and all of the beautiful scenery and wildlife of the Assawoman Bay. 

This is a CAN’T MISS experience for your friends or family.

experiences.title: Baltimore Haunted Pub Crawl Fells Point Ghosts Bars and Poe
experiences.description:
Drink your way through the haunted side of historic Fells Point on Spirits of Fells Point, Baltimore’s adults-only haunted pub crawl.

Along the route, guests will visit atmospheric bars and historic streets while hearing stories of Edgar Allan Poe, vanished sailors, smugglers, gamblers, haunted taverns, waterfront crime, and the bad decisions that helped give Fells Point its notorious reputation.

This is more than a night out at the bars. It is a haunted walk through the places where sailors once spent their wages, privateers and merchants chased fortunes, and legends of restless spirits still linger near the harbor. Guests will have time to purchase drinks at select stops while enjoying spooky storytelling, local lore, and a fun social atmosphere.

Perfect for adults who want ghosts, history, drinks, and a little chaos, Spirits of Fells Point offers a memorable way to experience Baltimore after dark.

Guests must be 21+ with valid photo ID.

experiences.title: OC Bay Hopper - Foodie Tour By Boat
experiences.description:
This is the perfect trip for foodies looking for something other than the typical day at the beach.  You’ll be joined by OC and restaurant aficionado Sandy Gillis.  Sandy will be your guide.  You’ll then head out for a 3-hour tour of 3 waterfront restaurants.
 
On your tour you will sample delicious foods and tasty cocktails.  Depending on your departure point you’ll stop at 3 of the following:  Tailchasers, Fager’s Island, The Green Turtle, Hoopers Crab House, Sneaky Petes, Frog Bar.  Sandy will fill you in on all the fascinating facts about OC and the restaurants you visit.
 
When this trip is over you’ll have more than just a full belly – you will have also learned a few things.

experiences.title: Baltimore Evening Sail on the Summer Wind
experiences.description:
Enjoy a beautiful time on the water while you nibble on cheese and sip delicious wine on this 1.5-hour sail. As you sail through beautiful Baltimore Harbor, take in the gorgeous scenery of the skyline as the city lights up. Treat yourself and a loved one on this elegant sailing experience.  It's BYOB, so bring your favorite bottle of wine and we'll take care of everything else!

Summer Wind is our larger boat with seating spread across the deck, great for couples and privacy. Unforgettable is our smaller boat with seating in the cockpit, great for families and small groups.

experiences.title: 2-Hour Relaxing Chesapeake Day Sail on Lady Patty
experiences.description:
Sail the serene waters of the Chesapeake Bay aboard the historic Lady Patty. This two-hour cruise offers a unique opportunity to unwind while taking in the picturesque views of St. Michaels, MD. Your journey includes gliding through the harbor and possibly spotting wildlife like osprey and dolphins. Enjoy a friendly crew that shares captivating stories about the area and sailing. Whether you’re looking for a fun family outing or a peaceful escape, this sailing experience is perfect for all ages.

- Duration: 2 hours, with daily availability
- Max capacity of 13 guests, ensuring a personalized experience
- Beer and wine tasting available for adults, with complimentary water
- Departing from Harbour Inn, 101 N Harbor Road, St. Michaels, MD

experiences.title: Baltimore Walking Foodie Tour in Fells Point
experiences.description:
We do 3 things: Food, facts and fun! 

Welcome to Fells Point, the true heart of Baltimore. 

Picture this: cobblestone streets lined with charming eateries, bustling markets, and hidden gems just waiting to be discovered. Join us as we guide you through Fells Point, where you’ll savor iconic dishes like mouthwatering Maryland crab cakes, fresh multi-ethnic exclusive offerings, and no fillers! Each stop is a celebration of Baltimore’s culinary heritage, and our passionate guide will share captivating stories about the area’s rich history and cultural influences.

Whether you’re a seasoned traveler or new to food tours, this experience is perfect for everyone! Connect with fellow food lovers as you explore the lively atmosphere, sample delicious flavors, and soak in the stunning waterfront views. 

Don’t miss your chance to taste the magic of Fells Point! Book your culinary adventure today and uncover why this neighborhood is a must-visit destination for food enthusiasts!

experiences.title: Fells Point Food Tour in Baltimore
experiences.description: This 3.5 hour tour explores parts of Baltimore's best preserved historic district, Fell's Point  is a spirited waterfront community founded nearly 280 years ago.  Enjoy Fell's point amazing atmosphere and historic roots while tasting a little of what makes Fells point the place to be in Baltimore.

experiences.title: Federal Hill Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the Federal Hill food scene in south Baltimore’s most historic neighborhood.  This 3.5 hour food tour will allow you to experience all of this historic neighborhood has to offer. The Cross Street area has become the Federal Hill "Place to Be on the weekends. Fresh seafood turns the west end of the Cross Street Market into a part of Baltimore's amazing food scenes. Folks from all over gravitate to this area to have a test of the federal hill scene.

experiences.title: Historic Annapolis Food Tour
experiences.description: During The Historic Annapolis Food Tour, you will enjoy a series of dishes from restaurants in downtown Annapolis while weaving through historic sites. The tour lasts approximately 3.5 hours.

experiences.title: Baltimore Boos & Booze Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Join us for a Baltimore Haunted Pub Crawl and add some fun to your work week or vacation! Explore several local watering holes and haunted hotspots on this unique, exciting tour.

This tour will take you to several pubs in Baltimore, which may be a combination of craft producers and local bars. There will be a variety of haunted stops in between these already notorious bars and pubs, so by the end of the tour, you'll be a ghost expert!

Grab your first drink at Max's Taphouse as your guide begins your haunting and historic journey through downtown Baltimore. From there, you'll have the chance to enjoy drinks at 3 other popular pubs and explore some other haunted locations in between. Hear stories of the Fell Family Cemetery while standing on haunted ground. Step back in time and hear the dark history behind the Waterfront Hotel. Enjoy your last drink at the Cat's Eye Pub before going home to tell your friends all about what you learned, saw, drank, and maybe even felt!

experiences.title: Annapolis Ghost Tours Boos & Booze Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Come on to our Haunted Pub Crawl Tour in Annapolis!

Enjoy some liquid courage while hearing ghostly tales of Annapolis' most historic haunts and drinking hotspots. Take a Boo's and Booze Haunted Pub Crawl for genuine stories, scares, and delicious drinks in the historic district, with up to 2 hours of ghostly fun with the city's spirits and Spirits. Price does not include drinks or tastings.

experiences.title: Baltimore: Fells Point & Little Italy Food Tour with 7 Tastings
experiences.description:
Explore the rich culinary heritage of Baltimore on this guided food tour through Fells Point and Little Italy. Stroll along cobblestone streets while savoring authentic Maryland crab cakes, pierogies from a beloved Polish deli, a classic potato knish, and a delightful mini cannoli. Your local guide shares insider stories and historical insights, immersing you in the vibrant culture of this historic area. Experience a surprise stop that leaves guests amazed, ensuring a memorable journey through the heart of Baltimore's food scene.

- Guided walking food tour through Baltimore’s historic neighborhoods
- Taste iconic local dishes including crab cakes and cannoli
- Meet your knowledgeable guide for personal storytelling and insights
- Enjoy a surprise culinary stop along the route

experiences.title: Enchanted Full Day Napa & Sonoma Wine Tour from Oakland
experiences.description:
Explore and relish the enchanted day trip to California's famous wine country on this full-day tour of Napa and Sonoma County.

Tour and taste wine at a Napa Valley landmark—Castello di Amorosa. You’ll stop for photos of the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, enjoy wine tastings in both Napa and Sonoma, where you'll take in the delightful notes of each region, and have free time to explore historic Sonoma Square.

Many of the wineries that will be visited are some of the oldest wine making families wine in the Napa and Sonoma Valley. You’ll learn of their family histories and first beginnings in California’s most famous Wine Country.

experiences.title: Maine Iconic Foods Tasting And Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Blueberries, seaweed, potatoes, craft beer and so much more! Take your tastebuds on a trip around the state and explore the ingredients and flavors that make Maine so special. Participants will be introduced to some of Maine's most iconic food and drink industries and hear the stories of local farmers, fishermen and other producers - while sampling delicious products that represent them! 

This guided, 30-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's food and beverage landscape, history and culture. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Coastal Flow A Maine Yoga Experience
experiences.description:
This is more than just a yoga class, it’s a sensory coastal experience. Set against the backdrop of Casco Bay, you’ll move through an all-levels flow while breathing in salt air, feeling the ocean breeze on your skin, and taking in the quiet rhythm of the water.

Each session is thoughtfully designed to blend mindful movement, nervous system support, and deep relaxation. We’ll move through gentle, grounding flow and close with savasana, including an optional cooling lavender-soaked towel.

Want to make the morning feel a little more special? Choose a taste of Portland, a locally made treat from one of the city's favorite bakeries, or toast to the morning with a mimosa. Either way, it's a small addition that turns a good morning into a memorable one.

An invitation to slow down, feel into your body, and experience the coast of Maine in a more present, connected way.

experiences.title: Maine Beer and Cider Tasting in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Explore the brewed flavors of Maine! Take your tastebuds on a trip around the state and explore the wide variety of beers and ciders being produced right here in our state. Participants will be introduced to six Maine-made ciders and beers from six different producers - and hear the stories behind the brewers that brought them to your glass. 

This guided, 30-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's beer/cider landscape and history. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Private Portland to Camden & Midcoast Lighthouse Experience
experiences.description:
Join us for an exciting **Private Coastal Tour from Portland to Camden**, exploring the beauty and history of Maine’s coastline! 

Start with Bath, home to the towering USS Wyoming sculpture and rich shipbuilding heritage. In Wiscasset, stroll through “The Most Beautiful Village in Maine” and visit the world-famous Red’s Eats lobster stand. In Rockland, enjoy a walk to the lighthouse and explore its maritime charm. 

In Camden, wander the charming streets, enjoy lunch, and see a unique waterfall flowing through town. The highlight of the tour is **Camden Hills State Park**, where you’ll take in the most breathtaking views of Midcoast Maine from the summit of Mount Battie.

We'll finish with a brief stop at the Maine State Capitol, designed by the same architect as the U.S. Capitol, offering a fascinating glimpse of Maine’s history.

This fun and adventurous tour is perfect for exploring Maine’s hidden gems. Book now to experience the best of the coast!

experiences.title: Luxury Camden Sailing Experience
experiences.description:
Small groups of up to six. 
Two staff members to take care of you. 
Cushioned seating for all.
Fastest boat in the harbor

experiences.title: Guided Ebike Tour of Acadia National Park Carriage Roads
experiences.description:
Explore Acadia’s historic Carriage Roads on our signature 22-mile guided tour featuring premium Cannondale e-bikes. Limited to just 8 riders per group, our tours include well-timed stops at iconic locations like Jordan Pond House and Eagle Lake, giving everyone space to relax, take photos, and enjoy Acadia's natural beauty at a comfortable pace. 
Consistently top-rated on TripAdvisor for 5 years running, Island Time e-bike tours deliver an unparalleled journey through Acadia's most breathtaking landscapes. Our knowledgeable guides will immerse you in the fascinating history of these meticulously-crafted roads, reveal hidden viewpoints, and share insider stories about Mount Desert Island's natural wonders during our many rest and photo opportunities. 
The park only allows Class I e-bikes (pedaling required), but our e-bikes motors provide excellent support on hills and longer stretches, making this adventure accessible to riders of various fitness levels.

experiences.title: Day Sails and Sunset tours on Schooner Surprise in Camden Maine
experiences.description: Sail on board the only historic day sailing schooner out of Camden Maine. We carry 18 passengers at most and have cushioned seating on board for all. Experienced crew will point out wild life, tell you history of our area and show local landmarks. Come and enjoy a beautiful sail overlooking Camden Hills and sail by the famous Curtis Island Lighthouse. Get involved in learning to haul sails or sit back and enjoy the views with a bottle of wine and picnic. Offering days sails, live acoustic music sails, sunset sails and full moon sails.

experiences.title: Windjammer Classic Sunset Sail from Camden, Maine
experiences.description: Maine sunsets are best appreciated from the water aboard the romantic Appledore II! This tall ship is limited to 49 passengers for an intimate sailing experience. She is a modern windjammer with luxurious accommodations and plenty of seating. The wide decks allow you to walk around with ease and take in all of the gorgeous sunset views.

experiences.title: Self-Guided Ebike Tours of Acadia National Park Carriage Roads
experiences.description:
Explore Acadia National Park's historic Carriage Roads at your own pace with our premium, professionally-maintained late-model Cannondale e-bikes. Our self-guided rentals include detailed maps highlighting iconic locations like Jordan Pond House and Eagle Lake, giving you the freedom to relax, take photos, and enjoy Acadia's natural beauty on your schedule. 
Consistently top-rated on TripAdvisor for 5 years running, Island Time e-bike delivers an unparalleled journey through Acadia's most breathtaking landscapes. Our professional guides provide an e-bike lesson and expert tips on route options. Most riders cover 25-40 miles in a day. 
While the park only allows Class I e-bikes (pedaling required), our e-bikes provide excellent assistance on hills and longer stretches, making this adventure accessible to riders of various fitness levels.

experiences.title: Windjammer Classic Day Sail from Camden, Maine
experiences.description: See the best of Camden while sailing Maine’s magnificent rocky coast on the elegant Appledore II! Feel like an adventurer from the 19th century while enjoying state-of-the-art accommodations on a modern windjammer. With wide decks, you can stroll and take in the sights without needing to duck the rigging. At only 49 passengers, there is abundant seating on which to make yourself comfortable for your intimate daytime sail.

experiences.title: Coastal Kennebunkport E-Bike Adventure
experiences.description:
(For guests 16 and older) Long sandy beaches, rocky coastal crags, sprawling seaside mansions, classic New England countryside, stunning historical architecture — this tour is for intrepid spirits who want to go the distance and see everything.

Along this 17-mile loop you'll venture a little bit farther afield than most while still visiting the must-see highlights of the Kennebunks.

And don't worry; this isn't a whirlwind tour. Your guide will make sure to allow plenty of time to stop, learn about local history, dip your toes in the ocean, and take pictures.

This is a true e-bike adventure, traversing a variety of environments with lots of opportunities to cruise and enjoy the ride. Your well-maintained class 2 e-bikes make it possible without working up too much of a sweat.

Never ridden an e-bike before? No worries. If you can ride a regular bicycle, you'll be fine. Your patient and personable guide will demonstrate everything you need to know before the tour begins.

experiences.title: Maine Seafood Tasting and Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Eel and seaweed and salmon, oh my! Take your tastebuds on a trip down Maine's coast and explore the aquatic ingredients and flavors that make Maine so special. Participants will be introduced to Maine's wild and farmed seafood industries and hear the stories of local farmers, fishermen and other producers - while sampling delicious products that represent them!

This guided, 30-60 minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's seafood landscape, history and culture. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Artisanal Maine Cheese Tasting and Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Maine has over 80 licensed cheesemakers, one of the largest amounts per capita of any US state! In this class, participants will be introduced to six different Maine creameries and hear the stories of the cheesemakers behind them - while sampling their delicious products!

This guided, 30-60 minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's cheese landscape, history and culture. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Camden, Rockland, Pemaquid, and Belfast Private Tour
experiences.description:
Join us for an exciting Private Coastal Tour from Portland to Camden, exploring the beauty and history of Maine’s coastline! 

Start with Bath, home to the towering USS Wyoming sculpture and rich shipbuilding heritage. In Wiscasset, stroll through “The Most Beautiful Village in Maine” and visit the world-famous Red’s Eats lobster stand. In Rockland, enjoy a walk to the lighthouse and explore its maritime charm. 

In Camden, wander the charming streets, enjoy lunch, and see a unique waterfall flowing through town. The highlight of the tour is **Camden Hills State Park**, where you’ll take in the most breathtaking views of Midcoast Maine from the summit of Mount Battie.

We'll finish with a brief stop at the Maine State Capitol, designed by the same architect as the U.S. Capitol, offering a fascinating glimpse of Maine’s history.

This fun and adventurous tour is perfect for exploring Maine’s hidden gems. Book now to experience the best of the coast!

experiences.title: Crazy Camden, ME Scavenger Hunt
experiences.description:
Our very unique, immersive adventures are the only ones of their kind. We, unlike other companies, provide your very own remote, interactive, live host to assist and encourage you along through your phone. We are an Austin, TX-based global custom event design company offering scavenger hunts and other events in 300+ cities in North America and beyond. Our specially hand-crafted adventures are equal parts tour, creative challenge, detective hunt, and social experiment! 

Guests get to discover in an alternate reality our favorite hidden gems off the beaten trail and creatively interpret fun art, history, and culture clues - for points! They get to enjoy fame and glory while appearing on our website’s international leaderboard, no matter what their score. They get to essentially race other teams in other cities, even if they don’t have competitors who have signed up in their city that day. Get ready to discover unusual oddities, laugh out loud, and make the experience your own!

experiences.title: Maine Fermented Foods Tasting and Class in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Producers across the state are harnessing the power of fermentation to create an amazing array of value-add products! In this class, participants will be introduced to a variety of Maine fermented products and hear the stories of the innovative producers behind them - while sampling their delicious products!

This guided, 45-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's fermented flavors and the history and culture behind them. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Maine Wine and Mead Tasting in Wiscasset
experiences.description:
Explore the wines and meads of Maine! Take your tastebuds on a trip around the state and explore the wide variety of wines made right here in our state - including those made with imported grapes, those made with cold-hardy grapes grown in Maine, and those made from ingredients that aren't grapes at all! Participants will be introduced to six Maine-made wines and meads from six different producers - and hear the stories behind the wineries that brought them to your glass.

This guided, 30-minute experience is a fantastic introduction to Maine's wine landscape and history. We recommend scheduling this class at the beginning of your time in Maine so you can take advantage of all you've learned during the rest of your trip. Stick around afterwards for personalized recommendations from your MTC host about wineries, breweries, markets, farms and other agritourism experiences to seek out while in Maine - customized to your interests and the regions you plan to visit while in Maine.

experiences.title: Guided Chocolate Tasting Session in Rockland
experiences.description: Learn about chocolate making process and how to taste chocolate at Maine's First Bean to Bar Chocolate Factory.

experiences.title: Discover Maine's Coastal Charms: Half-Day Scenic Sail
experiences.description:
Set sail with us and immerse yourself in the unparalleled beauty of coastal Maine on our half-day excursion. Traverse the serene waters of the Saco River and Saco Bay with its eight gorgeous islands as you uncover their hidden secrets.

If you're intrigued by shipwrecks, daring rescues at sea, or the ghostly hauntings of Wood Island Lighthouse, just let us know – we have a treasure trove of stories to share.

Indulge in relaxation as you sip on your favorite beverage and allow us to pamper you with impeccable service. As we sail, keep your eyes peeled for marine wildlife – from playful seals and graceful porpoises to majestic sharks and even whales, every moment on the water promises an encounter with nature's wonders.

To ensure an intimate experience, we limit our tours to a maximum of six people. Join us and embark on a journey that will leave you with cherished memories and a newfound love for Maine's breathtaking coastline.

experiences.title: Lobster Roll Crawl
experiences.description:
Love Lobster? Want to get a taste for some of the best rolls in Bar Harbor? 

Join our lobster roll crawl to learn from a local about how the "bugs" get from ocean to table while you sample the good stuff!

Stop to taste 3 different lobster rolls in downtown Bar Harbor while a local guide shares information about growing up working on a lobster boat. Each stop will showcase a different spin on the classic summertime staple and at the end we will vote on our favorites!

Please note this tour is not suitable for anyone with shellfish allergies. The restaurants may change depending on availability and ongoing customer reviews. Only tried and tested spots will be included for the best experience. Guide will provide bottled water. Tour does involve walking one mile on varied surfaces. Last stop will be at a sit down restaurant, where guests who wish can order additional food or drinks.

experiences.title: Portland ME: Casco Bay Boat Tour w/ Island Yoga + Mimosas or Wine
experiences.description:
This experience combines three things you rarely get in one outing: a small-group boat tour, yoga on a Casco Bay island, and a celebratory drink on the water. Choose a morning experience with mimosas and bakery favorites or an afternoon flow followed by a guided four-wine tasting and savory bites.

With only a handful of guests, the experience feels personal, relaxed, and completely different from a traditional boat tour or yoga class.

experiences.title: Belfast Lobster Fishing Experiences — Midcoast Maine
experiences.description:
This isn’t a typical boat tour—it’s a hands-on Maine lobster fishing experience rooted in real working-waterfront traditions.

Choose from three ways to experience it:

 Lobster Fishing Only — NO MEAL INCLUDED
Head onto Penobscot Bay and haul real lobster traps while learning the tools, techniques and traditions of Maine’s iconic fishery. See what comes up—lobsters, crabs and the occasional surprise.

 Lobster Fishing + Feast
Enjoy the full hands-on fishing experience, then step ashore for a VIP stop at Young’s Lobster Pound and a classic Maine lobster feast. From trap to table, this is the real thing.

 The Ultimate Maine Experience — Lobster Feast + Sunset Cruise
Haul real traps, feast at Young’s, then head back onto the bay and cruise into a spectacular Maine sunset. Lobsters, feast and sunset—all in one unforgettable experience.

Whichever you choose, expect small groups, real participation, local knowledge and a genuine taste of Maine’s working waterfront.

experiences.title: Sail Away: Explore Maine's Coastal Beauty on a 2-Hour Excursion
experiences.description:
Step aboard for an unforgettable journey along Maine's stunning coastline! Join us for a two-hour sail and create memories to cherish forever. Experience the beauty of Maine as you glide through the waters of the Saco River and Saco Bay on our intimate sailboat. No prior experience necessary!

Our knowledgeable crew will share fascinating stories about the eight captivating islands of Saco Bay and the picturesque Old Orchard Beach. Admire the iconic New England charm of Wood Island Lighthouse and Biddeford Pool as you soak in the wonders of the ocean and sun.

Take in the breathtaking views of the endless horizon and keep an eye out for wildlife along the way! If you're feeling adventurous, you can even try your hand at sailing the boat yourself.

Most importantly, take this opportunity to relax and unwind as you escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Come aboard and let us show you the beauty of Maine's coastline as you enjoy a well-deserved break on our two-hour sail.

experiences.title: Lighthouse Bicycle Tour from South Portland with 4 Lighthouses
experiences.description: Our 3-Hour tour leaves at 11:00 am and follows the scenic South Portland Greenbelt Pathway to three local lighthouses. The first stop on the tour will be Portland Breakwater Light, also known as "Bug Light" and then the tour will continue to Spring Point Ledge Light, located near historic Fort Preble. Next, the tour will pass by Willard Beach before arriving at the final stop, the famous Portland Head Light located at Fort Williams Park in Cape Elizabeth. It is recommended that patrons bring a lunch or we can assist in purchasing lunch from a local food truck that serves Lobster Rolls.

experiences.title: Private Sightseeing Charter on a Vintage Lobster Boat with Drinks
experiences.description:
100% PRIVATE TOUR! Step aboard a vintage Maine Lobster Boat for a private, 2-hour lighthouse viewing & sightseeing charter. Leave the crowds behind as we cruise through the islands of Casco Bay, passing four iconic lighthouses, historic 19th-century forts, and the stunning Maine coastline.

Charters depart from Portland’s Old Port and are perfect for families and small groups. Each charter is completely private for up to 6 guests, and all ages are welcome!

First round of drinks included – Enjoy a local Portland, Maine beer or a glass of wine as you take in the breathtaking views!

experiences.title: Boos and Brews Walking Ghost Tour of Boothbay Harbor
experiences.description:
The Boos and Brews Walking Ghost Tour uncovers Boothbay Harbor’s unexplained past with eerie events told from a local’s perspective. We combine spine-tingling tales told in picturesque locations with a visit to the Footbridge Brewery for craft beer and barbeque! A local paranormal researcher tells ghostly tales about the harbor’s most haunted old sea captain’s homes, Boothbay Harbor’s very own sea serpent, and the spooky legends that surround many of the harbor’s islands. We’ll wrap up our walk on the weird side at the Footbridge Brewery where you can enjoy beautiful harbor views along with a craft beer flight, brewed with all locally sourced Maine ingredients, and Bridge House barbeque. 

Unlike national corporate chains, Mysterious Harbor Tours is locally owned and operated. No mega-groups of 30+ people. Enjoy an intimate, creepy atmosphere where you can actually hear your entertaining guide.

experiences.title: Private Island Fort Tour in Casco Bay: Boat Cruise & Island Tour
experiences.description:
Board the Elizabeth Grace for this exclusive one-of-a-kind experience. Whether you are a local or visiting from away, the stone fortresses built in the early 19th century in Portland Harbor are always captivating. They are imposing reminders of days not too far gone when the defense of our coastline required their presence.

Despite their prominence, the forts are not easy to access for a variety of reasons, and most locals and visitors have never been to Fort Scammel, the only fort in the Harbor to see active combat. Fortunately, the owners of Fort Scammel have partnered with us to offer private tours of this incredible historic site. This is an experience NOT TO BE MISSED! Along the way, we’ll cruise past some of the other great sights in the bay, including the iconic lighthouses.

GROUP OF 6 OR MORE? Please reach out to us about private charter options for the best experience possible!

Our Fort Tour on a Private Island has a 4 PERSON MINIMUM to operate.

experiences.title: Savor Bar Harbor Culinary Walking Tour in Maine
experiences.description:
- An amazing array of tastes will be accompanied by a generous serving of local history, fun facts and lore – making your visit to Bar Harbor a unique and exciting adventure!
- As you sample the fare at the various stops, our tour guides and proprietors will reveal the history behind their industry and what goes into making their specialties. This is a fairly short walk around the Village Green and the beautiful harbor with plenty of food for lunch.

experiences.title: Portland's Best Craft Beverages Bus Tour
experiences.description:
Most recognize Portland, Maine for its vast selection of local craft breweries. And while we retain the title for ‘most breweries per capita,’ we’re experiencing profound growth in our craft beverage scene including a range of spirits and locally produced wine.

Neighborhoods like Portland’s East Bayside are brimming with craft beverage options to suit any taste, from Three of Strong’s small batch, organic rum to wines from Blue Lobster Urban Winery which are blended with Maine wild blueberries and apples from local orchards.

The third stop of the tour concludes at the Portland Beer Hub, the home of Maine Brews Cruise, and a blend of beer bar and retail space in the bustling heart of Portland’s Old Port. As a bonus, all guests snag a 10% discount on additional draft and to-go purchases at the Portland Beer Hub.

Please note that tour stops may change without notice due to events and the availability of staff at each venue.

experiences.title: Portland Bicycle Tour with 5 Lighthouses and XL Lobster Roll
experiences.description: Discover Portland Maine and the shores of Casco Bay by bicycle! Join us for the 5 lighthouse bicycle tour of Portland, Maine featuring the Maine coast, lighthouses, and Portland’s history. Groups will generally see only 4 lighthouses (Bug Light, Spring Point, Portland Head Light, and Ram Island Ledge). Lunch will be provided by the award-winning "Bite into Maine" Food Truck

experiences.title: Portland Walking Food Tour – Warm Donuts, History & Hidden Gems
experiences.description: Portland, Maine is known for its culinary scene, including amazing donuts. With this tour, you'll get to sample from the city's best donut shops, while also learning of Maine's connection to the invention of the donut and the city's history. Your tour guide will take you not only to the most famous of them all, The Holy Donut, to skip the line, but also to local favorites, that are equally delicious.

experiences.title: Old Port Culinary Walking Tour from Portland
experiences.description:
- Portland's culinary culture is made up of many kinds of artisan food and beverage entrepreneurs from bakers, brewers and chefs to confectioners and more - wherever taste and creativity meet!
- We combine a unique combination of social history, culinary education, the stories of talented entrepreneurs and current award-winning food scene narrated by friendly and engaging local guides
- This tour visits 4-5 venues where you will enjoy a mix of Maine/Maine-inspired cultural, up-and-coming, and trending fare, plenty for lunch with a sweet treat to cap it off.

experiences.title: Old Port "Seafood Lovers" Walking Lunch Tour in Portland, Maine
experiences.description:
Learn about Maine's most famous crustacean and the men and women who make their living from trap to table. Stroll along Portland's vital working waterfront , view lobster boats often unloading their catch and visit Old Port and waterfront district destinations for a progressive, iconic Maine lunch. 

- This walking tour is appx. 1 - 1.5 miles visiting local favorites with plenty of food, and food for thought - lots of time for Q/A. 
- There's always a whole lobster roll, a New England clam or seafood chowder, local craft beer (or soda) plus a whoopie pie or other Maine sweet, and a surprise seafood taste or two along the way. This is our most “classic heritage” Maine experience with a bit of modern flare.

experiences.title: Morning Lighthouse Cruise Along the Coast of Portland Maine
experiences.description:
Join us for 1 1/2 hours as we cruise along the rugged coastline, complete with lighthouses, seals, seabirds, and historic forts. 
Pack a meal, bring your favorite wine or beer, and sit back and relax as you slip through the tranquil waters of Casco Bay. 
All ages are welcome! Whether you are nine years old or 99, cruising aboard Ruth is a unique adventure, a 39’ long classic, picnic style tour boat built in 1935 at Handy Boat in Falmouth, Maine.

experiences.title: Boothbay Harbor Bites Guided Food Tour
experiences.description: The Boothbay Harbor Bites guided food tour is a carefully curated, unique culinary experience featuring five beloved, locally-owned restaurants and specialty shops designed to give you a taste of what it means to live and eat in this historic New England fishing village. Join our friendly, local tour guide on this movable treat feast along the harbor where you’ll hear stories about Boothbay Harbor while enjoying mouth-watering savory samples and sweet bites with opportunities to shop and take photographs.

experiences.title: Kennebunkport: A Tasty Lunchtime Walking Tour
experiences.description:
The area has been home to those who make their living on the sea for centuries and a popular destination for visitors who love the history, beautiful beaches and plentiful outdoor activities. In recent years the culinary scene is also attracting visitors with nationally renowned chefs, gourmet catering companies, craft brewers and award winning food artisans.

This tour takes a leisurely half mile walk from Dock Square across the bridge into the lower village as you taste all along the way what it means to be from Maine. You will visit with shop keepers and food artisans, taste chowders, lobsters and more, all regionally sourced and created by local talent. Our friendly and knowledgeable guides will take you to several venues to sip, taste and learn about Maine's culinary history and vibrant food scene.

experiences.title: Small Group Sunset Lighthouse Boat Cruise With Local Drinks
experiences.description:
Board the Elizabeth Grace to cruise around Portland Harbor while sipping local craft beer. This 1.5-hour harbor cruise will take you out into Casco Bay. Keep your eyes open for potential seal sightings, as well as the multiple lighthouses, islands, and forts you will see while cruising around.

We will turn the bow toward Portland so you can take in a Maine sunset from the water and then cruise through Portland Harbor as the city’s nighttime skyline illuminates. You won’t find a more spectacular experience in Maine!

GROUP OF 6 OR MORE? Please reach out to us about private charter options for the best experience possible!

experiences.title: Portland's World of Flavors Tour
experiences.description:
Introducing Portland’s World of Flavors Walk highlighting hidden gems and great flavors that give Portland its cosmopolitan flair. Enjoy this walkable city with a big palate on our international journey, tasting locally sourced foods prepared with the recipes, customs and spices from other lands.

On this 2.5-3 hour tasty romp through Portland’s historic Old Port and waterfront, you will enjoy the flavors while learning their food pathways and the owners journeys to Maine.

Portland’s World of Flavor serves up a diversity of tastes and ethnicities in a compact area, packing a punch of flavors you will love.

All tour experiences are highly educational and entertaining with trained, local guides.

experiences.title: Afternoon Lighthouse Cruise Along the Coast of Portland Maine
experiences.description: Join us for 1 1/2 hours as we cruise along the rugged coastline, complete with lighthouses, seals, seabirds, and historic forts. Pack a meal, bring your favorite wine or beer, and sit back and relax as you slip through the tranquil waters of Casco Bay. All ages are welcome! Whether you are nine years old or 99, cruising aboard Ruth is a unique adventure, a 39’ long classic, picnic style tour boat built in 1935 at Handy Boat in Falmouth, Maine.

experiences.title: Savor Bar Harbor Culinary Walking Tour
experiences.description:
- An amazing array of tastes will be accompanied by a generous serving of local history, fun facts and lore – making your visit to Bar Harbor a unique and exciting adventure!
- As you sample the fare at the various stops, our tour guides and proprietors will reveal the history behind their industry and what goes into making their specialties. This is a fairly short walk around the Village Green and the beautiful harbor with plenty of food for lunch.

experiences.title: Around The Peninsula Bike Tour
experiences.description: Discover the rich history and stunning architecture of the City of Portland . Only 3.5 miles long and 3/4 miles wide, the Portland peninsula is packed full of food, history, and culture. This 2.5-hour tour will show you the best of the peninsula.

experiences.title: Bar Harbor Food Walking Tour With Lobster Roll
experiences.description:
Join us on the Best of Bar Harbor Food Walking Tour, where we'll indulge in the city's most iconic treats.

We'll meet at a central location, where you'll be welcomed by our expert guide and fellow food enthusiasts.

Our first stop will be at a charming eatery known for its succulent lobster rolls, an homage to the city's coastal culinary heritage. Explore the rich flavors that make Bar Harbor's seafood a true delicacy.

Next, we'll venture to a delightful ice cream and fudge shop, where you can indulge your sweet tooth. 

As we continue our adventure, we'll take a leisurely walk through Agamont Park towards the Bar Harbor Beach. Enjoy the scenic harbor views as we continue to Balance Rock. 

Our final destination will be a hidden gem loved by locals and visitors alike. Here, you'll experience a celebration of ice cream, and enjoy the serene atmosphere of the Village Green.

Join us on the Bar Harbor Food Walking Tour and discover the city's most mouthwatering delights!

experiences.title: Belfast Bay Cruise with Lobster Rolls Small Group Experience
experiences.description:
What sets this experience apart is the combination of intimacy, access, and authenticity. With a maximum of six guests, this is not a crowded tour but a personal, small-group experience where the pace is unhurried and the focus is on enjoying the moment.

You’ll cruise on a classic wooden lobster boat, giving you a true sense of Maine’s working waterfront—not a generic sightseeing vessel. The experience is flexible, shaped around your group, the conditions, and what feels right on the day.

The highlight is a VIP dockside stop at Young’s Lobster Pound. Arriving by boat, you’ll step ashore away from the crowds, enjoy a live lobster demonstration, and pick up one of their iconic lobster rolls before heading back out onto the water to enjoy it.

It’s simple, personal, and exactly how Maine is meant to be experienced

experiences.title: Ultimate Acadia National Park Self-Guided Driving Audio Tour
experiences.description:
Recommended: purchase one tour per car. Everyone can listen at the same time!

Experience Maine’s most beautiful sights with this narrated driving tour! Cruise through Acadia’s pristine wilderness, hear the legends of the Native tribes who once called this place home, summit the majestic Cadillac Mountain. Plus, visit the quaint, picturesque coastal town of Bar Harbor along the way.

Due to poor signal in the park, enable OFFLINE MODE while driving.

After booking, check your email/text to download the separate Audio Tour Guide App by Action while connected to WiFi or mobile data. Enter the password, download the tour, and enjoy it offline. Follow the audio instructions and route from the designated starting point.

New, Lifetime access, no expiry. Use it anytime, on any trip, as many times as you want.

This isn't an entrance ticket. Check opening hours before your visit.

experiences.title: Acadia Mount Desert Island Self-Guided Driving Audio Tour
experiences.description:
Take a scenic trip across Acadia Mount Desert. Enjoy coastal and Rocky Shoreline views and learn about the Maliseet, Wabanaki, and Glooskap. Explore Charlotte Rhoades Park's lush vegetation, glacial relics, and George Dorr and the Rusticators' tales. Taste Acadian food, see marine life, and relax at Little Long Pond. Celebrate Bass Harbor's rich heritage.

Purchase one tour per car, not per person. Everyone listens together!

After booking, check your email/text to download the separate Audio Tour Guide App by Action while connected to WiFi or mobile data. Enter the password, download the tour, and enjoy it offline. Follow the audio instructions and route from the designated starting point.

New, Lifetime access, no expiry. Use it anytime, on any trip, as many times as you want.

This isn't an entrance ticket. Check opening hours before your visit.

experiences.title: Flavors of Bar Harbor History and Food Tastings Private Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy a private, exclusive tour in Bar Harbor with your own local guide. Discover the flavors that define Maine on a relaxed walk through the heart of Bar Harbor. 

This tour includes four tasting stops, offering a variety of small dishes, deserts and beverages. Every tasting highlights a different part of Maine's culinary heritage. Savor fresh seafood, handcrafted ice cream and locally roasted coffee. Learn about the lobster industry, blueberry traditions and the people who shaped Bar Harbor's food culture. Between tastings, your guide shares stories of the waterfront streets and Gilded Age landmarks. Enjoy a memorable experience that blends authentic local cuisine with fascinating history.

Please note: Restaurant menus and tasting selections may vary based on seasonal availability, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.

experiences.title: Private Wine & Mead Tasting with the Vintner in Lee, Maine
experiences.description:
Upon arrival, you will be greeted by your friendly staff and escorted to your cozy tasting room. The experience begins with an introduction to the tasting flight, carefully curated to showcase the best of your local offerings. As you sip on each variety, your vintner will share the captivating history of winemaking in the region, offering a deep dive into the processes and stories behind each bottle.

You'll have the opportunity to ask questions, making this an interactive and educational experience. The tasting room's ambiance, combined with the stunning views of the farm and orchards, creates a perfect setting for a memorable outing.

Included
~A guided tasting of a flight of wines and ciders
~A detailed presentation on the history and process of winemaking in the Maine Highlands
~Personalized attention from your expert vintner

experiences.title: Grand Haven Afternoon Guided Bike & Beer Tour - 3 Hours
experiences.description: Mi Bike Tours is the best way to experience Grand Haven like a local. Our bike route takes you through some of the most scenic parts of Grand Haven and stops at the most popular cafes and restaurants. This tour is fun, relaxed, and is guaranteed to be one of your favorite summer days!

experiences.title: Private Walking Food Tour In Detroit With Secret Food Tours
experiences.description:
On your Secret Food Tour: Detroit, you’ll explore the beating heart of
Motor City.

Your experienced guides will lead you on a rich journey through the
heart of Detroit, home to incredible history, diverse cultures, and a
thriving food scene boasting many of the cities favorite local eats.
Along the way, you'll indulge in classic comfort foods, local staples,
and the iconic dishes Detroit is known for. As you enjoy each dish,
you'll discover how the city became one of the largest and richest
cities in America fueled by the hearty classic dishes that make up the Motor City's food scene today. From the titans of industry who
occupied Detroits famed skyscrapers, to the beloved working-class
heroes that built the cars that got America moving, and the rich
immigrant communities that sought their fortunes in Detroit-communities made their mark on the cities iconic foods that you'll experience on your dive into the true flavors of Motown.

As a private Tour everything works around you!

experiences.title: Walking Food Tour Downtown Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
Discover the flavors of downtown Grand Rapids on this guided walking food tour! Sample a delightful mix of savory and sweet dishes from local hotspots while learning about the city’s rich history and culture. Perfect for food lovers, this tour features both hidden gems and popular favorites, making it a must for anyone seeking a unique culinary experience!

Note: The tour involves approximately 1 mile of light walking with frequent stops.

experiences.title: Indian Cooking Class in Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
Step into a warm and inviting home kitchen for a hands-on Indian cooking experience that immerses you in the heart of India’s culinary traditions. Learn to prepare classic dishes from scratch, including traditional chicken curry, fresh handmade rotis, and authentic Indian chai, all using wholesome ingredients and freshly ground spices. With over 30 years of cooking experience and a passion for sharing Indian culture, the host creates a relaxed atmosphere reminiscent of cooking with family. This class not only teaches traditional techniques but also shares stories about Indian food and culture, culminating in a delightful meal enjoyed together at the end.
- Small-group setting for personalized attention
- Learn to make chicken curry, rotis, and chai from scratch
- Led by a host with over 30 years of experience in Indian cuisine
- Enjoy a freshly prepared meal and cultural stories at the end

experiences.title: Experience to Forge a Railroad Spike Knife in Ferry Township
experiences.description: This is a truly one of a kind immersive experience. You will use a coal fired forge, a forge press, treadle hammer, anvil and hand held hammer to forge a one of a kind Railroad Spike Knife. This is an experiential learning workshop where you will be doing all the work required to make your knife. I will guide and assist when needed to make this the most hands-on immersive forge experience available.

experiences.title: 5-Hour Traverse City Wine Tour: 4 Wineries on Old Mission Peninsula
experiences.description:
Sit back and enjoy the gentle slopes, winding country roads and Caribbean-like views on a Traverse City Wine Tour. The Magic Shuttle Bus is a chauffeur service with an entire fleet ready to take your group around Old Mission Peninsula.

The 45th parallel, is home to the worlds most famous wine-making regions AND Traverse City. Grapevines planted in the region enjoy the perfect amount of sunlight for optimal growth. When coupled with micro-climates created by Grand Traverse Bay, and fertile soil, this sets the perfect stage for delicious award-winning wines that rival centuries-old grapes produced in Europe & California.

"We are proud to say that our Old Mission Wine Tour has been nominated as Top 20 Wine Tours in the Country by USA Today, and stands as our signature tour in Northern Michigan!"

**Wineries are subject to change based on availability**

***Gratuity of 20% for the driver is strongly recommended (Cash Only)***

experiences.title: 5-Hour Traverse City Wine Tour: 3 Wineries on Leelanau Peninsula
experiences.description:
Discover the best of Leelanau County's wineries with the convenience of inclusive transportation leaving from downtown Traverse City. This wine tour takes you to three carefully selected wineries, allowing you to savor the finest wines and revel in the stunning views without the worry of transportation. Our wine tours have won TripAdvisor's prestigious "Best of the Best" award three years in a row, and named among America's top 10 wine tours—a testament to our commitment to excellence. 

You'll gain exclusive access to wineries that are typically not open to the public for join-in tours. At each winery, there will be plenty of time for you to enjoy and learn. You'll gain exclusive access to each winery's tasting room, where you can sample a variety of wines crafted using local techniques. Find something you like? You can always purchase bottles, and your tour drivers will safely hold your purchases until the tour is over.

20% Gratuity for drivers is strongly recommended-cash only

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class With a Local Chef in Grand Rapids
experiences.description: Ordering sushi is great. Making it yourself and actually knowing what you are doing is a completely different level of satisfaction. That is exactly what this class is for. Chef See will take you from total beginner to confident sushi roller in one fun, relaxed session. You will master the rice, nail the rolling technique and build two crowd-pleasing classics: a California roll with fresh crab, avocado and cucumber, and a spicy tuna roll that brings just enough heat to keep things interesting. Along the way you will pick up the kind of insider tips that make the difference between sushi that holds together beautifully and sushi that, well, does not. Come for the skills. Stay for the eating. Leave as the person in your friend group who makes sushi now.

experiences.title: Fun Character Sushi Making Class at a Local Distillery
experiences.description: Forget ordinary dinner plans and spend your time creating sushi that's almost too cute to eat. Set inside a welcoming local distillery, this fun cooking class teaches the building blocks of sushi-making in a relaxed, social setting. You'll start by seasoning sushi rice and preparing fresh ingredients before learning how to spread rice evenly, roll nori with confidence and slice each roll into picture-perfect pieces. Then comes the creative twist as you decorate and shape your sushi into charming character-inspired designs that are guaranteed to earn a spot in your camera roll before your plate. Along the way, you'll pick up practical rolling, shaping and presentation techniques that make recreating sushi at home feel completely doable. Expect plenty of laughs, colorful creations and the satisfying moment when your handmade sushi comes together. Takeout might start getting a little jealous.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class With a Local Chef in Grand Rapids
experiences.description: There is a specific kind of satisfaction that comes from biting into a dumpling you folded yourself. This class exists entirely to give you that feeling. Chef Cortney will take you from total beginner to confident dumpling maker in just one session, starting with a flavour-packed filling of your choice, pork or a vibrant vegan version with napa cabbage, bamboo shoots, scallions and ginger. You will then learn the folding techniques that make dumplings look as good as they taste, cook them until the outside is golden and the inside is perfectly tender, and finish with a punchy dipping sauce that has just the right amount of kick. The room is casual, the crowd is friendly and by the time you sit down to eat, you will already be thinking about who you are going to make these for next.

experiences.title: Fun Gnocchi Making Class With local Chef in Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
Bring some warmth to your kitchen with this cozy, hands-on pasta-making class in Grand Rapids, hosted through Classpop! and led by Chef Jerry. You’ll learn to make sweet potato gnocchi from scratch, combining simple ingredients like flour, eggs and olive oil into a soft, flavorful dough. As your gnocchi cook, you’ll prepare a nutty brown butter and sage sauce with tender asparagus and a splash of lemon for freshness. Chef Jerry keeps it approachable, delicious and full of pro pasta tips. Perfect for foodies, date nights or anyone craving a new kitchen skill, this class ends with a homemade Italian feast you’ll want to make again and again.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Local Distillery in Grand Rapids
experiences.description: Settle into the casual atmosphere of a Grand Rapids distillery and get ready to make pasta from scratch with Chef Jerry. You’ll start with flour, eggs and olive oil, learning how flour type and ratios affect your dough before mixing, rolling and shaping ravioli-style cappelletti. Then comes the good part: a rich crab filling packed with crab, parsley, cream cheese, scallions and Old Bay. You’ll learn how to portion and fold the pasta so it holds that delicious filling without falling apart. While everything comes together, you’ll whisk up Hollandaise using eggs, butter, chicken base, lemon and Dijon mustard, mastering emulsification and heat control along the way. Finish with a punchy chive oil of chives, garlic, olive oil and chili flakes, then practice plating with color, height and negative space. No pasta-making confidence required—just bring your appetite.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Grand Rapids
experiences.description: Crab-filled cappelletti with Hollandaise sauce and chive oil, plated professionally. Sounds ambitious. Chef Jerry will have you pulling it off in a single class. This is the kind of workshop that actually explains the why behind the techniques, why flour ratios change everything, how emulsification works and why plating is less about talent and more about understanding color, height and negative space. By the time it all clicks, you will look at your own plate and wonder when exactly you got this good. The setting is relaxed, the crowd is welcoming and Chef Jerry has a gift for making complex techniques feel completely within reach, even if your current pasta experience begins and ends with boiling water.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class at a Trendy Local Venue in Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
Rolling sushi is way more satisfying than it looks, especially when you’re eating your creations five minutes later. In this lively cooking class with Chef Cortney, you’ll learn the basics of sushi making in a relaxed social setting hosted at a stylish local venue in Grand Rapids. This experience is designed for beginners who want a fun night out with actual useful skills involved.

The class starts with preparing sushi rice the proper way, focusing on texture, seasoning and easy techniques that make a huge difference in flavor. Chef Cortney will also share approachable knife and prep tips before guiding you through two handmade sushi rolls from scratch. First, craft a California-style roll with avocado, cucumber and imitation crab or cooked shrimp wrapped in nori and sushi rice. Then, make a fresh veggie roll layered with colorful vegetables, avocado, cucumber and cream cheese. Expect plenty of tasting, laughter and “wait, I actually made this?” moments throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Gnocchi Making Class With a Local Chef in Grand Rapids
experiences.description: Gnocchi sounds like the kind of thing only Italian grandmothers can pull off. Your local chef is about to prove that wrong, and make it really fun in the process. In this laid-back, beginner-friendly class, you will go from a pile of potatoes and flour to a plate of pillowy homemade gnocchi tossed in a rich brown butter sauce with crispy sage, fresh asparagus and a bright hit of lemon. Along the way you will pick up knife skills, dough technique and the deeply satisfying knowledge of exactly how brown butter is supposed to smell before you pull it off the heat. Come as a complete beginner. Leave as someone who genuinely makes gnocchi from scratch now.

experiences.title: Italian Pasta Cooking Class in Detroit (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Fresh pasta is simpler than you think. This hands-on class in Detroit, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, strips Italian cooking back to its essentials – dough made by hand, sauce made from scratch and a tiramisù to finish. Perfect for beginners and home cooks looking to level up.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Bruschetta – fresh tomato and basil on toasted bread
- Fresh Pasta – tagliatelle or gnocchi with classic tomato-basil sauce
- Tiramisù – mascarpone, cacao and espresso-soaked ladyfinger biscuits

You will leave with solid handmade pasta technique and the confidence to recreate this three-course Italian meal at home anytime.

experiences.title: Make Fresh Dumplings With a Local Chef in Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
A perfectly folded dumpling is part comfort food, part accomplishment. Join Chef Legina for a hands-on class that breaks down Asian dumpling-making into simple steps. You'll learn how to prepare fillings, handle wrappers and master folding techniques.

Start by crafting pork dumplings filled with seasoned ground pork and vegetables. Then create vegetable dumplings packed with fresh ingredients and vibrant flavor. Along the way, you'll practice filling, folding, sealing and shaping techniques. As the dumplings cook, the room fills with irresistible aromas. Chef Legina keeps the class relaxed and engaging, making it easy to build skills and enjoy the process regardless of experience level. You'll leave with practical cooking knowledge, confidence in the kitchen and a plate of handmade dumplings worth showing off before taking the first bite.

experiences.title: Mosaic Resin Frame Experience
experiences.description:
Anyone 7 years old and up is capable of doing this fun and easy experience. Ages 7-13 require parental supervision during this experience.
We provide all the materials needed.
The standard size for this experience is an 8.5”x11” picture frame.
All of your experiences are instructor-led and require no experience, which means we lead you step by step, and you leave with a masterpiece you love.

experiences.title: NON-BUS WINE & Dine Tour Old Mission / Downtown Traverse City
experiences.description:
The MOVIE STARS Wine & Dine Tour

Guests go to 2 of the hottest wineries on Old Mission Peninsula then downtown for food! We'll wait while your group eats! Try something different! 

Wineries include stops like Mari, Hawthorne, Peninsula Cellars, Bonobo, Brys, Chateau Grand Traverse, Chateau Chantel, Bowers Harbor, Old Mission Distillers. 

Including but NOT limited to Slate, Sorellina, Artisan Restaurant, Reflect Bistro, Mama Lu's, Red Ginger, Amical, The Parlor, U&I Lounge, Thatsa' Pizza, The Pretty Penny Steakhouse, The Cooks' House, Little Fleet, The Pub, Oakwood Proper Burger, The Flying Noodle, Poppycocks, Barrios, North Peak Brewing Company, Sisters, Town Plaza, Middlecoast Brewery, Loco Boys, Firefly, Bubba's Burgers, Mode's Bum Steer, Town Plaza, Taproot Cider House

This tour is 4-5 hours in duration. Book your tour date, and the guides will reach out to confirm your customized itinerary.

Tastings, wines and food are not included in the price of the tour.

experiences.title: Private Dinner Cooking and Cocktails Class
experiences.description: Travelers will be able to select a drink tasting menu and dinner menu for their group to sample and participate in creating. Guests will taste the menu and take home samples for later. Cuisine ranges from Mexican to Japanese menus, to reflect the knowledge, experience and culture of the host.

experiences.title: Wine and Canvas Night Activity in Ferndale
experiences.description: Unleash your creativity at a vibrant evening of art and wine in Ferndale. Sip on four delightful wine varietals paired with popcorn as you paint to the rhythm of the music. This interactive canvas experience encourages laughter and connection, making it perfect for friends, a date, or solo adventurers eager to meet new faces. With a DJ spinning tunes and games to keep the energy high, this isn’t just another paint-and-sip; it's a celebration of creativity and community.

experiences.title: Guided Private Pontoon Charter (4 yrs & up)
experiences.description: The very comfortable captain-chauffered Tritoon Pontoon boat offers you, your family, and friends a great way to get out on the water and enjoy the bay safely. The pontoon has a cooler full of ice waiting for you! Bring food, drinks, sunscreen, towels, and water toys, and have the fun you deserve on the brilliant blue water of the Grand Traverse Bay. You can head to Power Island for some swimming fun or tuck into a beach for the best of both worlds. This pontoon is actually a tri-toon, which means there are three tubes instead of two, making this ride super comfortable, smooth, stable and fast. Our highly trained captain is at your service! There may be an opportunity to swim, weather and wind permitting.

experiences.title: West Michigan Adventure Park with Ropes Climbing and Zip Lines
experiences.description: Discover endless thrills at Allegan Adventure Park, home of Michigan's largest indoor ropes course — where the thrill of adventure awaits with a variety of activities designed for kids, teens, and adults. Your ticket includes admission to the amazing high ropes course, featuring over 85 challenges that soar 35 feet in the air, along with exhilarating zip lines and 16 vibrant Clip ‘n Climb walls. This adventure hub is perfect for a lively family outing, a memorable date day or night, birthday parties, or a group team-building experience. It guarantees a day filled with lasting memories, fun, and camaraderie. Don’t forget to refuel with delicious snacks and drinks at the onsite eatery.

experiences.title: NON-BUS MOVIE STARS Traverse City Fine Red Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Skip the hassle of a loud obnoxious party bus and leave the driving to us! Check out our Tiered pricing for groups!

experiences.title: Private Wine Tour of Traverse Old Mission with Driver
experiences.description:
Your own Designated Driver on beautiful Old Mission Peninsula!

Most tasting tours drive you around in buses and vans, adding to the costs. But NOW you can hire a designated driver to drive your car on your adventure and save some money! Check out the area's best wineries, and distilleries in the Traverse City, Michigan area on our day and afternoon tours. Sit back, relax while someone else does the driving!

If you are in the Leelanau area and want to do a Leelanau Peninsula tour there is a Leelanau option. If you are staying in the Torch Lake area and would like to tour around Torch Lake we have included a Torch Lake option. 

Last minute bookings are subject to availability.

experiences.description:
SUNSET / AFTERNOON MOVIE STAR WINE TOUR!

experiences.title: Detroit Sweet Treats Food Tour: Donuts, Coffee, Pastries & More
experiences.description:
Our journey begins at Astoria Bakery, a local favorite offering a taste of Greektown’s charm with its array of irresistible baked goods. Here we'll try some of Detroit's best donuts, made fresh daily.

Heading near the Shinola Hotel, enjoy expertly crafted coffee and creative desserts in a neighborhood blending Detroit’s industrial roots with modern flair. In Parker’s Alley, tucked behind the hotel, discover a boutique chocolatier crafting unique confections in this revitalized urban gem.

Our next stop is Cannelle, a patisserie inspired by French baking, where exquisite pastries showcase Detroit’s elevated culinary scene. We’ll end at Campus Martius, the vibrant heart of downtown, where the city’s rich history meets its modern energy—a perfect conclusion to this flavorful exploration. Join us for a delicious dive into Detroit’s sweetest spots!

experiences.title: NON-BUS GMC Yukon Traverse Old Mission Wine Tour
experiences.description:
NO MORE MAGIC SHUTTLE BUS FOR MAGIC MIKE - Book Magic Mike here!
Yellowstone Style Meets Traverse City Wine Country in Luxury GMC Yukons (one fancy Suburban)!
Stunning views, NO BUSES, NO Rush, Iconic wineries, stellar wines, and 5-star Celebrity customer service
