experiences.title: 4-Hour Traverse City Sunset Wine Tour: 3 Wineries on Old Mission Peninsula
experiences.description:
Sit back and enjoy the gentle slopes, winding country roads and Caribbean-like views on a Traverse City Sunset Wine Tour. The Magic Shuttle Bus is a chauffeur service with an entire fleet ready to take your group around Old Mission Peninsula.

The 45th parallel, is home to the worlds most famous wine-making regions AND Traverse City. Grapevines planted in the region enjoy the perfect amount of sunlight for optimal growth. When coupled with micro-climates created by Grand Traverse Bay, and fertile soil, this sets the perfect stage for delicious award-winning wines that rival centuries-old grapes produced in Europe & California.

This 4-Hour Sunset Tour features 3 of the highest rated wineries in the state of MI. Great views, award winning wine, and a sunset!

*Wineries are subject to change based on availability*

*Gratuity of 20% for the driver is strongly recommended (Cash Only)*

Tour Start/End Times for Sunday-Friday: 5:30pm-9:30pm
Tour Start/End Times for Saturdays: 4:30pm-8:30pm

experiences.title: Day Sail from Traverse City with Food, Wine, & Cocktails
experiences.description:
For a full description please visit our website at https://www.winddancertc.com/
where you can learn about the vessel, crew, local history and make your bookings!

experiences.title: Iconic Foods of Detroit Tour
experiences.description:
Get ready to walk, taste, and discover your way through the heart of the Motor City on this food tour. Over the course of three flavorful hours, you’ll sample Detroit’s most iconic eats while soaking up the stories and spirit of the city that created them.

From historic eateries to buzz-worthy newcomers, this fully-narrated tour brings Detroit’s food scene to life with every bite. Savor a slice of Detroit-style pizza, bite into a classic Coney dog, sip on local fizzy favorites, and indulge in sweet traditions of the Motor City – first at a local chocolatier and then at an iconic downtown restaurant.

On this must-do walking tour, your guide will share fascinating stories of the people and places behind the flavors, all while leading you past some of Detroit’s most recognizable landmarks and photo-worthy backdrops.

experiences.title: Designated Driver TC - We Drive Your Car - Private TC Wine Tour
experiences.description:
We drive your car for wine, brew, distillery and cidery tours. We help you create your perfect itinerary which, can be changed on the fly. 

No pressure, stay as long as you want.... this is your day! Let's do exactly what you want to do.

NOTE: Additional hours past the 5 included will be charged separately through Designated Driver TC via cash or credit card.

experiences.title: Sunset Sail from Traverse City with Food, Wine & Cocktails
experiences.description:
Wind down and relax as our captain and crewmates teach you about our elegant schooner and share stories about the history of the lands, people, and waters of the Grand Traverse Bay area. Enjoy complimentary locally sourced food, wine, and cocktails while watching the sunset paint the sky. This is a 2.5-hour sail. 

Check-in at our kiosk 30 min before departure. The 2nd Mate will do a brief welcome about 10 min before departure and then will guide all passengers to board Wind Dancer. We have a variety of beverage options including wine, cocktails, local spirits, soda and water. Food is served around 1 hour into the sail. We respectfully request that guests not bring additional alcoholic beverages. Free parking is available at the check-in kiosk, which is located at The Delamar Resort, 615 E. Front Street, Traverse City, MI. Depending on the weather, please bring rain gear/sweaters and non-skid footwear for boating. Tours will be rescheduled if necessary due to inclement weather.

experiences.title: Keweenaw Copper Country Self Guided Driving Audio Tour
experiences.description:
Explore Michigan’s Upper Peninsula with a self-guided tour of the Keweenaw Copper Country—a hidden gem wrapped by Lake Superior's vast beauty. Venture into the heart of Copper Country, where stunning lake views, dense forests, and rich wildlife await. Explore the deep mining history that shaped the region, and indulge in Keweenaw's unique food and culture. Whether seeking tranquility or adventure, this Upper Peninsula destination offers a perfect blend of natural splendor and historical intrigue, making it an unforgettable escape into the wilderness.

After booking, check your email/text to download the separate Audio Tour Guide App by Action while connected to WiFi or mobile data. Enter the password, download the tour, and enjoy it offline. Follow the audio instructions and route from the designated starting point.

New, Lifetime access, no expiry. Use it anytime, on any trip, as many times as you want.

experiences.title: Grand Rapids, MI by the Seat Cycle Tour
experiences.description:
Pedal, Party, and Pour.

Climb aboard the Great Lakes Pub Cruiser’s Grand Rapids’ only 2-6 passenger party bike! This high-energy, pedal-powered pub crawl takes you through Beer City USA’s best breweries, taprooms, and bars, all while jamming to your favorite tunes and soaking up the city vibes.

Whether you're celebrating a birthday, bachelor(ette) bash, work outing, or just the weekend, the party is brought to the pedals. Cruise the streets, raise your glass, and create unforgettable memories with your crew — one stop (and one pint) at a time.

Let’s ride, cheers, and repeat.

experiences.title: Mackinac Bridge History Cruise
experiences.description: Learn the history of shipwrecks as you travel over them, local Native American folk-lore, learn about living in the north country and the maritime history of the area while cruising under the “Mighty” Mackinac Bridge. Get up close to this awe-inspiring piece of architecture.

experiences.title: Uptown Grand Rapids Walking Food Tour with Local Tastings
experiences.description:
Explore the culinary landscape of Uptown Grand Rapids on this engaging walking food tour, where you’ll savor a delightful variety of bites from four locally acclaimed eateries. Over the course of three hours, enjoy a mix of savory and sweet dishes while uncovering the rich history of this vibrant neighborhood. With a maximum group size of 12 guests, this tour ensures a personable experience filled with storytelling and insider knowledge. Whether you're a local or visiting for the first time, this foodie adventure is perfect for all palates, accommodating dietary restrictions upon request.

- Duration: 3 hours of delightful walking and tasting
- Sample four award-winning eateries with generous food tastings
- Light walking (0.7 miles) with frequent stops, wheelchair accessible
- Limited to 12 guests for an intimate and engaging experience

experiences.title: Small Group Walking Bar Tour
experiences.description:
Join us on an unforgettable walking bar tour along Detroit’s legendary Woodward Avenue, where you’ll explore 3-4 well traveled watering holes. From sleek cocktail lounges to time-honored dive bars, this experience blends the best of Detroit’s nightlife with its rich, gritty, and fascinating history.

Led by a fun, knowledgeable local guide, you’ll hear tales of Prohibition, the evolution of Detroit’s legendary bar scene, and the city’s musical and industrial roots—all while sipping craft cocktails, local brews, or whatever suits your taste. Along the way, we’ll stop for photo ops at landmarks like Hart Plaza & The Spirit of Detroit.

Note we also do private tours, please message us for details.

experiences.title: Self Guided Detroit's Spirit and History Solo Walking Tour
experiences.description:
You will discover Detroit’s hidden gems, artistic Alleys, funky food spots, golden era buildings and world class parks. Go at your own pace, your own schedule and stop and go as you please. This is a Self Guided Tour navigated by your smart phone on the WalknTours app. The technology is so good visitors say "It's like walking with Rick Steve's". 

Detroit is a city on the rise. Not long ago this was a different city, today it’s thriving and the people of Detroit are carving out a culture that is authentically D Town. Discover how Detroit is changing, and see how it's past changed world history. 

The tour starts at Buddy’s on Broadway, the shop that invented Detroit Style Pizza. So, grab a slice and let’s get this party started.

experiences.title: Detroit Downtown Food Tour with 6+ Iconic Tastings in Motor City
experiences.description: Dive into Detroit’s downtown soul on a flavorful walking food tour guided by genuine city storytellers. Explore the heart of Motor City—from Greektown to historic landmarks—as you enjoy 6+ iconic tastings that tell the story of Detroit’s culinary comeback. Indulge in corned beef egg rolls, sample rival Coney Island hot dogs, cool off with a Detroit original Boston Cooler float, savor a slice of Detroit-style pizza, treat yourself to a Greektown pastry, and uncover our chef’s exclusive Secret Dish with a local twist. Every stop pairs delicious bites with compelling stories—from immigrant roots to renaissance neighborhoods—offering a warm and authentic taste of Detroit you won’t find on your own.

experiences.title: NON-BUS MOVIE STARS 2 couple / 4 person Old Mission Wine Tour
experiences.description:
SEMI-PRIVATE OR PRIVATE VIP WINE TOUR 

NOT THE OVER-BOOKED CHEAP BUS TOUR!! Want cheap? Stop reading and book the bus...

2 COUPLES ONLY- this is the tour that books only 2 couples- never more than 4 people in this vehicle... great for groups of 4 or for couples who do not want a large crowd on a party bus. Couples that book 2 spots will at most have one other couple with them on this tour. Why would you ever book a loud, obnoxious party bus? See our semi-private or private booking options

Great for any romantic occasion!

experiences.title: Evening Local Food and Art Tour in Grand Rapids
experiences.description:
3 Hours | Downtown Grand Rapids | Local Food • Public Art • Creative Dessert

Experience ArtPrize on a guided walking tour through downtown Grand Rapids. Begin by exploring a hidden art gallery inside an award-winning local restaurant before picking up a slice of Detroit-style pepperoni pizza to enjoy as you stroll between ArtPrize venues and outdoor installations.

Your local guide will lead you through a thoughtfully planned route, sharing stories about the ArtPrize event, participating artists, and the city's vibrant arts scene. Along the way, you'll experience a variety of sculptures, installations, paintings, photography, digital media, and interactive works.

End the tour at one of Grand Rapids' favorite sweet shops, where you'll decorate your own slice of cake using colorful frosting before enjoying your edible masterpiece.

Alcoholic beverages are available for purchase. Guests 21+ may enjoy drinks while walking through Grand Rapids' Social District, following local guidelines.

experiences.title: Glass Painting Class
experiences.description:
Anyone 5 years old and up is capable of doing this fun and easy glass painting experience with parental supervision.
We provide all the materials needed.
The standard size for this experience is an 8.5”x11” picture frame.
All of your experiences are instructor-led and require no experience, which means we lead you step by step, and you leave with a masterpiece you created and love.

experiences.title: NON-BUS MOVIE STARS Leelanau & "That's a Pizza" Wine & Food Tour
experiences.description:
Napa Valley Meets Traverse City Wine Country on Leelanau Peninsula

Stunning views, stellar wines, and 5-star Movie Star customer service

Leave the driving to us! Sip and savor as you sample the wines of 3 wineries. This is a "Scenic View AND Drink Recommendation Tour"...

This is true VIP wine tour treatment with true Leelanau Wine experts NOT BUS DRIVERS. This wine tour isn't just transportation to the wineries, this is a WINE EXPERIENCE with real wine recommendations. The tour guides have been doing this Leelanau Peninsula Wine Tour for 5 years plus. WE don't have 20 buses, we roll in luxury SUVs. There aren't too many Stars around, so if you want to be a Movie Star for the day book with Movie Stars Wine Tours. 

Meet up and finish the tour with food at the famed That'sa Pizza N Long Lake location. Drop off at the same pickup location or downtown Traverse City at one of the restaurants or bars. Tastings, wines, and food are not included in the price of the tour.

experiences.title: Challah Baking Experience
experiences.description:
For thousands of years, Jewish people have brought in the Sabbath with candles, wine, and the blessing over challah -- the traditional braided bread. During this activity, you'll learn practical challah-baking tips as well as the history, significance, and cultural roots of challah-baking. 
You'll experience a genuine and age-old Jewish tradition as you learn the steps to bake your very own challah -- and then you'll be able to enjoy your warm-from-the-oven fresh-baked challah bread!

experiences.title: Luxury Sushi-Making Class in Minneapolis (Includes 5-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the refined art of sushi-making in a welcoming Minneapolis kitchen, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to a small group, this interactive class highlights Japanese techniques while guiding you through rice preparation, knife skills and rolling.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Asian salad with crisp vegetables and sesame-ginger dressing
- Sushi roll: Salmon avocado roll with creamy avocado and fresh salmon
- Sushi roll: California roll with cucumber, avocado and surimi
- Sushi roll: Spicy tuna roll with fresh tuna and sriracha
- Dessert: Assorted mochi ice creams in a variety of flavors

Enjoy your creations as you build confidence in sushi-making and leave with skills to recreate these dishes at home.

experiences.title: Monday Night Burrito Bowl Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
experiences.description:
Set sail on Lake Minnetonka for a delightful 2-hour cruise while crafting your own burrito bowl. Enjoy a unique dining experience aboard a two-story yacht as you glide past the scenic beauty of Big Island, featuring stunning homes, parks, and marinas. Customize your bowl with fresh ingredients like pulled pork, chicken, salsa, and guacamole. This family-friendly cruise is perfect for ages 2 and up, with drinks available for purchase. Relax and soak in the sights while savoring a delicious meal in a vibrant atmosphere.

- Two-hour scenic cruise around Big Island on Lake Minnetonka
- Build your own burrito bowl with a variety of delicious toppings
- Family-friendly, catering to adults and children alike
- Drinks available for purchase, enhancing the cruise experience

experiences.title: Pasta Shapes Cooking Class in Minneapolis (4 Pasta Shapes)
experiences.description:
One dough, four shapes, endless possibilities. This hands-on pasta class hosted through Cozymeal in Minneapolis, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, shows you how technique alone transforms flour, eggs, salt and olive oil into tagliatelle, ravioli, orecchiette and cavatelli.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Tagliatelle – long ribbon pasta from flour, eggs, salt and olive oil
- Ravioli – filled pasta pillows from flour, eggs, salt and olive oil
- Orecchiette – hand-pressed "little ears" from flour, eggs, salt and olive oil
- Cavatelli – hand-rolled pasta shells from flour, eggs, salt and olive oil

You will leave with four Italian pasta-making techniques and the confidence to bring handmade pasta to your table at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Fun Gnocchi Cooking Class at a Trendy Wine Bar in Minneapolis
experiences.description:
Slow down, sip wine and master Italy’s most comforting pasta in this immersive gnocchi-making experience.

Hosted at a stylish local wine bar, this class with Chef Aaron feels like stepping into a rustic Italian kitchen — without leaving the city. You’ll start by transforming simple ingredients — potatoes, flour, eggs and salt — into tender gnocchi dough, learning how to knead and shape each piece for that perfect pillowy bite.

While your pasta cooks, you’ll prepare a deeply flavorful ragu from scratch. Dice carrots, celery and onion, simmer fresh tomatoes and enrich the sauce with beef, pork and a splash of wine for complexity. Chef Aaron walks you through every step, sharing insider tips on sauce building, timing and texture.

At the end, sit down to enjoy your handmade gnocchi coated in rich ragu, paired with the warm, lively atmosphere of the wine bar. It’s a cozy culinary escape that blends technique, storytelling and incredible flavor into one memorable evening.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Venue in Minneapolis
experiences.description:
In this hands-on pasta making class with Chef Mimi in Minneapolis, you’ll have an immersive culinary experience that will help you master the time-honored techniques in a welcoming distillery venue. Chef Mimi has a passion for cooking and teaching excited students and hungry foodies new culinary skills and essential techniques.Class begins by learning the time-honored recipe to make handmade pasta. Combine eggs, flour, olive oil and salt to make the pasta dough. Master the technique to knead, shape and cut the dough into pasta. As the noodles cook, you’ll make a creamy homemade alfredo sauce with butter and Parmesan cheese.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Minneapolis
experiences.description:
If your dream vacation involves carbs and Italian grandmothers yelling “more flour,” this pasta-making class with Chef Aaron is basically your moment. Hosted at a stylish global eatery in Minneapolis, this interactive experience teaches you how to make two fresh pasta shapes completely from scratch using traditional Italian techniques.

Start by preparing classic pasta dough with flour, eggs and salt before learning how to knead, rest and roll it to the perfect texture. Chef Aaron, who trained in Italy, will guide you step-by-step through crafting fresh tagliatelle and handmade ravioli filled with creamy ricotta. Then comes the best part: finishing the ravioli with butter and sage for a simple but ridiculously flavorful sauce that lets the fresh pasta shine. The class is welcoming, social and beginner-friendly, making it perfect for date nights, friend outings or anyone tired of paying restaurant prices for pasta they could absolutely learn to make themselves.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class at a Local Brewery in Minneapolis
experiences.description:
Trade your usual brewery snacks for freshly rolled sushi in this fun, hands-on cooking class with Chef Pao.

Hosted at a local brewery, this interactive experience teaches you how to create two restaurant-style sushi rolls from scratch. Begin with the crowd-pleasing California roll, packed with imitation crab, cucumber and avocado. Next, prepare a flavourful spicy salmon roll with fresh salmon, crunchy vegetables and a creamy kick of spice.

You’ll learn how to handle sushi rice, arrange your fillings and roll everything neatly using professional techniques shared by Chef Pao. After class, enjoy your handmade sushi and pair it with a drink available for purchase from the brewery.

Perfect for beginners, food lovers, date nights or anyone who believes sushi tastes even better when you make it yourself.

experiences.title: Make Epic Pad Thai With Local Chef in Minneapolis
experiences.description: Unleash your inner chef and learn to make a perfect Pad Thai in this exciting cooking class with Chef Mimi! This hands-on class will teach you all the secrets behind creating this iconic Thai dish, from selecting the freshest ingredients like rice noodles, peanuts, and vegetables, to mastering the balance of bold flavors. Chef Mimi will share her expert tips and techniques to help you cook Pad Thai that tastes far better than any takeout dish. Whether you’re new to Thai cuisine or a culinary enthusiast, you’ll pick up valuable skills and have a blast creating your own Thai masterpiece. Bring your friends along for a fun, interactive cooking session and enjoy a delicious meal together!

experiences.title: Potsticker-Making Class in Minneapolis (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Explore Asian comfort food in this hands-on Minneapolis cooking class hosted through Cozymeal. You’ll prepare dumplings, fried rice and mochi while learning techniques that translate easily to weeknight cooking.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

 - First course: Pork or vegetable potstickers with scallion, garlic and lime soy sauce.
 - Second course: Chicken or vegetarian fried rice cooked for crisp edges and savory depth.
 - Dessert: Assorted mochi ice cream with a soft, chewy shell.

Learn how to portion fillings, fold and seal dumplings and combine steaming with pan-frying for a crisp finish. Your local chef will also cover rice texture, heat control and sauce balance. Enjoy the finished dishes together and bring wine or beer to pair with the menu.

experiences.title: Ravioli & Tagliatelle Making Class at a Wine Bar in Minneapolis
experiences.description:
Step into a stylish Minneapolis wine bar and learn pasta the Italian way.

This immersive class with Chef Aaron blends Old World technique with a modern night out. You’ll begin by crafting fresh pasta dough from flour, eggs and salt, learning how to knead, rest and roll it properly for perfect elasticity. Then shape two beloved classics: hand-cut tagliatelle and ricotta-filled ravioli.

For the tagliatelle, prepare a silky cacio e pepe sauce with black pepper, Parmesan and Pecorino, mastering the art of emulsifying cheese and pasta water. Next, fill and seal ravioli before finishing them in a simple butter and sage sauce that highlights every delicate bite.

This intimate experience includes personal instruction, premium ingredients and a full homemade pasta meal served in a trendy local venue. It’s an authentic Italian escape — right in the heart of Minneapolis.

experiences.title: Minneapolis Local Bar Tour with Tastings
experiences.description: Learn about the unique character and history of Minneapolis and its neighborhoods with local expert guides while enjoying hand selected drinks that define our city and its people. Share stories with your guide and fellow tour members as we walk the streets of Minneapolis between our bars. Chat with the knowledgeable bartenders and staff that help us get through those long winter months, and heartbreaking sports teams

experiences.title: Minneapolis Skyway Afternoon Snacks
experiences.description:
Explore the unique culinary landscape of Minneapolis on this guided walking food tour through the interconnected Skyway system. Over two hours, sample four distinct local dishes that showcase the flavors of Minneapolis and the Midwest. While navigating through the climate-controlled passages, discover the historical significance of the Skyway that has linked generations for over sixty years. Follow your local guide though the maze of passages to the best hidden gems above, and below the streets of Minneapolis.

- Guided walking food tour through the Minneapolis Skyway system
- Taste four local dishes representative of Minneapolis and the Midwest
- Learn about the history and significance of the Skyway
- Easy 2-hour tour, perfect for food lovers and culture seekers alike

experiences.title: Public Fall Colors Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
experiences.description:
Discover the stunning scenery of Lake Minnetonka on this 90-minute Public Champagne Sightseeing Cruise. Sip on a complimentary drink while soaking in the beautiful views. The heated and air-conditioned boat ensures a comfortable experience year-round, whether you're enjoying the fall colors or the summer sun. Perfect for families and friends, this cruise is a great way to relax and unwind on the water. Additional snacks and drinks are available for purchase to enhance your outing.

- 90-minute scenic cruise on Lake Minnetonka
- Includes a drink ticket for beer, wine, or soft drink
- Heated and air-conditioned boats for comfort
- Great for families, with discounted rates for children

experiences.title: Trendy North Loop Food Tour in Minneapolis
experiences.description:
Explore the dynamic North Loop neighborhood of Minneapolis on a unique food adventure. This tour showcases the area's rich history and vibrant culinary landscape, blending classic Minnesota flavors with diverse immigrant influences. Stroll through the trendy Warehouse District, where historic brick buildings now house exciting restaurants and shops. Taste an array of delicious dishes that highlight the region's gastronomic evolution while learning about the stories behind each bite. Perfect for food lovers and cultural enthusiasts looking to experience the heart of the Twin Cities.

- Discover the trendy North Loop neighborhood aka NOLO
- Savor local Minnesota favorites and diverse immigrant cuisine
- Immerse yourself in the neighborhood's rich history and culture
- Ideal for food lovers seeking a unique dining experience

experiences.title: Minneapolis Local Food Tour
experiences.description: Starting in the trendy North Loop neighborhood, we visit some of the best restaurants in Minneapolis! Learn about the city over a bite to eat (or four)! From a building with four James Beard nominated chefs under one roof, to classic upper midwest cuisine, and a little bit from northeast Minneapolis' eastern European heritage, this tour will leave both your brain and belly full! And don't forget to leave room for dessert!

experiences.title: Indoor Minneapolis Skyway Food Tour
experiences.description: While it’s chilly outside, join us as we weave through the cozy corners of downtown Minneapolis’ skyways on a delicious food adventure. Stroll through the iconic “Broadway” Theater District, see the Minneapolis skyscraper modeled after the Washington Monument and visit the beloved Statue of Mary Richards tossing her hat. Along the way, you’ll stop at four charming, locally owned eateries – businesses that take pride in tradition, including a beloved favorite dating back to 1932. As you sample each delicious bite, you’ll learn the stories and secrets behind the food, the culture, and the neighborhood, discovering what makes downtown Minneapolis so unique. By the end of the tour, you’ll leave with a flavorful experience of some of the best food finds in the city, all while soaking in downtown history and local culture—warm, comfortable, and knowledgeable.

experiences.title: #1 Ghost Tour in the Midwest : Candlelight Trolley Tour
experiences.description:
Climb aboard Minneapolis’ Candlelight Ghost Trolley Tour for a wickedly fun night of haunted history, paranormal legends, and eerie storytelling through the city’s darkest corners. Departing from the infamous haunted Pillsbury Club, guests can arrive early to explore the Halloween market, grab food, and relax in exclusive VIP lounges before the spirits come out to play.

Led by expert storytellers-you’ll ride through Minneapolis aboard a historic trolley rumored to be haunted itself, hearing chilling tales of ghostly apparitions, cursed mansions, unsolved mysteries, and the strange figures still said to wander the streets after dark.

Armed with flickering candlelight you’ll experience one of Minneapolis’ top-rated nighttime attractions and a year-round Halloween event that’s equal parts spooky, theatrical, and wildly entertaining.

experiences.title: Historic Downtown St Paul Food Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the best of St Paul food in the heart of downtown. You’ll learn about the Capital City's robust food culture while exploring its rich history including a lively gangster past. Tastings are based on our multicultural communities and the best water in the country for creating delicious craft beer.

Start by enjoying the sights along the Mighty Mississippi River and strolling through some of the most historic areas in town, including the Saint Paul Hotel that overlooks Rice Park and Landmark Center. Along the way you’ll enjoy quaint eateries that have pride in local ownership, including a favorite since 1932.

Visit one of the best local chocolatiers/confectioners to eat and sip their hand-crafted creations. Experience one of Thailand's most popular rice dishes. To cap off an incredible tour of Minnesota’s 2nd-largest city you'll taste a variety of savory African and Mediterranean dishes. Between the rich history and incredible food, you’ll never want to leave the state’s capital.

experiences.title: Sunday Dinner Show Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
experiences.description:
Enjoy a delightful evening on the Sunday Dinner Show Cruise, where you can savor a delicious Italian buffet while listening to live music featuring hits from the 70s, 80s, and today. This two-hour cruise on Lake Minnetonka offers a relaxing atmosphere with free unlimited soft drinks and a cash bar for your convenience. Perfect for families or anyone looking to unwind with good food and great music. Gather your friends and family for a memorable night out on the water.

- Two-hour cruise with live music entertainment
- Italian buffet menu with chicken fettuccine and dessert bars
- Free unlimited soft drinks and a full cash bar available
- Ideal for families and groups looking for a fun night out

experiences.title: Friday Night Happy Hour Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
experiences.description:
Enjoy a laid-back evening on Lake Minnetonka with the Friday Night Happy Hour Cruise. This 2-hour voyage features a soundtrack of classics from the 70s, 80s, and today while you take in the beautiful scenery. Each guest receives a complimentary drink—choose from a soft drink, beer, or wine—and savor packaged snacks as you relax and unwind on the water. Perfect for ages 18 and up, this cruise promises a perfect blend of music, views, and good vibes.

- 2-hour cruise on scenic Lake Minnetonka
- 1 Complimentary drink and snacks included (could be soft drink, beer or wine)
- Music from the 70s, 80s, and contemporary hits
- Great for ages 18 and up, ideal for a fun night out

experiences.title: Minneapolis Riverwalk Food Tour
experiences.description:
Hungry for an off the beaten path Minneapolis food experience? Join us as we explore a pair of the city's trendy and historical neighborhoods, the Mill District and St Anthony Main in Northeast Minneapolis. We'll take you through the founding and growth of the "City of Flour and Sawdust" while following in the footsteps of immigrants who came to work the mills. You'll enjoy sampling food at the first Thai restaurant in Minnesota, authentic Italian pizza, home-made ice cream, divine baked goods, and the best matcha you'll ever drink.

In addition to sampling food, we will also stroll by the local Farmers Market, Mill City Museum and Guthrie Theater. You'll enjoy gorgeous views of St Anthony Falls as we walk along the Stone Arch Bridge into historical St Anthony Main. Learn about the history of both neighborhoods while touring the oldest street in Minneapolis. Get to know your fellow food-loving guests while gaining an appreciation for distinct neighborhoods that most tourists never see!

experiences.title: Boats and Burgers Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
experiences.description:
Savor a delightful two-hour cruise on Lake Minnetonka aboard a spacious two-story yacht, featuring a narrated journey past stunning homes, parks, and marinas. Enjoy mouthwatering cheeseburgers alongside all the fixings, chips with dip, pasta salad, fresh fruit, and cookies for dessert. Beer, wine, and cocktails are available for purchase, ensuring a refreshing experience as you take in the scenic beauty of the lake. Perfect for families and friends looking for a casual dining experience on the water.

- Two-hour narrated cruise around Big Island on Lake Minnetonka
- Mouthwatering cheeseburgers, chips, and desserts included
- Beer, wine, and cocktails available for purchase
- Scheduled on Wednesdays and Sundays at designated times

experiences.title: Elvis Dinner Show Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
experiences.description:
Sail around Lake Minnetonka while enjoying the best of Elvis in a unique dinner show experience. With a performance celebrating 90 memories of the King, this cruise brings back the iconic songs that defined an era. Indulge in a delicious Italian buffet dinner featuring Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo and assorted dessert bars, all while soaking in the serene lake views. This special event runs on select Sundays from May to October, making it an ideal outing for music lovers and families looking for a memorable night out. 

- 2-hour cruise featuring live Elvis tribute performance 
- Delicious Italian buffet dinner included with your ticket 
- Cash bar available for refreshing drinks 
- Perfect for families and Elvis fans alike.

experiences.title: Minneapolis North Loop Food Tour of 6 Local's Favorites Tastings
experiences.description:
Discover the bold flavors and hidden gems of Minneapolis on this unforgettable food tour through the North Loop and St. Anthony Main neighborhoods. 

Led by a passionate local guide, you’ll enjoy 6 delicious tastings that showcase the city’s unique blend of Scandinavian heritage, immigrant flavors, and modern Midwest innovation. 

Stroll past red-brick warehouses turned award-winning eateries, cross the iconic Stone Arch Bridge, and taste how European and Indigenous traditions shaped the Twin Cities’ culinary identity. 

Along the way, you’ll uncover fascinating local stories, meet passionate food makers, and experience why Minneapolis is fast becoming one of America’s top food destinations. Come hungry and leave inspired and full!

experiences.title: Sunday Brunch Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
experiences.description: Join us for a public cruise around Lake Minnetonka. Glide over the lake as you enjoy Sunday brunch, a taco and margarita bar, a variety of shows and celebrations, and much more!

experiences.title: Loon Liquors Distillery Private Tour
experiences.description:
Set out on an adventure through the world of distillation, where you will discover farm to flask flavors. Join a local distillery tour and unlock the mysteries behind handcrafted spirits, from the first whiff of aromatic botanicals to the last lingering notes on your palate. As you wander through the production equipment and copper stills, expert guides will regale you with education and tales of innovation, and the passionate artisans who bring each bottle to life. Prepare for a sensory expedition that will ignite your curiosity, delight your taste buds, and leave you craving the next chapter in your spirited adventure!

Includes: 1 Spirits flight (for aged spirits - select "whiskey nerd"), 1 branded Glencarin crystal spirit glass, full production tour, and an overhead projector presentation. 

Pizza and food available to purchase before or after the tour. Pizza flour stone milled onsite!

experiences.title: Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride in Minneapolis
experiences.description: Discover Minneapolis from a fresh perspective on the Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride, a guided cycling route through one of the city's most creative districts. Pedal along scenic river routes while admiring public art installations, historic architecture, and vibrant urban murals. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, this tour offers an engaging way to explore local culture and waterfront views at an easy, enjoyable pace. Stops include iconic local restaurants serving food and beverages and art stops.

experiences.title: Private Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride in Minneapolis
experiences.description: Pedal through one of the most vibrant historic districts on the Private Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride. Departing from Marshall Street NE, this interactive pedal-powered group adventure allows travelers to work together while cruising past scenic Mississippi riverbanks, eye-catching neighborhood murals, and bustling local hubs. Led by a knowledgeable local driver, your group can sit back, pedal at a comfortable pace, and soak in the creative energy of Northeast Minneapolis while exploring top sights and stopping at neighborhood favorites. We'll stop at iconic, local restaurants offering food and beverages and art stops.

experiences.title: Standup Comedy Tour and Opportunity to Perform at ACME
experiences.description: Experience the only comedy tour of its kind in The Twin Cities with exclusive access to ACME Comedy Company, one of the top stand‑up clubs in the U.S. Guided by a working comedian, you’ll explore the venue, learn how open mic nights work, and get help signing up to perform a 3‑minute set. First‑time performers have a strong chance of getting stage time, and if you’re not selected, you’ll receive $10 toward food or drinks while enjoying the show. Perfect for comedy fans or aspiring performers, with an optional coaching add‑on to help you prepare.

experiences.title: Pendergast Cocktail College Classes
experiences.description: Tom's Town introduces Pendergast Cocktail College, a captivating series of cocktail classes held every Wednesday at 6:00 PM. In our 90-minute sessions in the Libations Lab, you’ll delve into our signature spirits—bourbon, gin, and vodka—and learn to mix three seasonal cocktails with rotating recipes. Beyond crafting drinks, our curriculum explores essential bar skills, the art of shaking vs. stirring, and shares historical insights into classic cocktails. Enrollment covers the class, three crafted cocktails, and a cheese board. Join us for a unique evening that blends creativity and craftsmanship, where every cocktail tells a story.

experiences.title: Small-Group Jewelry Making with Wine Tasting in Kansas City
experiences.description:
We apply a "farm-to-table" concept to our design approach, making every handbag and accessory from local leather, linen, and wood sources.

You will make earrings, bracelets, or card wallets from leather processed right here in Missouri while learning about the story of Kansas City's history in the garment industry and its revitalization in the 21st century.

experiences.title: SIX Show in Branson
experiences.description:
SIX® is a high-energy, all-vocal group made up of six real brothers celebrating 20 years of live performance in Branson, Missouri.

With no instruments, no backing tracks, and no auto-tune, SIX creates the sound of a full band using only their voices — from driving percussion and bass lines to guitar riffs, brass hits, and tight harmonies.

This fast-paced show blends contemporary hits, classic favorites, and original arrangements, all delivered with precision, humor, and genuine brotherly chemistry. Every sound you hear is created live, making each performance unique.

As one of Branson’s longest-running vocal groups, SIX® has built a reputation for authentic live music, world-class vocals, and family-friendly entertainment that appeals to all ages.

Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a returning fan, SIX at 20 celebrates two decades of music, brotherhood, and unforgettable live performance.

experiences.title: Day Trip to Sainte Genevieve Experience
experiences.description:
A Day in Ste. Genevieve: Taste, Sip & Explore! (Wednesday, Thursdays, Fridays & Sunday)

Ready for the perfect day trip?

Spend the day tasting, sipping, and exploring some of the best experiences Ste. Genevieve County has to offer.

Travel to the world-renowned Baetje Farms (arrive at 10am for your tour), tour the farm, learn how their award-winning goat cheeses are crafted, and of course, enjoy a delicious tasting. Trust us, this isn’t your average cheese plate!

Next, head to Charleville Brewery & Winery. Enjoy 4 hand selected samples. Enjoy what you tried?! We have 24 taps where you can purchase addition samples of beer, wine, margaritas and you will have time to purchase some tasty lunch!

Then wrap up the day in historic Ste. Gen, to see one of MO's most charming towns. Enjoy a sweet treat at Sara's Ice Cream (124 Merchant, Ste. Gen). Explore historic landmarks, check out unique local shops, and soak up the small-town French colonial charm. Flavor, history & fun all in one day!

experiences.title: Private Firearms Training for Two at Sharpshooters St. Louis
experiences.description:
Sharpshooters St. Louis is the ultimate indoor shooting range and training center for every skill level. Focused on safety and confidence, your expert instructors provide tailored lessons in a welcoming environment. 

In addition to training, guests can enjoy a spacious retail showroom and an on-site BBQ restaurant, making Sharpshooters a one-of-a-kind destination!

Each lesson includes eye and ear protection, targets, lane time, and your choice of rental firearm. The only extra cost is the ammunition you select for your training.

experiences.title: Private Tour of St. Louis's Iconic BBQ Joints & Breweries
experiences.description:
St. Louis is one of America's great beer and BBQ cities, and this private tour takes you straight to the heart of both.

Your guide Wayne drives you to a hand-picked lineup of the city's best smokehouses and breweries, from nationally acclaimed spots like Side Project Brewing to the legendary Anheuser-Busch Biergarten. Each stop is chosen for what it does best, whether that's a perfect rack of ribs, a small-batch sour, or an American Lager in a beer hall with 170 years of history.

Between stops, Wayne fills in the story of how German immigrants turned St. Louis into the beer capital of America, why the city's BBQ style is its own thing, and where the locals actually eat everyday.

Food and drinks are purchased by your group at each stop, so you choose exactly what you want.

***Larger private group tours (up to 55 guests) are available. Please contact us for options, pricing, and availability***

experiences.title: StL's Signature "Sights and Bites" - Private Tour in St. Louis
experiences.description:
Explore the heart of St. Louis on a customizable private tour that combines iconic sights with delicious local eats. This experience is perfect for families, food enthusiasts, and history buffs, allowing you to select from famous attractions like the Gateway Arch, Forest Park, and Anheuser-Busch brewery, alongside culinary favorites such as Pappy’s Smokehouse and Ted Drewes Frozen Custard. With a knowledgeable guide, complimentary food, and transportation included, you'll enjoy a tailored adventure that highlights the best of the Gateway City at your own pace.

- Duration: 4–6 hours with a private group size of 2–6 guests
- Choose your culinary experiences and attractions
- Includes transportation, expert guide, and food tastings
- Pickup/drop-off from central St. Louis hotels or homes included

***Larger group tours up to 55 guests are available. Inquire with Wayne for specific details.***

experiences.title: Private Day Trip to Missouri Wine Country
experiences.description:
We have been providing private hospitality services in the St. Louis region since 2005. We are very knowledgable on the area, attractions, dining, and social scenes.

We create personalized experiences based on guest input and host expertise. The entire excursion is customizable to the needs of our guests. Get ready for fun, hospitality, and delicious MO wines and craft beers!

This experience is perfect for a couples getaway or a group of friends wanting to explore the country's first American Viticultural Area.

experiences.title: Kansas City's Sweet Escape Chocolate & Wine: A Private Tour
experiences.description: Skip the crowds—this private tour is for your group only! Embark on "Kansas City's Private Sweet Escape: Chocolate & Wine Tour," a stroll through districts. Discover Kansas City's heritage as you explore the historic Power and Light District, where elegance meets modern indulgence. Your adventure begins in a transformed civilization, where centuries of legacy blend with cuisine. Savor wine pairings with chocolates. Then continue to the Crossroads Arts District, a vibrant hub of artistic expression and classical influence. Here, artisan chocolates reveal bold flavors amid galleries and murals telling stories of urban reinvention. This isn't just an outing—it's a personal journey into the epicurean soul of a city with deep historical roots. Treat yourself to an evening of luxury. Join us for an intimate experience that delights and dazzles.

experiences.title: Private Chocolate Tasting Half-Day Tour in Saint Louis
experiences.description: This private chocolate tasting tour reveals Saint Louis through refined flavors. Begin at the Cathedral Basilica and admire historic mosaics and sacred art. Travel through Central West End where elegant streets host artisan chocolatiers. Taste handcrafted chocolates while learning traditional techniques and cultural origins. Continue to The Grove where modern creations reflect evolving culinary artistry. Explore Maplewood and enjoy carefully prepared confections in a charming setting. How did chocolate traditions evolve into today’s craftsmanship? This journey blends cultural heritage with premium tasting experiences. Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.

experiences.title: Private Food Tasting Walking Tour in Saint Louis Downtown
experiences.description: This private food tasting walking tour reveals Saint Louis through culinary heritage. Discover flavors shaped by diverse cultural influences. Walk through historic downtown where classic architecture meets evolving cuisine. Taste local specialties while learning how traditions developed over generations. Pause at Citygarden where art and atmosphere enhance each moment. Continue to Washington Square Park and enjoy refined bites in a calm setting. How did migration and history shape these distinctive flavors? This experience blends gastronomy with cultural storytelling. Each taste reflects a deeper connection to the city’s identity. Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.

experiences.title: The Mind Spy
experiences.description:
The Mind Spy isn’t just another Branson show—it’s one of the most exclusive and intimate experiences in the Midwest, performed only twice a week inside the cozy Little Opry Theatre at the Branson IMAX Entertainment Complex. This limited‑engagement format means every guest is close to the action, creating a level of connection and astonishment you won’t find in large theaters.

Led by Branson’s top‑rated mentalist, the show delivers Mind Melting Mental Magic that blends psychological illusion, Spycraft and audience participation. It’s no surprise the experience earned Tripadvisor’s Traveler’s Choice of the Year Award and Steve was named one of the Top 10 Entertainers in Missouri by Best Rate.

Every performance is interactive, family‑friendly, and uniquely personal—no two shows are ever the same. If you’re looking for something different, smart, surprising, and truly unforgettable, this is the Branson experience travelers talk about long after they leave.

experiences.title: Tom's Town Distillery Tour and Tasting
experiences.description:
Whether you're visiting KC or were born and bred in Tom's Town, we'd love to show you around! Tours last an hour and include a look at our distilling process, a brief overview of Kansas City history during Boss Tom's rule, and a tasting of each of our award winning spirits.

Each tour includes spots for up to 20 people, and reservations may be made online. Reservations close one hour prior to the start of the tour.

experiences.title: Bullets & BBQ at Indoor Shooting Range in St. Louis County
experiences.description:
Sharpshooters Indoor Gun Range is the ultimate shooting experience, offering comfort, convenience and excitement for everyone – from the beginner to the expert. Sharpshooters offers 20 indoor lanes, for education, training and practice opportunities. Our superior ventilation and air filtration in a comfortable, spotless environment. Each range lane has ballistic-rated shooting stalls for your safety, with plenty of elbow room and Range Safety Officers monitoring all lanes. Bring your own firearm or use one of our firearms from a large selection of brands and calibers at our indoor shooting range.

Before or after your time in the range, savor mouth-watering St. Louis-style barbeque that is smoked fresh daily. We serve our "Bang Good BBQ" in our Grill, outside deck, private party or training rooms.

We are considered a Five Star Range and brag about friendly & well trained credentialed staff. Welcome phone calls with questions to feel comfortable shooting alone or with a group.

experiences.title: Tour The Ozarks Private Wine & Shine Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy a private four-hour tour for your group with pickup and drop-off in the Branson area. Your guide handles the driving and builds the route around your preferences, venue hours and availability. Possible winery and distillery stops are examples, not guarantees. Tastings, flights, food and other venue purchases are paid directly to each stop unless specifically stated as included. Your guide can help with photos, local recommendations and a safe, relaxed day.

experiences.title: Branson Murder Mystery- Branson's Original #1 Murder Mystery
experiences.description: Branson Murder Mystery is a hysterical original Comedy unlike anything you will see while visiting Branson. A full buffet dinner and dessert come with your ticket. The show is a highly interactive audience experience. This is one show you will want to see again and again

experiences.title: KATY Self-Guided 6-day Tour - Clinton to St. Charles + 1 bag/per
experiences.description: Ride the longest Rails to Trails State Park in the USA. This ride is on many people's bucket list! Give us a call for more details

experiences.title: A Taste of Two Cities St Louis Food and History Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Join a neighborhood local in the Central West End and enjoy "A Taste of Two Cities", a curated sampling of hidden gems and only-in-STL eats like toasted ravioli, gooey butter cake, and the perennially controversial Provel cheese. Most guests skip dinner.

In between, you'll enjoy an easy 2-mile walk accompanied by sights and tales of two distinct eras of St. Louis' (and American) history. 

The first, one of opulent Gilded-Age wealth culminating in a globally-attended showcase of human achievement in 1904 - a World's Fair we still won't shut up about.

And the second - a less-spoken-of chapter of self-inflicted wounds that would create the Delmar Divide and come to a head when the Black Lives Matter movement is born in nearby Ferguson in 2014.

"A balanced view of history. No punches pulled. Every part is human, beautiful and ugly." — ahunkins, Minneapolis MN

"I always book a walking history/food tour in every city I visit, and this was hands down the best." — Kelly E.

experiences.title: Private Tour of The Hill, The "Little Italy" of Saint Louis
experiences.description:
Explore The Hill, St. Louis's legendary "Little Italy", on a private walking tour through one of the most authentic Italian-American neighborhoods in the US.

Your guide Wayne takes you on a journey of the mom-and-pop shops, bakeries, delis, and restaurants that have made The Hill a food destination for over a century. You will share signature tastings at multiple stops. Think Toasted Ravioli, St. Louis-style pizza, and Gioia's Deli's famous hot salami subs.

Between bites, you'll walk the neighborhood streets and hear the stories of the immigrant families who built The Hill and kept it thriving for generations — from the Italian flag fire hydrants to the bocce courts to the homes that produced baseball legends like Yogi Berra and Joe Garagiola.

This is The Hill the way locals experience it — not from a bus window.

Shared food tastings are included at multiple stops.

Individual drinks and gelato are available for purchase also.

Benvenuto in Collina!
(Welcome to The Hill)

experiences.title: Branson VIP Wine Tasting and Dinner Tour
experiences.description: You will sample the tastes of the Ozarks with one of our experienced local guides as they take you on a tasty tour of Branson’s finest wineries and sometimes a distillery too. Tour also includes a delicious dinner at one of the area’s top eateries.  You will roll like VIPs in one of our luxury coaches, sampling wine and shine at our best picks for Branson tastings.  Our tours are limited to 14 passengers, so you’ll get a personal experience filled with great information and stories from your Branson “expert” tour guide. Learn the rich history of the Missouri wine industry while sampling wines made from Missouri’s state grape Cynthiana/Norton as well as other varieties including native American grapes and French-American hybrids. After a relaxing afternoon of sampling, you’ll enjoy an incredible 3-course dinner at Black Oak Grill, at Branson Landing.

experiences.title: ReVibe Three Course Dinner Show Experience
experiences.description:
Step into ReVibe, Branson’s newest high‑energy dinner show that blends gourmet dining with an immersive, music‑driven party atmosphere. Instead of just watching a performance from your seat, you’ll feel like you’ve stepped inside the show—surrounded by music, movement, and nonstop entertainment.

This isn’t a traditional theater evening. It’s a vibrant, full‑evening experience designed to make you dance in your seat, sing along, and connect with performers in a uniquely personal way. Travel from the smooth sounds of the 1940s to today’s modern hits. The cast performs an exciting mix of Rock, R&B, Pop, Jazz, and Country.

- Enjoy a high‑energy, multi‑genre show spanning eight decades of music
- Experience interactive dining with performers serving and entertaining tableside
- Savor a gourmet meal in an elevated balcony setting.
- Perfect for guests looking for nightlife, dinner entertainment, and unforgettable Branson experiences

experiences.title: Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery Show - St. Louis, MO
experiences.description:
At The Dinner Detective, you’ll tackle a hilarious and challenging crime while you feast on a fantastic dinner. Just beware! The culprit is hiding in plain sight somewhere in the room, and you may find yourself as a Prime Suspect before you know it! Our engaging and unique murder mystery dinner theatre performances have been playing across the country since 2004.

Our show is very different from traditional murder mystery dinner shows. We will hide non-costumed actors in the audience that are pretending to be part of the crowd. This results in a much more social and interactive evening than with other shows. Our shows are set during the present day and take place in real time. Over the course of the night, our costumed Detectives will uncover clues, interrogate audience members that may or may not be part of the show, and help everyone get closer to solving the mystery.

experiences.title: Kansas City Downtown Food Tour with 5 Local Dishes
experiences.description:
Join us on a food tour through downtown Kansas City. You'll dine in several locally owned restaurants, trying some of their signature and unique dishes.
Learn the cowboy’s story of a city that started with the sale of herded cattle from the deep south. At the end of your Downtown food tour of Kansas City, you'll have sampled some of this city’s most delicious dishes and gained a better understanding of America’s Heartland.
 Your Kansas City food tour starts here as you travel back through history while enjoying foods that resonate with Kansas City. All the food will be served with water.

experiences.title: Bear Creek Winery and Brewery history, tasting, with lunch tour
experiences.description: Experience the Ozarks on a walking tour of the beautiful Bear Creek property, along with coffee, pastries and lunch with the owner of Bear Creek. Tour the bed and breakfast she started over 20 years ago, along with our two beautiful chapels and garden. Chat about local history of our neck of the woods and the surrounding Branson and Ozarks area from the source of a local that's been born and raised here for generations. This tour takes you away from the hustle and bustle of Branson to experience true Ozarks culture.

experiences.title: Branson Comedy Bash Dinner Show - Branson’s Best Comedy
experiences.description:
Get ready to laugh out loud at the all-new Branson Comedy Bash—a high-energy, family-friendly dinner show now playing at the Playhouse Theater at The Shepherd of the Hills! This 90-minute variety experience blends stand-up comedy, sketch performances, magic, and live music into one unforgettable night.

Featuring a talented cast including Christopher James, Blake Walker frequent special guest Jim Barber, Shannon Thomason, and the Comedy Bash Band, this fast-paced show delivers nonstop entertainment for all ages.

Enjoy a delicious meal served right at your table while the laughs keep coming—making Branson Comedy Bash the perfect night out for families, groups, and anyone looking for serious fun.

Don’t miss the newest comedy event in Branson—get your tickets today!

experiences.title: Branson Redneck Comedy Bus Tour
experiences.description:
Hop aboard the Branson Redneck Comedy Bus Tour for a two-hour adventure filled with laughter and sightseeing. This unique tour takes you through Branson's iconic landmarks while delivering a stream of hillbilly humor from experienced comedians. The camo-decked bus adds Southern charm to your ride, making it a fun experience for families with adult children and groups looking for a good time. With free parking and air-conditioned comfort, this tour is designed for maximum enjoyment. Plus, enjoy a moonshine tasting for a true local flavor.

- Two-hour sightseeing and comedy tour in Branson
- Unique camouflage bus with friendly comedians
- Enjoy a moonshine tasting as part of the fun
- PG-14 Humor

experiences.title: Branson’s WhoDunnit Hoedown Murder Mystery Dinner Show
experiences.description: The WhoDunnit Hoedown Murder Mystery Dinner Show is Branson's newest Murder Mystery Dinner Show Experience. Come out and have a delicious dinner and lots of laughs! You might figure out Who Dun It!

experiences.title: Tour The Ozarks Private Springfield Brewery Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy a private four-hour brewery tour for your group with pickup and drop-off in the Springfield area. Your guide handles the driving and builds the route around your preferences, brewery hours and availability. Possible brewery stops are examples, not guarantees. Flights, drinks, food and other venue purchases are paid directly to each stop unless specifically stated as included. Your guide can help with local recommendations, photos and a safe, relaxed day.

experiences.title: Museum of BBQ General Admission Ticket
experiences.description:
Welcome to the world's first museum dedicated to barbecue. The Museum of BBQ is 10 interactive exhibits that teach you how barbecue gets its flavor and the difference between the four main American regions: the Carolinas, Memphis, Texas, and Kansas City. 

Smell the components of spice, walk on sauce, and take a dip in our bean pit. Yeah, we have a bean pit. 

Get tips from pitmasters, hear a message from Duke the Bush's spokesdog, and get a few fun surprises along the way. On your way out, check our lineup of more than 150 curated sauces and rubs. 

This is an experience your whole family will love and it will leave you craving barbecue. Welcome to the smoke show.

experiences.title: SEA LIFE Kansas City Aquarium Admission Ticket
experiences.description: Dive into an underwater adventure at SEA LIFE Kansas City Aquarium, home to thousands of tropical fish and over 30 captivating displays. Come face-to-fin with blacktip reef sharks, graceful rays, and the incredible giant Pacific octopus. Kids can test their sea knowledge on a fun quiz trail and bring their imaginations to life at Doodle Reef, where their virtual sea creatures swim in a live display.

experiences.title: Kansas City Haunted Pub Crawl Ghostly Drinks and Stories
experiences.description:
Discover Kansas City after dark on a haunted pub crawl through the city’s historic downtown, where grand hotels, old theaters, society neighborhoods, and lively bars reveal a past filled with vice, scandal, tragedy, and restless spirits. This 21+ walking tour blends haunted history, true crime, and Kansas City nightlife into one unforgettable night out. 

This is not the polite version of Kansas City history. This is the city behind closed doors: the city of saloons, hotel rooms, gambling halls, backroom deals, scandal, jazz-age nightlife, and stories that refused to stay buried. Perfect for date nights, friend groups, visitors, locals, skeptics, believers, and anyone looking for a grown-up ghost tour with a drink in hand.

All guests must be age 21+ with a valid I.D. Drinks not included with tour.

experiences.title: Private Beer Tasting Half-Day Tour in Saint Louis
experiences.description: This private beer tasting tour explores Saint Louis through brewing heritage. Discover traditions shaped by European influence and early industry. Begin at City Hall and admire its French Renaissance architecture. Travel to Forest Park where historic landscapes meet relaxed tasting moments. Continue through downtown where classic streets host local breweries. Taste selected beer samples while learning brewing methods and cultural roots. Explore Soulard and experience one of the oldest districts with deep traditions. How did brewing become part of this city’s identity? This journey blends history with refined tasting experiences. Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.

experiences.title: Al Foster Trail Guided E-Bike Experience in Missouri
experiences.description: Embark on a dynamic guided ride across varied terrain, tackling hard-packed paths, rugged dirt off-trails, and sandy Meramec River sandbars along the historic Al Foster Memorial Trail. The route guides travelers through dense wooded landscapes and past towering natural bluffs on a multi-surface expedition. While bug spray is provided to keep outdoor pests at bay during the journey, personal gear, food, and drinks are excluded. Participants should come prepared with comfortable athletic clothing, sturdy closed-toe shoes, and plenty of water to handle the physical demands of riding unpaved and uneven surfaces.

experiences.title: Branson Redneck Christmas Lights Tour Comedy Adventure
experiences.description:
Join the jolliest ride in Branson on the Christmas Lights Tour, where laughter meets festive cheer. This two-hour journey showcases Branson's brightest holiday displays, all seasoned with down-home humor. Perfect for families and friends, enjoy iconic sights while our comedians keep the giggles rolling. Highlights include a moonshine tasting and a comfortable, air-conditioned bus ride. Don your Santa hats and get ready for a merry time filled with holiday spirit and redneck charm.

- Experience two hours of laughter and festive fun on an air-conditioned bus
- Enjoy stunning holiday light displays throughout Branson's iconic sights
- Sample local moonshine to add a unique twist to your tour
- Family-friendly atmosphere, rated PG-14

experiences.title: E-Bike Experience from Chesterfield to Katy Trail in Missouri
experiences.description: Set out on a seamless, self-paced e-bike rental experience designed for all skill levels seeking an active outdoor escape. The excursion begins at the designated pickup point at Topgolf in Chesterfield, where travelers are equipped with a reliable e-bike to tackle the terrain with ease. Riders should wear comfortable athletic clothing, closed-toe shoes, and weather-appropriate gear for an extended ride in the open air. The route follows paved and well-maintained paths, making it accessible for anyone comfortable riding a bicycle for a few hours. Out-of-pocket expenses such as additional food and drinks, also personal souvenirs along the way are not included. Riders must be prepared for changing weather conditions and are responsible for operating the equipment safely throughout the duration of the experience.

experiences.title: Herman MO Wine Tour at your Service Shuttle and Taxi
experiences.description:
You're looking good among the crowd, but when it's time to hit the road, don't worry about the heavy load. Let AYS shuttle and Taxi drive you around.

Call AYS for that Herman winery, don't wear your feet
We are known as the safest in the street, professional style, for your party. Vibe the best drivers for your tribe!

experiences.title: Kansas City Culinary Journey: A Private Food Tour
experiences.description:
Skip the crowds with this private experience reserved exclusively for your group. Discover Kansas City through a flavorful journey that combines legendary barbecue with local culture and historic landmarks. Begin at Jack Stack Barbecue for a taste of the city’s famous barbecue tradition. Continue to Union Station and admire its grand architecture while learning about its role in Kansas City’s history. Then visit The Antler Room for a creative taste of the city’s modern culinary scene. Finish in Midtown Westport where historic streets meet a lively neighborhood atmosphere. Along the way your guide connects each stop to the people and traditions that shaped Kansas City’s food culture. This experience offers a delicious introduction to the city through barbecue, cocktails, history, and local character.

Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.

experiences.title: Kansas City Food & History Tour with a Local Guide & Tastings
experiences.description:
Kansas City has a flavor unlike anywhere else in America, and this tour proves it. Your local food specialist takes you through Downtown KC's most beloved streets, hidden gems, and kept secrets. No tourist traps. Just the real thing.
You'll start with beef burnt end stew, the slow-smoked original that put KC on the culinary map, before stepping inside a neighborhood morning gem locals have relied on for years. Along the way, your guide brings the city's past to life: cowboys, gangsters, and the food culture that outlasted them both.
Then the streetcar. A short ride delivers you to the Secret Dish, with a skyline view that stops your mid-bite. The afternoon closes with a luxurious specialty chocolate that lingers long after the last stop.
Want to make it a full KC experience? Add our Drinks Upgrade and raise a glass with a refreshing KC Lemonade and the iconic KC Flyer!

experiences.title: Private Kansas City World Cup 2026 Chocolate and Wine Tasting
experiences.description: Kansas City is a World Cup city in 2026. Football fans are arriving in a city that takes food and drink more seriously than almost anywhere in America. Your private 3-hour chocolate and wine tour moves through the two most vibrant neighbourhoods in downtown Kansas City. The Power and Light District opens with energy and light. The Crossroads Arts District follows — Kansas City's most creative quarter where chocolate shops and wine bars sit between galleries and street murals. Your licensed guide connects every stop to the cultural story of a city that built its identity on barbecue, blues and an extraordinary appetite for the good things in life. Samples at every stop are included. Pickup from Kansas City is available. Whether you are here for the football or the flavour Kansas City delivers both. In World Cup year this city is ready to show the world what it has always known about itself.

experiences.title: Biscuit and Brunch Class with Chef Regina
experiences.description:
You will learn so much from Chef Regina. It is a very personal, informative experience. Classes are limited to eight guests. You get to eat a wonderful brunch with new friends.
You are welcome to bring any alcoholic beverage you like. If you let Regina know what set ups you need, she is happy to provide those. Bottled water and juice is available for all classes.
You will also leave with a special gift from Chef Regina. Her Tea towel with her biscuit recipe printed on it and a biscuit cutter.

experiences.title: Zombie Scavengers Game - Jackson, MS
experiences.description:
Zombie Scavengers tests your ability to survive after a Zombie Apocalypse. The game leads you through the city, where you will have 60 minutes to collect survival items for your colony.
The Setting:
Small colonies of the living are doing all they can to survive. You and your team have been tasked with scavenging for survival supplies for your colony. You’ll only have 60 minutes to figure out which items you'll need and find as many items on the list as you can. 
Your Mission: 
With 1 hour and your team of up to 10 people, you will use your smartphone to search the area for much needed food, supplies, and shelter. Along the way, you will be asked to do some challenges or answer some trivia questions. The goal is to score at least 4000 points in 1 hour in order to survive the zombie apocalypse!
PS. Our game is family friendly, no actual zombies are involved in the scavenger hunt.

experiences.title: Ocean Springs: Food Tour with Local Tastings & History
experiences.description: Designed for travelers who want more than just a meal, this guided walking food tour lets you experience Ocean Springs the way locals do. Enjoy multiple tastings of favorite local dishes while learning the stories, history, and culture that shape the town. Led by Gulf Coast locals, the tour blends food, community, and storytelling into a relaxed, authentic experience you won’t find on your own.

experiences.title: Hard Rock Cafe Biloxi
experiences.description: Enjoy a prix-fixe menu at the Biloxi Hard Rock Cafe. Classic American cooking comes to the heart of The Playground of the South, where you’ll enjoy a 2- or 3-course meal with your choice of theme. Each option comes with a drink (coffee, tea or soda) and dessert. Expect entrees like the classic cheeseburger, a half-rack of hickory-smoked ribs, salmon, steak and even some vegetarian options. Love All - Serve All!

experiences.title: Coastal Stroll Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Coastal Stroll Walking Tour:
Voted The Coolest Beach Town in America. See it now on your guided Tour!
Join us to uncover the hidden stories, legends, and vibrant culture of the Mississippi Coast. A guided tour is the only way to experience the secrets and soul of this beautiful region. Whether you prefer to stroll through a charming historic town or relax on an extended scenic drive, we have the perfect tour for you. The Bay Saint Louis Guided Walking Tour
A Historic Stroll is more than a History tour and the sounds of Mississippi Coastal life. Explore an eclectic town consistently ranked as one of America's coolest. Your knowledgeable guide will lead you through its storied streets and to all the key landmarks.
Why walk with us?
Expert Guidance: Our passionate local guides provide insider knowledge you won't find on your own, ensuring you don't miss a single hidden gem.
Book your tour and discover the magic of the Mississippi Gulf Coast today!

experiences.title: Middle Fork Flathead River Rafting Adventure for 2 Days
experiences.description:
The Middle Fork Flathead River offers an exhilarating multi-day rafting adventure through stunning landscapes adjacent to Glacier National Park. Experience 2 days of navigating class III and IV rapids while camping under the stars. Experience the thrill of paddling through clear waters, spotting wildlife, and enjoying delicious meals prepared by your guides. This trip provides a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation, making it ideal for families and groups seeking outdoor fun. Each trip is led by experienced guides, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience for all levels of rafters. Minimum of two participants required, with private launches available for larger groups.

- Navigate thrilling class II to IV rapids on the Middle Fork
- Enjoy freshly prepared meals and camaraderie around the campfire
- Expert guides ensure safety and insider knowledge of the area

experiences.title: Private Yellowstone Lower Loop Experience and complimentary lunch
experiences.description: No need to stress about driving, finding the best routes and stops, and navigating parking lots. Your guide has all the first-class knowledge needed to make the most out of the day so you can relax and enjoy your vacation. We'll explore the entire lower loop, with visits to the Canyon, Hayden Valley, Old Faithful, and Grand Prismatic Spring. Lunch and snacks will be provided, and you'll be able to experience the world's first National Park the way it was intended, with eyes on the landscape instead of the road.

experiences.title: Downtown Bozeman Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
This tour is more than a meal—it’s a relaxed, local-led introduction to the flavors, stories, and character of downtown Bozeman. Guests will visit a curated selection of locally loved restaurants, bars, and specialty food stops while learning about the history, architecture, and culture that make this mountain town unique.

What sets this experience apart is the combination of great food, local storytelling, and an easygoing pace. Instead of choosing just one restaurant, travelers get to sample several downtown favorites in one afternoon, meet the places that help shape Bozeman’s food scene, and leave with personal recommendations for the rest of their trip.
With small group sizes, a walkable downtown route, and generous tastings included, this tour is a fun and memorable way to experience Bozeman like a local.

experiences.title: Guided Alpine Lake Float and Hike - Northern Bitterroot Mountains
experiences.description:
The Bitterroot National Forest is an incredibly beautiful and rugged place with amazing mountains and deep glacial canyons. The trails are not always well maintained, and often times seasonal creeks will deter folks who aren't used to water crossings. You'll be glad you brought a guide along!

The hike and packraft float is an experience unique to Bitterroot Backpacking. You will not find any other guide or company providing this service! (And if you do, they probably found the idea here!)

experiences.title: Bozeman Brewery Hop
experiences.description: Learn and have fun drinking beer with a Master Cicerone -- one of only 29 in the world. Perfect experience for anyone who's a fan of flavor. Regardless of whether you're a beer fan, more of a wine or cider drinker, or don't really know what you like. You'll experience 2 Bozeman breweries that are world-class and two of the best in Montana! You'll taste lots of different beers, sample different barley malts and hops, pick up tasting tips, learn how to navigate beer menus wherever you drink beer down the road. Discover important beer styles, flavors and trends, have all your beer questions answered by a true expert and educator. You'll appreciate beer in fantastic new ways.

experiences.title: Winter in Yellowstone Wildlife Tour
experiences.description:
Yellowstone Hiking Guides is a long-time, local tour operator that offers top-rated experiences in Yellowstone National Park. Our Winter Wildlife Tours start run from February to April.

Winter in Yellowstone is a magical time. Be sure to bundle up in layers as we put wolves and other rare animals in the spotting scope. Use our binoculars to see foxes hunting in the snow and bison weathering the winter conditions. 

We pack the lunch, snacks, and the hot and cold beverages. Please allow us to host you at the highest level on one of our group tours. We pick up guests in West Yellowstone (6AM), Big Sky (7AM), and Bozeman (8AM). 

Top destinations in the Park include the Roosevelt Arch, the Lamar Valley, Mammoth Hot Springs terraces, and the Old Gardiner Road. We also drive through the scenic Paradise Valley, home to winter wildlife outside of Yellowstone National Park.

We look forward to hosting you and your group to show you Yellowstone's winter wildlife and stunning scenic beauty.

experiences.title: Custom Guided Day Hike in the Bitterroot Mountains
experiences.description:
Explore the REAL backcountry of Bitterroot Mountains in the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness! Plan an unforgettable hike with a professional guide before you go, then set off on your adventure with your guide!

We provide top notch gear! All essential hiking rental gear included in pricing including backpacks, trekking poles, bear spray, ect. 

Along the way, you will learn about the ecology of the Bitterroot, identifying plants animals as you go. Join a hike in July and August for Huckleberry picking! You'll also learn about the local geology and identify a few rocks and minerals too.

Delicious snack options like trail mix, beef jerky (vegan available too!), fig bars, fruit leather, and chocolate cookies included!

Your guide will also carry a water filter, first aid, Garmin GPS communicator, and other basic necessities like toiletries for an outing in the backcountry. They are wilderness first responder certified, leave no trace certified, and food handler certified.

experiences.title: Private Yellowstone Tour: ICONIC Sites, Wildlife, Family Friendly Hikes + lunch
experiences.description:
All of our private tours are led by a professional wildlife biologist. We will tour the park in a modern chevy suburban. Our goal is to view the most wildlife possible on your tour while also visiting the most ICONIC destinations in there park as well visiting many hidden locations that are off the beaten path. During our day we will see Old Faithful, Grand Canyon of Yellowstone, Yellowstone Falls (308'), lots of wildlife, large waterfalls, seldom seen geysers, and two historic hotels. We will provide high end binoculars and spotting scopes for the entire group so we can view animals or geysers that are far off the road! This will be an educational experience for your family/ group yet fun and entraining at the same time. Your tour will experience the wonders of hidden Yellowstone that's awaiting around each corner of Yellowstone National Park. 

For lunch we will stop for an incredibly scenic picnic style lunch along the shore of Yellowstone Lake!

experiences.title: Lower Loop Van Tour from West Yellowstone: Grand Prismatic and Old Faithful
experiences.description:
This Active Van Tour is a great way to see Yellowstone National Park beginning in the fun gateway town of West Yellowstone. The early morning part of the tour explores wildlife haunts in the famous Shadow Canyon of the Madison River. This area is home to bear and elk.

Later we hike to an overlook of the famous Grand Prismatic Hot Springs. If you don't feel like walking we find a safe, scenic spot for you to wait for the group. 

Next we explore the Old Faithful area, including some time at the famous Old Faithful Inn. 

We continue over the continental divide and down to the West Thumb Geyser Basin on Yellowstone Lake for a view of some spectacular lakeside thermal pools.
