After arriving India airport we take care of you and all your travelling needs

experiences.title: Sip of the Jersey Shore Brew Tour
experiences.description:
The Sip of the Jersey Shore Tour offers a unique, all-inclusive craft beer experience along the stunning Jersey Shore. Visit three local breweries, enjoy guided tastings, and learn about the brewing process, all while relaxing with round-trip transportation. Perfect for beer lovers looking to explore the vibrant craft beer scene in a fun and stress-free way!

This tour includes walking short distances and some areas may not be wheelchair accessible.

experiences.title: Taste the NJ Suburbs - South Orange Food Tour
experiences.description:
This 2.5-hour walking tour will showcase the diverse and delicious restaurant scene in the charming village of South Orange. Chefs and culinary connoisseurs at 4 amazing restaurants will provide an inside look at what makes them special. 

This is the only food tour in Essex County, NJ at this time! We are proud to offer the premier food tour of the New Jersey suburbs -- the only tour that currently offers an insider's view of a highly popular retail incubator marketplace as well as food from a modern restaurant located inside a former police and fire station!

experiences.title: Niagara Falls, Ottawa, Montreal, Quebec City 7-day Tour
experiences.description:
Visit four spectacular famous cities in Eastern Canada: Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal, and Quebec in five days!
Experience an unforgettable waterfall view and enjoy the colorful night view of the Niagara Falls!
Ride on the Hornblower Cruise to experience the waterfall views of Niagara Falls from multiple angles.
Complimentary Skylon Tower ticket is included. Following, you will enjoy a delicious lunch. You may enjoy authentic French food in Quebec at your own expense. 

Room Details
All hotel rooms are based on two Full / Double beds or one King/Queen bed depends on what hotel availiable on the day. The maximum occupancy per room is four travelers.

One Room Selection 
If you are a party of more than four guests or desire to have separate rooms, please provide a separate booking.

Avoid traveling in a different bus?
If you have more than one booking, please provide all confirmation numbers once your bookings are complete.

experiences.title: Spirits Tasting at Little Water Distillery
experiences.description:
Sample the best of our distillery with a tasting flight (two options available) of our award-winning spirits and cocktails.

Award-winning spirits: Whiskey, Rum, Vodka, and Gin
Bottled cocktails: Espresso Martini, Chocolate Martini, or Old Fashioned
A complimentary souvenir shot glass

Special Offer: Stick around for hand-crafted cocktails and receive 10% off all bottle purchases made today!

experiences.title: Dinner Cruise with Dolphin Watching from Cape May
experiences.description: Enjoy dinner, sight dolphins, drink an ice cold beverage, enjoy the company of loved ones and see one our beautiful sunsets over Delaware Bay. No other Dinner Cruise in the world can offer top quality food (from a Restaurant, not a microwave), unparalleled views and dolphin sightings in a single evening. We have the most to offer in Southern New Jersey. We offer the finest food available a float (see Menu and Ship), the largest and cleanest vessel, and a family oriented atmosphere.

experiences.title: City Cruises New Jersey Signature Bottomless Mimosa Brunch Cruise
experiences.description: No matter the occasion, a New Jersey Signature Bottomless Mimosa Brunch Cruise is sure to create an unforgettable afternoon. Experience a brunch cruise on the East and Hudson Rivers. Dine the day away with friends and family and soak in New Jersey and New York's skyline views along the Hudson and East Rivers. Enjoy spectacular views of the city skyline and local landmarks, including the Empire State Building, the Brooklyn Bridge, and the Statue of Liberty.

experiences.title: New York and New Jersey To Boston and Harvard in One Day
experiences.description:
Come discover beautiful Boston.

Let us take care of your transportation and itinerary. Your only job is to sit back and enjoy Boston. We even offer convenient pick-up locations.

We will explore the best Boston has to offer:
 • Fenway Park stadium home to the Boston Red Sox 
 • Harvard University Main campus: Harvard Yard, Old Yard, John Harvard Statue, Johnston Gate, Harvard souvenir store. 
 • Copley Square: Trinity church, Fairmont Copley Hotel, Boston Public Library, John Hancock Tower, “End line” to Boston Marathon. 
 • Boston Common and the public gardens   
 • Freedom trail: Massachusetts State house, Old state House, Granary Burying ground, Kings chapel, Faneuil hall. 
 • Quincy Market 

Boston has so much to offer and we will show you the best of it.

experiences.title: City Cruises New Jersey: Signature Lunch Cruise
experiences.description:
When looking for a fun and festive way to get out on the water, a Signature cruise is your answer. Come aboard and experience breathtaking NYC skyline views, a chef-prepared buffet-style lunch, attentive service, DJ entertainment, rooftop lounge and onboard games!

Departing from Lincoln Harbor Marina in Weehawken NJ, a lunch cruise with City Cruises is the perfect way to spend a relaxing afternoon on the water taking in the iconic sites along the Skyline. Enjoy views of Empire State Building, One World Trade Center, Brooklyn Bridge, Statue of Liberty and more!

experiences.title: Hard Rock Cafe Atlantic City
experiences.description: Treat your senses with a prix-fixe menu at the Atlantic City Hard Rock Cafe. Classic American cooking comes to the heart of America's Favorite Playground, where you’ll enjoy a 2- or 3-course meal with your choice of theme. Each option comes with a drink (coffee, tea or soda) and dessert. Expect entrees like the classic cheeseburger, a half-rack of hickory-smoked ribs, salmon, steak and even some vegetarian options. Love One - Serve All!

experiences.title: City Cruises NYC: Skyline Dinner Cruise from New Jersey
experiences.description:
Dine along the skyline with City Cruises
Enjoy chef prepared menus, seasonal cocktails, live music, iconic sights, and the bright city lights as you dine along the New York skyline!

Depart from Lincoln Harbor Marina in Weehawken NJ and sail for two-and-a-half hours along the Hudson and East rivers past many notable attractions such as Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Vessel at Hudson Yards, Chrysler Building, One World Trade Center, Intrepid Sea, Air & Space Museum, South Street Seaport, Brooklyn Bridge and more.

Take in the views as you enjoy the chef prepared dinner buffet with freshly prepared entrees, salads and desserts along with live musical entertainment provided by the onboard DJ. Creative cocktails, wine and beer available from the well-stocked bar. 

Board the Spirit of New Jersey for a festive and casual dinner cruise with incredible skyline views from interior and exterior open-air observation decks.

experiences.title: Private Yacht Sunset Cruise on the Hudson River and NYC Harbor
experiences.description:
Experience the beauty of the Hudson River with a private yacht sunset cruise. Enjoy stunning views of iconic landmarks like the Statue of Liberty and Brooklyn Bridge. This family-owned service ensures personalized attention, making your cruise truly special. Explore at your leisure while sipping complimentary drinks, including beer, wine, and soda.

- Unforgettable sunset views from a private yacht
- Personalized service for families and small groups
- Complimentary beverages included during the cruise
- Convenient departure from Liberty State Park

experiences.title: 3 Day Experience New York City and Boroughs Explorer
experiences.description: Embark on a captivating journey through New York City's iconic landmarks and vibrant neighborhoods over three exhilarating days. From the bustling streets of Manhattan to the historic charm of Brooklyn and the cultural melting pot of Lower East Side, Chinatown, and Little Italy, each day promises immersive experiences like no other! Traverse the High Line, visit the Statue of Liberty, explore Coney Island's iconic boardwalk, indulge in diverse cuisines, and unwind in the tranquility of Central Park. With an expert local guide leading the way, discover the essence of the Big Apple in an unforgettable adventure.

experiences.title: 4 Day East Coast Exploration - NYC, Philly and Washington DC
experiences.description: Experience the best of East Coast cities on this Short Break that includes three exciting destinations filled with food tours, history walks, and authentic local experiences! With local experts to lead the way, you’ll discover the top historic attractions of Philadelphia and indulge in the world-famous cheesesteak, and enjoy both the culinary scenes of Philadelphia, Washington Dc and the Big Apple! During our 4-day tour, you’ll enjoy time with a knowledgeable guide as well as time for yourself to enjoy shopping, exploring, and more good eatin’. History lovers will enjoy the charm of Philadelphia’s Old City and symbols of the American Revolution from the Liberty Bell to Independence Hall or all the National Monuments in Washington DC? And who couldn’t fall in love with New York City and its skyline’s famous icons from the Statue of Liberty to the Empire State Building?

experiences.title: Cape May Personalized Self-Guided App Tour
experiences.description:
In this tour, you are going to love, love Cape May. Its such a magical place, that love and warmth of a small town community, but with the luscious beauty of the New Jersey Coast, With beautiful white sand beaches, excellent food and drinks, and a laid back fun atmosphere, you are in for a trip of a lifetime!

We are very excited to take you on this journey!

Don't worry about other people, this tour is completely tailored to you with our App!

With our app, you can pause the tour, and check out the locations as long as you want! You can skip a stop you don't like, and you have all the best information about each stop at your fingertips.

experiences.title: New Jersey Local Vineyard and Winery Tour
experiences.description: Explore the heart of local wine country with a guided tour to two picturesque vineyards and wineries. Travel comfortably in a climate-controlled Jeep Wrangler, ensuring an enjoyable ride as you discover the unique flavors of the region. Each stop features wine tastings where you can savor 5-6 ounces of exquisite local wines. This intimate experience is perfect for small groups of up to four passengers, offering an insider's look at the art of winemaking and the opportunity to learn from knowledgeable guides. Pickup is conveniently provided from your designated location, making this tour an easy choice for wine enthusiasts.

experiences.title: Private Party Bus in New Jersey with Professional Chauffeur
experiences.description:
Upgrade your celebration with our Luxury Party Bus in New Jersey, perfect for weddings, proms, birthdays, and corporate events. Enjoy a seamless, stress-free experience with our well-maintained fleet featuring plush seating, vibrant neon lighting, and state-of-the-art sound systems. Custom packages allow you to tailor your journey to fit your needs while our experienced drivers ensure your safety and comfort on the road.

- Ideal for a variety of events: weddings, proms, and more
- Premium amenities for a luxurious travel experience
- Custom packages available to suit your needs
- Safe and reliable transportation with experienced drivers

experiences.title: Abstract Painting Class
experiences.description: Santa Fe is a mecca for artists who have a wide array of diverse creative talents. In this activity, travelers work with an experienced artist-teacher who is trained to bring out the creative talents of everyone, even novices. We specialize in abstraction and make painting approachable and fun.

experiences.title: Silver Casting with Cuttlebone
experiences.description:
A great activity for friends, partners, or families to do together! Each creation is completely unique, and you'll learn new things in a safe and comfortable environment, with expert guidance the whole way. Leave with a one-of a kind wearable treasure, made with your own hands! We teach groups of up to six participants; if you have fewer than six participants and would like to make this a private experience, please reach out to us and we will do our best to accommodate. 
Our studio on Canyon Road in Santa Fe is in the heart of the historic arts district, surrounded by world-class galleries and the unique Pueblo-Revival architecture that this area is known for. With views of the Sangre de Cristo Mountains, and the Santa Fe River close by, you are truly in a creative's paradise.

experiences.title: Silver Stacking Rings- Jewelry Making Workshop
experiences.description:
A great activity for friends, partners, or families to do together! Each creation is completely unique, and you'll learn new things in a safe and comfortable environment, with expert guidance the whole way. Leave with one-of a kind wearable treasures, made with your own hands! 

We teach groups of up to six participants; if you have fewer than six participants and would like to make this a private experience, please reach out to us and we will do our best to accommodate. 

Our studio on Canyon Road in Santa Fe is in the heart of the historic arts district, surrounded by world-class galleries and the unique Pueblo-Revival architecture that this area is known for. With views of the Sangre de Cristo Mountains, and the Santa Fe River close by, you are truly in a creative's paradise.

experiences.title: Learn the Art of Leather Tooling
experiences.description:
Learn the art of leather saddle tooling from a second-generation leatherworker. Focusing on creative expression - I teach the process, then set you free to make your own patterns and designs. Students will create functional pieces of leather art: wrist cuffs, keychains, bookmarks, and coasters that make the perfect keepsake or gift.

A unique high desert experience ideal for couples and families, large groups, or weddings.

Solo travelers also welcome!

experiences.title: One Time Wheel-Throwing Experience
experiences.description: Dive into the most popular method of making ceramics. Working at the wheel is a meditative, yet challenging process. In this two-hour class, our potters will take you through the process of throwing a piece of pottery on the wheel. While pieces are recycled at the end of the class, each person will get a $15 credit to our gallery.

experiences.title: Stained Glass Class - Hidden Santa Fe Gem
experiences.description: Stained glass is a rare art these days, and classes are even harder to find. This distinctive art and straightforward instruction with unique tools make for a fun combo! Plus, how often do you get to break glass and melt metal?

experiences.title: Make Your Own Stained Glass Honeycomb
experiences.description: There are very few stained glass classes in the US, and even fewer that don't require multiple weeks and hundreds of dollars. We make stained glass accessible and fun!

experiences.title: New Mexico Wine Tasting Small Group Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy a relaxing day making new friends. Door-to-door service, a delicious and hearty lunch, and tasty snacks served at one of the wineries. Wine tasting offers a delightful way to experience wines you've never tried before, each winery being unique. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, and small groups, this is a wine tour you won't forget—so when you've shopped till you dropped, come aboard, explore our beautiful state, and sip some wine with us. You can also add-on activities like a glass blowing class or river rafting (which takes place before wine tasting), making for an even more memorable adventure. 
Tour Includes lunch.
Tasting fees ARE NOT included in your tour, 3 to 4 winerys.
Cost would be $41.00 for 3 of the Wineries. For the 5 wineries $20.00 more.

experiences.title: The Official Santa Fe Margarita Trail Tour
experiences.description:
NEW!!! From the #1 traveller ranked tour/activity operator in Santa Fe. 
Explore Santa Fe’s renowned Margarita Trail on this guided walking tour, where history and flavor come together in the country’s Margarita capital. Join the ONLY tour in SF that earns you 3 passport stamps in 2 hours while checking out some The Trail’s most beloved participants. Sample some of the city’s best expertly crafted margaritas featuring local spirits and fresh ingredients paired with yummy bites. Along the way, your guide will share stories of Santa Fe’s rich culture, tequila traditions, and the lore around the origins of New Mexico’s iconic state cocktail.

PLEASE NOTE: We are unable to make dietary substitutions on this tour.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Chocolate Tasting and History Exploration Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the rich history of chocolate on this immersive 3-hour tour in Santa Fe, the oldest capital city in the United States. Explore the evolution of chocolate from ancient elixirs to modern delights. Sample unique offerings at four local chocolate shops, each showcasing a distinct aspect of Santa Fe's culinary scene. Delve into the stories of chocolate’s cultural significance while enjoying a flavorful journey through time.

- Explore four local chocolate shops with unique specialties: Kakawa Chocolate house, Chocolate En La Plaza, Chocolate and Cashmere and Senior Murphy's.
- Learn about chocolate’s history from ancient Central America to modern treats
- Tour duration of 3 hours with a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 12 participants
- Comfortable shoes and a bottle of water are recommended for this walking tour

experiences.title: Las Cruces El Paso Weekend Wine Shuttle
experiences.description:
Leave your cares and your car behind while exploring the charm of New Mexico’s wineries. Savor the rich aroma of oak barrels as you taste rich red wines. Laugh with newfound friends over a glass of rosé under the heat of the desert sun. Let the gentle hum of live music set the rhythm for the day as you sip your new favorite white wine. Each stop offers new flavors, a new story—designed to leave you with lasting memories of a day well spent.

Set Your Own Pace
We spend about one hour at each location to give you time to savor your wine, enjoy live music, take pictures, and socialize. Drinks are not included.

Expert Tour Guide
You’ll learn about local history, get wine tasting tips, and listen to great music between stops.

For Visitors and Locals
Whether you’re visiting for the first time, hosting guests from out of town, or looking for a new way to experience your favorite places, our Weekend Wine Tours are unforgettable.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Day trip to Northern New Mexico Wine Country
experiences.description: Take the scenic High Road to Chimayó and experience a full-day wine tour through northern New Mexico’s stunning high-elevation wine country. Visit three of the region’s highest altitude vineyards, where dramatic landscapes meet exceptional wines. Enjoy curated tastings at each stop, paired with local flavors and seasonal bites. Travel in comfort aboard a luxury Mercedes-Benz Sprinter with a local guide who shares the stories behind the wines, the land, and the culture. This small-group experience offers unforgettable views, rich flavors, and a deep taste of northern New Mexico’s unique wine scene.

experiences.title: Enchanted Eats of Santa Fe Half-Day Private Tour
experiences.description:
Skip the crowds—this private tour is just for your group! Enjoy a delightful half-day walking tour through the enchanting streets of Santa Fe, blending historical exploration with mouthwatering food tastings. Begin at the historic Santa Fe Plaza, where centuries of culture and tradition come alive. Amid the Plaza’s iconic architecture and vibrant scene, sample a variety of local culinary delights. Next, visit San Miguel Chapel—the oldest church in the U.S.—before heading to Galisteo Street, known for its charming buildings, artsy vibe, and local eateries. This immersive experience offers more than just a stroll; it’s a flavorful journey into Santa Fe’s rich heritage and diverse cuisine.

Note: Program and attractions may vary based on booking time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit offers something unique.

experiences.title: Red or Green: Chef-Guided New Mexican Lunch Immersion
experiences.description:
Skip to the front of the famously long lines to savor authentic New Mexican flavors with a seated luncheon at one of Santa Fe’s most beloved generational eateries. Enjoy award-winning chile, top-shelf Margaritas, artisan confections and our rich local history on this flavorful journey.
Led by a formally trained culinary expert, this immersive lunch tour explores the origins and evolution of NM’s distinct cuisine through a guided comparative tasting that highlights the key differences between Mexican and New Mexican flavors. To elevate the experience, we’ll celebrate Santa Fe’s status as the Margarita Capital of America with a top-shelf margarita pairing for each course, showcasing different styles and expressions of this iconic cocktail.
After indulging in a feast of local flavors, we’ll finish on a sweet note with a locally inspired dessert at Santa Fe’s premier craft ice creamery.

experiences.title: The ORIGINAL Wander New Mexico "Sip & Savor" Plaza Tour
experiences.description:
Don't be fooled by imitations and take THE original "SIP & SAVOR" chef-guided food and history tour, offered by the #1 Tour/Activity Operator in Santa Fe. 
This classic Santa Fe food and drink adventure is focused on historic downtown Plaza neighborhood. Explore Santa Fe by foot while sampling the best in local food and beverage. Along the way, you’ll learn about the city’s long and fascinating history, with an emphasis on how Native, Hispanic, and Anglo cultures shaped – and were shaped by – the region’s unique (and delicious!) food culture.
This tour is designed with adventurous eaters in mind and includes a variety of restaurants, and is NOT focused exclusively on New Mexican food. We bring you the best of Santa Fe, which includes a diverse array of cuisines.

experiences.title: White Water Rafting and Wine Tour
experiences.description:
If you're looking for a memorable addition to your vacation.
Bringing everyone the perfect day of adventure.
Groups, couples & single travelers come join the fun.
Join us for a FUN & relaxing day of rafting the Rio Grande with good wine & food after your rafting trip.
Go to our website for more information about your tour and BOOK!

experiences.title: Plaza Sip, Savor, & History Walking Tour in Santa Fe
experiences.description:
Hosted by tour company Vigilante Guides. As a 12th generation New Mexican we take pride in culture and history and want to share a piece of our everyday life on this tour. This is a fun and informational experience that is all inclusive. We talk about our unique culture and heritage, our amazing food and drink, art and outdoors and everything else in between. This is an experience unlike any other where you truly feel like a local. We have fun, interact, and enjoy each others company while we eat and drink some local delicacies. Oh and yes, come hungry, you should be adequately fed by the end of this tour.

On this tour you will stop at 3 locations and try a variety of craft cocktails, beer, wine, and margaritas along with some amazing pizza and tacos. 

We will walk away as friends and show you the true Santa Fe experience.

experiences.title: Tumbleroot Brewery and Distillery Tour and Tasting
experiences.description: Brewery and distillery tour led by experienced brewers/distillers. It is an interactive, hands-on and multisensory tour. The tour is followed by sampling spirits and/or beer in our intimate tasting room.

experiences.title: Taste of Santa Fe Wine and Dine Lunch
experiences.description: The Taste of Santa Fe Tour is unique because it features 3 of our top spots in Santa Fe, highlights our favorite historical points of interest, and wraps up with our favorite hidden gem for dessert. This tour has a bit more of a upscale theme, is eclectic, and happens to be our top tour. We will provide information about the history of Santa Fe, our food, culture, and historical points of interests. This tour includes a full lunch, n/a drinks, alcohol pairings (Such as wine, margaritas, or local beers), as well as dessert. This tour meets at 10:45am near the plaza (Exact meeting instructions will be found on your ticket), starts at 10:55am and lasts 2.5-3 hours. **NOTE** This tour may feature New Mexican inspired foods and can be spicy for some guests. We don't recommend this tour for anyone with serious food restrictions and minimal walking ability.

experiences.title: Taos Artisan Walking Tour + Chocolate
experiences.description:
Immerse into Taos’ eclectic artistic community! Starting on Kit Carson Road, weave in and out of winding alleyways exploring the historical context while pausing to mix with the local art scene. Taos has been on the map as an art colony since the late 1800s and it has a reputation for its eclectic talented creative populace. Come to this high desert mountain town to not only experience the ethereal light and vivid landscape, but to also encounter this dynamic community and their remarkable art to life. Enjoy a mix of old and new while exploring downtown’s rich art history. Discover the vibrant center of this uniquely quirky and highly talented community.
We conclude this tour with a Chocolate Elixir at Chokola to weave in the art of chocolate making by owners Deb and Javier who are passionate about every step in the process of their decadent sipping chocolate, truffles, mousses and tarts! A perfect way to celebrate the finale of your immersion to Taos Artisans!

experiences.title: New Mexican Flavors Food Tour of the Santa Fe Plaza
experiences.description: Join this fun food tour, with locally raised guides who have generations of knowledge! This tour is unique because you will enjoy a hand-picked New Mexican food experience. Experience New Mexican food and discover some of the best foodie spots near the Santa Fe Plaza. On the tour, you will also learn about the history of Santa Fe, the food, culture, and historical points of interest such as the Palace of the Governors, The San Miguel Mission (The oldest church structure in the USA), and The Loretto Chapel (Home to the Miraculous Staircase). This casual tour includes a full lunch, non-alcoholic drinks, alcohol pairings (Such as wine, margaritas, or local beers), as well as dessert. **NOTE** This tour features New Mexican-inspired foods and can be spicy for some guests. We don't recommend this tour for anyone with serious food restrictions and minimal walking ability.

experiences.title: Savor Santa Fe: Wine Pairing Dinner
experiences.description: The Savor Santa Fe Tour is perfect for unique romantic experience with a loved one or private experience with family, friends, or co-workers. Savor Santa Fe is a more upscale tour that provides an eclectic progressive dinner, wine, and dessert! Along the way we will provide information about the history of Santa Fe, our food, culture, and historical points of interests. The tour includes a full dinner, n/a drinks, wine pairings, and dessert. The tour meets at 3:50pm at our designated meeting location(Exact meeting instructions will be found on your ticket), starts at 4:00pm and lasts 2.5-3 hours. Tours will sell out. Note: We are the only food tour company in Santa Fe that are truly locally owned and operated.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Sweet & Spicy Food Tour: Churros, Biscochitos & More
experiences.description:
Indulge in Santa Fe’s finest sweets on this delicious tour through historic downtown. Start at a cozy café near the Santa Fe Plaza, savoring filled beignets and coffee while uncovering the city’s rich art scene. Stroll to the iconic Plaza, where you’ll soak in the vibrant atmosphere and learn about local legends and Pueblo-style architecture. Sample traditional New Mexican treats, including biscochitos, and visit a hidden bakery renowned for its creative sweets. This sweet experience culminates with fresh churros and homemade dipping sauces, making it a perfect outing for food lovers and culture enthusiasts alike.

- Taste beignets, churros, and traditional New Mexican sweets
- Guided tour through Santa Fe's historic sites and art scene
- Visit local cafes and bakeries with unique flavors
- Ideal for food lovers and cultural explorers; walking distance of 1 to 1.5 miles

experiences.title: Viator Exclusive: Gourmet Brunch in Santa Fe with Chef Carolina
experiences.description:
Dine in Santa Fe with a memorable meal at a specialized chef's brunch. Let Chef Carolina, trained at Le Cordon Bleu School, prepare dishes that showcase the unique flavors of Santa Fe, a mix of Spanish, Mexican, and Native American cuisines. 

You'll be enjoying a three-course menu with hand-picked dishes, fresh flowers, and tableware, creating an air of sophistication. 

In winter months there is a communal table for up to 10 people. In summer months small tables await guests outside. 

Chef Carolina is joined by Manuel, an experienced sommelier and aesthete.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Haunted Spirits Tour
experiences.description:
The Best Cocktail and Ghost Stories Tour Ever. Sample great drinks served with incredible stories of Santa Fe's dark side as you walk through downtown Santa Fe. Lots of history and photo moments fills in the voids of ghost stories, which are chilling and rooted in reality, real people or actual events. 

Tour guide is great for offering other great suggestions from dinner, day trips, in and outs of things to do in Santa Fe or the surrounding area, with a smile.

experiences.title: Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery Show - Albuquerque, NM
experiences.description: America's largest interactive murder mystery comedy dinner show!  Solve a hilarious crime while you feast on a fantastic four-course plated dinner.  Just beware!  The killer is hiding somewhere in the room, and you may find yourself as a prime suspect!

experiences.title: Santa Fe Scenic
experiences.description:
Enjoy all the beauty New Mexico has to offer on our Scenic Train ride!
New Mexico is known around the world for its beautiful landscapes. So why not take in those gorgeous views from the comfort of our beautifully restored passenger cars. You and your family can enjoy first class service and amazing vistas while our train takes you out across the high desert to the views overlooking the Galisteo Basin.

The Santa Fe Scenic Train departs and returns to the Santa Fe Depot. Each ticket includes a seat in our enclosed train cars, a complimentary champagne welcome as the adventure begins, and live entertainment! Additional snacks and drinks can be purchased.

This train has no depot stop, you are onboard the duration of the ride. Outside food and drink are prohibited.

experiences.title: New Mexico Flavors Tour Of Old Town Albuquerque
experiences.description: This tour is unique because our guides are locally grown (born and raised) in New Mexico. Mostly Santa Fe and Albuquerque. We take pride in our history, culture and of course, our FOOD! We treat everyone like they are a part of our family for the 3 hours we are together on the only food tour in Albuquerque.

experiences.title: Santa Fe Historic Downtown Smart Phone Audio App Self Guided GPS Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Walk around historic downtown Santa Fe and discover it’s 400-year history and the stories behind the sites. Go at your own pace and schedule. 

Advantages of this tour?
- Our app offers immersive location aware walking tours navigated by your smart phone. Go at your own pace, on your own schedule and on your own terms. It's like a real life tour guide. 
- Best deal in town.
- Professional Narration, production and music to bring the history to life
- Walk at your own pace and hear the stories of what you see.
- Stop anytime. 
- The tour never expires. 
- Listen remotely after taking the in person tour. 

On the tour you’ll learn about the times of the Spanish Conquistadores, the Crypto Jewish people, the Santa Fe Trail, the scientists of the Manhattan Project, the Pueblo Native People, the patron saint of animals, Artists, Georgia O’Keeffe, Billy the Kid, Zozobra, the oldest church in the US, how to make your food “Christmas Style”, and so much more. Not to be missed.

experiences.title: The Town Too High To Die: A Self-Guided Audio Tour in New Mexico
experiences.description:
Madrid produced the coal that both built the Bomb and inspired Walt Disney. Abandoned as a ghost town for many years, it was reborn as a thriving artistic community. The Oral History Tour lets you hear Madrid’s stories, as told by the people who lived them. Using smartphone technology, it plays the audio automatically, at exactly the right time and place.

All dimensions of Madrid’s peculiar, multifaceted story are explored: from an eyewitness account of union-busting violence, to that time the brand-new fire engine accidentally burned down the firehouse. The Oral History Tour was distilled from seventy hours of interviews, and endures as a preserved collective memory of this unique New Mexican treasure.

Of this two-hour tour, The Santa Fe Reporter wrote, “It’s a deep dive into the fascinating history of the little town. You’ll find interviews with locals, some of whom have lived in Madrid their whole lives, and a narrator with a soothing voice ... it works exceedingly well.”

experiences.title: A Food and Art Walking Tour through Old Town ABQ
experiences.description: This one-of-a-kind walking tour blends food, art and a bit of history all while supporting women-owned businesses in Old Town Albuquerque. Guests enjoy exclusive tastings, explore local art and haunted history, and visit Ascension Crystals for a mystical touch. Unlike other tours, this intimate experience offers a curated mix of flavors, stories, and culture in a way that’s both immersive and unforgettable.

experiences.title: Las Vegas Mexican Salsa Cooking Experience with Celebrity Chef
experiences.description: Experience an unforgettable cooking class led by a renowned Mexico City chef, featured on Top Chef VIP Telemundo and trusted by Disney, HBO, Coca-Cola, and Meta. Master four classic Mexican salsas with raw, roasted, boiled, and fried methods, indulge in unlimited chips, cheesy handmade quesadillas, authentic Mexican flan, and refreshing agua fresca. Perfect for travelers, foodies, and groups, this hands-on culinary celebration blends delicious recipes, vibrant culture, and the expertise of one of Mexico’s most acclaimed chefs.

experiences.title: Sandbox -Shooting Range Package
experiences.description:
American Shooters is the premier indoor range in Las Vegas featuring fourteen 25 yard lanes, seven 50 yards lanes and 4 VIP lanes. Travelers and locals are all welcome to use the facility with special deals and packages for everyone. Whether you want to shoot a machine gun or become a member to get in your weekly practice American Shooters range and experienced staff is ready to help you do it.

Our first goal is to make sure that each and every one of our customers have a safe and exciting gun range experience that will keep them coming back.

experiences.title: Luxury French Cooking Class in Las Vegas (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Immerse yourself in the artistry of French cuisine in this refined Las Vegas cooking class, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the four-course menu highlights bistro classics with a luxurious touch.

The menu you will prepare includes:
- Salade Niçoise with seared tuna, potatoes, olives and lemon-tarragon vinaigrette
- Coq au vin braised in red wine with mushrooms, pearl onions and bacon lardons
- Demi-glace pommes fondant with buttery reduction
- Dark chocolate pots de crème and black cherry clafoutis

With guidance from your French chef, you’ll master advanced techniques while savoring elegant flavors.

experiences.title: Rookie Shooting Experience in Las Vegas
experiences.description:
American Shooters is an indoor range in Las Vegas featuring fourteen 25 yard lanes, seven 50 yards lanes and 4 VIP lanes. Travelers and locals are all welcome to use the facility with special deals and packages for everyone. Whether you want to shoot a machine gun or become a member to get in your weekly practice American Shooters range and experienced staff is ready to help you do it.

experiences.title: Las Vegas Outdoor Machine Gun and Rifle Shooting with Shuttle
experiences.description:
Skip the crowded indoor ranges and experience the ultimate Las Vegas outdoor shooting adventure.

Enjoy complimentary hotel pickup from the Las Vegas Strip and head into the beautiful Nevada desert, where you'll shoot legendary firearms under the guidance of professional Range Safety Officers. From first time shooters to experienced enthusiasts, everyone is welcome.

Feel the power of iconic firearms, including the famous Barrett .50 Caliber rifle, while surrounded by stunning desert landscapes that make for incredible photos and unforgettable memories. With convenient transportation, expert instruction, breathtaking scenery, and world-class firearms, this is far more than a shooting range visit, it's a true Las Vegas adventure.

experiences.title: Must-See Spots: The Original Vegas Strip Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Mostly indoors to avoid heat. All the good stuff is inside.

Hey everyone, I'm Jonathan. I love a good adventure and an ice cold beer. I developed this tour to showcase my favorite must-see spots on the Vegas Strip to those who don't want to waste time and money wondering around aimlessly not knowing where to go and spending $50 on a Pina Colada when right around the corner it could be $7. Places you should see/ know and not miss. Spots even the locals don't know or you might miss if venturing alone.

Some are traditional iconic spots, views, photo spots & some are hidden bars, speakeasies, where the food and drink deals are, happy hours and lunch specials. How to do quality on a budget. This isn't the type of tour where I have a flag, 50 people wearing headsets while I lecture you for 3hrs. Have fun, drink, gamble. You're in Vegas aka Disney for adults. Save that for Rome. If anything is in my hand, it's a beer.

Great for the first day of your trip so later you know where to go!

experiences.title: Las Vegas Beginner ATV Tour with Safety Training
experiences.description: Experience the thrill of ATV riding in Las Vegas with the “First Time Adventure” class—designed specifically for beginners eager to build confidence and learn essential safety skills. experiences.description: Explore Camel Safari’s 176-acre property by safari tram, see more than 30 camels, enjoy a hands-on ambassador camel encounter and photo opportunity, and join knowledgeable keepers for a guided tour of the zoo’s exotic animals.

experiences.title: Camel Ride and Guided Zoo Tour at Camel Safari

experiences.title: Bars Unknown: Vegas Strip Speakeasies, Dives & Gems
experiences.description:
Hey everyone, I'm Jonathan & I enjoy the off-the-beaten-path bars & good deals! I developed this bar-crawl to counter the stereo-typical party-bus nightclub-crawl where you're herded on a bus with 50+ amateurs being served "free seltzers" and cheap vodka drinks. This is a walking experience to the lesser-known hidden gems, the ones most tourist miss if venturing alone. I've done bar-crawls around the world and most are 3 or 4 spots only, you wait to get in, wait to sit, wait long for overpriced mediocre drinks & they're not really special or hidden.

This is a mix of several bars. Some are cheap, some have happy hours, some are divey or hidden spots that most people walk right by. Drinks not included which means you can budget what you wanna spend & decide what you want to drink rather than being forced a specific menu and price.

All the bars are walking distance. Some are to-go spots, some we can sit & relax. The goal is to have fun & introduce you to something unknown!

experiences.title: Las Vegas Food Tour: Chinatown Favorites & Hidden Gems
experiences.description:
This is more than a food tour. It is a guided exploration of one of Las Vegas's most exciting neighborhoods, combining incredible food with the stories, culture, and people that make Chinatown so special.

Located just minutes from the Las Vegas Strip, Chinatown has become one of the city's most vibrant dining destinations. Along the way, you'll visit a carefully selected mix of local favorites and hidden gems while learning how the neighborhood evolved into a culinary hotspot. Each stop has been chosen not just for the food, but for the story behind it.

With small groups and an experienced guide leading the way, you'll get a more personal experience, plenty of opportunities to ask questions, and a deeper understanding of the neighborhood than you could get by exploring on your own.

Come hungry, leave with a full stomach, and discover a side of Las Vegas that many visitors never experience.

experiences.title: BLACKOUT Dining in the Dark Experience, Dining Attraction
experiences.description:
Embark on a culinary adventure unlike any other at BLACKOUT, a fascinating dining experience just off the Las Vegas Strip. Sitting in total darkness, your sense of taste and smell are completely heightened as you feast on a plant-based, multi-course, mystery meal of wonderful specialties.

Upon arrival at BLACKOUT, you're greeted by the friendly and entertaining staff. Next, you're led into the pitch-black dining room where your meal can begin. Taste and touch your way through a delicious lunch or dinner, one dish at a time.

At the end of your meal, the staff escorts you back to the lobby. Head back out into Vegas happy that you've had a truly unique sensory experience that you won't soon forget.

experiences.title: Las Vegas Strip: Rat Pack Ghost Mystery City Game
experiences.description:
The lights have gone dark on the Las Vegas Strip. As a musician chasing your dream, it's up to you to bring the entertainment back, guided by the ghosts of the Rat Pack themselves.

Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis Jr., and the rest lead you through 11 iconic landmarks. Solve riddles, decode hidden messages, and collect five mystical artifacts to restore Vegas to its former glory.

How it works: download the Questo app, activate your quest with the booking code, and start playing when you reach the MGM Grand. No guide, no schedule, just explore at your own pace and pause whenever you like.

You'll uncover stories most tourists walk past: the MGM Grand's Wizard of Oz origins, how New York-New York became a 9/11 memorial, the mafia ties behind Planet Hollywood, and a 40-foot Burning Man sculpture hidden between the casinos.

Perfect for couples, friends, or families looking for something beyond the usual Vegas tour. About 90 minutes, 11 stops along the Strip.

experiences.title: SouthWest Vegan Food Tour in Las Vegas

On this Las Vegas Food Tour, you'll sample delicious foods from around the world but in the convenience of the Southwest area. 

We'll start at a cozy vegan Italian spot, and you'll soon see why that is! We'll have a seat, share some mouth watering food!

Then we'll head over to a local Juice Bar and you'll learn about the benefits of juicing and smoothies. 

Lastly, we'll end at a plant based Mexican eatery where the food is yummy and (almost) guilt free .

We're going to focus our time at 3 major food spots in Southwest Las Vegas. You'll sample everything from comfort food to upscale menu items! All the dishes and foods will be plant based and vary from indulgent to healthy.

More than just a food tour, this experience combines fantastic flavors with engaging storytelling and insider tips about the city’s past, present, and what’s happening now in Sin City.

experiences.title: Scenic Wine Tasting Tour from Las Vegas with Food

The destination is the renowned Charleston Peak Winery, where you’ll spend approximately 2 to 2.5 hours enjoying a guided tasting of 8 carefully selected wines.
