experiences.description: Learn the art of fresh tagliatelle while enjoying the lively setting of a local brewery in Tulsa in this fun cooking class. In this class booked through Classpop!, Chef Gregory breaks down traditional pasta-making into easy, approachable steps, starting with mixing flour, eggs and olive oil into a fresh dough. You’ll knead, roll and cut your own tagliatelle by hand, learning techniques that help create the ideal texture and shape. Next, build a classic burro nocciola sauce by browning butter to bring out its deep, nutty flavor, then add sage and garlic for a savory finish. Toss everything together, top with Parmigiano Reggiano and enjoy your handmade pasta fresh from the pan.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Local Brewery in Tulsa
experiences.description: Your pasta era starts in a Tulsa brewery, flour-dusted hands included. This two-hour cooking class with Chef Gregory is built for total beginners, date nights, friend hangouts and anyone who has ever looked at fresh pasta and thought, “Cute, but absolutely not.” You’ll prove yourself wrong fast. First, you’ll turn flour, eggs and olive oil into fresh egg dough while learning how to mix, knead and handle it without panic. Next, you’ll roll the dough thin and cut it into classic tagliatelle ribbons. Then comes the sauce: golden brown butter, crispy sage leaves, a little garlic and a generous finish of Parmigiano Reggiano. You’ll cook, toss and taste Tagliatelle al Burro e Salvia in a casual brewery atmosphere that feels more like a night out than a formal lesson. Low pressure, high reward, very sauce-worthy.

experiences.title: Savory Blackened Fish Tacos Virtual Masterclass with a MasterChef
experiences.description:
Learn how to prepare the Blackened Tilapia Fish Tacos that earned the apron for MasterChef Season 8 Top 8 contestant Chef Gabriel.

In this interactive virtual class to help you prepare professional, high quality meals from the comfort of your own home. Join Gabriel and hear the story behind the dish that changed his life!

experiences.title: Bikes & Brews Tour
experiences.description: Oklahoma City is home to some of the best craft breweries in the country. This unforgettable experience will stop at five breweries for beer tastings. Our comfortable and easy to ride 3-speed bicycles allow for many interesting view points of the city. Ride OKC was founded by passionate native Oklahoman's, a registered architect, cyclist, and off the beaten path travel enthusiasts. All bikes come with water bottle cages; baskets are available upon request.

experiences.title: Asian District Food Tour in Oklahoma City
experiences.description:
Discover the vibrant flavors of Oklahoma City's Asian District on this guided walking food tour. Sample authentic Vietnamese, Chinese, and other Asian cuisines at three different food stops while enjoying two refreshing drink breaks. Your local guide will share intriguing stories and historical insights about the area, ensuring you gain an insider’s perspective on OKC's diverse food scene. This approximately 1-mile stroll is perfect for food lovers looking to explore the culinary richness of the district. Come hungry and ready to experience a unique blend of traditional dishes and innovative fusions. 

- Guided walking food tour through Oklahoma City's Asian District
- Visit 3 food stops and enjoy 2 drink stops along the way
- Learn about the history and culture of the Asian District
- Approximately 1 mile of relaxed walking with a local expert

experiences.title: Plaza District Food Tour Taste Oklahoma City Culinary Gems
experiences.description:
Explore the vibrant Plaza District of Oklahoma City on a guided walking food tour that highlights local eateries and the area's artistic charm. This culinary journey features five delicious food stops, paired with engaging stories and insider knowledge about the local food scene and history. Enjoy a leisurely stroll of approximately one mile, discovering the rich personality of the Plaza District while tasting diverse dishes. Perfect for food lovers and those seeking a unique experience in OKC.

- Guided walking food tour showcasing 5 local food stops
- Learn about the history and culture of the Plaza District
- Insider insights into Oklahoma City's dynamic food scene
- Approximately 1 mile of leisurely walking with a local guide

experiences.title: Ride Eat Explore OKC Streetcar Food Tour
experiences.description:
Do you want to try different food across OKC? Hop on your streetcar tour! You'll experience 4 unique districts while your tour guides share fun facts as we travel on the OKC Streetcar. Delicious local food will be waiting for you at each stop. So let's EMBARK and connect your taste buds to the community!

What to Expect: 
- A guided food tour with a local guide
- 4 food stops and tastings
- Stories, facts, and history about each area
- Travel on the Streetcar (fare included)
- Insider's guide to OKC's food scene

experiences.title: The Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery Show - Tulsa, OK
experiences.description: Our show is very different from traditional true crime mystery dinner shows. We will hide non-costumed actors in the audience that are pretending to be part of the crowd. This results in a much more social and interactive evening than with other shows. Our shows are set during the present day and take place in real time. Over the course of the night, our costumed Detectives will uncover clues, interrogate audience members that may or may not be part of the show, and help everyone get closer to solving the mystery.

experiences.title: Dinner Detective True Crime Murder Mystery - Oklahoma City, OK
experiences.description:
At The Dinner Detective, you’ll tackle a hilarious and challenging crime while you feast on a fantastic dinner. Just beware! The culprit is hiding in plain sight somewhere in the room, and you may find yourself as a Prime Suspect before you know it! Our engaging and unique murder mystery dinner theatre performances have been playing across the country since 2004.

Our show is very different from traditional murder mystery dinner shows. We will hide non-costumed actors in the audience that are pretending to be part of the crowd. This results in a much more social and interactive evening than with other shows. Our shows are set during the present day and take place in real time. Over the course of the night, our costumed Detectives will uncover clues, interrogate audience members that may or may not be part of the show, and help everyone get closer to solving the mystery.

experiences.title: Bean to Bar Chocolate Making and Tasting Tour
experiences.description: No other experience in Bend lets you travel the globe through chocolate. The chocolate experts guide you through the entire bean to bar journey, from how we source directly from small farms to the small-batch roasting techniques that preserve each origin's distinct character. Be welcomed with a mug of house-made hot cocoa, then explore the global cocoa story told by the people who live it every day. Learn how soil, climate, and region shape every bar, from fruity Peruvian beans to earthy Indonesian cacao. Then take the craft into your own hands and pour your own bar from warm, liquid single-origin chocolate to take home. Close with a guided tasting flight of the award-winning lineup — comparing the terroir of multiple cacao-growing regions side by side, just as a sommelier would explore fine wines. Taste the world's finest single-origin cacao in one sitting, then shop the full collection at guest-exclusive pricing.

experiences.title: Chocolate Tour Including Hot Chocolate and Samples
experiences.description: You will enjoy a behind the scenes look at how this local award-winning chocolate maker creates their incredibly savory product. You’ll learn about how various beans from different regions of the world help make these chocolates and experience how the process works. Perhaps the highlight will be forming your own chocolate bar into a mold that will be packaged to take home with you. At the end, everyone will enjoy some wine or hot chocolate along with tasting their various samples. If you choose to purchase some chocolate bars, we have arranged special wholesale pricing for you.

experiences.title: Grilling Techniques Class in Portland Oregon
experiences.description:
I have been grilling and BBQing for over 20 years, and have trained abroad in France, Spain, Argentina, Thailand, South Korea and other countries. As a native of the American South, I combine my culinary roots with eclectic and diverse flavor profiles. The result is a completely unique approach to grilling, based on science that marries traditionally Southern recipes and techniques with exciting ethnic-inspired flavors. With over 350 classes delivered and a perfect 5 out of 5 stars rating, I know you will leave my kitchen as a better griller and overall cook! Let's get grilling y'all! 
Other classes include: Pasta Making, Paella Basics, Sushi 101, Pizza Making.

experiences.title: Premium Loose Leaf Tea and Chocolate Tasting
experiences.description:
Spend time being a real chocolatier. Make your own truffle ganache, learn about infusing flavors. Prep and use various treats to dip or coat your finished ganache. Best of all, you get to take home what you make (unless it gets mysteriously consumed before you make it out the door).
Criteria is “You must be fun!”

Chocolate can be messy so we’re providing an apron for use. We also recommend closed toed shoes. Age 13 and up. If you have any questions please let us know.

Level: Beginner People: 6 Cost: $90 per person

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Portland
experiences.description:
If folding dumplings while surrounded by good food and good vibes sounds like your kind of evening, this cooking class with Chef Jimmy belongs on your Portland bucket list. Hosted at a trendy local venue, this interactive dim sum experience teaches you how to make authentic dumplings from scratch without the stress or intimidation.

You’ll start by preparing fresh hot water dough before learning how to shape delicate dumpling wrappers by hand. Then, Chef Jimmy will walk you through two flavorful fillings: a hearty pork and chicken mixture with green onions and a savory vegetarian option featuring cabbage, shiitake mushrooms and parsley. Once your dumplings are folded and ready, you’ll make a simple but addictive dipping sauce with soy sauce, sesame oil and chili crunch for the perfect finishing touch. This beginner-friendly class includes all ingredients and cooking tools, plus step-by-step guidance that makes every part of the process approachable, fun and surprisingly therapeutic.

experiences.title: Fun Gnocchi Making Class With a Local Chef in Portland
experiences.description: If you've ever wondered what makes fresh gnocchi so irresistible, this cooking class has the answer. You'll learn how to make homemade potato gnocchi from scratch using approachable techniques that are easy to recreate in your own kitchen. Start by preparing a smooth potato dough, then practice rolling, cutting and shaping each gnocchi into soft, bite-sized pillows. As they cook, you'll discover how to recognize the perfect texture before finishing them with a delicious homemade sauce. You'll sharpen practical kitchen skills, from dough preparation and shaping to cooking and plating, without feeling rushed or overwhelmed. The atmosphere is relaxed, the process is satisfying and every bite is warm, tender and comforting. By the end, you'll have a fresh Italian classic on your plate and the confidence to skip the packaged version for good.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Local Brewery in Portland
experiences.description: Chef Sarah brings a cozy, down-to-earth vibe to this pasta-making class in Portland, making it easy for anyone to dive in and have fun with no experience needed. You’ll learn real pasta techniques in a relaxed, hands-on setting as you mix and knead fresh egg-free dough using simple ingredients like flour, water and salt. While your dough rests, you’ll work as a group with a prepared batch to practice rolling and cutting pasta with a machine. Then, Chef Sarah will show you approachable hand-shaping techniques that prove fresh pasta does not require special equipment. As you shape your dough, she’ll demonstrate how to make a rich butter sage sauce with garlic, lemon and olive oil, then cook the fresh noodles you cut together. At the end of class, you’ll sample the pasta made during the session and take home a full batch of fresh pasta to cook within the next three days.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class With a Local Chef in Portland
experiences.description:
Skip the sushi restaurant and become the person who casually says, "I make my own rolls at home." In this interactive cooking class with Chef Jimmy, you'll learn authentic sushi-making techniques in a relaxed, beginner-friendly setting at a local Portland brewery. Whether it's your first time working with nori or you've always wanted to improve your rolling skills, this class makes every step feel surprisingly easy.

Chef Jimmy will teach you how to prepare perfectly textured sushi rice before guiding you through layering ingredients and rolling sushi using traditional techniques. You'll create a smoked salmon roll with avocado, negi and nori, then make a vibrant vegetable roll featuring glazed king mushrooms, cucumber and carrots. Throughout the class, you'll pick up practical knife skills, ingredient tips and presentation techniques that make homemade sushi look as good as it tastes.

experiences.title: Make Japanese Sushi With a Local Chef in Portland
experiences.description:
Forget wrestling with a sushi menu when you can roll your own. In a welcoming local venue, you’ll get hands-on with the basics of sushi-making and discover that creating restaurant-style rolls is much less intimidating than it looks.

Start by preparing sticky sushi rice, learning how the right texture helps every roll hold together. Then grab a sheet of nori and build a California roll with crab, avocado and cucumber. Next, make a tuna and cucumber roll packed with fresh tuna, avocado and cucumber. Along the way, you’ll practice spreading rice, arranging fillings, rolling tightly and slicing your finished rolls into neat, bite-sized pieces. It’s relaxed, practical and easy to follow, whether you’re completely new to sushi or simply ready to sharpen your skills. One thing is certain: your next sushi craving may come with a rolling mat.

experiences.title: Make Pasta With a Local Chef at a Trendy Brewery in Portland
experiences.description: Chef Sarah brings a cozy, down-to-earth vibe to this pasta-making class in Portland, making it easy for anyone to dive in and have fun with no experience needed. You’ll learn real pasta techniques in a relaxed, hands-on setting as you mix and knead fresh egg-free dough using simple ingredients like flour, water and salt. While your dough rests, you’ll work as a group with a prepared batch to practice rolling and cutting pasta with a machine. Then, Chef Sarah will show you approachable hand-shaping techniques that prove fresh pasta does not require special equipment. As you shape your dough, she’ll demonstrate how to make a rich butter sage sauce with garlic, lemon and olive oil, then cook the fresh noodles you cut together. At the end of class, you’ll sample the pasta made during the session and take home a full batch of fresh pasta to cook within the next three days.

experiences.title: Willamette Wine Tour from McMinnville (Tasting Fees Included)
experiences.description:
Do you want to taste the best wines in Willamette Valley?

Our custom private tours are designed to take couples and groups of friends deep into the heart of Willamette Valley to explore the cult wines, highest-rated wines, and legendary vineyards of Willamette Valley!

We love building unique tours according to your preferences and ensuring you leave Oregon wine country with lasting memories.

Our tours will take you to 3 or 4 wineries (depending on your desire for a slower pace or more experiences) and will include elevated tours if you choose. 

Our wine tour company, Wine History Tours, is centered in the heart of the valley, and our primary drivers are all industry insiders with years of experience and connections. 

This private tour isn't simply about providing a driver, but ushering you into the best experience of Willamette Valley wines and wineries possible. 

McMinnville, Salem, Newberg, Dundee, and other pickup locations are all serviceable.

experiences.title: Willamette Wine Tour from Newberg (Tasting Fees Included)
experiences.description:
Do you want to taste the best wines in Willamette Valley?

Our custom private tours are designed to take couples and groups of friends deep into the heart of Willamette Valley to explore the cult wines, highest-rated wines, and legendary vineyards of Willamette Valley!

We love building unique tours according to your preferences and ensuring you leave Oregon wine country with lasting memories.

Our tours will take you to 3 or 4 wineries (depending on your desire for a slower pace or more experiences) and will include elevated tours if you choose. 

This private tour isn't simply about providing a driver, but ushering you into the best experience of Willamette Valley wines and wineries possible. 

McMinnville, Salem, Newberg, Dundee, and other pickup locations are all serviceable.

experiences.title: Portland Sushi Omakase Tour – 3 Stops, Small Group
experiences.description:
This is Portland’s elevated sushi night out: a small-group, omakase-style progressive dinner across three top sushi spots downtown. Instead of tiny samples, you’ll sit down at each stop for chef-selected dishes—crafted to highlight different styles, cuts, and techniques—so you leave genuinely full and seriously impressed.

Over 2–3 hours, you’ll enjoy a curated progression that can include nigiri, sashimi, specialty rolls, and seasonal plates (selection varies by night). Your guide keeps it fun and approachable while explaining what you’re eating, how to spot quality, and how to order with confidence the next time you’re at a sushi bar.

All food is included, and group size is capped so the experience stays personal and high-touch. —and if you have dietary needs (gluten-free or vegan), message us after booking so we can plan your best possible menu.

Why this is worth it: you’re getting a guided, chef-curated sushi progression at three restaurants in one night—without the guesswork.

experiences.title: Oregon Coast Tour and Wine Tasting From Portland- Full Day Tour
experiences.description: The Oregon coast is one of the most majestic geologic formations that was formed by lava flows millions of years ago. We depart to the coast and have lunch in the charming town of Cannon Beach and do hiking and exploring on the coast. Explore the majestic Oregon coast, view the amazing Haystack Rock formation, and during low tide gaze at starfish and clams. We will also explore Oswald State Park for lite trail walking and see the stunning cliffs of Manzanita point. This is a joinable small group tour for 2 persons or more, door to door service. Please dress for the season, expect a full day beginning 10am and back to Portland by 6pm.

experiences.title: Portland: Wine Tasting + Vinotherapy Tub Soak at The Wine Spa
experiences.description: Experience a unique spa treatment that combines Oregon wine, self-care, and relaxation at the only vinotherapy spa in the United States.

experiences.title: Afternoon Tour in Columbia Gorge Waterfall with Free Wine Tasting
experiences.description: The Columbia Gorge NSA features waterfalls, mountains, monoliths, terraces, resort towns, vineyards, orchards, and The River, harboring a plethora of fish and birds, and unique plants and invertebrates. In the early 1900s, Portlanders would drive their Model T cars along the Columbia River Highway to gaze at waterfalls. There is said to be over 4000 waterfalls; many are hidden away, but many are just a short hike off the Historic Highway. On this afternoon half-day tour you'll make new friends while exploring "waterfall alley", including views of the Vista House and a stop at Multnomah Falls, the tallest waterfall in Oregon and most visited site in the Pacific Northwest. Your expert guide will teach you about the natural history, cultural history, and wine background of the area, as you drive the Historic Columbia River Highway Scenic Byway. You'll continue on to stop at a vineyard in the Columbia Gorge American Viticultural Area (AVA). Tasting fees included.

experiences.title: Portland Party Bike Tours: The Classic Crawl - Public
experiences.description:
Explore Portland's vibrant nightlife on a two-hour guided bike tour, where laughter and good vibes flow alongside refreshing drinks. The Classic Crawl takes you through the city's coolest neighborhoods and stops at three local bars, showcasing everything from neon-lit dives to quirky favorites. Perfect for groups looking to celebrate special occasions or simply enjoy a fun night out, this tour features onboard music and group photos to capture the memories. Come ready to pedal and dress up for the occasion—costumes are encouraged.

- A public tour means making new friends, allowing others to join you on your crawl.
- Two-hour guided bike tour through Portland's neighborhoods.
- Visit three unique bars and enjoy a lively atmosphere.
- Group photos and music provided for a memorable experience.
- Minimum group size of 6 and maximum of 15 riders.

experiences.title: All-Inclusive Downtown Portland Food Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the essential food and drinks at the heart of downtown Portland, Oregon on this all-inclusive walking tour led by an experienced, professional, Portland-native guide and standup comedian. Meet local vendors and hear their stories while getting inside knowledge about the city, its history, its food, and its identity. This is your insider access to some of the best-known and best-hidden bites that define downtown.

This tour is operated by a small local business, and due to our lean business model and relationship to other local small businesses, we are capable of offering unrivaled value and flexibility.

experiences.title: Portland Food Carts, Pods and Patios Tour
experiences.description:
Discover what the food cart hype is all about in the city invented food cart pods! With over 1000 food carts throughout the city, let us take you around to some of the best and taste the delicious foods that make Portland a true foodie destination. On this walking tour, you’ll discover global foods, quench your thirst with tasty drinks, and learn fun history in this colorful neighborhood. We like to think this is the perfect way to discover quirky Portland, eat where the locals eat, and have fun! 

Tour highlights: 
- Try hearty servings of food and beverages from 5-7 different food carts. You'll get more than a full meal!
- Learn all about Portland food cart culture. (We don't call them trucks for a reason.)
- Try a selection of diverse food like Slavic, Mexican, Bavarian, and Burmese delights.
- Discover Portland’s historic, off-the-beaten-path Eastside neighborhood to check out the local street art.

experiences.title: Downtown Portland Coffee and Donut Tour
experiences.description:
Jumpstart your morning with a huge variety of coffee and donuts across 4-5 mouthwatering stops where each bite and sip was crafted right here in Portland. Along the way, immerse yourself in quirky history while exploring Downtown Portland. We like to think this the perfect way to discover Downtown Portland, see where locals get their coffee and donut fix, and have fun!

Tour highlights: 
- Taste two single-origin coffees brewed by pour-over, side by side.
- Portland has over 75 locally owned donut shops, and we’ll sample a selection of the best from our favorite. 
- Stand in Pioneer Courthouse Square and learn all about “Portland’s Living Room”.
- At the coziest Portland hole-in-the-wall café, indulge in a traditional macchiato paired with a homemade French pastry.
- Plus much more! 

Note: We do not visit Voodoo or Blue Star during this tour as they are on the common tourist track – instead we keep it local.

experiences.title: Portland Urban Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Taste your way through Oregon’s renowned wine scene right in the heart of Portland! Try a variety of wine varietals and savor delicious bites, all while exploring the vibrant Pearl and Slabtown neighborhoods. 

What makes this wine tour special? We’ve met with the wine experts themselves and did all the research for you, so the tastings and snacks are curated and included. You’ll try 10+ wines at two winery tasting rooms plus one wine bar, including a variety of white, rosé, and red, and snack small bite pairings. 

Highlights: 
- Taste 4 Oregon wines paired with artisan popcorn at an approachable winery while learning why Oregon wine is special.
- Explore 2 trendy Portland neighborhoods, blending old and modern architecture with rich history.
- Dine on bruschetta paired with wine at a family-run winery.
- End your evening sipping Bordeaux in a secret wine bar where you might just uncover a hidden surprise.
- Learn from your tour guide and wine experts.

*This tour is 21+ ONLY.

experiences.title: Portland Oregon Foodie Field Trip By Bike and E-bike
experiences.description: Arrive hungry and experience a variety of flavors from local hotspots in Portland, Oregon. Learn about the bustling culinary scene as well as the “localvore” philosophy that drives it. Indulge your taste buds and ride with us on this classic Portland experience.

experiences.title: Portland's Original Delicious Donut Adventure & Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
We've always had a passion for donuts, but only recently did we realize just how many others do too. And when looking around, we didn't see anything that truly celebrated donuts in all their glory, hence the Underground Donut Tour was born. This tour is for anyone who truly enjoys donuts. At each location, you'll be able to try a curated sample of one of that location's best donuts. Many locations offer vegan, gluten, or nut-free options, however, please make sure to let us know ahead of the tour, so we can make sure to highlight those specifically for you. Our tours include such favorites as Coco Donuts, Blue Star Donuts, Nola Doughnuts, Voodoo Doughnuts, and more. 

We also offer much more information about the route, the city, the stops, and more.

We hope you can join us!

experiences.title: Coffee Roasters of Portland Eastside Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Our small group Eastside Coffee Roaster walking tour takes you to the makers who have called the neighborhood their home for decades, each with a different approach to coffee roasting and brewing. Across from downtown Portland, the industrial neighborhood has transformed from manufacturing and warehouses to the heart of passionate creators: artists, chocolate makers, food innovators, and every kind of free spirit.

Portland has the most coffee roasters of any city in the world, and we would argue some of the most earnest and unique origins and barista artistry is happening right where Around Portland Tours makes its home.

The tour in total is 1.5-3 miles (2-5 km) of walking, tasting and learning. You'll also discover a lot about Portland and how these artisans are nourished. We keep groups small, so you'll have an intimate experience with your passionate guides. Ask about larger private groups.

experiences.title: Essential Portland Oregon Bike and E-Bike Tour!
experiences.description:
Explore Portland, Oregon! This signature bike tour is an ideal introduction to the City of Roses. Visit historic Old Town, pedal the Waterfront Park Esplanade, cruise the Green Park Block corridors, Portland State University and explore the Pearl District with our experienced guides and comfortable rides. E-bikes available!

Important - 
 • Minimum age is 10 years 
 • Minimum height of 4'11" to participate

experiences.title: Small Group: Willamette Valley Wine Tour From Portland (Tasting Fees Included)
experiences.description:
The Northern Willamette Valley's close proximity to Portland creates a perfect opportunity to join others on a small group public tour of Oregon’s wine country with Sea to Summit Tours, Portland Oregon's original tour and adventure company. 

Experienced, knowledgeable guides, providing fun and informative tours with unparalleled customer service, while operating the nicest and most comfortable, custom equipped 4x4 Mercedes-Benz vehicles in Portland’s tour industry.

We set an itinerary with outstanding wine, great hospitality, and beautiful scenery with wine tasting fees included – all the keys to creating a unforgettable Willamette Valley Wine Tour for our clients... Created, owned and operated by native Portland Oregonian's, since 2001

experiences.title: Hike and Bike Tour to Columbia River Gorge Waterfalls
experiences.description:
This is our favorite tour! One of the most unique experiences in the world, riding down the historic highway built for Model Ts with the spectacular Columbia Gorge unfolding beneath us. We transport our guests and bikes in comfortable vans, and our guides ride with our small groups for much of the ride. You'll get personal attention and the safest experience we can provide.

Beyond the 180 years of pioneers and loggers, before the century-old highway, this was the land of people with a rich mythology. We tell the stories that have been told to us by the indigenous people as best we can. 

You'll visit waterfalls, with engaged hiking and a leisurely approach to the tour itinerary. We want you to enjoy yourself -- whether you are traveling alone or with a big group. Ages 13 and up. (We can accommodate much bigger groups traveling together, please reach out!)

Please note there are cars that share the scenic highway.

experiences.title: Portland Pizza Walking Tour: 4 Stops, Full Slice Each
experiences.description:
Portland takes pizza seriously—and this tour is the easiest, most fun way to taste the scene in one walk. You’ll hit four pizzerias on a relaxed route with short walks in between (about ~1 mile total), tasting a curated progression of styles and signatures.

This is a full-meal experience: each guest gets a full slice at each stop (four slices total). Your guide keeps it laid-back and social while sharing quick, useful pizza insight—what makes a great slice, what to order, and where to go next depending on what you loved most.

Pizza and drinks are included. Rain or shine, come hungry and ready to eat like a local.

experiences.title: Willamette Valley Wine Tasting Tour from Portland
experiences.description: World-famous Pinot Noirs, crisp Chardonnays, and sweet Rieslings are just a taste of the dozens of wines that Oregon has to offer. On this adventure through the rolling hills of the Willamette Valley, we’ll visit three carefully selected wineries, vineyards, or tasting rooms. Guests will partake in tasting flights and experience a behind-the-scenes view of viticulture. Please note: Tasting fees are not included in the cost of the tour.

experiences.title: Willamette Valley Wine Tour with Lunch
experiences.description: Join an all day Willamette Valley Wine Tour, and get a taste of the most decadent wines the lush Willamette Valley has to offer. Whether you are a wine tasting veteran or a newcomer, there is something for you. Our guides are second to none all with many years experience in the ways of the Willamette Valley and its many vineyards. They will usher you to 3 separate wineries over 7.5 hours, where you will have the opportunitie to taste the famous Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Riesling, and other varieties that are unique to the region.

experiences.title: Bike Around Portland Oregon: Art, Culture, Bridges, Poetry
experiences.description:
It's all about the bike ride! We spend more time riding in the neighborhoods Portlanders love, & always stopping to smell the roses. Start in the inner Eastside at 833 SE Main #124, where we will safely fit you for a bike and helmet, ready for a sweet 7-11 mile ride through a pretty residential neighborhood, to our favorite rose garden, into an art-heavy industrial district, across the sexy Tilikum Bridge, and onto Portland's waterfront. From there, it's a trip along the edge of downtown and more stories, before we head over another bridge back to our shop!

Check out our new two-hour option! Easy riding, little hills, 5-8 miles.

You'll visit most of the city's quadrants, ride over two bridges, and along the Willamette River. We'll visit almost-secret beaches, read poetry written in sidewalks and rocks, see public art of every shape, color and texture. And have you tried some of the city's best doughnuts or ice cream? We’ll tell you our favorites! 

Bikes, helmets and water provided.

experiences.title: Mt Hood, Waterfalls, and Wine Tour
experiences.description: Visit the top attractions in the Columbia River Gorge National Scenic Area in this full day of exploration just outside of Portland. In the morning enjoy unparalleled scenic views from Portland Women’s Forum and Vista House, then gaze in wonder at towering waterfalls like Multnomah Falls and Latourell Falls. For lunch, explore charming downtown Hood River where the historic buildings are filled with boutiques, designer shops, outdoor adventure gear outfitters, antique shops, art galleries, and more than 30 restaurants. In the afternoon visit one vineyard in the Columbia Gorge AVA where the beauty of the landscape is inextricable from its allure as a world class wine region. Wines produced from this region tend to be riper than wines from Oregon’s cooler, western regions and with higher acidity and structure than what occurs naturally in the warmer, eastern AVAs. Discover the postcard-perfect scenery and great wines of the Columbia River Gorge during this day trip from Portland.

experiences.title: Food Carts of Portland Bike Tour: local flavors and stories
experiences.description:
Portland’s famous food carts are scattered all over the city's five (now six) quadrants, over 600 in total, in over 60 pods — collections of food carts! Starting at our shop, 833 SE Main Street #124, we'll put you on one of our lightweight bicycles and guide you on a 8-12 mile (11-17 km) culinary experience through some of our best-loved chefs and makers, sampling everything from Oregon farm-to-table delights to snacks appropriate to late-night cravings.

Our focus is on locally-owned businesses with a great story; we’ll take you to a few of our favorites, many of which were important in creating the food cart scene as it exists today. Without these unique and passionate people, we may not have even half of what Portland offers to residents and guests alike. Expect flavors and fusions that tell not only a culinary, but also a cultural, tale. Bikes, helmets and plentiful food samples provided. 

We keep groups small, so you'll have an intimate experience with your passionate guides!

experiences.title: Waterfalls & Wine Tour-Multnomah Falls,Vineyards,Hood River Combo
experiences.description: This is an amazing way to see the most spectacular Oregon wonders like Multnomah Falls, Vista Point driving thru the breathtaking and rugged beauty of the Columbia Gorge. We will see various waterfalls like Multnomah Falls, Latourell Falls , a lunch stop in the quaint historic downtown Hood River, a wine tasting stop at one of the amazing Vineyards in the Columbia Gorge AVA. This is ideal if you want to do some scenic, nature stops with light trail walking and also enjoy a vineyard stop, its absolutely the most amazing way to spend 8 hours.

experiences.title: Columbia Gorge Waterfalls & Wineries from Portland: All-Inclusive Afternoon Tour
experiences.description:
Experience two of the greatest attractions of the Pacific Northwest – the Columbia Gorge Waterfalls and Oregon wines! Hear amazing narratives that lie beneath the scenic beauty as you admire the basalt cliffs, lofty waterfalls, and vineyards and orchards that define the area.

Begin your afternoon along the mighty Columbia River, watching for bald eagles and ospreys as you make your way to the verdant forests of “Waterfall Alley.” Your guide will provide a naturalist perspective on the mossy environment as you meander around some of the 70 waterfalls that drape the region’s cliffs. As you continue east, the wet forests of the coastal Pacific Northwest give way to Garry Oak, Ponderosa Pines, and other more arid vegetation, creating prime conditions for grapes.

Spend the rest of the day exploring the fertile basin around Hood River, where you’ll taste boutique wines found only in Oregon. Learn how the forces that shaped this incredible landscape have also crafted the wine in your glass.

experiences.title: Portland Ice Cream Tour – Sample Every Flavor + 4 Scoops
experiences.description:
This is not a tiny-spoon tasting tour.
At every stop, guests sample every available flavor and receive a full scoop per person — all included in the ticket price. There’s no choosing just one flavor, no standing in lines, and no additional purchases.
The entire experience is fully hosted by entertaining local guides who handle ordering, keep things moving, and make it fun. You’ll enjoy laughs, insider food recommendations, and a relaxed walk through the heart of Portland.
With multiple flavors plus full scoops at each stop, many guests say this feels closer to an almost all-you-can-eat ice cream crawl than a traditional food tour — just without the chaos or rushing.
Created by Portland locals with a genuine love for ice cream and their city, this tour is designed to be generous, easy, and unforgettable — perfect for families, visitors, and serious ice-cream lovers.

experiences.title: Portland Downtown Food Tour: 6 Tastings of Local & Global Flavors
experiences.description:
Join Secret Food Tours through Downtown Portland, Oregon. Delight in the fusion of international flavors with locally sourced and crafted ingredients, showcasing the vibrant diversity of the city.

Immerse yourself in our city’s rich history, while capturing the essence of Portland’s food scene. You will discover local culinary gems by savoring an array of extraordinary and authentic dishes.

experiences.title: Full-Day Mt Hood Waterfall Tour with Lunch and Wine Included
experiences.description: Mt. Hood is the highest summit in Oregon. It features waterfalls, glaciers, and historic Timberline Lodge, built by local artisans during the Great Depression, and featuring the longest ski season in the US. To the north of Mt. Hood is the Hood River Valley and Columbia Gorge American Viticultural Area (AVA), the lovechild of the Columbia Valley and Willamette Valley AVAs. You will get intimate with this area through the opportunity to enjoy the local wine, cider, and beer, a visit to Timberline Lodge on Mt. Hood, and stops at Vista House and Multnomah Falls, the tallest waterfall in Oregon and most visited site in the Pacific Northwest. Your expert guide will teach you about the natural history, cultural history, and wine background of the area, as you drive the Mt. Hood and Historic Columbia River Highway Scenic Byways. You'll visit 2 vineyards. We host lunch, and a glass of wine at one vineyard, *you cover beverages at a second vineyard, at your leisure*.

experiences.title: Waterfall Hop-On Hop-Off Trolley Tour Multnomah Falls Day Pass
experiences.description:
See more waterfalls without traffic, parking, or timed-entry stress on the Historic Columbia River Highway. The Waterfall Trolley lets you explore the world-famous waterfall corridor at your own pace.

Ride our narrated open-air trolley for excellent views, unobstructed photo opportunities, and stories about the waterfalls, highway, and Columbia River Gorge. Hop on and off at designated stops to visit waterfalls, viewpoints, hiking trails, food, restrooms, and photo spots without moving your car.

Driving guests board at Corbett Grade School, 35800 E. Historic Columbia River Highway, Corbett, OR 97019. Look for the green Waterfall Trolley ticket booth in the parking lot. Free parking is available.

Guests arriving by scheduled bus from Portland may join at Multnomah Falls. Trolley loops begin at 9:00 a.m., with the last loop at 4:00 p.m. Enjoy the Historic Highway the easy way, with more time at the waterfalls and less time worrying about parking.

experiences.title: Willamette Valley Wine Tour - Full Day Tour
experiences.description: Discover Oregon's world famous wine region known as Willamette Valley and experience the best pinot noir, chardonnay, rose and other varietals guided by local wine lovers on this 8 hour tour. An excellent trip for new and seasoned wine lovers, a romantic weekend, or last minute vacation with your friends. Gain an inside perspective about the growing region, the winemaking process and the history of this valley. Expect to be pampered, entertained, and truly have a memorable trip in Oregon's Wine Country. This is a joinable small group tour for 2 persons or more. We will explore 3 of the finest vineyards in the valley and do a sit down lunch at our favorite establishment or vineyard lunch pairing. Proceed to check availability to see your exact price for the group size, we will handle all route planning and reservations on your behalf and offer door to door pickup and dropoff.

experiences.title: 'The Best of Portland' City Tour: Small-Group Sightseeing Tour
experiences.description:
Experience the Pacific Northwest’s most-dynamic cultural hub on this small-group tour of Portland's highlights! Explore diverse neighborhoods with your TripAdvisor 'Hall of Fame' guide. You’ll be treated to morning tea and pastries, as well as walks & scenic views, with round-trip downtown Portland hotel transport included.

Begin with Pittock Mansion for unparalleled views of the city and Mt. Hood. The historic setting is an ideal place to discuss Portland’s pioneer history and development.

Take in roses or cherry blossoms, see the landscape design of J.C. Olmsted, witness sustainability integrated into an urban environment, and learn about cinder-cone volcanoes that once covered the area!

After experiencing the city’s natural side, dive into its artsy and independent spirit. Experience neighborhoods such as the Pearl District, Hawthorne, Nob Hill, Alberta, and North Mississippi for a slice of Portlandia, embodied in food truck pods, hip specialty boutiques, and craft breweries.

experiences.title: Oregon Wine Tour-Full Day Tour with Lunch Stop
experiences.description: Explore Oregon's world famous wine country known as the Willamette Valley and experience the best Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Rose, Chardonnay and other varietals guided by local wine lovers with an opportunity to do food pairings at a vineyard or seperate lunch stop. Gain an inside perspective about the growing region, the winemaking process and the history of this valley at each vineyard during your tasting. Expect to be pampered, entertained, and truly have a memorable trip in Oregon's Wine Country. This is limited to 10 people in a small joinable group, but usually much smaller in our modern and comfortable 15 passenger vans.

experiences.title: 2-hour Lunch Cruise on Willamette River
experiences.description:
Delicious Northwest cuisine and beautiful river views provide the perfect ingredients for a Portland lunch to remember. This two-hour cruise on the Willamette River is perfect for Portland natives and newcomers alike. 

Boarding: 11 am
Cruising: 11:30 am - 1:30 pm

experiences.title: Haunted Pub Tour
experiences.description:
Portland's longest running Ghost Tour with 300+ 5 star reviews. The city's wicked and wild history will blow you away!

On this spine-tingling walking tour, you will uncover Portland’s dark side. In the early 1900s, unsuspecting sailors were often ruthlessly abducted and wisked away through the notorious Shanghai Tunnels. We will entertain you with stories of how notorious local gangsters managed to kidnap thousands of people off the streets and why their ghosts still haunt the city today. Don’t worry, this tour is all above ground! 

Our tour guides are local historians and ghost hunters who love to share their passion with you. We LIVE for seeing our guests eyes light up and hearing an audible gasp at the end of a spooky tale. 

Stops include the famous merchant hotel, home to Nina Portland's most famous ghost. Tours will include 5 local beer samples. The tour is rated ‘mildly’ spooky and is a 50:50 mixture of wicked history and hauntings.

experiences.title: 2.5-hour Dinner Cruise on Willamette River
experiences.description:
The best way to dine in Portland, Oregon — on the Willamette River enhanced by dazzling city sights and lights. You'll enjoy an evening featuring Northwest cuisine (locally sourced and prepared fresh on board), live piano music and narration of the sights on the outer decks. This two and a half hour cruise on the Willamette River is perfect for Portland natives and newcomers alike. 

Vessel is subject to change.

experiences.title: Happy Hour Sightseeing Cruise
experiences.description: Take in the sights of Portland, Oregon from a different perspective. Cruise through the heart of Portland on the Willamette River. Enjoy a narration of the sights available on all the decks. A happy hour menu and full bar is available for purchase during the cruise.

experiences.title: Aerial Tram Ride with Doughnuts near Sunrise in Portland Oregon
experiences.description:
Note: Sunrise is too early in the summer to ride during the tram’s open hours! We will be riding after sunrise April - August. The early tour guest gets the spectacular views. We’ll meet you on the edge of downtown Portland, where you will have a chance to pick up coffee (or tea). We will head over to OHSU, where we will walk with you to the Aerial Tram. We’ll ride up this feat of Swiss engineering up to the top as the early sun reveals the city’s glowing colors. Once there, depending on sunrise timing and weather, we'll watch the sun crest the horizon, or check out city views in the early morning light.

After we ride back to the bottom, we'll tell you the story of the bridge and its quixotic lights, and orient you to the city whose east-west divider lies before us.

The Aerial Tram was built in 2006 to connect the main campus of Oregon Health Sciences University with the new neighborhood of the South Waterfront. We will be joining students and medical staff on their daily tram ride!

experiences.title: Shanghai Tunnels Underground Tour - with Beer Tasting
experiences.description:
This tour is the only access to Portland's underground Shanghai Tunnels with a new bonus visit to the 2nd floor and ballroom of the haunted Merchant Hotel.

Under the Merchant Hotel is the largest intact area of the legendary Shanghai Tunnels, where we are the exclusive tour provider. Learn about Portland's dark history and hear stories about our resident ghost, Nina. Finish up with special beer tasting and 1 pint of our internationally award-winning beer.

Named One of the Most Haunted Places in America by Conde Nast, USA Today, Thrillist, Cosmopolitan Magazine and more.

Featured on The Travel Channel. 

Must be 21+ other than noon, 1, 2 & 3pm tour.

experiences.title: Portland Haunted Pub Crawl Ghost Stories and Drinks Tour
experiences.description:
Discover Portland's darker side on an adults-only haunted pub crawl through the city's historic Old Town district. Visit legendary bars, haunted landmarks, and infamous locations connected to Portland's most chilling ghost stories, true crime mysteries, and the notorious Shanghai Tunnels.

Along the way, hear tales of restless spirits at Kells Irish Pub, the ghostly residents of the Benson Hotel, the unsolved murder connected to the Roseland Theater, and the tragic legend that still haunts Old Town Pizza & Brewing. Between stops, enjoy time at local pubs while exploring the history of sailors, bootleggers, performers, laborers, and outcasts who helped shape Portland's haunted reputation.

Perfect for paranormal enthusiasts, history buffs, and anyone looking for a unique night out, this 21+ experience combines haunted history, local legends, and Portland's vibrant bar scene for an unforgettable evening after dark.

All guests must be age 21+ and have a valid I.D. with them.

experiences.title: Authentic Delicious Chinese Dumplings
experiences.description:
I am all about sharing my knowledge and having fun with my students!

Here are the experiences from my students:
"I would definitely recommend this experience. Jinni is an awesome teacher, so patient and encouraging. She is passionate about cooking and sharing her experience and knowledge with her students. I took this class with my daughter and we both were so happy to be able to actually learn from a pro how to make delicious dumplings. Jinni was so welcoming and such a great host, sharing many stories about growing up in China and learning to cook there."

"Jinni is warm and caring. Her beautiful home is inviting and we were put at ease immediately. Her personal stories and passion for cooking easily came through in her abilities and attention to details. She is knowledgeable about her craft and her love of teaching is easily noted. I would absolutely take another class with her. I now know how to properly make dumplings. No more frozen dumplings for me!"

experiences.title: Classic Candle Making Experience @ Waxery in Philadelphia
experiences.description: Craft your own unique candles in a creative 90-minute session at Waxery in Philadelphia. Enjoy the freedom to choose from various scents and styles, ensuring your candle reflects your personal touch. With options like classic or elegant wooden wicks, you’ll leave with two custom-made 8oz candles. This hands-on experience is perfect for groups of friends or family looking for an enjoyable activity. Plus, the BYOB facility adds an extra layer of fun, making it a great spot to unwind and get crafty.

experiences.title: Bourbon Tasting in York
experiences.description:
With the help of our native host and sommelier you will discover the tastes of 5 different small batch bourbons accompanied by a small cheese board. Many bourbons today are difficult to obtain. We have 5 unique bourbons with each tasting.

While Woodford Reserve and Maker's Mark are available at our restaurant and bar, these are not the type of bourbons we will taste. We will utilize our lighted tasting table that give allows each participant to view the true colors of each tasting.

experiences.title: Philadelphia: Rug Tufting Workshop
experiences.description:
Craft your own custom rug in just one session and unleash your creativity! 
Our Rug Tufting Workshop is a fun, hands-on experience where you design and tuft a rug from scratch - no experience needed! Take home your masterpiece the same day, enjoy a cozy studio vibe, and make unforgettable memories in Philadelphia.
Perfect for solo travelers, couples, friends, and anyone looking for a unique DIY adventure!

experiences.title: Turkish Mosaic Art Workshop in Pittsburgh
experiences.description: Unleash your creativity at the Turkish Mosaic Art Workshop in Pittsburgh PA where you'll craft your very own mosaic lamp. Guided by experienced instructors, learn the intricate techniques of mosaic artistry while enjoying the rich heritage of Turkish culture. After selecting your design, you’ll piece together stunning glass and bead mosaics, creating a beautiful lamp that you can proudly display at home. Enjoy complimentary Turkish tea and delights as you relish the satisfaction of your artistic creation. This workshop welcomes participants aged 8 and up, making it a perfect outing for families or friends looking to explore something new together.

experiences.title: Flavors of Philly Food Tour
experiences.description: The Flavors of Philly Tour is great for out-of-towners! Terrific value--Philly history AND full lunch rolled into one great adventure. Features cheesesteaks, tomato pie, soft pretzels, and 2 desserts at the iconic Reading Terminal Market.

experiences.title: Private Shopping Tour from Philadelphia to Gloucester Outlets
experiences.description:
Comfortable Roundtrip Tour from your hotel in Philadelphia to Gloucester Premium Outlets - plays host to luxury boutiques and stores selling everything from clothes and accessories to cosmetics and home essentials. Its world-class boutiques showcasing collections from prestigious local and international designers make for a truly memorable shopping experience. Add to all these a unbeatable prices, and a handful of trendy cafés and restaurants, and what you’ll get is one of the best shopping destinations in and around the Philadelphia. After you finish your shopping you will be picked up and will be delivered directly to your hotel in Philadelphia.

All our vehicles are fully licensed and insured. We are happy to provide child seats in our cars for all ages upon request. Vehicles are clean inside and outside; our drivers are well-dressed and unfailingly attentive to our guests. They speak English. They will greet you with a name sign and will help with luggage.

experiences.title: Above & Beyond Candle Making Experience @ Waxery in Philadelphia
experiences.description: This experience stands out for its combination of creative freedom, elegant candle‑making materials, and a fun, customizable atmosphere. Guests can enhance their session with optional hookah and even karaoke, creating a lively studio environment ideal for celebrations or group outings. With all materials included and a BYOB setup supported by provided cups, ice, and napkins, travelers enjoy a premium, stress‑free crafting activity that blends creativity, leisure, and entertainment.

experiences.title: Candles & Karaoke CandleMaking Experience @Waxery in Philadelphia
experiences.description: This experience offers a rare and entertaining blend of music and creativity, giving guests the chance to sing their favorite songs while crafting a personalized candle. The combination of karaoke, custom candle making, and a BYOB setting creates a lively, memorable atmosphere suitable for friends, families, or celebrations. Optional hookah service adds another unique touch, making this activity stand out as both fun and customizable.

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Trendy Candle Shop in Philadelphia
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy candle shop in Philadelphia. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Crystal will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Fun Gnocchi Making Class With a Local Chef in Philadelphia
experiences.description: If comfort food had a master class, this would be it. Set in a welcoming local venue, you'll learn how to prepare Gnocchi alla Romana completely from scratch using simple ingredients that transform into something seriously satisfying. You'll cook semolina with milk and salt, then stir in butter, eggs and Parmesan to create a silky dough before spreading, cooling and cutting it into perfectly shaped rounds. Learn how to layer the gnocchi in the traditional scalloped style, top everything with melted butter and a generous shower of Parmesan, then bake until bubbling with crispy golden edges and a creamy, tender center. Every step builds practical kitchen skills you can easily recreate at home, whether you're brand new to cooking or already love spending time in the kitchen. You'll leave with a comforting Roman recipe, new techniques and a dish you'll want to make again and again.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Philadelphia
experiences.description: Roll up your sleeves — dinner is getting made from scratch. In a laid-back local venue, you’ll start by making fresh pasta dough, learning how to mix, knead and roll it until it’s ready to become delicate tagliatelle. You’ll cut and shape the pasta yourself, turning simple ingredients into ribbons ready for the pot. Then comes the good stuff: you’ll make a vibrant pesto di melanzane using eggplant, garlic, pine nuts and olive oil. You’ll cook the fresh tagliatelle, toss it through the silky eggplant pesto and finish it with Pecorino Romano for a salty, savory bite. You’ll learn hands-on pasta-making, shaping, cooking and sauce techniques without needing prior experience. Finish by enjoying your freshly prepared dish and the easygoing atmosphere around you — flour on your hands is basically part of the uniform.

experiences.title: Mosaic Workshops in King of Prussia Area PA
experiences.description:
Unleash your creativity at the Turkish Mosaic Art Workshop in King of Prussia Area, PA where you'll craft your very own mosaic lamp.

Guided by experienced instructors, learn the intricate techniques of mosaic artistry while enjoying the rich heritage of Turkish culture.

After selecting your design, you’ll piece together stunning glass and bead mosaics, creating a beautiful lamp that you can proudly display at home.

Enjoy complimentary Turkish tea and delights as you relish the satisfaction of your artistic creation. This workshop welcomes participants aged 8 and up, making it a perfect outing for families or friends looking to explore something new together.

experiences.title: Philadelphia: Turkish Coffee on Sand Workshop
experiences.description:
A Taste of Tradition, Brewed on Sand 
Step into the world of Turkish hospitality and rich coffee culture! This hands-on workshop brings you more than just a cup of coffee - it offers a journey through centuries of tradition. From the mesmerizing sand brewing technique to the aroma of finely ground beans, you’ll learn how every detail creates the bold, velvety flavor Turkish coffee is known for.
What makes this experience truly unique?
 Sand brewing adds a distinct depth and smoothness
 Cultural rituals make each sip feel meaningful
 Delightful pairings like Turkish delight elevate the moment
It’s not just about coffee - it’s about connection, story, and savoring every step.

experiences.title: Private Shopping Tour from Philadelphia hotels to Tanger Outlets
experiences.description:
Comfortable Roundtrip Tour from your hotel in Philadelphia to Tanger Outlets Lancaster - plays host to luxury boutiques and stores selling everything from clothes and accessories to cosmetics and home essentials. Its world-class boutiques showcasing collections from prestigious local and international designers make for a truly memorable shopping experience. Add to all these a unbeatable prices, and a handful of trendy cafés and restaurants, and what you’ll get is one of the best shopping destinations in and around the Philadelphia. After you finish your shopping you will be picked up and will be delivered directly to your hotel in Philadelphia.

experiences.title: Prohibition Cocktails and Mocktails Experience in Philadelphia
experiences.description: Step into a modern & fun speakeasy, where the allure of a secret eclectic colorful bar comes alive. Using a secret password for entry, indulge in four expertly crafted cocktails and mocktails featuring premium spirits. Enjoy a fizzy Blueberry Wisconsin Old Fashioned, a refreshing Guava Mojito, a classic Lavender Bees Knees, and a mocktail that serves as a bookend to Prohibition—all while snacking on complimentary treats. Led by an experienced mixologist, making it a perfect outing for both cocktail enthusiasts and casual sippers alike.

experiences.title: Relic Hunter Indoor Shooting Experience in Coplay, PA
experiences.description: A visit to the site means stepping into Lehigh Valley's largest indoor shooting range. With 12 modern lanes and a welcoming atmosphere, this facility caters to shooters of all skill levels, from beginners to experts. Enjoy the convenience of on-site gun rentals, including pistols, shotguns, and rifles, while practicing under the supervision of certified instructors. Join friends or colleagues for a group package to make it a memorable outing, complete with private bay rentals for a personalized experience.

experiences.title: Wooden Dough Bowl Candle Making Experience
experiences.description:
PLEASE ALWAYS CONTACT THE US BEFORE BOOKING, FOR UP TO DATE AVAILABILITY

Unleash your creativity by transforming a handcrafted wooden dough bowl into a stunning candle. This engaging activity invites you to customize your bowl with premium soy wax and high-quality fragrance oils, all while selecting botanical toppings for that personal touch. With step-by-step instructions, you'll craft a beautiful centerpiece that not only brightens your home but also fills it with delightful scents. Perfect for a cozy day in or a fun gathering with friends.

INCLUDES:
Wooden Hand Carved Dough Bowl
100% Soy Wax
Botanical toppings
Step by Step Instructions
High Quality Fragrance Oils

experiences.title: South Philly Supper Club
experiences.description:
Enjoy a night out centered around great food at 
Chef Jacquie’s favorite spaces with a small group, featuring chef insights, insider stories, on a fun foodie journey.

Along the way, you will make new friends, eat great food and dive into lively conversations centered around the 5 BIG F’s — food, folklore, film, friends, and family — the heart and soul of South Philly life.

Welcome: Start at Alice with a glass of wine and a delectable bite — the perfect way to kick off the evening.

Sips & Bites: Next, stop into Di Bruno Bros. Bottle Shop for sips, charcuterie and pick up a bottle of wine for dinner.

Dinner & Dessert: Stroll over to Angelina's Restaurant for handmade pastas just like nonna used to make, appetizer, and warm crusty bread. Finish with a classic cannoli from Isgro Pastries and a sweet treat — all part of our friendly supper club–style experience built around great food and shared moments at the table.

experiences.title: Pittsburgh Sweet Treats Food Tour: Donuts, Pastries, & More
experiences.description:
Explore Pittsburgh's rich history while tasting a delightful selection of sweet treats including almond torte donuts, French pastries, and Turkish baklava. The adventure kicks off at the historic Omni William Penn Hotel, where you’ll learn about its legacy before strolling through downtown's landmarks. Along the way, enjoy freshly brewed coffee at a century-old coffee shop and discover the city's transformation from a frontier town to an industrial hub. This tour promises a unique blend of culture, architecture, and delicious flavors, making it perfect for food lovers and history enthusiasts alike.

- Sample a variety of local and international sweet treats
- Visit iconic sites like the Omni William Penn Hotel and Market Square
- Enjoy fresh coffee from a historic family-owned cafe
- Discover Pittsburgh's fascinating history with an expert guide

experiences.title: Hershey Trolley Food Tour Experience
experiences.description:
Experience the flavors of Hershey like never before on our Mid-Day Magic Food Tour — a curated dining experience that showcases the finest in local cuisine and hospitality. Perfect for food lovers seeking an elevated yet approachable afternoon outing, this tour highlights the best of Hershey’s culinary scene, from expertly crafted small plates to indulgent desserts.

1. Board our comfortable Yokl trolley and settle in for a ride through the heart of Hershey and its surrounding neighborhoods. Our expert guide will share insights into the region’s rich history and culinary traditions.

2. Gain exclusive behind-the-scenes access as chefs and restaurant owners share the inspiration behind their dishes. Discover the stories that make each stop unique and learn how local ingredients and culinary creativity come together to create unforgettable flavors. 

3. Your tour will conclude with a decadent dessert tasting — the perfect way to end a magical afternoon.

experiences.title: Shopping and Food Walking Tour in Philadelphia with Guide
experiences.description:
Our tour is one-of-a-kind in Philly as it combines vintage shopping with sweets and sips. You will also get a very good feel for the historic district of Old City that will allow you come back and dive deeper into the famous landmarks. 

We will be starting with a treat at the oldest confectionery store in the country, to be followed by stops at some of our favorite vintage boutiques scattered amongst the charming, historic streets. Each one has a unique, secondhand vibe, so there's sure to be something for everyone. In between some of the shopping we will stop for some delicious pastries as well. Next, we will head towards Center City with a stop in Chinatown on the way. 

You will get an introduction to Reading Terminal Market, which is one of Philly’s top three tourist attractions. The market can be overwhelming, but we will take you to some favorite vendors and will make you feel truly at home. Sweet bites, a sweet+savory taste, a spirit tasting and a cocktail sip are included.

experiences.title: Philly Breakfast Food Tour
experiences.description:
Taste the heart of Philadelphia with a family-friendly breakfast food tour within steps of many Center City hotels. In only 75 minutes, you'll get a mix of iconic Philly breakfast items with some trendy flavors while soaking in the vibrant atmosphere of one of the city’s top culinary destinations. 

Perfect for families with kids of all ages, cruise passengers, and travelers checking out of hotels, this eating adventure has constant motion strolling through the Reading Terminal Market's colorful aisles. All while indulging in a coffee smoothie, a savory breakfast roll-up, a retro dish with Millennial taste, a sweet dessert from a beloved bakery, and more!

- 75-min guided breakfast tasting experience all within the Reading Terminal Market
- Sample five delicious breakfast items, including local specialties
- Easy walking level completely indoors - great for strollers and wheelchairs
- Ideal for families with kids, food lovers, cruise passengers, and first-time visitors

experiences.title: South Philly Tour Italian Market and Cheesesteaks
experiences.description: Join us for a walking tour through the heart and soul of Philadelphia—South Philly! From Rocky Balboa to cheesesteaks, many of Philly’s most iconic symbols come from this vibrant neighborhood. On this 2-hour tour, we’ll explore the streets of South Philadelphia and dive into the stories behind its rich culture. You’ll visit locations tied to the Rocky movies, including Giordano’s and Victor’s Café, and learn about the origins of the city’s famous cheesesteak. Later, we’ll stroll through the historic Italian Market on 9th Street—America’s oldest outdoor market—where you’ll have free time to shop, grab a bite, or explore. Your guide will be on hand to answer questions and share local secrets. Along the way, you’ll also see some of Philadelphia’s most famous murals. South Philly’s vibrant public art is part of what makes this area so unique, and you’ll have plenty of chances to admire and learn about these colorful works.

experiences.title: Lancaster History and Craft Beer Walk
experiences.description:
Experience historic Lancaster City one story—and one sip—at a time!

We’ll begin in the heart of downtown Lancaster’s historic Penn Square before setting out to explore more than 300 years of local history, all packed within a few walkable blocks.

As we make our way through charming streets and hidden alleys, you’ll discover the people, places, and stories that helped shape Lancaster and the nation. Along the way, we’ll explore landmarks connected to the nation’s oldest continuously operating farmers market, historic theaters and churches, the birthplace of the famous Conestoga Wagon, homes of notable Lancaster residents, and much more.

Your guide will bring Lancaster’s past to life through fascinating stories, colorful characters, architecture, art, and local history. You’ll discover how this relatively small city played an important role in America’s early development—and how its history continues to influence the Lancaster we know today.

experiences.title: Philadelphia Old City History Pub Crawl Small-Group Tour
experiences.description:
This isn’t your 8th-grade field trip! On the Liberty Pub Crawl, you’ll visit iconic Philadelphia bars and taverns in Old City with an expert local guide. Uncover the unknown and hilarious history your teacher left out, from a Founding Mother to a devious Ben Franklin and the spies who helped win the American Revolution. Laugh with fellow travelers from around the globe while the adults finally get their turn to learn history!

The tour lasts 2 hours and 15 minutes and begins at the corner of Market Street and North 2nd Street in Old City. Tickets must be purchased in advance. Drinks are not included in the ticket price and are available for purchase separately at each bar, so you can choose exactly what you would like to enjoy. Buying a drink is never required. Walking is limited to just a few blocks, allowing guests with a wide range of physical capabilities to enjoy the crawl.

Come laugh, learn, and raise a glass to Philadelphia’s rebellious past. Cheers!

experiences.title: Behind The Scenes Food Tour: South Philly & Italian Market
experiences.description:
Tiny Table Tours was founded by a well-known local food journalist, and those relationships are at the core of our tours. We share stories gathered from one-on-one interviews with business owners and chefs that will give you a behind-the-scenes, personal view of South Philadelphia. Our tour guides are deeply immersed in Philly food and dining scene, giving you a deeply personal experience. 

The tour includes six bites of food, including sweet treats, a Vietnamese sandwich, tacos and more. We'll talk about (but not eat) cheesesteaks, and introduce you multigenerational family businesses.

We’ll also share our cheat sheet: a list of recommendations for bars, restaurants, and other fun activities in the city.

All in all, we’ll walk about 1 mile over the course of 2.5 hours, so please come prepared.

We can easily accommodate vegetarians and pescatarians with advance notice. PLEASE let us know if you/anyone in your party has any dietary restrictions we should be aware of.

experiences.title: Philadelphia's Italian Market Food Tour
experiences.description:
Come and explore one of Philly's most vibrant, diverse and delicious neighborhoods during our Italian Market Food Tour. This tasty stretch of 9th Street has been home to a curbside market since the 1800's, and has served as a backbone of this community for generations. Listen as your expert local guide tells some amazing stories of the market's past while you delight in 5 delectable bites that show-off the local flavor. 

This tour highlights Philly's wonderful diversity, and the amazing food scene that it has created. You will try Italian classics like the tomato pie and cannoli, Mexican delicacies like spicy chicken tacos and freshly-pressed tortillas, and Vietnamese bites like the banh mi sandwich. 

Take a nice relaxing stroll with your guide as your senses are immersed in the sights and sounds of this iconic Philly market. In addition to the amazing food, you'll also enjoy some dazzling pieces of public art that can be found down many backstreets and alleys in the area.

experiences.title: Philly Chef-Led Italian Market Food Tour
experiences.description:
Looking for the ultimate mix of food, flavor, history, and local treasures? neighborhood experts as you explore the strEATS of Philadelphia’s iconic Italian Markethome to some of the city’s most legendary vendors. Let a true South Philly native lead the way through this unforgettable culinary and cultural experience.

Savor an Italian roast pork sandwich at Paesano’s from the chef who beat Bobby Flay, sit down in the city’s most buzzed-about Mexican spots for a South Philly Barbacoa Taco, or signature square pizza. Taste artisanal cheeses and pairings at Di Bruno Bros. and the perfect cannoli from Isgro Bakery. Wander past produce stands that have fed families for generations, specialty shops brimming with imported goods. We eat our way through the market and shop to stock your pantry, and meet the makers who keep this market alive. Voted Best of Philly Day Trip Experience, this is Philly’s most iconic market served with its greats - full of heart, history, and unforgettable flavor.

experiences.title: Philadelphia Africatown Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
Explore the vibrant culinary landscape of Philadelphia’s Africatown community on a guided walking tour. Sample four delectable bites, featuring flavors from West African, Jamaican, Southern American, and Italian cuisines. Meet local chefs and shop owners, gaining insight into their stories and the rich history of Southwest Philly. This two-hour tour not only satisfies your taste buds but also supports local businesses and promotes cultural understanding in this diverse neighborhood.

- Enjoy four unique tastings that represent Africatown's diverse culinary influences.
- Meet local chefs and learn about their contributions to the community.
- Visit independent shops that reflect the spirit of this thriving area.
- Limited to 12 guests for an intimate experience with a knowledgeable guide.

experiences.title: Bike the Burgh Tour
experiences.description:
On this tour you will get a great overview of the city while learning about the rise, fall and most recent comeback of Pittsburgh. You will be introduced to outstanding architecture, interesting historic facts and fantastic views of the city. We will leave the beaten paths with you to also discover some surprising hidden gems. Old and new buildings, city squares and public art will turn this bike ride into a memorable event full of exciting (re)discoveries of The Burgh.

We are pleased to also offer this tour in Spanish. Please contact us at least 2 weeks in advance to ensure that the Spanish tour is available.

experiences.title: Philadelphia's Sweetest Food Tour: Donuts, Sweet Treats & More
experiences.description:
Your journey begins near Reading Terminal Market, one of Philadelphia’s most iconic food destinations. Inside the historic market, we’ll start with fresh, handcrafted donuts featuring classic and creative flavors. Next, we’ll enjoy warm, freshly made soft pretzels, a savory taste of Pennsylvania’s deep Pennsylvania Dutch and Amish food traditions.

From there, we’ll leave the market and explore the heart of Philadelphia while your guide shares stories about the city’s history, landmarks, neighborhoods, and diverse culinary influences. Our next stop features colorful mochi donuts, known for their uniquely chewy texture and creative flavors. Finally, we’ll finish with another round of handcrafted donuts and seasonal specialties, providing a delicious ending to our exploration of Philadelphia’s food, history, and culture.

experiences.title: Highlights of East Passyunk Food Tour
experiences.description:
This fascinating walking tour explores the incredibly popular neighborhood in South Philly that's booming with cutting-edge shops and ambitious restaurants that would rather set trends than follow them. The Highlights of East Passyunk tour is the best place to get the most up-to-date scoop on all of the openings and closings in this foodie mecca that Food and Wine Magazine named one of the 10 best foodie streets in America. 

This two-hour afternoon tour demystifies the places that have put East Passyunk on the map and have catapulted this quaint street from its humble beginnings into the epicenter of the city's culinary scene. We'll start at one end of the Avenue and make our way past many of the local highlights, share stories of the restaurateurs, their restaurants and bars. Along the way, we'll check out iconic landmarks and murals.

experiences.title: Unique Amish Immersion in Lancaster
experiences.description:
Designed for travelers seeking genuine connection and authentic experiences, this tour offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of the Amish community through the relationships we've built over many years. Our trusted partnerships with local Amish families and businesses allow us to share experiences with them.

Your journey begins with a scenic drive through Lancaster County's beautiful farmland as one of our knowledgeable local guides brings the region's history to life. Learn how the Amish and Mennonites first settled in Pennsylvania, why they came, and how their faith continues to shape their way of life today. Along the way, you'll gain insight into Amish traditions, education, family life, farming, religion, and the values that have sustained their community for generations.

experiences.title: Philadelphia Historic Centre Food Tour with 5 Authentic Tastings
experiences.description: Taste Philadelphia like a true insider on our Secret Food Tour through the city’s historic district. With 5+ handpicked tastings, you’ll experience the dishes that define Philly and the flavors most visitors never find. Bite into a hot, sugary donut fresh from the fryer, then sink your teeth into our signature pretzel cheesesteak—a bold twist on the city’s most iconic bite. Savor hearty Irish pierogis, then travel the world with flaky Malaysian roti canai, showcasing the city’s diverse food scene. Along the way, your local guide will share hidden stories and foodie secrets that bring Philly’s culture to life. To finish, you’ll indulge in our delicious Secret Dish—revealed only on the tour. Come hungry, leave with bragging rights, and discover why Philly is one of America’s must-visit food cities.

experiences.title: Center City Philadelphia Food Tour with Reading Market
experiences.description:
Come and taste why Philadelphia has become one of America's top foodie destinations on this delicious tour of Center City! Join your local expert guide as they escort you around this bustling neighborhood to try 5 bites that demonstrates Philly's culinary prowess. A portion of this tour will take place inside the amazing Reading Terminal Market, a wall to wall collection of vendors who offer foods from around the world.

This tour will feature true local classics like the world-famous cheesesteak, the soft pretzel or the tomato pie, along with trendy and innovative bites like tahini-based shakes or gluten free cheese curds. We also highlight foods the reflect Philly's wonderful diversity. You may enjoy some Japanese inari or Georgian soup dumplings or Caribbean chicken patties. 

And if you have a sweet tooth, look no further! Your guide will know the best Amish whoopie pie or Italian cannoli, or perhaps will plan a stop at one of the best doughnut shops in town. 

Bring your appetite!

experiences.title: Sweet & Savory Tour of Lancaster City!
