experiences.description:
Discover the flavors of Lancaster on a delicious walking tour through the heart of downtown!

We’ll take you off the beaten path to visit some of Lancaster’s unique locally owned food destinations. Along the way, you’ll have the opportunity to meet local owners and makers, hear the stories behind their businesses, ask questions, and experience the passion that goes into their creations.

At each stop, you’ll enjoy generous samples while discovering some of the hidden gems that make Lancaster’s food scene so special. From local favorites to unexpected finds, this experience is a fun and flavorful way to explore the city beyond the typical tourist stops.

And the experience doesn’t end when the tour does—take-home goodies are included with your tour!

Come hungry, explore local, and experience Lancaster one delicious stop at a time!

experiences.title: Downtown Pittsburgh Hidden Gems Food Tour with 5 Food Tastings
experiences.description:
Your Steel City adventure starts where the city itself began: Point State Park, at the tip of the Golden Triangle, where the Monongahela and Allegheny Rivers meet to form the Ohio. From there we wander into Downtown Pittsburgh, past glass skyscrapers rising beside century-old facades, into the Cultural District, once industrial and now alive with theaters and galleries, hearing the story behind the Three Sisters bridges along the way.
Hunger sets in fast. We start with the city's most famous sandwich, piled high with all the fixings, and pierogies, the local favorite. Later, a Greek sampler from a Mediterranean spot with over 45 years of history, once known for feeding pier workers and the Kennedy family. We close with a thumbprint cookie, a classic Pittsburgh treat and a true must have for locals, and our Secret Dish, revealed only when it lands on your plate.

experiences.title: Authentic Tour & Meal with the Amish!
experiences.description:
Go beyond the typical tourist experience and discover the heart of Lancaster County through an authentic visit with a local Amish family.
Your experience begins aboard one of our comfortable vans as you travel through Lancaster County's breathtaking countryside.

The highlight of your experience is a visit to an Amish family's home, where you'll be warmly welcomed and treated to a traditional, home-cooked meal prepared by your Amish hosts. This isn't a restaurant or staged attraction—it's a genuine opportunity to gather around the family table, enjoy delicious homemade food, and engage in meaningful conversation.

-Service Animals: Due to the nature of this experience taking place in a private Amish home and on a working farm, accommodations for service animals may vary. 
-Out of respect for our Amish hosts, your guide will explain any photography guidelines before arriving at the home.

experiences.title: Reading Terminal Market OFFICIAL Tour
experiences.description:
The Reading Terminal Market is a must-see for anyone in Philadelphia. Designed for locals, visitors, students, and fans of the Market, join us as we explore the Market's rich history, witness the skilled cooking styles passed down from generations, and take in the diverse and mouth-watering scents from the 80+ merchants.

Starting off with a famous Philly snack, this 45-minute tour will tantalize your taste buds and provide insight into the Market's vibrant history. Our expert guide will lead you through the Market's bustling aisles, pointing out must-see spots and sharing stories of the Market's past.

Come enjoy a fun and informative tour of the market, with an option to take home a scrumptious treat too. Advanced booking is required; walk-ons not guaranteed a spot. 

Our Tour Guides accept tips, and they are greatly appreciated. Tipping is left up to the individual, but as a general practice, 20% is the common gratuity for service workers.

experiences.title: Wigle Whiskey Rebellion Distillery Tour
experiences.description:
Pittsburgh was the birthplace of American Whiskey! 

Landmark Distillery, Wigle Whiskey, re-ignited Pittsburgh's whiskey tradition. A twice nominated James Beard Semi-Finalist and 7 years as the most awarded craft whiskey distillery in the country by the American Craft Spirits Association, visiting Wigle is a Must-Do in Pittsburgh.

Join the Distillery team Saturdays for a tour and tasting. They'll walk you through how they start with local grain to produce their award winning Rye and Bourbon Whiskey, Gin, Rum and other spirits. Throughout the tour they'll regale you with the true tale of the Pittsburgh’s Whiskey Rebellion, one of the country’s quirkiest and most pivotal events. The tour includes an explanation of our distillation process, a history of the Whiskey Rebellion told through the eyes of their namesake Philip Wigle, and a seated tasting of straight spirits.

The total length of the tour is 1 hour and is limited in size to ensure a fun experience for everyone.

experiences.title: Secret Bars and Favorite Spots Walking Tour in Philadelphia
experiences.description: Looking for a fun night out exploring Philly's best kept secrets? Join our 'Secret Bars and Favorite Spots' tour! We'll visit 4-5 unique bars, including a hidden speakeasy or secret bar—places even many locals don't know about. This is a bar-hopping experience focused on enjoying the present-day atmosphere and discovering local favorites. Please note: This is not a historical tour. While we'll be in an area with rich history, our focus is on the bar scene and creating a fun social experience. We look forward to having a great time with you, and please drink responsibly.

experiences.title: International Food Tour Lancaster, PA
experiences.description:
In just two hours, you’ll indulge in generous portions of mouthwatering dishes from diverse cuisines, all while uncovering the rich history of Lancaster. Perfect for food lovers, families, or corporate outings in Lancaster City.

Unique Lancaster Experiences is your host. They will guide you to downtown's most authentic global flavors. Learn about how the oldest Inland City in America became a Certified Welcome City.

Get tickets for a fun foodie experience that accommodates all diets, including gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian. Book now or buy a gift card for future use. We are a year-round tour operator in Lancaster City. Come learn what makes Lancaster famous!

experiences.title: Philadelphia Italian Market Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Discover the flavors, stories, and traditions of one of Philadelphia’s most vibrant immigrant neighborhoods on this delicious walking tour of the Italian Market. For more than 150 years, this lively open-air market has been the heart of the city’s Italian community—and today it remains one of the most exciting food destinations in Philadelphia.

As you stroll through bustling market stalls and family-run shops, you’ll experience the neighborhood through its food. Enjoy the aroma of freshly baked Italian bread, sample rich gourmet vinegars, and taste some of the finest cheeses and specialty products the market has to offer.

Along the way, your guide will share the stories of the immigrant families who built the market and shaped the neighborhood’s unique character.

Whether you’re a food lover, history enthusiast, or curious traveler, this flavorful tour offers a true taste of Philadelphia.

experiences.title: Rise and Dine Food Tour in Vintage Style Trolley
experiences.description:
You'll visit a handpicked selection of Hershey’s best brunch spots — from cozy cafés to beloved local restaurants — where you’ll sample signature dishes and creative brunch cocktails. These are the flavors that locals love, and you’ll get to taste them all in one morning!

Ride in Style on a Vintage Trolley
Our charming, climate-controlled trolley adds a touch of vintage elegance to your experience. Sit back and relax as you cruise through Hershey’s historic streets, hearing fun stories and insider tips from your knowledgeable guide.

‍Meet the People Behind the Plates
Connect with the chefs and business owners who make Hershey’s food scene special. Hear their stories, learn about their culinary inspirations, and discover why Hershey is more than just chocolate.

A Social and Delicious Experience
Whether you’re traveling with friends, family, or flying solo, this tour is the perfect mix of delicious food and good company. You'll leave with a full belly and new friends!

experiences.title: Providence Food and History Walking Tour New England Classics
experiences.description:
Explore the culinary delights and unique history of Providence via our Mostly Accurate New England Classics walking tour. This guided experience takes you through the vibrant streets of Fox Point, where you'll savor iconic dishes such as a warm buttered lobster roll, a legendary New England-inspired sandwich, award-winning pizza, chef-made soft serve, and a classic Rhode Island stuffed quahog. 
Perfect for locals and visitors alike, this tour combines food with fascinating tales for a memorable outing.

- Duration: 3 to 3.5 hours, covering approximately 1.5 miles
- Enjoy a variety of local dishes, with all food and a 20% restaurant tip included in the ticket price
- Ideal for anyone seeking an immersive culinary and historical experience
- Dietary replacements available upon request, including vegetarian and gluten-free

More info: https://www.mostlyaccuratetours.com/faqs

experiences.title: Providence Food and History Walking Tour International Flavors
experiences.description:
Discover the culinary treasures of Providence’s Fox Point neighborhood on a delightful food and history tour. This engaging experience takes you through vibrant streets where you'll savor up to seven global delicacies—from a Palestinian pistachio croissant to authentic Japanese sushi and spicy regional Chinese dishes. Led by an expert guide, learn about the rich immigrant history that shapes this unique neighborhood while enjoying delicious bites that reflect its diversity. Perfect for food enthusiasts and history buffs alike, this tour promises an enriching experience for locals and visitors. 

- Duration: 3 to 3.5 hours, covering approximately 1.3 miles 
- Sample dishes from hidden gems and immigrant-owned eateries 
- Includes all food and tips for each restaurant 
- Vegetarian and gluten-free options available on request
- Does not include gratuity for your Tour Guide

experiences.title: Clues and Brews: Murder Mystery Beer Tour
experiences.description:
This isn’t just a brewery crawl. It’s a murder mystery van adventure through Providence where you and your fellow detectives will solve one of Rhode Island’s most fascinating historical crime while visiting some of the city’s best breweries. Enjoy a craft beer flight at three brewery stops and a delicious pretzel along the way. Throughout the tour, you’ll uncover clues, solve puzzles, and follow the twists of a real 19th-century murder case that once dominated national headlines. Can you solve the mystery before the final round? 

Please note: A minimum of four guests is required for all tours to run. If less than four are booked, we’ll contact you the morning of to offer a full refund or rescheduling options

experiences.title: Providence Comedy Bus City Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy everything Providence has to offer aboard the Comedy Bus:

- Our 90-minute R-Rated comedy city tour is delivered by the best comics around! This tour features a short stop at a local restaurant or brewery.

 - Our 3 hour, R-Rated comedy brunch tour is delivered by the best comics around. This tour feature 2 stops at local restaurants for brunch, and each ticket comes with 2 free drinks and 2 food items. 

Bring your own beer and wine, and purchase some along the route!

experiences.title: Federal Hill Dinner Stroll
experiences.description:
Savor the flavors of Providence’s Little Italy on the Federal Hill Dinner Stroll, an intimate guided tour that takes you through the heart of one of New England's finest culinary neighborhoods. Enjoy a multi-course Italian dinner featuring antipasto, house-made pasta entrées, and delectable desserts, all while walking between the city’s iconic restaurants. With all food included, your only task is to relax and choose your favorite drinks at each stop. This 2.5 to 3-hour experience is perfect for food lovers and requires a minimum of four guests to run.

- Explore renowned dining spots like Cassarino’s and Trattoria Appia.
- Indulge in a 3-course meal paired with optional wine or cocktails.
- Enjoy a guided stroll led by a knowledgeable host celebrating local traditions.
- Convenient valet parking available at the meeting point for ease and comfort.

A min of four guests is required for all tours to run. If less than four are booked, we’ll contact you the morning with refund options.

experiences.title: Downcity Providence Food Tour
experiences.description: Join this 3-hour small-group food tour to savor 6+ food tastings in one of America's top food cities with a professional guide. Sip on alcoholic beverages (if option selected) at select locations. Explore this historic capital city's architecture while listening to fascinating stories about the history and view the art and culture as you walk through the Downcity Arts District. Tour is limited to a maximum of 14 people to ensure personalized service and includes a guide offering recommendations for you to further explore on your own.

experiences.title: Newport Neighborhood Food Tour
experiences.description:
Discover Newport’s culinary side and let your local guide lead you on this three-hour walking tour through historic neighborhood streets. Explore the evolving diverse culinary landscape of Rhode Island while gaining insight into the history, architecture and cultural components of Newport, Rhode Island. Your tastings will take you to at least 5-6 diverse local restaurants off-the-beaten-path where the locals go, away from the more touristy areas of the city.

A one-of-a-kind guided food tour for Rhode Island natives and visitors alike.

experiences.title: Crime and Cuisine on Federal Hill
experiences.description:
A food tour with a felonious twist!

The Federal Hill neighborhood of Providence is one of its hottest destinations, home to some of the best Italian food in the world. This tour will give you a smorgasbord of its best bites and drinks, from fine wines to family recipes passed down through generations. Come hungry! 

Every guest will also get a memento from their time on the Hill to take home with them. Spoiler alert: it's delicious! 

The Hill was also home to some historic characters who dabbled on the wrong side of the law. Follow the intrigue of State v. Patriarca, when a future mayor took on a mob boss; learn about the corruption which brought Rhode Island's banking system to its knees in the '90s, and about a raid on an illegal dice game that sent a Providence Police Officer through a second-story window.

Guests under 21 will not be served alcohol on this tour. 

A min of four guests is required for all tours to run. If less than four are booked, we’ll contact you the morning.

experiences.title: Newport Walking Food And History Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy delightful food from five restaurants while strolling the historic streets of Newport, Rhode Island! Our tour begins in front of the Wave sculpture on the corner of America's Cup Ave. and Memorial Blvd..  We will talk about Newport's infamous pirates, Revolutionary War armies, the Gilded Age of mansions and industrialists, the Irish American heritage up to and including the condominium boom. Our tour will last 2.5 hours and will cover approximately 1.75 miles.  Bring your appetites, you will not be disappointed!

experiences.title: Providence Twilight River Cruises
experiences.description:
Join us on a Twilight Cruises and toast to an unforgettable night on the river! Bathed in the warm glow of twilight, Providence’s historic architecture, bridges, and cobblestone paths take on an entirely new life as the sun slips below the horizon. Step aboard and unwind with complimentary wine and Prosecco from Rhode Island’s own Gooseneck Vineyards, as you soak in unparalleled views of our capital city. Whether you’re planning a romantic date night, a relaxed corporate outing, a fun girls’ night out, or a memorable after‑dinner adventure, this experience is designed to create unforgettable summer moments with family, friends, co‑workers, and your significant other. Let the river carry you into the heart of twilight — reserve your seats today and savor the magic of the evening! 

Additional Info:
- This is an evening cruise ONLY. There is NO NARRATION offered during this boat ride.
- This tour is ages 16+
- Not a wine drinker? Other beverages are available for purchase at The Landing.

experiences.title: The Nightcap: Cocktail & Spirits Tour
experiences.description:
SIP YOUR WAY THROUGH PROVIDENCE’S BEST-KEPT SECRETS.

The Nightcap: Cocktail & Spirits Tour is a thoughtfully crafted evening that takes you to three of Providence’s hidden cocktail destinations. Each stop has been carefully selected for its distinctive atmosphere, exceptional drinks, and talented bartenders, giving you an insider’s look at a side of the city’s nightlife many visitors never discover.

Relax as we travel by van between venues while enjoying expertly crafted cocktails and locally inspired spirits at each stop. From intimate neighborhood hideaways to inventive cocktail bars, The Nightcap is the perfect way to experience Providence one unforgettable sip at a time.

experiences.title: Customized Private Tour Adventure in Rhogue Island
experiences.description:
Discover Rhode Island your way with Customizable Rhogue Island Tours, a private, fully tailored touring experience designed around your interests, pace, and travel style. From iconic coastal towns and historic landmarks to hidden local gems, these personalized tours offer an insider’s perspective of the Ocean State.

Led by knowledgeable local guides, each tour is thoughtfully crafted to match your preferences—whether you’re interested in history, food, scenic views, culture, or off‑the‑beaten‑path experiences. With flexible itineraries and private transportation, this is an ideal option for couples, families, small groups, and travelers seeking a more personal connection to Rhode Island.

experiences.title: Private Morning Cruise Aboard Camelot in Newport
experiences.description: An exclusive cruise aboard the beautifully appointed vessel Camelot along the enchanting Newport coastline. Watch sailboats race by, seagulls soar overhead and the sun glisten across the water while you sit back and enjoy the ride. Experience why the New York City elite made Newport, Rhode Island their summer get away during the Gilded Age in a classic picnic boat that reminds you of something from the 1920's. You are welcome to bring food or beverages on your cruise.

experiences.title: Sip History In a Secret Speakeasy Cocktail Class
experiences.description: 2-hour, interactive cocktail class that combines history, jokes, techniques, recommendations, and drinking.

experiences.title: Backyard Shrimp Boil on Shem Creek
experiences.description:
Learn the art of the classic Lowcountry boil with Captain Bryan right on the picturesque banks of Shem Creek. This private cooking class offers an authentic taste of Charleston culture as you dive into the shrimping industry’s history. Guests will meet at a specially designed food trailer with wrap around bar seating on the banks of the creek. Start by creating a fresh shrimp ceviche with local ingredients, then engage in a fun shrimp peeling competition. Under Captain Bryan’s guidance, you’ll learn how to prepare a mouthwatering Lowcountry Boil featuring local shrimp, sausage, corn, and potatoes, seasoned to perfection. Enjoy your culinary creations in a relaxed setting, making this an unforgettable local experience.

Guests with shellfish allergies will not be able to join. Guests with dietary restrictions please note we cannot make substitutions. Solo travelers please kindly call to join the next available outing as we have capacity requirements.

experiences.title: Create Your Very Own Custom Perfume or Cologne in Charleston - Fragrance 101
experiences.description: Tijon is a unique make-your-own fragrance experience not found elsewhere. Original location is on the French side of the island of St. Maarten and Charleston is the first US location.

experiences.title: DIY Trucker Hat Experience in Charleston
experiences.description: We are an interactive trucker hat making experience with a nostalgic camp themed cafeteria twist. You won't find mashed potatoes on our menu. Book a private in-store experience for just you and all your friends! You will enjoy the entire storefront to yourself, a personal hat barista to guide you through your hat making experience, access to play your own music, and champagne for each guest!

experiences.title: Private Surf Lessons in North Myrtle Beach
experiences.description:
One on one, group lessons, and coaching.
Lifelong native, local surfer.
With a Personalized touch. We make sure every student gets personal instruction and guarantee you to be riding waves!

experiences.title: Custom Resin Art Tumbler Making Workshops
experiences.description: Create Your Own Lowcountry Masterpiece. Step off the beach and into the studio, Hilton Head’s favorite destination for hands-on art. Whether you're an expert or haven't touched a brush in years, this studio specializes in "success-based" art—techniques that look professional no matter your skill level. Resin projects typically require 24 hours to "cure" before they can be transported, so be sure to book your session early in your trip! Paint Projects may need to be shipped-ask your instructor for further information.

experiences.title: Sand Castle Building Lesson in North Myrtle Beach
experiences.description: Crafting sandcastles isn’t just child’s play anymore. In North Myrtle Beach, unleash your creativity with expert-led sandcastle lessons, featuring tools that wowed the Sharks on Shark Tank. Under the sun, you’ll learn the art of building gravity-defying sculptures using patented professional kits. Choose between two prime beach locations in North Myrtle Beach or Myrtle Beach and enjoy stunning ocean views while you sculpt. Your instructors guide you through the techniques, and in case of rain, the fun shifts indoors with mess-free kits. This engaging activity welcomes all ages, making it a perfect outing for families or groups looking to create memorable beach experiences together.

experiences.title: Surf Lessons on Folly Beach
experiences.description: Surfing is unlike anything else. Only those who have experienced it can truly understand. It’s exciting, surreal, and calming all at the same time. With a locals professional instruction you get a short cut to successfully surfing. Within minutes you go from a complete beginner to showing skills only an advanced surfer could perform. What makes us different is that our goal is not just to take you surfing, but to truly teach you how to surf! Come walk on water with us!

experiences.title: Undiscovered Charleston: Half Day Food, Wine & History Tour with Cooking Class
experiences.description:
Charleston's only chef led historic walking tour, cooking demonstration and lunch! Our experience begins with a 90 minute food history walking tour in the historic district, followed by a cooking demonstration, lunch & paired wine tasting at the popular local's spot Bistro a Vin. It's led by Charleston's only South Carolina Chef Ambassador & Palmetto Guild Certified tour guide, Forrest Parker. Leading the teams at some of Charleston's most iconic restaurants, Parker has been called a "visionary who calls upon the culture, history & flavor traditions of South Carolina to create heritage-infused experiences." Parker was recognized by then Governor Nikki Haley as a S.C. Chef Ambassador in 2016, a capstone for a culinary career that began in 1995.

Chef Forrest invites you to take the path less traveled; to see, touch, sip and taste the Undiscovered Charleston!

experiences.title: Create a Custom Perfume or Cologne in Charleston, SC: Mix & Match
experiences.description: Tijon is a unique make-your-own fragrance experience not found elsewhere. Original location is on the French side of the island of St. Maarten and Charleston is the first US location.

experiences.title: Hands-on Cooking Class in Charleston
experiences.description: Embark on a unique hands-on cooking adventure in the heart of Charleston’s historic French Quarter, as you join a seasoned Lowcountry culinary expert in our charming 19th-century headquarters. Through expert guidance and experimentation, immerse yourself in the essence of Southern cuisine while learning to prepare authentic regional dishes. Our personalized cooking class offers a delightful journey through the region’s rich culinary history, surrounded by the ambiance of a bygone era. Discover the secrets of traditional Lowcountry cooking in this immersive experience, blending history, culture, and the vibrant flavors that define Charleston’s gastronomic legacy. Book your spot now for an unforgettable and educational culinary escape in one of the South’s most iconic destinations.

experiences.title: Sip History in The Sun Cabana Covered Cocktail Class
experiences.description: On track to host over 3000 guests with a total of 1500 five-star reviews, the famous Tommy 'Alchemy' teaches you prohibition history through cocktails. *3 Cocktails & Snacks Included!

experiences.title: Surf Lessons in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
experiences.description: For added fun and memories that will last a lifetime, take either a 1- or 2-hour surf lesson in Myrtle Beach! With side-by-side guidance, your instructor will show you the ins and outs of surfing to prepare you for the rest of your trip. Your board is provided, just bring your bathing suit for a great time catching some waves.

experiences.title: Myrtle Beach Area Ghosts, Pirates and Historic Families Trolley Tour
experiences.description: Take a half-hour ride south of Myrtle Beach on a climate-controlled trolley to the fishing community of Murrells Inlet, SC, and beyond. Hear the quintessential ghost stories that locals have grown up with, background on the pirates who were said to have frequented the local shores 300 years ago, and historical commentary on the influential families who lived in the area and helped shape our nation's history. IF YOUR OBJECTIVE IS TO SPEND TIME AT AREA ATTRACTIONS, THIS IS NOT THE TOUR FOR YOU. This 2-hour narrated tour serves as an introduction to wonderful places that we will be passing by that you'll want to come back and visit. BRIEF STOPS, where passengers will hop off for just a FEW MINUTES, include The Pawleys Island Hammock Shops Village and at a photo-worthy overlook in Murrells Inlet. Board at 9:45 AM in front of the Grand 14 Theater at The Market Common. GUESTS MUST BE AT LEAST 3 YEARS OLD FOR THIS TOUR. It is best that you book prior to the Monday before your desired tour.

experiences.title: Charleston Historic Downtown Food Tour
experiences.description:
Savor the very best of the Lowcountry on a unique Charleston food tour designed for true foodies. Our family-run business has crafted a curated culinary experience giving you guaranteed line-skipping access to top restaurants in Historic Downtown. 

Indulge in iconic Southern classics, including:

- Rich and creamy She-Crab Soup
- A slow-cooked, savory BBQ Slider
- Tender, seasoned Collard Greens
- Warm, golden Cornbread
- A decadent Daily Special Cake

As you walk off your tastings along beautiful cobblestone streets, an expert local guide uncovers the deep history behind landmarks like the Old Exchange Building and the Pineapple Fountain at Waterfront Park. Discover where locals actually eat, learn the complex history of Southern spices, and enjoy a full meal's worth of world-class cuisine.

(Note: Child tickets ages 0-6 does not include food).

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Local Brewery in Charleston
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local brewery in Charleston. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Hannah Rose will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Streets and Eats Charleston Walking and Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Experience Charleston’s charm through its flavors and history on this 2.5-hour small-group walking and tasting tour. Explore the city’s most iconic streets and neighborhoods—including the French Quarter, South of Broad, and the colorful Rainbow Row—areas often missed by traditional food tours.

Led by a City of Charleston-certified guide, this tour blends culinary delights with cultural insights. Enjoy three tastings from local favorites: two quick grab-and-go bites and one relaxed, sit-down experience where you can savor Lowcountry cuisine and learn about its rich heritage. Alcoholic beverages are available for purchase at the sit-down stop.

Along the way, immerse yourself in Charleston’s architecture, stories, and vibrant street life. Your journey concludes near the Charleston City Market, leaving you perfectly positioned to continue exploring the Holy City at your own pace.

experiences.title: Morning Dolphin and Donut Cruise (Up to 10 Passengers)
experiences.description:
Start your morning with an unforgettable adventure on the waters of Hilton Head Island! Our Dolphins & Donuts Tour combines two of the best things in life, delicious, fresh donuts and the chance to see playful dolphins in their natural habitat.

Perfect for families, couples, and nature lovers, Dolphins & Donuts is the ideal way to start your day on Hilton Head Island. Book your spot today and treat yourself to a morning of sweetness and adventure!

experiences.title: Sunday Mimosa Brunch Charleston Harbor Sail - Food Included
experiences.description:
Kick back and soak up the ultimate Sunday vibes on our Sunday Funday Mimosa Bar Sail. Step aboard our a spacious and stylish 50-foot catamaran, and set sail for a relaxing and refreshing 2-hour cruise through Charleston’s historic harbor.

Sip on mimosas and other beverages from the onboard bar as you glide past iconic sights, including Fort Sumter, the Ravenel Bridge, and the USS Yorktown. With vibrant music, ocean breezes, and Charleston’s scenic beauty all around, this sail is the perfect way to recharge and wrap up your weekend.

Whether you’re enjoying an afternoon date, reconnecting with friends, or spending quality time with family, the Palmetto Breeze offers the ideal mix of comfort and fun. Relax on deck, soak in the panoramic views, and let the gentle rhythm of the waves set the tone for an unforgettable Sunday Funday.

Reserve your spot now and make your Sunday the highlight of your week!

experiences.title: PRIVATE GROUP! History & Food - Charleston's Tastes Through Time
experiences.description: Just you and your crew! Private groups allow for more opportunities to ask questions and to interact with your native Charlestonian guide. This unique foodie tour blends the perfect pairing of culinary delights with the captivating history of Lowcountry culture and the evolution of the region's cuisine. While you dine on Charleston's signature dishes and delicacies of the Lowcountry, your fun, knowledgeable, engaging guide, will escort you through the famous Historic District to some of the city's premier restaurants, where you will receive VIP service. Your guide will be glad to recommend the best local dining and touring experiences to make the most of your stay in Charleston. *Minimum of 4 guests required for this tour to operate.*

experiences.title: Wednesday Happy Hour Sunset Sail - Drinks Included
experiences.description:
Aloha Wednesday Sunset Sail: Island Vibes & Relaxation on the Charleston Harbor
Celebrate the spirit of the islands right here in Charleston with our Aloha Wednesday Sunset Sail. This midweek escape combines tropical charm with stunning harbor views for an evening you won’t forget. Enjoy complimentary drinks—including beers, seltzers, and wine—while you relax aboard our spacious and comfortable catamaran. (Local Craft Beers, Tipsy Wine Coolers, and CBD Seltzers not included.)

Feel the ocean breeze on your face as you sail past Charleston’s iconic sights, all bathed in the warm hues of the setting sun. Whether you're unwinding solo, catching up with friends, or making memories with family, this two-hour sail is the perfect way to recharge and reconnect.

Leave your worries on shore and let Aloha Wednesday transport you to paradise. Book your spot today and experience Charleston’s beauty from the water, island-style!

experiences.title: Dolphin Adventure (Private or Public) to 12 guests
experiences.description:
Enjoy a quintessential lowcountry cruise through the salt marshes of one of Charleston’s most scenic rivers where we see multiple dolphin sightings on 99% of our tours! The waters here are calm and less crowded with land always in sight making this private tour more relaxing, intimate, and enjoyable! 

You will be onboard a 27’ Coast Guard Certified vessel. “Marsh Mama” is designed with an open concept. She has comfortable cushioned seats, and Bluetooth stereo for your enjoyment. Spacious coolers with ice and waters will be provided. You are welcome to bring whatever food and drink you’d like! (BYOB)

Your captain will be experienced, knowledgeable, and fun. He will keep you safe, teach you interesting facts, and take great care of you. Your captain has a Masters License.

The tour is great for guests of all ages! It is perfect for families, friends, and celebrations! You can even bring your pet!

Inquire for group rates for up to 20 guests.

experiences.title: Taste of History A Private Charleston Culinary Tour
experiences.description:
Discover Charleston at a relaxed pace with this private, elevated culinary experience that blends food, culture, and history. Starting in the historic French Quarter, your group will enjoy a curated journey through Lowcountry classics and modern interpretations, with stops at three top restaurants for generous tasting portions—more than a full meal.

Your experience is fully tailored: before the tour, your guide will connect to learn your preferences and dietary needs, ensuring every dish suits your taste. The final stop is your choice—savory, sweet, or a surprise delight.
As you dine, your City of Charleston-certified guide shares stories of the city’s past and its influence on today’s cuisine. Light walking between locations keeps the focus on food and culture. Alcoholic beverages can be purchased or added with an optional libations package.

Perfect for special occasions, couples, or friends, Taste of History offers an immersive way to savor Charleston’s culinary heritage.

experiences.title: Tour and Tasting at Striped Pig Distillery
experiences.description: As the first distillery in Charleston, Striped Pig Distillery is a unique experience! We're also one of the few woman owned distilleries, and are family run! Stop in and feel like a part of our family.

experiences.title: Greenville Bites and Sights Lunch Tour
experiences.description:
Embark on a delightful luncheon tour through historic Greenville, South Carolina—a city where rich history and vibrant culinary scenes intertwine. Your culinary journey begins at Brick Street Cafe a unique dining experience with a touch of history, class, and an amazing history. The building is well over 100 years old, with just as many stories! A true local fave and a delight for visitors. Featuring dishes that blend exquisite taste with homemade perfection! Delicious!

Next we will visit a new venue, Matadors, an upscale and modern Mexican venue. They are featuring three unique Tex-Mex style tacos for our guests to enjoy. The decor is both interesting and unique. Venue is 100+ years old! Matadors is a great location for lunch!

Conclude your tour at Le Petite Croissant and experience authentic French pastries created especially for our tour guests. In this charming cafe, you will experience authentic french recipes direct from a small village near Chamonoix, France. Bon Apetit!

experiences.title: Charleston Catamaran Afternoon Party Sail with Bar Adults 21+
experiences.description:
Charleston's Best Adults-Only 2 Hour Harbor Party Sail

Leave the crowded bars behind and step aboard Charleston's largest sailing catamaran for a fun, laid-back afternoon on the water.

Departing from beautiful Shem Creek, this 2-hour adults-only sailing experience combines incredible harbor views, great music, cold drinks, and an energetic social atmosphere. Perfect for couples, friends, bachelor and bachelorette groups, birthdays, and anyone looking to kick off a Charleston weekend.

Stretch out on cushioned lounge seating, grab a drink from our full onboard bar, and let our experienced crew sail you cruise through historic Charleston Harbor.

Enjoy panoramic views of the Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge, Fort Sumter, the Charleston skyline, working shrimp boats, and, if you're lucky, playful dolphins swimming alongside the boat.

The Palmetto Breeze is a spacious 55-foot sailing catamaran with plenty of room to move around, dance, mingle, or simply relax with a drink.

experiences.title: Charleston History and Hops Tour: Bar and History Walk
experiences.description: Come Live the Local Life with Captain Bryan or Historian Adam! This experience is for guests who enjoy sipping their way through a new city full of history. This is not a classic "sit there and shut up tour" but an opportunity to engage with a local. The licensed guide will meet guests at the initial bar establishment and receive a small complimentary snack and the opportunity to purchase some of the areas finest beers/ mixed drinks while the guide goes over the historical roots of the city. From there guests will walk the historical alley ways and cobblestone streets of Charleston to several cultural sites included alleys, churches, a theater, and 300 year old homes. A second bar will be the site of another drink opportunity where the guide will relate stories specifically regarding the Prohibition era in Charleston. Guests will share a range of emotions as we combine humor, history and a beverage or two and bring history to life. Come live the local life!

experiences.title: Private Charleston Walking Food Tour in the French Quarter
experiences.description:
Step back through cobblestone streets where pirates, patriots, and duelists once tread. This walk uncovers Charleston's French Quarter through three centuries of gritty legend and Lowcountry character. We start at the Historic City Market, beneath the 1840s Market Hall, once a cornerstone of local trade and resilience. From there we pass St. Philip's Church, the Dock Street Theatre (America's first playhouse), and the notorious Pirate House, before slipping into shaded Philadelphia Alley, tied to whispered 19th-century duels. Your guide shares how fires, bombardments, and shifting centuries shaped the district's architecture. 

As afternoon light falls across secret courtyard gardens, take in pastel facades, wrought-iron gates, and quiet piazza balconies. The walk closes with a look at how this storied quarter's rhythm, architecture, and living history still linger in every corner of Charleston today.

experiences.title: Charleston Sweet Treats Food Tour: Beignets, Biscuits & More
experiences.description: Discover the sweet side of Charleston with a tour that celebrates the city’s most irresistible, international treats. From pillowy beignets and flaky baklava to crunchy chocolate clusters, refreshing pineapple ice cream, buttery biscuits, and fluffy Belgian pancakes, every stop is a new indulgence. Along the way, you’ll soak in Charleston’s rich history and culture while sharing laughs, snapping Instagram-worthy photos, and enjoying a fun-filled walk with family and friends. Whether you’re local or visiting, it’s a delicious way to explore the city together!

experiences.title: Small-Group Walking Tour in Greenville with Breakfast
experiences.description: Our first stop will take us to an iconic Greenville landmark hotel and restaurant where you will enjoy one of the the chef's signature dishes. Then we will venture over to another Southern favorite - Tupelo Honey. They will have prepared for you a wonder breakfast experience (which does change seasonally). Currently, they are serving pecan pancake with Hot Honey Chicken. Yummy! After our time at Tupelo Honey, we will conclude at Roost. Roost has recently been totally remodeled and will be serving our guests a wonderful breakfast entree to enjoy. Usually the entree is french toast, but again, they are a farm to table venue, so anything that is available seasonally, they will try to provide the guests with the freshest options. This is an eating tour....and you will be quite full at the end. We love to feed our guests, and you will have plenty of delicious food. Enjoy your time with your friends, family and the wonderful tour around Greenville. Thank you!

experiences.title: Wine Sippin'-Tea Drinkin'-Tree Huggin' Lowcountry Sightseeing
experiences.description:
Enjoy this all-Inclusive, day-trip out to the Lowcountry, on Wadmalaw Island, Charleston's rural farming sea island, and tour 3 unique locations. Join Snap! for an intimate, small group tour, of no more than 10 guests. 

First, we visit the magnificent 500 year-old Angel Oak tree. No words can describe this surreal park. Then we are off to Charleston Tea Garden, America's only farm to table, tea farm & production plant. Includes trolley tour around the farm, factory tour and ALL the tea you can drink (both hot & iced) Finally, we will drive over to Deep Water Vineyard for wine tasting and vineyard strolling. 

All this in one complete experience!

Leanne is a city certified tour guide that takes you outside the limits! Come enjoy the tranquillity of Charleston's sea islands.

Please note! Sometimes the tour takes longer than the 5 hours. Lunch is not included, but you may bring your own. Dinner reservations should be scheduled at least two hours after tour ends.

experiences.title: The Charleston Boo Hag and Brews Ghost and Bar Tour
experiences.description: Is this a walking brew tour with a side of ghosts or a ghost tour with a side of brews?? While guests will have to decide that for themselves, we can tell you this is not an average "sit there and shut up " tour, but rather an opportunity to engage back and forth with a local Charlestonian. As a combined bar and ghost tour guests will visit two different bars where complimentary appetizer will be served at the first location and the guide will provide drink recommendations. As part of the tour guests will also walk by and receive history based ghost stories near graveyards, alleyways, and a haunted dungeon. The second bar is an historic building with a fantastic local beer selection. Guests will ward off the spirits with some "spirits." The tour will wind down at a hauntingly beautiful local park where one of the first female serial killers was hung. Don't stick around too long after the tour or you may end up a ghost yourself! (Please note we do not enter the graveyards.)

experiences.title: Charleston Brunch Food Tour: Biscuits, Shrimps, Grits and More
experiences.description:
Discover southern hospitality on our Charleston Brunch Food Tour in the vibrant Upper King Street district! Starting near the historic William Aiken House, we kick off the morning with a buttery, handmade Hot Little Biscuit.

As we stroll toward Marion Square, we dive into the soul of Lowcountry cooking with crunchy Fried Green Tomatoes. Walking through the Mazyck-Boragard neighborhood, we'll savor a sweet and savory Croffle with Fried Chicken and local honey. We also indulge in creamy Shrimp & Grits and Pimento Cheese, the 'Caviar of the South.'

Before ending near the Aiken-Rhett House Museum, we reveal our incredible Secret Dish—a warm, nostalgic delicacy with a unique local twist!

experiences.title: Charleston Haunted Booze and Boos Ghost Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Your pirate guide will lead the group on a 2.5-hour walking tour through historic downtown Charleston. You will begin and end at a bar, each housed in historic buildings with their own unique ghosts and stories. Guests will have time to purchase and enjoy a delicious libation as the guide tells them all about the fascinating history of Charleston and some of its most famous and creepy haunted stories!

Please keep in mind that there will be a lot of walking between drinks stops where your guide will share the haunted history of several landmarks along the way. Per city law, Alcohol must NEVER be taken out of the bar.
*Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
*All guests must be 21+ with Valid ID. Alcohol is not included.
*Some of the bars we visit may require guests to be 23+ to consume alcohol. While we will do our best to select alternative options for those under 23, we cannot guarantee accommodations. We strictly adhere to each bar’s policy without exception.

experiences.title: Friday Night - Date Night Cocktails in Greenville, South Carolina
experiences.description:
Introduce yourself and your guests to Greenville while on the Date Night Cocktail and Appetizer Tour by visiting wonderful historic venues, enjoying 3 delicious cocktails and 3 wonderful appetizers, meeting other foodies to share this wonderful evening with.

 Delight in the charming downtown and learn all about the historic character of this truly beautiful southern belle - Greenville. Experience 1:1 service and attention from the general mangers of the restaurants, the executive chefs, and be a pampered guest on a delightful evening with friends, family, or your special someone. Create memories to last a lifetime..
This is a great time to experience 3 separate and unique venues, be treated like VIPs with special service, engage with other foodies, and learn about Greenville...2 tours in one!

experiences.title: Charleston Farm-to-Table Food Tour and Chef's Challenge
experiences.description:
This Farm-to-Table Experience is provided by CHARLESTON CULINARY TOURS, the longest-running food tour company in Charleston. This 2.5-hour tour showcases the seasonal bounty of the Lowcountry and the creative prowess of a local chef.

- Handpick local seasonal produce at a favorite neighborhood market.
- Explore the historic TwoBoroughs neighborhood and Upper King Street with a city-certified guide.
- Enjoy a one-of-a-kind farm-to-table experience at a local restaurant with a multi-course feast, created from your seasonal Market selections.

This is a great way to explore beloved local shops and a historic neighborhood, meet a Charleston chef (or two!), and see their creativity in action. Come enjoy a true Charleston farm-to-table experience that's unique, local, and not to be missed.

experiences.title: Hilton Head Morning Dolphins & Donuts Cruise
experiences.description:
This is a Dynamite combo - Dolphin & Donuts! 

This 1.5 hour tour will depart from Palmetto Bay Marina. Our local guides will tell you all about the local ecosystem, history & wildlife while keeping it fun for all! 

We will enjoy Donuts/juice/water as we cruise and observe the Atlantic bottlenose dolphin in its natural habitat! Watch as they play, eat, or simply swim. 

This tour is perfect for families, friends or couples!

experiences.title: Charleston French Quarter or Brunch Food Tour with 7+ Tastings
experiences.description: Whether you join our classic itinerary or select our Brunch option, you are in for an unforgettable culinary journey through 300 years of history! Our classic tour features iconic Lowcountry staples like Pulled Pork Tacos, Benne Wafers, She-Crab Soup, and Shrimp & Grits. Meanwhile, our brunch highlights Southern favorites like warm biscuits, Spinach & Feta Quiche, Fried Green Tomatoes, Pimento Cheese, and Banana Pudding. Both choices wind past the French Quarter's most iconic historic landmarks and culminate in our incredible mystery Signature Secret Dish!

experiences.title: Charleston's Authentic Cuisine & True History Cultural Experience
experiences.description: This fun, fascinating, unique, four course foodie tour blends the perfect pairing of culinary delights with the captivating history of Charleston's cultural blend and the evolution of the region's cuisine. While you dine on Charleston's signature dishes & delicacies of the Lowcountry, your fun, knowledgeable, engaging guide, a lifetime local of the area, will escort you to some of the city's best known restaurants, where you will receive VIP service. Why is Charleston the "Holy City?" Why do we call this area the "Lowcountry?" Most importantly, who are the Gullah Geechee, named an official Creole culture by US Congress in 2006? All of the restaurants are in Charleston's historic Market/French Quarter area, within close proximity, so minimal walking is required. Your guide will be happy to recommend the best local dining & touring experiences to make the most of your stay in Charleston. Our partner restaurants gladly substitute dishes for food restrictions upon request.

experiences.title: Trolley Tour in Wadmalaw Island of South Carolina
experiences.description: The trolley ride takes about 35-40 minutes and you'll get to see our many acres and acres of tea bushes. You'll learn more about tea both from our trolley guide as well as our founder, Bill Hall, who narrates a portion of the tour over the bus sound system. The trolley also makes a stop at the greenhouse where everyone departs the trolley and gets to see up close and personal just what it takes to bring new tea bushes into the world. This trip is a once-in-a-lifetime experience

experiences.title: Hilton Head Morning Kayaking & Coffee Guided Tour
experiences.description:
This morning kayak tour is the perfect time to get on the water - quiet, calm, less boat traffic, coffee and picturesque views! 

Upon check in, our staff will hook you up with a speciality brewed coffee - a portion of the proceeds benefit the manatee population. Our trained guides will do a short "paddle clinic" to make sure you feel comfortable and confident while kayaking! They will lead you along the route while telling you more about the Hilton Head ecosystem, history & wildlife! There are also chances of seeing many species of bird & the local Atlantic Bottlenose Dolphins. 

This tour is perfect for couples, families, friends, etc!

experiences.title: Downtown Charleston Food Tour
experiences.description: This Downtown Culinary Tour is provided by CHARLESTON CULINARY TOURS, the longest-running food tour company in Charleston. Visit four food establishments on this 2.5-hour tour that combines elements of a historical tour with a culinary adventure! Learn about Charleston's history as you enjoy tastings of traditional favorites and contemporary innovations, all of which highlight the cuisine of locally-owned restaurants. Insight into Lowcountry cuisine accompanies the broad range of samples on your food tour. This is our original tour around the French Quarter and City Market and focuses on the traditional flavors of the region.

experiences.title: River Tubing & Kayaking
experiences.description:
Spend the afternoon floating along the beautiful Waccamaw River on an inflatable river tube or kayak. Bring some food and drinks (or grab some from our Snack Shack) to take with you on your trip to explore the river.

The duration of the trip can vary between 25 - 45 minutes depending on the flow of the river. You can do 2 - 3 trips during the 3 hour reservation window.

When you arrive at our Outpost you will find:
- Fun and games: enjoy our unique super sized yard games: Jenga, Connect 4, Corn Hole and more. 
- Amenities: 4 restrooms, 4 changing rooms with hot showers, hammocks, swings, large fire pit, picnic tables and propane grills that are available for you to use.

If you are looking for more adventure you might like our most popular activity: Escape River Island where you play SURVIVOR games on our private island!

experiences.title: Charleston’s Spirits & Spirits Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Come on our Haunted Pub Crawl tour of Charleston, SC!

On select nights, join us and discover the darker side of Charleston, while enjoying some liquid courage along the way. You'll visit some of the best local bars and pubs, and make stops at historical and haunted locations in between. From the origins of the Blind Tiger Pub's name, to the ghosts of St. Philip's Graveyard and experiences at the Angel Oak, we have you covered for a hauntingly good time!

experiences.title: Hilton Head Shrimp Trawling Boat Cruise
experiences.description:
Come join the crew aboard the Tammy Jane for a 2-hour educational and picturesque low-country experience as we take you out Shrimping! We invite you to learn about our healthy salt marsh environment, and introduce you to some of the sea creatures we'll safely pull up in our nets (in addition to shrimp!). 

We will explore how various ecosystems intertwine to create the rich food web that provides food for our tables. 

This is a unique opportunity for guests of all ages! If we do catch shrimp aboard an expedition the crew will package some up for guests to take home.

experiences.title: Charleston's Savor the Flavors of Upper King Street Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
See what the Upper King Street fuss is all about with this relatively new tour featuring bites from the trendy neighborhood’s most delicious spots. Experience the unique Savor the Flavors food tour in the famous Upper King Street district. Sample mouth-watering dishes of Lowcountry cuisine from the popular culinary innovators in this ever-evolving restaurant district. Come join Charleston’s original food tour company as we enjoy what Charleston’s best Upper King Street restaurants are bringing to the table. 

Please note this tour is seafood heavy and not recommended for travelers with allergies.

experiences.title: Polynesian Fire Luau and Dinner Show Ticket in Myrtle Beach
experiences.description:
Polynesian Fire Luau is one of the hottest shows in Myrtle Beach. The entertainment event features performers from different Polynesian Isles, just for the Luau. Your evening begins with a lei greeting by dancers. 

Then enjoy a buffet dinner accompanied with live music by our Polynesian band! After dinner, the show which highlights songs and dances from the different Polynesian cultures of Hawaii, Tahiti, Tonga, New Zealand and Samoa, begins. The night ends with an amazing performance by our World Champion Samoan Fire Knife Team.

Check in time is half hour prior to start time and the address is:
St John's Inn
6803 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach

experiences.title: Savor the Flavors of Charleston Walking Food Tour
experiences.description:
Walk, talk and taste your way through historic Charleston South Carolina. This 2.5 hour Charleston food tour immerses you in the history and culture of the Lowcountry and reveals how our unique cuisine has evolved over the past 300+ years. Menu and routes change daily, expect a serving of lowcountry favorites.

***PLEASE NOTE: If there are any food allergies in your party, we must know at least 48 hours in advance or some restaurants may not be able to accommodate. We also can't guarantee there will be a substitution at every location due to some allergies.

experiences.title: Charleston Upper King Street Food Tour
experiences.description:
This Upper King Street Culinary Tour is provided by CHARLESTON CULINARY TOURS, the longest-running food tour company in Charleston. This 2.5-hour tour offers insight into Charleston's Upper King Street neighborhood (named as one of the top 10 food neighborhoods in America), showcasing four of Charleston's culinary innovators who exemplify cooking in the New South.

The Upper King Street district has emerged as an area with tremendous energy; showcasing culinary innovation, experimental design, and exuberant nightlife. The restaurants featured on the food tour are trailblazers in Charleston's culinary scene, edgy and innovative, with tremendous passion for their craft. This Upper King Street tour is designed to show off the modern and eclectic side of the Lowcountry while providing insight into Charleston's ever-changing culinary scene.

experiences.title: Speakeasy Sagas - Charleston Prohibition Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Step back into the shadows of the 1920s, when Charleston was a city of contradictions—charming on the surface, rebellious underneath. On the Speakeasy Sagas Pub Crawl, you’ll walk the very streets where bootleggers dodged federal agents, secret bars buzzed behind locked doors.

During Prohibition, alcohol was outlawed—but in Charleston, the party never really stopped. This wasn’t just a city of Southern charm and steeples. It was a city of hidden rooms, rumrunners, and lawmen who conveniently looked the other way. From elegant society scandals to rowdy waterfront crime, this tour reveals the untold story of Charleston’s wild side. Along the way, stop at hand-picked pubs where you can enjoy your favorite modern cocktails (not included in tour price) in the Holy City with a refusal to stay dry.

experiences.title: Full-Day Private Bike Tour of Mickelson Trail and Brewery
experiences.description: Get off the beaten path and onto your bike to see the real beauty of the Black Hills! This day tour takes you to some of the quieter and most beautiful areas of the Mickelson trail (where the locals ride) and a taste of South Dakotan produce. A true balance of effort and reward and a great day out! We give the option to stop at one of few breweries up in the Hill City area, with the outdoor Lost Cabin Beer Garden at the Mickelson Trail Burlington Trailhead being a favorite.

experiences.title: Exclusive: Rushmore, Custer State Park & Crazy Horse
experiences.description:
Welcome to My XO Adventures! This is your tour, for your group! We don't mix with strangers on this adventure to ensure it's extraordinary. Your tour will be unscripted, unique, and back-road driven. We are always tuned in to your particular interests and automatically adjust accordingly. We aim to ensure you've had the most amazing experience possible. We do what we want, when we want, where we want. 

Think of it as the difference between a fast-food burger and a gourmet steak. We’ll customize your experience based on your interests, timing, and comfort level. 

Our extensive knowledge of the Black Hills means you’ll see famous spots and hidden gems that other tours can’t reach. 

This is your exclusive adventure, designed to create unforgettable memories in the Black Hills. We'll take you anywhere in the Black Hills within an 8-10 hour time period. Lunch is included.

experiences.title: Private - Badlands Rugged Jeep Backcountry Tour with Lunch
experiences.description: Duration: 6–8 hours (Full Day)Start/End: Rapid City or Interior, SDActivity Level: Easy to ModerateGroup Size: Maximum 6 guests per JeepInclusions: Guided 4x4 transport, park park entry fees, bottled water, and a complete picnic lunch

experiences.title: Private Badlands Package
experiences.description:
Experience the breathtaking beauty and rugged landscapes of the Badlands on a tour that showcases one of America's most extraordinary natural wonders. Marvel at the park's dramatic rock formations, colorful buttes, deep canyons, and vast prairie vistas while discovering the incredible forces that shaped this ancient landscape over millions of years. Lunch will be provided picnic style from a local eatery. 

Throughout the day, your guide will share fascinating stories about the Badlands' rich history, unique wildlife, Native American heritage, and world-renowned fossil discoveries. Whether you're taking in sweeping panoramic views, photographing the striking scenery, or learning about the remarkable geology that makes this region unlike anywhere else on Earth, this unforgettable adventure offers a deeper appreciation for the beauty and history of the Badlands.

experiences.title: Premier Private Badlands Day Tour
experiences.description:
Experience another world in Badlands National Park. Wildlife and fossil spotting is a favorite as we weave our way through the spires and pinnacles of the park. We make many stops, and can incorporate a hike if you wish! Lunch in the park with spectacular views will be a highlight. On to the Minuteman National Historic Site, for some incredible living WW2 history. On our way back to Rapid City, Wall Drug calls us in for homemade donuts. 

Tour with our knowledgable local guides and take in the park in your own time. Our private tours are flexible, with time to take photos, walk and enjoy the area as you wish to!

This tour is customizable. Questions? Contact us for more information.

experiences.title: Mount Rushmore and Black Hills Tour with Two Meals and a Music Variety Show
experiences.description:
Join us on a journey through the breathtaking landscapes and historic landmarks of Mount Rushmore and the Black Hills. This all-inclusive tour offers an immersive experience, combining expert-guided sightseeing with delicious meals and an entertaining variety music show. Discover the beauty, history, and adventure that Mount Rushmore and its surrounding attractions have to offer.

Mount Rushmore Tours is the longest operating local family owned and operated tour company in the Black Hills. Founded in 1973 and since 2023 second generation owned and operated, we are widely regarded as the local experts in the bus tours for Mount Rushmore and the Black Hills.

experiences.title: Downtown Sioux Falls Food Tour
experiences.description: Saturday food tours are a collection of tastes from different restaurants and breweries in Downtown Sioux Falls. Join us for the history of the city and some amazing bites that might surprise you.

experiences.title: You-Pick Flower Bouquet Experience at the Cut Flower Farm
experiences.description: Explore a vibrant cut flower farm where you can handpick your own bouquet from a stunning selection of zinnias, cosmos, dahlias, and sunflowers. This delightful outing allows you to wander through colorful fields, surrounded by butterflies, bumblebees, and honeybees, creating a personal floral masterpiece that reflects your unique style. Capture the joy of nature as you gather blooms and embrace the beauty of the outdoors.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co: Blend Your Own Whiskey — Bottle Included
experiences.description: Craft a one-of-a-kind whiskey during a 60-minute blending session at the Nashville Barrel Company. Guided by award-winning experts, taste various whiskey profiles, experiment with different mashbills, and create a unique blend tailored to your palate. Adjust the proof to your liking and leave with a custom-labeled bottle that embodies your personal touch. Perfect for bachelorette parties, anniversaries, or team-building events, this interactive experience ensures each participant walks away with a distinct whiskey that represents their creativity.

experiences.title: Cocktails and Conversations: Chattanooga Cocktail Making Class
experiences.description:
Shake, stir, and sip your way through one of Chattanooga’s most interactive culinary experiences. 

Our Craft Cocktail Making Class goes beyond simply following recipes—guests learn the techniques, history, and flavor science behind creating exceptional cocktails while enjoying a hands-on experience led by knowledgeable mixologists.

Unlike a standard bar tasting, this immersive class allows participants to step behind the bar, work with premium ingredients, and master professional bartending skills they can recreate at home. 

Perfect for couples, friends, corporate groups, and travelers looking for a unique local experience, this engaging class blends education, entertainment, and plenty of delicious cocktails into an unforgettable experience. 

A recipe card of the class' 2-cocktail creation is included for all attendees.

experiences.title: Candle Pouring Workshop at Paddywax Candle Bar - Berry Hill
experiences.description: Discover the art of candle making at Paddywax Candle Bar in Nashville's vibrant Berry Hill. This hour-long, instructor-led workshop allows you to craft your own custom candle, selecting from a variety of vessels and seasonal fragrance blends. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere as expert Chandlers guide you through the pouring process, all while sipping on your complimentary beverage. After pouring, explore the neighborhood or take advantage of 10% off all retail products. This creative experience is perfect for birthdays, date nights, or simply unleashing your artistic side!

experiences.title: Belle Meade Bourbon Mixology Experience
experiences.description:
Craft your own signature cocktail using the rich flavors of Belle Meade Bourbon in this immersive mixology experience. Led by a certified Bourbon Steward, participants explore a selection of seasonal juices, handcrafted syrups, and aromatic bitters while learning the art of mixing and shaking.

This hands-on adventure culminates in your very own custom drink, presented in unique Belle Meade drinkware, along with a take-home recipe card. Ideal for bourbon enthusiasts and novices alike, this experience blends creativity with expert guidance in a historic setting.

experiences.title: Nashville Bach Party Line Dancing Class
experiences.description:
The Nash Bach Bash is designed to recognize your bride or groom. It's a celebratory party atmosphere as much as it is a fun line dance lesson. You'll dance, you'll party, you'll scoot your boots and love every second. Your bride will receive a souvenir wristlet to remember the experience.

The dances taught are typically beginner level and easy to learn. The instruction is mixed with jokes and humor so it's light and fun which makes learning easier.

There is plenty of time for photos or videos throughout the event so you can remember the amazing time you had with your friends and family. Phone tripods are also provided if you'd like to record your group performing the dances and looking fire!

experiences.title: Ocoee River Middle Whitewater Rafting Trip (Most Popular Tour)
experiences.description: This section is great for beginners or the experienced rafter with over 20 continuous class III & IV rapids. With plenty of places to surf and play, you’ll see why thousands of folks return year after year to raft this classic 5-mile run. Starting just below the Ocoee Dam No. 2, you’ll encounter your first big rapid, Grumpy’s, then its on to Broken Nose, Roller Coaster, Table Saw, Hell’s Hole and many more. Top that all off with a great place to swim about half way down and you’ll certainly become “one” with the river. Our wonderful river guides will help make your adventure one to remember. Must be 12 years and older.

experiences.title: Beginner's Line Dancing Class with Instructor in Nashville
experiences.description:
At Turn Their Heads, we believe learning to dance should be just as fun as dancing itself. That's why we've built an experience designed to keep you laughing, moving, and making memories.

You'll learn authentic Nashville line dances in a spacious, climate-controlled studio where comfort and fun go hand in hand. Free parking, complimentary water, optional BYOB, and snacks and non-alcoholic beverages available for purchase help keep the good times rolling.

The fun doesn't stop on the dance floor. Strike a pose at our photo opportunities, borrow a complimentary cowboy hat, capture your own content with our phone tripods, and enjoy fun mood lighting. Our team also captures photo and video content so you'll have memories to relive and share long after your Nashville adventure ends.

Most importantly, we teach the dances you'll actually see on Nashville dance floors—popular line dances that are easy to learn, fun to dance, and perfect for taking straight to the honky tonks.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co "Straight from Barrel" Tasting with Bottle
experiences.description: Nashville Barrel Co leads the way on Bourbon experiences. We offer this Single Barrel Experience that is the first of it's kind. In the past, you had to be a store or bar to go pick your own barrel of whiskey. We made the same experience open to everyone and without the commitment to have to buy the entire barrel. You get a bottle from the favorite!

experiences.title: Learn Cocktail Design from Nashville's Bartender Guild President
experiences.description:
Most cocktail classes stop at recipes. Tennessee Whiskey Workshop digs deeper. This is storytelling stitched into hospitality, where Tennessee Whiskey isn’t just poured—it’s unpacked, demystified, and celebrated. You’ll use professional bar tools to create three original Old Fashioned variations, but what sets this apart is the atmosphere: no scripts, no ego, just a host who’s lived and breathed Nashville’s bar culture for 25+ years.

Set in the private Tank Room at Love & Exile, the workshop is intimate, welcoming, and rooted in Southern hospitality. Guests walk away not just with new skills, but with the kind of confidence, perspective, and insider connection that makes Nashville feel like more than a stop on the map. This is cocktail education with character—part storytelling, part hands-on craft, part Eastside magic.

experiences.title: Create Your Own Custom Perfume or Cologne Workshop in Nashville
experiences.description: Tijon is a unique make-your-own fragrance experience not found elsewhere. Original location is on the French side of the island of St. Martin.

experiences.title: First class limo in Nashville, Tennessee luxury car
experiences.description: Our service is super reliable and punctual, so you can count on us to get you where you need to go on time. We also offer a wide range of options to suit your needs, whether you're traveling solo or with a group. And let's not forget about our friendly and professional drivers who will make your journey comfortable and enjoyable. So go ahead and book with us for a hassle-free and enjoyable transportation experience!

experiences.title: Sip History in Music City Cocktail Making Class
experiences.description:
Combines hands-on bartending with a journey through the city's storied bootlegging and cocktail history. In your intimate retro bar setting, you'll shake and stir three different cocktails with guidance from a local expert, learn the stories behind Tennessee whiskey and other spirits, and enjoy curated bar snacks.

Every guest has the chance to step behind a real bar and make a cocktail! (3 cocktails included). Be ready for jokes, stories, history, pro tips on drinks, and interactive drink making.

experiences.title: Beginner's Country Swing Dance Class - Dance Downtown That Day
experiences.description:
This amazing class is taught by country swing dancer Rick Harris and his caring group of instructors. Rick is considered the father of country swing in Nashville. He was the first to teach country swing in Nashville and has been teaching and dancing country swing for over a dozen years. 

Prior to teaching dance full time, Coach Rick taught athletes how to perform at their best. Beginners find his unique teaching methods easy to follow which makes learning how to dance a breeze. 

Coach Rick and his instructors also bring their country sense of humor and entertaining style to this fun class. You'll laugh and dance, and be ready to show off your new moves at the honky tonks, at weddings and in your kitchen when you leave. 

If you prefer to have an adult beverage when you learn to dance, you are welcome to BYOB your beverage of choice if done so responsibly.

experiences.title: Nashville's Goo Goo Chocolate Tasting & Candy Making Class
experiences.description: With a local instructor as your host, you’ll learn all about America’s first combination candy bar and it’s significance to Nashville history. As part of the class, you’ll get to taste several types of chocolate and try a sample of this beloved Tennessee treat. All guests take part in a hands-on candy making session where you design your own Premium Goo Goo, choosing from a plethora of ingredients.

experiences.title: Line Dancing on Broadway + Beginners Level+ Souvenir Video
experiences.description: You'll make forever memories when you learn to line dance in the heart of Music City! Our classes are held in historic and authentic Honky Tonks right on Broadway in downtown Nashville. We offer COUNTRY line dances you can do everywhere and a unique honky tonk experience that you won't find anywhere else and immerses you into the world and culture of Country Music & line dancing entertainment! We fell in love with dancing and we want to share our love of dancing with our guests. We strive to give you the confidence to own the dance floor. We want to make you feel good and look good! Our motto is 'Fake It Til You Make It' - and our #1 goal is that you have FUN!

experiences.title: Sip History in a Secret Speakeasy with Drinks Included
experiences.description:
Join a 2-hour interactive cocktail class in Nashville. Learn to make 3 cocktails, enjoy a performative history lesson, and discover local drink history in a speakeasy setting.

Full description
Step into the legendary Golden Sound in the Gulch, a retro recording studio turned Speakeasy, and be transported to an era of moonshine, flappers and speakeasy secrets.

Begin with a charismatic cocktail expert who combines storytelling, booze news, and local drink history with pro tips on making better drinks.

Learn about Nashville’s rich alcohol and cocktail history, including tales of Al Capone’s bootlegging escapades through Printers Alley during Prohibition.

Enjoy three cocktails and basic bar snacks as you immerse yourself in this interactive experience. Whether you’re a bachelorette party looking to let loose or a couple wanting to elevate your cocktail game, this is the perfect experience for you.

experiences.title: Memphis Discovery Tour
experiences.description:
Get the complete Memphis experience on this all-inclusive city tour. It’s a part history tour, part attraction hopping, part food tour that will introduce you to everything that makes Memphis special. You’ll visit World Famous Beale Street (the Home of the Blues), see the Mississippi River and historic Cotton Row, and get a barbecue tasting at one of the best barbecue joints in the city! Along the way, we'll show you our favorite Memphis sights, including Victorian Village, St. Jude's Children's Research Hospital, historic churches, and Court Square, the lovely and historic heart of 19th century Memphis. Visit the Lorraine Motel. to see the balcony where Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. was assassinated. 

Admission to the National Civil Rights Museum, the Rock 'n' Soul Museum or Edge Motor Museum is available (please make sure you select that option).

experiences.title: Make you own Rolled Ice Cream in Nashville
experiences.description:
Showcase your skills and learn how to make rolled ice cream like a pro! The Roll Academy is a hands-on rolled ice cream crafting class that will leave you feeling like a master roller.

During your experience, you’ll create two rolled ice creams, our best-selling flavor and your own fully customized creation. You’ll also discover the history and science behind rolled ice cream, explore our unlimited topping bar, and enjoy an immersive photo experience. Plus, every participant receives a take home apron!

We proudly offer vegan and gluten-free options, so everyone can join in on the fun.

experiences.title: Guided Pub Crawl Walking Tour of Downtown Nashville
experiences.description: Music City Pub Crawl is Nashville's oldest and most coveted bar crawl, with attendees from all across the globe! Guests are taken to a slew of unique watering holes off the beaten path of touristy Broadway, each with exclusive drink specials only available to our pub crawlers! All the while, our world-class tour guides combine hysterical & intriguing local history with a heaping pile of friendly competition and a plethora of interactive, Nashville-themed games & activities to keep guests entertained and on their toes! Our general groups run every day and are legendary for spurring camaraderie. By the end of the tour, it's very difficult to tell who arrived with whom. Music City Pub Crawl is perfect for guests of all ages, and one that's ideal for individuals, couples, birthday parties, family gatherings, bachelor & bachelorette parties, and corporate events! Given our low price point and tour duration (2.5+ hours), our pub crawl tours are the best deal in Nashville!

experiences.title: Candle Pouring Workshop at Paddywax Candle Bar Gulch
experiences.description: Located in one of Nashville’s trendiest neighborhoods, Gulch location is perfect for visitors and locals alike. With its relaxed, self paced approach, this workshop offers a creative outlet for all ages and skill levels. Whether you’re planning a group activity, a date night, or just exploring Nashville, our DIY candle making workshop is a must try experience.

experiences.title: Nashville Airport Transfer with Limo Service
experiences.description:
We pride ourselves on offering exceptional, reliable, punctual and best limousine service in Nashville. No more waiting for taxis or dealing with crowded shuttles—our luxurious limousines are equipped with top-tier amenities, designed to provide a relaxing atmosphere after a long flight.

Book our Best Limo Services in Nashville for your next airport transfer, and enjoy the ultimate in convenience, comfort, and class. Let us make your journey an unforgettable part of your trip to Nashville.

experiences.title: Instructor Led Line Dance Class
experiences.description: The world of Country Dancing has made a comeback! We'll teach you the latest line dances (beginner level) as our goal is to make dancing a fun party atmosphere and add even more excitement to your time here in Music City! Whether you have two left feet or you can already cut-a-rug, we will accommodate.

experiences.title: Goos & Booze | Candy Making + Spirit & Chocolate Tasting
experiences.description:
The Spirit & Bonbon plus Candy-Making experience features multiple (4) spirits paired with our beautiful handmade bonbons. You'll learn a little about each spirit, taste some amazing chocolates, and even get to create your own custom Goo Goo!

 - Tasting plus Insider look at the history of Nashville's official candy bar
 - Hands-on candy making 
 - Classic clusters plus take home apron
 - Chocolate and Spirit pairing activity

Please note: This is a 21 plus experience. All participants must have a valid form of Identification. All parties in the classroom must purchase a ticket.
