experiences.title: Hands On Pasta Making Class in Chattanooga
experiences.description: Step into the world of authentic Italian cuisine at Chattanooga’s leading pasta-making school. Here, under the guidance of seasoned chef Debi, who has over 40 years of experience, you'll learn traditional techniques to create silky pasta and delicious sauces from scratch. The intimate class setting ensures personalized attention, allowing you to hone your skills while enjoying engaging stories and laughter. At the end of the session, savor your homemade creations with newfound culinary confidence.

experiences.title: Make Your Own Candle at a Local Brewery in Nashville
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local brewery in Nashville. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Tamee will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Nashville
experiences.description: Homemade fettuccine and marinara sauce from scratch, made at a local Nashville brewery. It is the kind of evening that sounds too good to be true until you are actually there doing it. Chef Dylan walks you through every step in a relaxed, no-pressure setting, from kneading and rolling your dough to cutting proper fettuccine strands and building a rich marinara from crushed tomatoes, Parmesan, garlic, red pepper and fresh basil. By the time everything comes together on the plate, the hardest part will be deciding whether to pair it with the pasta or just drink it. Simple ingredients, timeless technique and one of the more unexpected evenings Nashville has to offer.

experiences.title: Sensory Nature Walk and Artisanal Tea at Bask Nature Sanctuary
experiences.description: Experience a nature sanctuary set across 42 rolling acres of forests, wetlands, grasslands, and winding creeks in Centerville, Tennessee (just 90 minutes west of Nashville). A living example of dedicated land restoration and active reforestation. As native plants, wildflowers, and wildlife resurge across the grounds, you’ll step into an ecosystem thriving with natural renewal and peace, guided by an expert educator.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Brewery in Nashville
experiences.description: Sushi at a brewery in Nashville. Yes, really. And it is every bit as fun as it sounds. In this beginner-friendly class hosted at a local Nashville brewery, Chef Dylan will take you from never having touched a bamboo mat to confidently rolling a classic California roll and a bright, fresh mango veggie roll that looks every bit as good as it tastes. He breaks down each step without making it feel like a lecture, from getting your rice to the right texture to cutting your sushi into clean, even pieces that hold together beautifully. The setting is casual, the atmosphere is buzzing and by the end of class you will already be planning whose dinner party you are going to show this off at first.

experiences.title: Suzy Wongs Drag n Brunch Food and Show Included
experiences.description:
Ladies and gentlemen, it's show time! Experience a new way to brunch at Suzy Wong's Drag'n Brunch in Nashville every Friday--Sunday. We are the ONLY Food-Inclusive Drag Brunch in Nashville! We also have the ability to celebrate any Special Occasion for you or members of your party. 
Whether you're celebrating a Birthday, Bachelorette/Bachelor weekend, Going-Away party, Graduation, Divorce, or you just need an excuse to day drink with friends, Suzy Wong's is an unforgettable Nashville drag brunch experience. We are not a traditional restaurant!

experiences.title: Big Machine Distillery Guided Distillery Tour With Tastings
experiences.description: Experience the Spirit of Tennessee, where tradition meets innovation in idyllic Lynnville, TN. Explore our diverse range of spirits, from our craft Tennessee Whiskey to our New American Style gin, and small-batch bourbons. Whether you're a connoisseur seeking sophistication or an adventurer craving new flavors, there's something for everyone.

experiences.title: Nashville Street Food Tour With A Local Guide
experiences.description: Embark on a flavorful adventure through East Nashville and 12South with our guided culinary tour, where you'll experience the best of Southern cuisine and trendy eateries. Taste delights like catfish tacos, Tennessee whiskey glazed donuts, and pulled pork while discovering the rich culinary traditions of Nashville. Your knowledgeable guide will lead you to iconic landmarks, including Dolly Parton's studio, and share fascinating stories about the city’s musical heritage. Perfect for food enthusiasts and culture seekers alike, this tour offers an immersive dive into Nashville's vibrant food scene and history.

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co Premium Tasting Experience with Guide
experiences.description: You will get to taste offerings that are limited and rare with a guided whiskey expert. You will get to try whiskey straight from the barrel that will include Rye and Bourbon.

experiences.title: Nelson's Green Brier Distillery Guided Tour with Tastings
experiences.description:
​​Digging into the past didn’t turn up skeletons and scandals for brothers Andy and Charlie Nelson; more like sour mash and stills. After discovering their triple great grandfather was one of the most successful whiskey distillers in pre-prohibition America, the brothers vowed to revive the since-forgotten family business. If you’re into sunken ships and lost gold, a woman running a distillery before women could vote and the rebirth of a Nashville business after 100 years, you’ll be sucked into this story.
Sample gold medal award-winning Nelson’s Green Brier Tennessee Whiskey, the spirit based on the wheated mash bill recipe for Tennessee’s oldest whiskey and mellowed in a sugar maple charcoal bed. Taste the perfected blends of two, modern-day, straight bourbon whiskeys crafted by the Nelson Brothers, and finish your tasting with strong and sweet Louisa’s coffee caramel pecan liqueur.

experiences.title: Downtown Nashville Food Tour: Bites Beyond Broadway
experiences.description:
Embark on a 3-hour culinary adventure with 5 unforgettable tasting stops. Savor a diverse range of local flavors, from elevated Southern classics to comforting favorites, all crafted with seasonal ingredients.

As you stroll through the vibrant streets of Nashville, your guide will reveal fascinating history and hidden gems even locals don’t know. Between bites, you’ll discover iconic landmarks like the historic Ryman Auditorium and the architectural grandeur of the Schermerhorn Symphony Center, all while uncovering stories that blend Nashville’s storied past with its dynamic present.

Whether you’re a first-time visitor craving an authentic taste of Nashville or a local eager to reconnect with the city’s evolution, this tour promises a one-of-a-kind journey. Book now and explore the heart of Music City like never before!

experiences.title: Nashville Barrel Co "Flight from the Barrel" Whiskey Tasting
experiences.description: Get the chance to try whiskey straight from the barrel at cask strength! You will get to pick from Bourbon, Rye, Tennessee Whiskey, Rum and agave!

experiences.title: The Ultimate Wine, Shine & Bourbon Experience
experiences.description:
Check out our reviews! This is an experience not offered like any other and cannot be experienced the same way on your own. Visit multiple distilleries...not just one! We created this tour to share our passion of local (SMALL BUSINESS) moonshine and wine locations! 

People love this tour because you will be visiting as friends! From private VIP backstage to sampling, its all included!

I will be showing you real life working stills and getting behind the scenes where people can't go. You will be treated as VIP guests at all the locations we visit. 

During our walk we will have a couple of stopping points where we will go over the fun (NOT DRY) history and tidbits of moonshine and of course talk about "how the old-timers did it".

This tour will be action packed for the full 3 hours you are with me with the goal of trying different wines and over 15 different flavors of all proofs and even a moonshine cocktail!

- Mobility scooter accessible

experiences.title: Nashville's Sweetest Food Tour: Taste Nashville's Best Donuts
experiences.description:
Our tour begins in the Sobro (South of Broadway) neighborhood at Parlor Doughnuts, one of the newest editions to the area. Here we’ll try some of their amazing donuts, featured above. After that, we’ll take a leisurely walk through downtown, stopping along the way to talk about the major entertainment district along Broadway. We’ll then continue our way to two amazing donut shops in the Arts District. We’ll end our tour at Donut Distillery in the Assembly Food Hall, which has plenty of options for delicious donuts, as well as other amazing food and drinks. 

This is one of our most fun tours for friends, family, locals, and visitors. Also - if you’re planning a bachelor or bachelorette party, please let us know. We also have special packages available to make your day even more amazing. Hope to see you soon!

experiences.title: Walking Food & Drink Tour of Downtown Nashville
experiences.description:
Experience downtown Nashville through the eyes of a local on this award-winning 3 to 3.5-hour walking food tour. Recognized by Tripadvisor as one of the Top 1% of Experiences Worldwide, A Little Local Flavor has welcomed 23,000+ guests, earned 2,700+ five-star reviews, and helped direct nearly $1.5 million to locally owned Nashville businesses.

Come hungry! Visit 6 locally owned restaurants and tasting rooms as you savor Tennessee barbecue, shrimp and grits, a locally brewed beer, two handcrafted cocktails, and a tasting at a local distillery. Dine at a James Beard Award semifinalist, explore one of downtown Nashville's most historic venues, hear the stories behind iconic landmarks, and soak in the city's legendary live music.

Generous tastings add up to a hearty meal. Every stop is locally owned, every dish is made from scratch, and our passionate local guides share insider stories and recommendations to help you experience Nashville like a local.

experiences.title: Nashville's Wildest Honky Tonk Public Party Bus (21+)
experiences.description:
Experience Nashville’s most iconic, one-of-a-kind party on wheels – the Honky Tonk Party Express, Nashville's only honky tonk on wheels! This isn't just a tour; it's a full-blown dance party, taking you through the heart of downtown Nashville.

Get ready to boot scoot down Broadway in our custom built, open-air party buses. Dance it out on our led light-up dance floor while our DJ plays all your favorite songs. 

VOTED NASHVILLE'S BEST PRE-GAME, enjoy icy cold drinks served by our onboard while our professional party bus driver navigates the streets of downtown Nashville giving you a true Honky Tonk party on wheels!

 - Unique way to experience Nashville in our mobile honky tonk bar

 - 1 hour and 45 minute party Tour
 (Purchase drinks on-site before you board) 

 - Party with up to 25 of your friends. 

 - Load up at our exclusive honky tonk bar - "The Honky Tonk Hideaway" with a full bar, kitchen and Nashville's wildest mechanical bull!

 - 21+ tour

experiences.title: Downtown Chattanooga Food Tour
experiences.description: Chatt Taste Food Tours, LLC showcases the transformation of dining and local businesses in Downtown Chattanooga through guided food tours. Visit 3-4 restaurants locations effortlessly for the same amount of time and money as a conventional dining experience. With the surge of available eateries, Chatt Taste has dubbed this era as "Chattanooga's Culinary Renaissance". Since our start, Chatt Taste has been identified as a TOP 10 Food Tour in the country based on a USA Today poll.

experiences.title: Nashville 12South District Authentic Food Tour with 7 Tastings
experiences.description:
Traverse Nashville’s most iconic corridor where residential charm meets high-end Southern chic. Our 12 South Food Tour is a curated stroll through a district that has transformed from a quiet suburb into a world-class destination for fashion and country music royalty.

Walk in the footsteps of legends. As we wander down vibrant 12th Avenue, you’ll feel the creative pulse of a neighborhood shaped by stars like Sheryl Crow, Reese Witherspoon, and Dolly Parton. We’ll pause for essential photos at the legendary Nash Angel wings and the original "I Believe in Nashville" Mural, symbols of a community that prides itself on local grit and global style.

A Deep Dive into Local History. Explore historic landmarks like the 1920s-era Waverly Belmont Elementary and the lush greenery of Sevier Park, home to the historic Sunnyside Mansion.

An Elevated Narrative of Flavor. Our gastronomy is a sophisticated reflection of Nashville's communal culture.

experiences.title: Nashville: Authentic Food Tour with 5 Tastings of Local Dishes
experiences.description:
East Nashville has always done things its own way. Five Points and Historic East Edgefield grew back from the 1916 Great Fire with Victorian streets, an arts corridor, and a food scene rooted in Tennessee tradition. Your tour starts at Hunter's Station, a former automotive garage on Main Street, and moves through blocks shaped by the same spirit of reinvention. The food follows: Double Cheese Burger, a 2-Bone Rib (Southern style), Bee Bite (Yemeni Honey Pastries), Nashville hot chicken, a crispy catfish taco, and a Secret Dish kept under wraps until you're there.

12SOUTH - Uncover the city's trendiest avenue with our guides. Explore vibrant streets boasting cool coffee shops, stylish eateries, and restored buildings. Discover unique shops and maybe even a celebrity-frequented dress store. Indulge in the finest local bites and drinks during this exciting adventure!

experiences.title: Taste of Downtown Memphis Food Tour
experiences.description: There’s no better way to get acquainted with Memphis than by tasting some of its most acclaimed foods.  You’ll sample the very best of Memphis cuisine from BBQ nachos to southern tamales to delectable desserts. Memphis offers a plethora of choices from delicious and historic family-owned, local restaurants to trendy award winning Chefs. We provide a local, sustainable experience tasting a variety of foods, allowing you to feel like a native Memphian.  Your guide will provide a sampling of culture and history sprinkled throughout this walking tour. 2 person minimum per booking

experiences.title: Brewery Hop-On Hop-Off Trolley Tour of Nashville
experiences.description:
Travel in a vintage trolley on a convenient 1-hour loop for a Nashville beer tour unlike any other. Hop on/off at your brewery picks!

Music City’s only hop-on hop-off trolley brewery tour includes unlimited rides the day of your ticket to explore the Nashville beer scene. With 7 different brewery stops on our 1-hour loop you are sure to find something for everyone. We visit Honeytree Meadery, Stoke Haus Brewing & BBQ, Tailgate East, Xul Beer Co., East Nashville Beer Works, Bearded Iris Brewing and Monday Night Preservation Society.

We make it easy to visit your choice of local unique neighborhood craft breweries providing safe, responsible, and fun transportation on your schedule. Hop-on and start your day at any of the 7 stops on our loop.

PLEASE NOTE: We only depart once from downtown each day (Omni Hotel Nashville/5th Ave side) and return several times in the evening. Our downtown departure is at 11:50am (daily). 
You can also meet us at ANY brewery on our tour and start there!

experiences.title: Taste of Nashville Food & Sightseeing Tour
experiences.description:
On this fun and delicious tour, sample the best of Nashville's classic cuisine and visit some amazing places along the way. We'll enjoy a frosty local cocktail, taste hand-made spirits, visit a bakery with a history, enjoy Centennial Park, where you'll learn about the Parthenon, Vanderbilt, and more. Experience whole-hog barbecue at it's very best and learn the secrets that make it so amazing. Feel the heat with authentic Nashville Hot Chicken. Lots of food, fun, and local insights! 

Along the way, you'll see sights such as the Capitol, Bicentennial Mall, Sounds stadium, Germantown, the Cumberland River, Marathon Village, East Nashville's Five Points, Nissan Stadium, and much more!

We may substitute or alter the specific stops and foods, based on daily closures or events.

Travel in our comfortable high-roof touring van with a knowledgeable and fun local guide. The very best way to experience Nashville's neighborhoods, history, and amazing local foods!

experiences.title: Murals & Mimosas Tour
experiences.description:
Kickstart your day diving into Nashville’s hippest neighborhoods to see popular murals, pose for the best pics, and top it off with a mimosa and small bites. Grab your friends and a camera—this mural sightseeing tour with sweets and sips is not to be missed. Whatever the occasion, this tour makes parties easy since all planning, coordinating, and transportation are handled.

Travel to multiple eclectic Music City areas with an expert guide to see street art and wall murals. Snap pics at top spots on this three-hour tour, plus one stop for mimosas and bites!

Itinerary
- Depart from the Omni in Downtown Nashville near Rep. John Lewis Way South. Feel free to BYOB for the bus. (21+, please drink responsibly.)

- Sightseeing Murals Tour
Explore neighborhoods like downtown, the Gulch, & Capital View. Guests see 10+ murals and get out to take photos at many stops. Includes one stop for a drink and snack at a local Nashville spot.

- Return to the Omni in Downtown Nashville.

experiences.title: Private Small Group Nashville Food & Sightseeing Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy Nashville's favorite foods and a private sightseeing tour exclusively for your group. Visit Nashville neighborhoods and landmarks with your private guide, and sample our quintessential foods along the way. Discover the food, fun, and facts that make Nashville a unique and fascinating city! Along the way, sample our signature Nashville Hot Chicken, Whole-hog BBQ, our own frosty alcohol milkshake, and the quirky and local neighborhoods that showcase Nashville's creativity. BYOB on the van! It's fun, social, and delicious!

experiences.title: Nashville's Big Machine Distillery Guided Tour with Tastings
experiences.description:
Centered in the heart of downtown Nashville, at The Big Machine Brewery & Distillery you can get a taste of Nashville like no other. Here we are home to hand-crafted spirits: Big Machine Platinum Filtered Vodka, Double Spiked Coolers, Clayton James Tennessee Whiskey, Abernathy Gin, All Mighty Moonshine, and more!

Experience how our custom Platinum filter reinvents vodka as you know it! As the only distillery in the United States to use such technology, we bring the vodka tasting experience to new levels creating The Smoothest Tasting Vodka, Period!

Join us at Big Machine and experience the platinum standard!

experiences.title: Downtown Nashville Food Tour With Sidewalk Food Tours
experiences.description:
Join us on a 3-hour food walking tour of Downtown Nashville (The Gulch) On your eating extravaganza, you will savor amazingly delicious foods from 5 unique restaurants, eateries, and bakeries. 

In addition to all the mouthwatering foods you'll be enjoying, your guide will discuss the history, culture, and food scene of the neighborhood. We tell the story of Downtown Nashville through its food and the people who prepare it. Lace-up your sneakers and come eat with us on an eating adventure through Downtown Nashville (The Gulch)

experiences.title: Tennessee Whiskey Experience: Bus Tour with 11+ Whiskey Tastings
experiences.description:
The Tennessee Whiskey Experience is your chance to go beyond the big names and explore the heart of the state’s craft distilling scene. This small-group tour visits three award-winning, locally loved distilleries, each offering a different take on Tennessee spirits — including whiskey, bourbon, and other spirits.

You’ll enjoy guided tastings at each stop, transportation in a comfortable tour vehicle, and insights from a local guide who knows their whiskey and the region’s history. Along the way, you’ll get a behind-the-scenes look at how Tennessee whiskey is made — from grain to glass — in places most tourists don’t discover on their own.

This is a great choice for guests looking for something authentic, relaxed, and off the beaten path. Whether you’re a whiskey connoisseur or just curious to try something new, this tour gives you a full taste of what Tennessee spirits are all about — without having to worry about a single detail.

experiences.title: French Cooking Class in Houston (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the flavors and elegance of French bistro cooking in this immersive culinary class. This 3-course experience celebrates refined techniques and bold flavors.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

 - First course: Salmon rillettes spread over toasted baguette.
 - Second course: Pork tenderloin with mustard sauce, plus potatoes au gratin and bacon-wrapped green beans.
 - Dessert: A decadent chocolate mousse with silky texture and deep cocoa notes.

This class combines professional instruction with approachable recipes, leaving you confident to recreate French bistro dishes at home. Bring wine or beer to enjoy with your freshly prepared meal.

experiences.title: Candle Pouring Workshop at Paddywax Candle Bar Dallas
experiences.description: When it comes to creative experiences in Dallas, your candle pouring workshop offers something truly unique. We provide a welcoming atmosphere, expert instruction, and the perfect mix of fun and learning. Whether you’re a Dallas local or visiting from out of town, this workshop is a top pick for making lasting memories.

experiences.title: Upscale Italian Cooking Class in Houston (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming Houston kitchen and explore the flavors of refined Italian cooking in this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. With a maximum of 8 guests, this intimate session highlights timeless techniques across a four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Zuppa Toscana with sausage, kale and potatoes
- Main course: Chicken marsala with a rich wine sauce and risotto
- Side dishes: Garlic-sautéed broccolini and carrots
- Dessert: Lemon cream cake with layers of citrus cream

With guidance from your local chef, you’ll gain confidence in crafting Italian sauces, risotto and vegetables with finesse. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy with the meal, making this both an educational and celebratory culinary evening.

experiences.title: Cake Decorating in Houston
experiences.description: Join us for a hands-on cake decorating class! Experience the joy of transforming your pre-baked cake into delicious masterpieces, guided by our instructor. This unique class combines skill-building, camaraderie, and the creation of beautifully decorated cakes. From the crumb coat to the final touches, discover the satisfaction of newfound talents to share with loved ones. Make your mark in the sweet world of cake decorating with us!

experiences.title: Cook Authentic Chinese Feast in Houston (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming Houston kitchen and experience the flavors of authentic Chinese cooking in this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop introduces essential skills and bold recipes that go beyond takeout.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Hot and sour soup with shiitake mushrooms and tofu
- Appetizer: Crispy shrimp toast with a savory shrimp filling
- Main course: Sesame chicken or beef coated with sesame seeds
- Side dish: Vegetable fried rice with colorful vegetables

With step-by-step guidance from your local chef, you’ll gain confidence in seasoning, frying and layering flavors to recreate these dishes at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy alongside their meal in a relaxed, small-group setting.

experiences.title: Downtown San Antonio Riverwalk Tamale Cooking Class
experiences.description: Our cooking class offers a unique experience including a cultural presentation on the history of tamales to give each bite more of an impact while you sip on our iconic El Jefe Margarita and enjoy some of our famous guacamole. The tamales that you make alongside your guided instructor will have you leaving inspired to carry the tradition on yourselves at home and with your friends and family.

experiences.title: Drop In and Make Mosaic Art
experiences.description: Drop-in mosaics are perfect for playful experimentation in your flexible, inclusive environment. It’s a great way to try something new, get your hands creatively busy, and experience one of the most satisfying artistic outlets in Austin. Come see why your mosaic drop-in is one of the city’s most inviting open studio experiences!

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Local Brewery in Dallas
experiences.description: Craving bold Southern flavor with a handmade twist? Step into a welcoming local venue where you’ll roll up your sleeves and turn simple ingredients into fresh Cajun butter fettuccine that tastes far better than anything from a box. Store-bought pasta is officially on notice. Chef Dee brings more than 12 years of culinary and hospitality experience, making every step approachable and fun. You’ll mix flour, eggs, oil and salt into silky pasta dough before rolling and cutting your own fettuccine. Then you’ll build a rich Cajun butter sauce with garlic, butter, herbs and bold Louisiana-inspired seasoning before tossing everything together into one irresistible bowl. Along the way, you’ll practice dough preparation, rolling, cutting and sauce-making techniques you can recreate at home. Whether you’re visiting the city or simply looking for a memorable night out, you’ll leave with new kitchen confidence and a dinner worth bragging about.

experiences.title: Premiere Wine and Chocolate Experience in Fredericskburg
experiences.description: Indulge in the exquisite art of wine and chocolate pairing at Hill Country Chocolate in Fredericksburg, Texas in the heart of the Texas Hill Country. Over the course of 90 minutes, guests will savor a selection of wines from the exclusive DKM Cellars portfolio, meticulously paired with handcrafted chocolates that highlight unique flavor combinations. The experience begins with an enticing welcome featuring brittles and artisanal chocolates, including a signature cocoa nib goat cheese drizzled with Texas honey and a wall of agave bourbon glazed candied bacon. Led by a knowledgeable chocolatier team, this guided tasting offers insight into chocolate making while you enjoy stunning views of the factory through floor-to-ceiling windows. This is a perfect retreat for chocolate and wine enthusiasts alike. This is considered the ultimate wine and chocolate tasting in the United States.

experiences.title: Sushi Making Cooking Class at a Local Tap Room in Austin
experiences.description: Discover the art of sushi-making in this hands-on cooking class with Chef Melanie, hosted at a local taproom in Austin! Learn step by step how to create three delicious sushi rolls, starting with a perfectly seasoned sushi rice base. Then, layer fresh ingredients to build a creamy veggie roll, a classic California roll, and a bold tuna roll with fresh ahi tuna. Under Chef Melanie’s expert guidance, you’ll practice rolling techniques and experiment with toppings like spicy mayo, black sesame, and Japanese 7-pepper spice. While you perfect your sushi skills, enjoy the lively atmosphere of the taproom, where craft beer is available for purchase to pair with your handmade rolls. Whether you're looking for a unique date night, a social event with friends, or a fun new skill, this sushi-making class is the perfect way to roll, sip, and savor. Book your spot today!

experiences.title: Art of Candle-making in Houston Texas
experiences.description:
Hello, I am KC, a Biochemist turned Chandler.

After studying chemicals and toxins and how they impact the environment and human health for many years, I started my all-natural journey using eco-friendly products and materials.

experiences.title: Galveston Red Light District Tour
experiences.description:
Step into Galveston’s most scandalous secret, where the police stopped at the bridge and vice ruled the island.

Return to an era where Galveston was known as "America’s Playground", a wide-open paradise of sin where gambling, booze, brothels, and back-room deals flourished under the protection of organized crime. As long as the money flowed, visitors were treated like family and indulgence came without consequence. Casinos pulsed through the night, and The Red Light District thrived behind unmarked doors. Corruption was no longer whispered, it was expected.

This was Galveston’s own Vegas dream, complete with world-class entertainers like Frank Sinatra, Sammy Davis Jr., and Dean Martin performing just steps away from prostitution, payoffs, and illicit pleasures.

On this tour, you’ll uncover the stories they tried to bury, the places where power was bought with favors, and how Galveston became one of the most notorious Red Light Districts in America, all hiding in plain sight.

experiences.title: Candle Making Class in Dallas
experiences.description: We focus on clean, toxin-free fragrances and guide you through the art of fragrance composition. Plus, we save your custom scent on file for reorders! Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, bonding with friends, or looking for a creative escape, this hands-on experience is perfect for everyone. Don't miss out—reserve your spot today!

experiences.title: Historic Galveston Red Light District Tour
experiences.description: Return to a time when the mob ran Galveston and their guests were treated as if they were family. When you crossed the bridge you enter "The Free State of Galveston," where the only rules were mob rules. The stars of the era were world class entertainers brought in to perform in the casinos, including Frank Sinatra, Sammy Davis Jr., and Dean Martin. Everyone was enjoying their own "Vegas Dream" right here in Galveston.

experiences.title: Viral Drip Bear Painting w/ RnB & Hip Hop Tunes
experiences.description:
Ready to vibe with us? Join our ultimate Hip Hop & R&B Paint & Sip experience and drip your own viral bear. The spot for great vibes, paint brushes and beats come together for an unforgettable experience.

All supplies included

experiences.description:
Hello, I am KC, a Biochemist turned Perfumer.

Hi, I’m a biochemist-turned-scent artist. With years of experience blending custom fragrances and hosting fun DIY workshops, I’ve helped thousands of guests craft candles, perfumes, and body products that tell their story through scent.

experiences.title: Luxury Candle Making Class Dallas
experiences.description: Unleash your creativity in exclusive Luxury BYOB Candle Making Class, where art and science unite to craft your own custom-scented masterpiece. In just one hour, you'll work with eco-friendly soy wax and explore over 60 luxurious non toxic fragrance options under expert guidance. - Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

Guided by expert instructors, you'll explore the art of blending fragrances from over 60 luxurious options, all while enjoying a complimentary beverage. In just one hour, you'll learn the science behind scent composition and leave with a unique 8oz masterpiece, tailored to your personal style. This eco-friendly experience not only nurtures your artistic side but also fosters a love for sustainable practices. Join fellow candle enthusiasts and let your imagination shine.

experiences.title: Dessert Candles & Karaoke in Houston
experiences.description:
Pipe, decorate and sing at Dessert Candles & Karaoke in Houston. Create two custom-scented dessert candles with whipped-wax swirls and decorative wax toppings, using piping bags and guidance from your instructor.

As your candles begin to set, the karaoke keeps the evening going. Sing a favorite song, cheer on your friends or simply enjoy the music in Studio 786 HTX’s glow-lit creative space. No crafting or singing experience is required.

This two-hour experience brings hands-on dessert-candle making and a relaxed karaoke night together for friends, dates, celebrations and solo travelers. All candle-making materials are included, and you take home both candles you create.

experiences.title: DIY Candle Making Class at a Trendy Distillery in Houston
experiences.description: Swap the usual “what should we do today?” debate for a fun, hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local distillery in Houston. In this hands-on experience, Instructor Cafi will guide you step by step as you design and pour your own custom candle. You’ll explore different scents, learn how fragrance, wax and wicks work together and create a candle that feels completely personal. And the best news? No experience is needed. Get ready for an experience that is creative, relaxing and way more memorable than sitting through another average happy hour. This class is ideal for couples looking for a unique date night, friends planning a girls’ night out, solo guests who want a calming creative escape and travelers searching for a local activity beyond the typical sightseeing list. Come for the cozy atmosphere, stay for the joy of making something with your own hands and leave with a custom candle that feels totally you.

experiences.title: Fiesta Flower Wine Meet the Winemaker at Florvino
experiences.description:
During Fiesta, Florvino's winemakers leave the cellars to spend time with you, share their story and the basics of how flower wine is crafted. 

The Fiesta Flower Wine event is presented by our winemakers and is inspirational, motivational, entertaining and educational. During the 90 minute journey you get to taste 6 different flower wines and discover how our winemakers learned their craft. 

We will take you via video and animation into the fields, where we harvest flower nectar and flower petals, and into the wine cellar where we craft our delicious flower wines. Let us bring the winery to you. 

Get ready to sip, laugh, learn and be truly inspired.

After the show, linger at the Florvino Wine Bar, enjoy some delicious cocktails, wine floats or the best charcuterie board in San Antonio. Every Fri & Sat evening you can also enjoy the live tunes of some of the best singer songwriters of the region.

experiences.title: French Cooking Class in Fort Worth (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
French technique, three courses, one unforgettable dinner. This hands-on class in Fort Worth. Hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, takes you from savory stuffed mushrooms to a butter-finished Béarnaise and a silky chocolate mousse – each dish a lesson in classical French cooking.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:

- Bacon & Blue Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms – cream cheese, blue cheese, bacon and chives
- Filet Mignon – Béarnaise sauce, butter, egg yolks and grilled asparagus
- Dark Chocolate Mousse – berries macerated in Grand Marnier and sugar

You will leave with the skills to prepare a sophisticated French dinner at home, from the first bite to the final dessert. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With a Local Chef in Dallas
experiences.description: Chocolate gets a serious upgrade in this hands-on class. You’ll start from scratch by combining semi-sweet chocolate, heavy cream, butter and vanilla extract into a rich, silky ganache. After chilling the mixture, you’ll learn how to roll and shape it into neat truffles before giving each one its own finishing touch with cocoa powder, chocolate sprinkles, crushed cookies or chopped pecans and almonds. Chef Dee’s beginner-friendly approach makes the techniques easy to follow, whether you’re already comfortable in the kitchen or still figuring out which way the whisk goes. You’ll spend two relaxed hours making, tasting and learning, then leave with a beautiful assortment of handcrafted chocolate truffles. Store-bought chocolates are officially on notice.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Cooking Class With Local Chef in Austin
experiences.description:
Learn how to make fresh pasta from scratch, mastering the techniques of mixing, kneading, rolling, and cutting to create delicate, silky noodles. Then, cook up a gourmet shrimp Alfredo dish, featuring plump, fresh shrimp infused with lemon zest and a rich, velvety Parmesan cream sauce. Whether you're an experienced home cook or just looking for a fun and unique night out, this class is the perfect way to learn, taste, and create. Book your spot today for an evening of handmade pasta, bold flavors, and craft beer in Austin!

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Local Distillery in Houston
experiences.description:
Ready to give pasta night a serious upgrade? Step into a lively local distillery and learn how to make fresh farfalle from scratch, even if your usual cooking technique involves opening a delivery app. You’ll combine flour, eggs, olive oil and sea salt into a smooth pasta dough, then practice kneading, rolling and shaping each piece into classic bow ties.

With expert guidance, you’ll learn how to handle fresh dough, create consistent pasta shapes and cook your farfalle for the ideal texture. The best part comes when you sit down to enjoy the pasta you made yourself, surrounded by the easygoing buzz of the venue. It’s hands-on, delicious and refreshingly low-pressure, whether you’re a local trying something new or exploring the city through its food scene.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Austin
experiences.description:
Making pasta from scratch somehow makes life feel dramatically more organized, even if it’s only for two hours. In this fun and interactive cooking class with Chef Erin, you will learn authentic pasta-making techniques in a relaxed social setting at a stylish Austin venue. This experience is perfect for date nights, friend outings or anyone tired of paying restaurant prices for pasta they could absolutely learn to make at home.

The class begins with preparing fresh pasta dough using flour, eggs and olive oil before learning how to knead and shape handmade tagliatelle. Chef Erin keeps every step approachable while sharing practical tips that make homemade pasta feel far less intimidating than expected. You will also prepare a flavorful marinara sauce with crushed tomatoes, garlic and basil while sharpening knife skills making fresh bruschetta with toasted bread, tomatoes and olive oil.

experiences.title: Fun Poke Bowl Cooking Class at a Local Distillery in Houston
experiences.description: A local Houston distillery sets the scene for a hands-on poke bowl session that puts fresh ingredients front and center. You’ll learn how to cook fluffy white or brown rice, practice safe knife handling and master different cuts for vegetables and fish. Then comes the star: sushi-grade ahi tuna tossed in a bright soy, ginger and sesame marinade with low-sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, red pepper flakes, green onions and sesame seeds. You’ll finish by assembling your bowl with creamy avocado, crisp cucumber, edamame, carrots and radish. Along the way, you’ll pick up useful techniques for handling raw fish safely and preventing cross-contamination. No culinary background needed, just an appetite for something fresh.

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class at a Local Brewery in Dallas
experiences.description: Sushi looks fancy, but making it yourself is much less intimidating than you think. At a local Dallas brewery, you’ll learn the tricks behind two fresh rolls, starting with a California roll made from nori, sushi rice, avocado, surimi and cucumber. You’ll learn how to properly cook and season sushi rice, prepare and portion your fillings, then roll and shape everything into tidy pieces. Next comes a bright veggie roll with mango, avocado and cucumber, giving you a chance to practice slicing, filling placement and rolling again. With Chef Jarrett’s approachable guidance and a laid-back setting, you can focus on learning, laughing and actually enjoying the process. By the end, you’ll have a complete meal you made yourself — and a few sushi-making skills worth showing off at home.

experiences.title: Gnocchi Making Class With a Local Chef in San Antonio
experiences.description:
Turn potatoes into something seriously delicious at a relaxed San Antonio brewery. You’ll mix potato, egg, flour and salt into a soft gnocchi dough, then roll and shape it by hand, learning the simple techniques behind those tender, pillowy bites. No intimidating pasta equipment or chef-level skills required. 

While your gnocchi takes shape, you’ll make a savory marinara from tomatoes, garlic, onion and Italian seasoning. You’ll learn how to season the sauce, cook the gnocchi and bring everything together before topping your finished dish with Parmesan and thyme. 

Then sit back and dig into your freshly prepared Italian meal while enjoying the casual brewery setting. It’s relaxed, social and hands-on from start to finish — and your potatoes are about to have a much better day than they expected.

experiences.title: Italian Pasta Cooking Class in Austin (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Two pasta shapes, two sauces, one seasonal Italian menu – this class in Austin, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, puts fresh pasta technique at the center of a four-course experience built around bold seasonal flavor.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Pimento Cheese with Cheddar, cream cheese and pimentos
- Capellini al Pomodoro with 00 flour, eggs, tomatoes and fresh herbs
- Tagliatelle con Crema with cream and Parmesan
- Seasonal Salad with spring mix, seasonal fruit, cheese, nuts and Dijon honey vinaigrette
- Olive Oil Gelato with milk, cream, eggs, sugar and extra virgin olive oil

You will leave knowing how to make two fresh pasta shapes and two sauces from scratch. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Make Pasta With a Local Chef at a Local Brewery in Dallas
experiences.description:
Nothing beats the moment fresh pasta hits a buttery Cajun sauce you made yourself. In a relaxed local venue buzzing with good energy, you’ll learn every step behind homemade Cajun butter fettuccine in a beginner-friendly session that feels more like cooking with a talented friend than sitting through a lesson.

Start by combining flour, eggs, oil and salt into fresh pasta dough, then roll and slice it into delicate fettuccine ribbons. Next, prepare a bold Cajun butter sauce with garlic, butter, herbs and signature Cajun seasoning before coating every strand in rich, savory flavor. You’ll sharpen practical skills like kneading, rolling, shaping pasta and balancing seasonings without feeling overwhelmed. Chef Dee’s approachable teaching style keeps things relaxed, so you can laugh through the flour clouds, enjoy every bite and head home with a recipe that deserves a permanent spot in your dinner rotation.

experiences.title: Mexican Street Tacos Cooking Class in Austin (3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Everything from scratch in 90 minutes – this hands-on cooking class in Austin, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, covers the full cycle of Mexican taco preparation: guacamole, homemade tortillas, braised chicken and an avocado chocolate mousse.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Guacamole and Pico de Gallo made from scratch
- Homemade Tortillas with masa harina
- Homemade Pasilla Sauce with ancho chiles
- Braised Chicken Street Tacos with cilantro, radishes, lime and cotija cheese
- Avocado Chocolate Mousse with non-dairy milk, orange juice, zest and cinnamon

You will leave ready to host a full scratch taco night at home – every element made by hand. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Thai Cooking Class in Austin (Includes 3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Three dishes, three techniques – this hands-on Thai cooking class in Austin, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, takes you through spring rolls, pad Thai and mango sticky rice using fresh, vibrant ingredients and authentic flavors.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Spring Rolls with romaine, cabbage, carrots, cucumber, green onions and cilantro
- Pad Thai with rice noodles, fresh vegetables and chicken
- Mango Sticky Rice with fresh mango and coconut milk

You will leave with three simple, flavorful Thai recipes to bring Southeast Asian cooking straight to your kitchen. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.

experiences.title: Austin BBQ Tour: 6 Tastings, Michelin Stops & Skip the Line
experiences.description:
Six barbecue stops in East Austin — including a MICHELIN One Star joint and two Bib Gourmand smokehouses — with skip-the-line access at every one and an air-conditioned ride between them. No walking in Texas heat, no three-hour queue, and enough food that most guests tap out before the last plate.

la Barbecue holds a MICHELIN One Star and a line that wraps the building. Micklethwait Craft Meats is a Bib Gourmand honoree and one of Food Network's 25 Best Food Trucks. KG BBQ is chef Kareem El-Ghayesh, a James Beard semifinalist, smoking lamb with Middle Eastern spice. Mum Foods makes the pastrami Texas Monthly's barbecue editor calls the best in the state. Parish Barbecue brings Louisiana heat from a pitmaster who cooked at Franklin.

Then a sixth stop we don't announce. It's sweet. You'll think you're finished eating. You aren't.

Between plates, your guide tells you how East Austin was built and why these blocks became America's most argued-about barbecue.

Come hungry.

experiences.title: Boat Shuttle to Ski Shores - Scenic Water Taxi Tour
experiences.description:
Enjoy a total 3 hour experience where you take a 20-25 minute cruise from the Loop 360 Boat Ramp to Ski Shores Cafe (Price includes round trip). The boat shuttle runs from the Loop 360 Bridge to Ski Shore Restaurant on the lake.

While at Ski Shores Cafe you can enjoy live music, dinner, Lake Austin Sunsets on the water, Brunch, etc. 
When you are ready to leave, just hop on the boat shuttle departure time from Ski Shores back to Loop 360. The shuttle picks up every hour on the hour until 9:00pm. (20-25 min Cruise each way)

Most groups stay a total of 2-3 hours at ski shores.

experiences.title: At-Home Private Wine or NA Wine Tasting Experience in Austin
experiences.description: We are excited to host your at-home, private tasting featuring local wines and/or non-alcoholic wines in Austin! Get ready to see, swirl, & sip with a expert Sommelier!

experiences.title: 2-Hour Express Austin Food Tour: Local Street Food Flavors
experiences.description:
Meet up in front of Cosmic Saltillo. A lush garden oasis serving up coffee, brews and cocktails in a unique setting that is the definition of what makes East Austin a top destination for locals to hang out at. 

We begin our 2 hour walking food tour with a leisure journey through a small part of the east side and stopping for the first food bite at a local favorite food truck that has grown with the neighborhood. There we will try a delicious falafel bite. 

Our journey will continue with a walk through the neighborhood taking in the Historic sites and street art to our 2nd destination, a place that was once a local convenient store turned brewery. There we try a Tex-Mex bite while learning about how this place became a local favorite brewery that has won multiple awards for their craft and a place that is literally off the beaten path.

We then end our food journey with a sweet, unique bite you can’t find anywhere else, from a local place with an Austin cult following.

experiences.title: Austin Street Art and Street Food Tour with Local Guide
experiences.description:
A tour of Austin’s best street art and most delicious food trucks.
sips, samples and snaps along the way

Includes a drink of choice and two (2) food truck snacks

Want to get to know Austin? First thing you need to know is there’s amazing art and delicious food on just about every street corner. We’re going to drive you around in our luxury Mercedes Sprinter van to learn more about the street art in Austin, and in doing so, learn more about Austin itself.

experiences.title: Grapevine Main Street Food Tour + Winery by Food Tours of America
experiences.description:
Taste your way through Historic Downtown Grapevine, where Texas food, local favorites and wine come together along historic Main Street. Enjoy 8 generous tastings with plenty of food for a meal at handpicked local stops, from Tex-Mex and house-smoked brisket at veteran-owned AJ’s on Main to a sweet treat at an artisan food hall and a custom olive oil trio tasting.

Between bites, discover the people and stories behind Grapevine, from its agricultural and railroad roots to its rise as one of North Texas’ best-known wine destinations. Explore historic Main Street, local landmarks and stories most visitors walk right past.

Finish at Messina Hof Grapevine Winery, inside a re-creation of the historic 1891 Wallis Hotel, with an included splash of Texas wine. Stay afterward and enjoy more time at the winery.

Texas food, local stories and a taste of Grapevine wine country—all in one delicious walk down historic Main Street.

experiences.title: Houston Distillery Tour with 4 Spirit Tastings
experiences.description:
Discover the art of distilling at William Price Distilling in Houston with a guided tour that provides a behind-the-scenes look at the spirit-making process. Enjoy a tasting flight featuring four of their unique in-house spirits, including whiskey and vodka. This engaging experience is perfect for whiskey enthusiasts, couples, groups, and anyone looking for a memorable outing in Houston. Guests will have access to the production area, barrel room, and tasting room while learning about the distillation process from knowledgeable guides.

- Guided distillery tour with production insights
- Tasting flight of four in-house spirits included
- Available multiple days a week at 6 PM, and 3pm on weekends
- Private tours for groups of 6+ can be arranged upon request

experiences.title: Private Pink Hummer 2 Limo Wine Tour in Fredericksburg
experiences.description:
Explore Texas Hill Country in style on this private Pink Hummer Limo wine tour. Enjoy visits to three top wineries, with tastings available for purchase at each stop. The experience includes a fun pink party bag, your choice of music, and the option to bring champagne to sip during your ride. With pick-up and drop-off from your Fredericksburg accommodation, this 5-hour tour is perfect for groups looking to enjoy a day of wine tasting and relaxation. Waters are provided, but please note that food is not allowed on board.

- Visit 3 pre-selected top wineries in Texas Hill Country
- Enjoy a private ride in a stylish Pink Hummer Limo
- Bring your favorite champagne and enjoy it during the ride
- Pick-up and drop-off in Fredericksburg city limits included

experiences.title: Howdy H-Town EADO Food Tour
experiences.description:
PUBLIC TOURS AVAILABLE OCTOBER - APRIL 

Taste some of the many flavors Houston has to offer as your guide walks you to five delicious venues. Through food, art and history you will see how EADO has evolved from Houston’s original Chinatown into one of the fastest growing neighborhoods in the country.

Sample delicious food from a bakery, a taco stand, a BBQ restaurant, a unique supermarket and a Vietnamese restaurant as you learn about the graffiti art, architecture, public art and green spaces that have helped shape EADO. 

2 miles of total walking with stops along the way.

experiences.title: Austin's Best Speakeasies 3-Hour Guided Tour
experiences.description:
This is our star tour, showing the very best speakeasy bars Austin has to offer—each with its own unique theme. 

We begin right at sunset at a hidden speakeasy disguised as a travel agency just outside downtown. This tiki-themed venue features vibrant, exotic décor, theatrical drinks, and unmatched creativity.

From there, we head to a hidden luxury speakeasy tucked inside a casual Mexican restaurant, where the atmosphere and décor are breathtaking and the aesthetic alone is enough to consider this location one of Austin's best speakeasies!

We then journey through the heart of downtown, sharing Austin’s rich history while passing landmarks such as the Texas State Capitol and the famously haunted Driskill Hotel. Then we slip into an exclusive speakeasy—accessible only by invitation—hidden in a back alley behind the Driskill. Intimate and luxurious, it serves some of the most unforgettable cocktails you’ll ever taste.

This isn’t just a tour—it’s Austin’s ultimate speakeasy experience.

experiences.title: VIP Breakfast with NASA Astronaut & Space Center Houston Ticket
experiences.description:
Enjoy an exclusive, once-in-a-lifetime experience found only in Houston, where the story of space exploration comes alive through the eyes of a veteran astronaut.

Begin with an elegant brunch catered by Wolfgang Puck Catering, followed by a captivating presentation and private Q&A session with your guest astronaut. Hear firsthand stories, gain rare insight into life in space, and connect with one of the pioneers of human exploration.As a special memento, each guest receives a personalized photograph from the astronaut—a keepsake of an extraordinary encounter.

This unique experience also includes General Admission for the NASA Space Center allowing your group to explore the remarkable legacy of NASA and human spaceflight once breakfast is over! Finish your day with an amazing tour of the NASA Rocket Park —the very place where Apollo 11's famous Saturn V rocket lies for observation. 

Exclusive. Inspiring. Unforgettable. A truly unique Houston experience you won’t find anywhere else.

experiences.title: Downtown Plano Walking Tour with Food and Drink
experiences.description:
We are Texas born and Texas proud. Our tours feature delicious food at 3 different restaurants. We also include 2 alcoholic beverages and a dessert. We offer retail therapy in addition to eating!
Our guides know the area and want to share what makes the neighborhood unique. We provide excellent customer service. Engaging activity for locals and visitors, young and young at heart.

experiences.title: Capitol Reef Photography Tours
experiences.description:
On every tour, you will learn about your camera, settings, composition and more. I have chosen these great locations based on ease of access, quality images and great lighting and times. 

As a professional landscape photographer, you can book with absolute confidence that you will enjoy, learn, and laugh during these photography tours.

You will also see landscapes that no one else gets to experience. As a Utah local, explorer, and photographer, I make these one-of-a-kind tours!

experiences.title: Moab Half-Day Morning Rafting – Colorado River and Fisher Towers
experiences.description:
Start your day with a scenic, family-friendly rafting trip on the Colorado River near Moab. This approximately four-hour adventure explores the section locals call the “Moab Daily,” surrounded by red-rock cliffs, Professor Valley and views toward Fisher Towers.

Mild Class I–II rapids make this an excellent choice for first-time rafters, families and multigenerational groups. Help paddle, enjoy the splashy sections or relax while your guide shares stories about the area’s geology, history and desert landscape.

Way to Moab is a small, owner-operated company focused on personal service and a welcoming river experience. Your trip includes a professional guide, rafting equipment, personal flotation devices, transportation from our downtown Moab shop, drinking water, snacks and water guns.

The morning departure leaves your afternoon open for Arches, Canyonlands or more time exploring Moab.

experiences.title: Zen Garden Yoga Bliss Experience
experiences.description:
Experience yoga bliss in this private Zen Garden with spectacular views of the mountains and the red cliffs of Snow Canyon. Renew, restore, and connect to nature and your higher self immersed in natural beauty.

Yes, you can linger longer and enhance your experience: 
Add a homestay and make this your adventure base camp.
Add a guided hiking adventure tailored to your interests.

experiences.title: Bryce Canyon Photography Tours
experiences.description:
Sunrise Tour: If you want to experience the golden glow of sunrise in Bryce Canyon at the perfect spots and at the best times, this is the tour for you! As a local guide and professional photographer, you can expect only the best from each of these tours! 

Astro Tour: Witness some of the darkest night skies in the world! You will be in disbelief as you see the illuminated Milky Way Galaxy stretch across the entire sky, horizon to horizon. The silence of the night is extremely special that not many people get to experience. You will feel small among the towering hoodoos that make up the park.

experiences.title: Ravens Rim Red Rock Challenge Course Adventure
experiences.description: A guided red rock adventure awaits at the Raven’s Rim Challenge Course, where a blend of climbing, balancing, and controlled jumps create an unforgettable experience embedded in stunning sandstone. Professional guides will support you through thrilling challenges, including a via ferrata for safe climbing, a tightrope walk to test your balance, and a daring wall run. Navigate a spacenet suspended in a natural pothole and finish with a jump off a suspension bridge, perfectly controlled with an auto-belay system. The adventure wraps up with a guided rock climb, catering to both beginners and seasoned adventurers eager to explore Moab's breathtaking landscape.

experiences.title: 3 Hour Guided E Bike Tour in Zion National Park
experiences.description:
Learn what makes Zion National Park a world class destination with one of our knowledgeable local guides, while avoiding the lines and crowds so you can spend more time with the task at hand; enjoying your visit to Zion National Park.

Top of the line e-bikes, and highly trained guides means you can travel confidently and with ease to the must see sites of Zion Canyon.

experiences.title: Private Slovak Kolache & Babka Home Baking Class in Park City
experiences.description:
Dive into this 2-hour journey of mouth-watering Slovak flavors and uncover the secrets behind traditional family recipes. Hosted by Lenka, a passionate baker and food lover from Slovakia currently living, eating, and baking in Park City, Utah! She learned to cook and bake from her grandmother when she was eight, and still uses her valuable recipes. This 1.5 private, hands-on baking class is sure to take your taste buds on an unforgettable adventure. Learn to bake traditional kolaches (breakfast pastries) and babka (sweet braided bread of Jewish origins) from scratch. Discover the vibrant culture through local dishes as you bake two homemade specialties in Lenka's cozy home kitchen, then savor the result with her.

• Private baking lesson in a local home in Park City
• Learn to bake Kolaches and Babka in a hands-on baking class
• Introduction to Slovak culture and cuisine
• Vegetarian, Vegan and Lactose free options available

experiences.title: Day of Photography in Moab, Arches & Canyonlands
experiences.description:
We will visit at least two world class locations for photography in Utah's Canyonlands in the morning (sunrise), as well as several great spots in iconic Arches National Park in the afternoon (sunset). I have traveled extensively in search of amazing photographic locations, and it is hard to beat Arches, Dead Horse Point and the Islands in the Sky district of Canyonlands National Park. 

I will show you great locations, and make suggestions on photographic composition and subject matter. I can even help you with your camera settings if you are a beginner. We will take a break for lunch (not included) during the middle of the day when the light is not as good.

experiences.title: Sunset Zipline Adventure at Raven Rim
experiences.description:
Soar above the stunning Moab canyons on the Sunset Zipline Adventure, where thrill meets tranquility. Begin with a scenic UTV ride to the summit of our private red rock property and cross a suspension bridge before zipping through the air on six exhilarating zip lines. As the adrenaline fades, unwind at our exclusive sunset overlook with s’mores and beverages, soaking in the breathtaking desert sunset. Each tour is timed to perfection to catch the sunset's vibrant colors over the canyon, making for a memorable conclusion to an adventurous day.

- Experience six thrilling zip lines with stunning canyon views
- Scenic UTV ride and suspension bridge crossing included
- Relax with s’mores and beverages at a private sunset overlook
- Departure times adjusted seasonally to align with sunset

experiences.title: Private Guided Tour of Salt Lake City
experiences.description:
Experience the Soul of the Crossroads: The BeUTAHful SLC Tour
Why settle for a bus window view when you can feel the pulse of the city?

Salt Lake City is more than just a gateway to the mountains—it’s a vibrant tapestry of pioneer history, and world-class architecture. At BeUTAHful Tours, we don’t just show you the sights; we tell you the stories that the plaques leave out.

What Makes Our Tour Different?
Most tours give you dates and names. We give you the "why." From the spiritual gravity of Temple Square, to the beautiful architecture of the state capitol, we provide a balanced, insider’s look at what makes Salt Lake tick.

The Icons: Stand in the shadow of the Salt Lake Temple and marvel at the acoustics of the Tabernacle.

The Views: Scale the heights of the Utah State Capitol for a panoramic vista that proves why we call this place "BeUTAHful."

The Heritage: Step back in time at Heritage Park and walk the same paths as the early settlers.

experiences.title: Moab Rivertrippers Half Day Rafting Trip - Colorado River ~ FUN!
experiences.description:
Raft the iconic Colorado River through Castle Valley, also known as the Fisher Towers section just outside Moab. This is the stretch every Moab rafting trip is built around, even if you see it called by different names. No matter the name, you are on the same legendary section of the Colorado River.

Splash, laugh, and cool off as you move through a mix of calm sections and fun rapids. The river typically features Class I and II rapids, with occasional Class III during higher water earlier in the season, making it a great fit for all experience levels.

We are a smaller, more personal outfitter, focused on quality over volume, so you get a more relaxed and connected experience on the water.

With over 40 years of experience, our team delivers a smooth, well run trip from start to finish.

experiences.title: Half Day Guided Whitewater Rafting in Moab
experiences.description: Navigate the thrilling waters of the Colorado River on a half-day whitewater rafting adventure in Moab, Utah. Starting at the exhilarating Onion Creek Rapid, this 4-hour trip features class II/III rapids that promise both excitement and stunning views of the majestic red rock formations. With all gear provided and expert guidance, you’ll paddle through the Fisher Tower’s section, making memories with every splash. Perfect for adventurers looking to dive right into the action.

experiences.title: Whitewater Rafting on the Colorado River
experiences.description: Our guided trips are in 6-person paddle rafts making for big fun. The section of Colorado River is a beautiful section of class II whitewater. We provide a healthy and delicious lunch on this all-inclusive tour. Beautiful scenery, towering red rock walls, and great guides is what you can expect with a Paddle Moab trip.

experiences.title: Moab Afternoon Half Day Rafting Trip - Colorado River
experiences.description:
Castle Valley is the poster child for western landscapes, and you’ve probably already seen it somewhere in a movie, TV show, or commercial. And if somehow you have, in fact, never laid eyes on Castle Valley before, you’re not going forget it once you do!

This serene section of the Colorado River moseys through a big beautiful red-rock canyon. As for the waters here along the Colorado River, it stays pretty warm from late spring to early fall. 

You’ll spend 2 hours on the water floating, with a few Class II rapids to cool you off along the way. Expect plenty of fascinating interpretations and fun stories from your river guide on this mild trip!

experiences.title: Moab Full-Day Rafting: Colorado River Adventure
experiences.description:
Experience the beauty of a rafting trip along the Colorado River near Fisher Towers, a short drive from Moab. Seemingly untouched by civilization, the landscape of stunning red rock canyons cut by the Colorado River provides awe-inspiring vistas throughout the day. Between thrilling bouncy rapids, you can swim, take photos and listen as your guide shares informative commentary about the ecology, wildlife and human history of the region. 

This full-day trip starts by rafting upstream from Moab near stunning Fisher Towers and cover a 14-mile (22-km) section of the Colorado River. A combination of stunning canyon scenery and splashy white water makes for a fun day and photographer’s dream. Between rapids, drift lazily between soaring canyon walls and marvel at the red rock landscape along the river. At lunchtime, your guides serve a buffet-style picnic during a stop on a riverside beach.

experiences.title: Distill Your Own Gin In Our Private Hands-on Class
experiences.description: Our gin school is one of only a few in the country, that allows you to develop and distill your own gin!

experiences.title: 10 VIP Group Yellowstone 5 Day Tour Salt Lake City Round Trip
experiences.description:

• Comfort Upgraded in All Aspect VIP Exclusive First-Class NAPPA Leather Seats, Extra-Spacious Interior, Equipped with Ventilation, Heating and Massage Functions, for a Luxurious Journey. 
• Five-star reviews, quality guaranteed, attentive service, making your trip more worry-free 
• Starlink Online - Equipped with Starlink satellite network throughout the journey, with full Wi-Fi coverage throughout the vehicle, ensuring seamless connectivity for every trip. 
• Thoughtful amenities - Bottled water, snacks, binoculars, and other amenities are provided on board, significantly enhancing comfort and overall experience.

experiences.title: Colors of Moab Southwest Watercolor Workshop 2026
experiences.description: Set against the breathtaking red rock landscapes of Moab, Utah, this watercolor plein air workshop, led by award-winning artist Carol Newsom, invites participants of all skill levels to explore their creativity. Over five immersive days, you'll paint iconic desert vistas and receive personalized guidance, live demonstrations, and constructive critiques. Evenings provide a relaxed atmosphere for connecting with fellow artists while savoring local cuisine. This experience uniquely blends expert instruction with the stunning beauty of nature, making it a perfect getaway for art lovers.

experiences.title: Country Dance and Western Culture Experience
experiences.description: Most dance classes teach steps. This experience explores the culture, history, and traditions behind country swing dancing in the American West. Guests receive personalized instruction while learning how dance has helped build community and connection across generations. No experience is required, making it an authentic and welcoming introduction to a unique part of American culture.

experiences.title: Desert Rock Climbing
experiences.description: Our Rock Climbing programs are tailored to an experience that you are looking for. We will meet you where your skill level is, your specific interests, and the type of day you want to have. Whether just for fun, educational, or for personal growth, we can make it happen!

experiences.title: Fun Sushi Making Class in Salt Lake City (3-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Discover the secrets to restaurant-quality sushi in this interactive class with Chef Nate, hosted through Classpop!. You’ll dive right in by prepping fresh fish and crisp vegetables, then practice the art of rolling with an authentic bamboo mat. On the menu: a California roll with avocado, cucumber and surimi; a spicy tuna roll made with ahi tuna and creamy avocado; and a Philadelphia roll featuring cream cheese, cucumber and avocado. Along the way, Chef Nate will share insider tips for balancing flavors, achieving tight, even rolls and presenting them beautifully. Beginner-friendly and totally hands-on, this class is great for date nights, foodie adventures or group hangs.

What to Expect:
- Step-by-step guidance from a talented chef who makes it make sense.
- A fun, beginner-friendly class where no one judges your knife skills.
- Tasting, laughing and leveling up your kitchen game.
- Ideal for: a solo outing, date night, girls’ night or group fun.

experiences.title: Private 6-Hour Custom Western Hat Design Experience in Park City
experiences.description: Create a one-of-a-kind custom western hat during a private hat making activity in Park City. Work with experienced hat shapers to personalize every detail, from the crown shape and brim style to the hat band and finishing touches. This hands-on experience combines traditional western craftsmanship with a personalized fitting and shaping process, resulting in a custom hat designed to match your individual style and fit.

experiences.title: Arches Full Day Private Tour & Hike
experiences.description:
This trip is tailored to you and your group, so we can make adjustments to the day based on your interests. Experience the red rocks at day break as you explore some of the over 2,000 arches in the park. Our seasoned guides will immerse you in Arches’ natural wonders, sharing the park’s formation story, indigenous cultures, historical significance, and insights into its diverse flora and fauna.

Enjoy a hassle-free adventure with our comfortable transportation services. We handle all the logistics, allowing you to relish the scenic drive without worrying about navigating unfamiliar roads. Our convenient pick-up locations cater to various lodging areas around Arches, ensuring your journey starts smoothly.

*Arches National Park now requires a timed-entry ticket in order to enter, booking a guide means you bypass this system!

experiences.title: Private full day tour and hike combo.
experiences.description: A private day of touring and hiking catered to your interests and skill level. Based on a few questions we will create a custom full day or multi day experience for you or your group. You are not one to follow the crowd, so why do that during your trip? Whether you are looking for moderate, active or challenging, we can deliver a unique hike and tour experience.

experiences.title: Salt Lake City Bike and Brew Tour
experiences.description:
The Bike and Brew tour of Salt Lake City gets you out on a bike, exploring our sites with local experienced guides, and includes visits to microbreweries with opportunities for tastings! It is about 3 hours from start to finish (can be modified), and is $74/person. Sightseeing locations on our Big City Loop Tour are built into the route. We also hop from one excellent microbrewery to another, as you are guided around the City in the absolute most fun way: on bikes! 
Questions are fielded by your personal, friendly, and locally-based tour guide. Each location has food options as well, so getting a bite to eat is an easily accessible option. 

We provide bicycles, helmets, water in bottles to drink, one sample at each brewery, and of course, the guided experience.

Must be 21+ and have valid ID on your person. 

Difficulty level: Mild

experiences.title: Sand Hollow Boat Charter for 3 Hours
experiences.description: Our company offers the nicest Master-craft water sports boat charters and tour in Utah at Sand Hollow State Park. Newer models and the convenience of on the water boat tours makes our company stand out from the competition. We have any type of water toy you can add to the boat charter. Great for families, retreats and small or large groups! All ages will love our luxury Master-Craft boat charters where you can enjoy all types of water sport activities; tubing, wake-surfing, knee-boarding, water skiing, wake-boarding and so much more. This will be the adventure of a lifetime. Choose when to start and stop and how many people you want to bring. Our tour boats can seat up to 18 people and are the nicest boat on the water!

experiences.title: East Zion: Sunset, S'mores, Stargazing Jeep Tour
experiences.description:
Join an unforgettable sunset Jeep tour that culminates in a cozy stargazing experience. This exclusive tour takes you to a private viewpoint where you can witness a stunning sunset without the need to hike. Afterward, gather around a campfire to enjoy warm s'mores while your knowledgeable guide shares fascinating tales of the night sky. Perfect for families and friends, this 2.5-hour journey combines adventure with relaxation, offering a unique opportunity to connect with nature and each other under the stars. 

- Experience a guided Jeep ride to a secluded sunset viewpoint
- Enjoy delicious s'mores by the campfire while stargazing
- Small group size for a personalized and engaging experience
- Ideal for all ages (2+), with hot chocolate provided for added comfort

experiences.title: Guided Uinta Forest 3-Mile Hike w/fire + Lunch/charcuterie Stop
experiences.description: Utah is an expansive destination. That makes finding the right hiking experience difficult sometimes. That's why we provide the best guided hikes in the area. Our 3.5-mile looped hikes feature the best traction equipment, a halfway stop for hot cider, conversation, and pictures. The trails are also looped trails which is particularly difficult to find in the winter months. Hikes are also led by local Utahans so learning the area, food options, and about other experiences to maximize your vacation has never been easier.

experiences.title: Day Trip Activity at Utah Mountain Backcountry with Box Lunch
experiences.description: Fall colors are at their best right now!!! Late September and early October is prime time and the forecast for those weeks looks promising, with sunshine, warm temperatures, and crisp mountain air. Come with us!!! We spend a whole day with you in the mountains. We bring all the gear, knowledge of the terrain, and provide transportation to help you have a memorable and fun filled day exploring what Utah mountains are all about. We operate on a US Forest Service Outfitting & Guiding Permit providing the authorization for us to take you in the Wasatch-Cache-Uinta National Forest. All the details are covered.

experiences.title: Award Winning, Projection-based, Axe Throwing
experiences.description: Red Giant Experiences has been recognized as an industry leader due to its commitment to quality experiences reflected in over 40 awards since 2018. Relax in between throwing at your own table and test out the full array of throwables with 15 digitally projected games that make this axe throwing experience fun for everyone. Order some cold drinks and delicious food while you enjoy the excitement of our top rated axe throwing experience and 2026 #1 rated axe throwing facility in Utah County by Utah Valley Magazine!

experiences.title: Salt Lake Scavenger Hunt with Tacos and Drinks
experiences.description:
Discover Salt Lake City's vibrant taco scene with the SLC Epic Taco Crawl. Enjoy four signature tacos from the city's top taco joints, paired with a refreshing drink and a sweet treat of mini churros. This self-guided adventure allows you to explore the downtown area's murals and local businesses at your own pace, all while engaging in a fun scavenger hunt. Perfect for food lovers and those looking to explore local culture, this crawl should take about 90 minutes to complete. 

- Savor 4 premium tacos from must-try taco spots
- Includes a drink of your choice and mini churros
- Explore with a self-guided app, available for 6 months
- Engage in a local landmark scavenger hunt with a prize opportunity

experiences.title: Sand Hollow Flyboard Adventure
experiences.description: Hire our Sand Hollow Flyboard tour on your next vacation to St George. Great for small or large groups we can help any age group to flyboard within short periods of time safely. This is one of the funnest water sport on the market today. We offer this at the beautiful Sand Hollow state park with beaches and crystal clear water!

experiences.title: Yellowstone, Grand Teton, and Hot Springs: Small Group 5-Day Tour
experiences.description:
As commercial tour operators, we are exempt from the Alternating License Plate System and can access Yellowstone National Park daily.

* With Nomad Unlimited Adventures’ “2CanGo” promise, departure is guaranteed once 2 guests book. Groups are limited to 2–8 travelers for a more personal experience.
