experiences.title: Premium Utah, Smash & Rage Room Experience
experiences.description: Red Giant Experiences is an award-winning destination for immersive entertainment in Utah, offering a wide range of high-quality experiences including escape rooms, axe throwing, rage rooms, and splatter paint adventures. Built on the success of Red Giant Escape Rooms, the team has taken everything learned from designing cinematic, story-driven escape experiences and applied it across all offerings, creating attractions that feel more immersive, interactive, and unique than anything else around. From custom-built environments and engaging gameplay to high-energy, hands-on activities, every experience is designed to fully pull guests into the action. With thousands of 5-star reviews and national recognition, Red Giant has become a go-to destination for groups, families, and anyone looking for something beyond the ordinary—while also earning the title of the #1 rated axe throwing facility in Utah County two years in a row, according to Utah Valley Magazine’s Best of Utah County awards.

experiences.title: Private Photo Workshop and Sightseeing in Wasatch Mountains
experiences.description: Being a life-long resident of Utah, along with photographing its splendor for over 30 years, have given me great insight on technique, location, and timing. I know where to go and when. Photography is my passion, my love, my life. I'd love to share my enthusiasm for capturing mother nature's glory with you.

experiences.title: Vintage Spirits Distillery Tour with Spirits Tasting
experiences.description:
Step inside the world of artisanal spirits with the Vintage Spirits Distillery Tour & Tasting Experience. This immersive 1-hour journey combines education, craftsmanship, and flavor for an unforgettable visit.

Begin with a 30-minute guided distillery tour, where you’ll explore the entire grain-to-glass process. Learn how raw ingredients are transformed into premium spirits through time-honored techniques and modern innovation. Walk through production areas, see the equipment up close, and gain insider knowledge from our passionate team.

After the tour, enjoy a 30-minute tasting session featuring a curated selection of our finest spirits. Discover the unique aromas and flavors that define our craft, and learn how to savor each sip like a true connoisseur.

Perfect for spirit enthusiasts and curious travelers alike, this experience offers a behind-the-scenes look at the artistry and science of distillation—plus the chance to taste the results firsthand.

experiences.title: UTV Sunset S'mores n' Stars at Coral Pink Sand Dunes
experiences.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Coral Pink Sand Dunes State Park to the fullest! Glide effortlessly through the majestic dunes on UTVs at sunset then end at a breathtaking overlook, offering 360-degree views of the entire state park. As the sky darkens, take a moment to roast marshmallows, relish a decadent s'more, and lose yourself in the awe-inspiring spectacle of the starlit sky. It's the greatest EARTH on show.

experiences.title: 100 Mile Zion National Park Panoramic Helicopter Flight
experiences.description: Experience the ultimate aerial adventure with our Premier Zion Helicopters tour, featuring breathtaking views as you circle the entirety of Zion National Park. Take in every stunning angle of this natural wonder, then soar over the rarely seen Canaan Mountain Wilderness—home to some of the most striking rock formations on Earth. This unforgettable flight offers a truly comprehensive and scenic look at Southern Utah’s iconic landscapes.

experiences.title: Sunset UTV ride with S'mores n' Stars at Coral Pink Sand Dunes
experiences.description:
Experience the breathtaking beauty of Coral Pink Sand Dunes State Park to the fullest! Glide effortlessly through the majestic dunes on UTVs at sunset then end at a breathtaking overlook, offering 360-degree views of the entire state park. As the sky darkens, take a moment to roast marshmallows, relish a decadent s'more, and lose yourself in the awe-inspiring spectacle of the starlit sky. It's the greatest EARTH on show.

experiences.title: Mirror Lake & Uinta Mountains Half-Day Tour from Park City
experiences.description:
Explore the captivating Mirror Lake Highway and the Uinta-Wasatch-Cache National Forest on this half-day tour from Park City. Marvel at alpine meadows, pristine lakes, and breathtaking mountain vistas along one of the most scenic routes in America. Enjoy a refreshing stop at the cascading Provo waterfalls and take a short walk at Mirror Lake, where you can opt for a swim in its crystal-clear waters. This tour is perfect for families, outdoor enthusiasts, and anyone seeking an unforgettable alpine experience.

- Half-day tour with departures at 10:00 am
- Includes private air-conditioned transportation and a professional guide
- Stops at historic landmarks, waterfalls, and Mirror Lake for a swim
- Lunch stop at a nostalgic log cabin pub or Lush's Tennesee Bar-B-Que (food not included but special tour pricing available)

experiences.title: Guided Urban Art and Historical E-Bike Tour in Park City
experiences.description: We are a small locally owned business with local guides. Most of our team has been guiding throughout park city for 20+ Years. Get the best recommendations for food and fun. We know the area better than anyone and we don't get paid for our recommendations, so you'll know your vacation will continue to be amazing even after you leave PCEBIKES

experiences.title: Kayak/SUP Tour: Birds, Beavers, Turtles, maybe even Cliff Jumping
experiences.description:
Decompress, engage, and rejuvenate on the water near Zion National Park and St. George, Utah.

Beginner-friendly, we launch from our section of beach at Quail Creek State Park. We'll paddle kayaks or stand up paddleboards to see cliffs, limestone shale beaches, and known locations for wildlife viewing. Our creek channel is a great nature walk or paddle. We may see beaver, sunbathing turtles, great blue heron, eagle, and perhaps even owl.

While we paddle, we'll share information about the geology of the area. You'll learn something of the ancient peoples and more modern settlers of the region. We may even have time to see some petroglyphs near our shop. 

When finished, stay and eat from our Dig In Grille.

experiences.title: Zion Canyon Hot Springs Soak Experience
experiences.description: The Day Pass to Zion Canyon Hot Springs offers the freedom to truly settle into relaxation at your own pace. Arrive any time during operating hours, guests receive Select or Premier Access to all pools, hot springs, cold plunges, and saunas, including up to 32 mineral pools and 16 WorldSprings Inspired pools reflecting soak traditions from around the globe. Families can soak, swim, and play in welcoming Select areas, while those seeking an elevated retreat can escape to the 21+ Premier side with cocktails, beer, and wine. In between soaks, savor fresh bites and drinks from The Springs Café, or unwind by the firepits with Zion’s breathtaking red rock cliffs as your backdrop. Whether you’re making it a family outing or an indulgent day of adult relaxation, this pass ensures a complete and unhurried hot springs experience, with the ability to leave and come back same day.

experiences.description:

experiences.description:

experiences.title: Local Food Walking Tours in Salt Lake City

Explore Salt Lake City's bustling downtown or stroll along Park City's charming Main Street, savoring gourmet delights from beloved local eateries. Each bite unveils a story, each step uncovers hidden gems, transforming every tour into an unforgettable gastronomic escapade."

experiences.description: Discover the best of Park City’s food scene on a guided walking tour along historic Main Street. Sample a variety of local dishes, from savory starters to decadent desserts, at some of the town’s top restaurants and hidden gems. Along the way, enjoy stories of Park City’s fascinating history, from its mining roots to its evolution into a world-class ski destination. You’ll experience delicious flavors, and soak in the scenic charm of this iconic mountain town. By the end, you’ll feel full and satisfied, having enjoyed an unforgettable culinary adventure. Book now for a unique local experience!

We guarantee a spectacular, up-close encounter 100 percent of the time, whether the bison are hungry or just want to say hello!

experiences.title: Capitol Reef National Park Self-Guided Audio Tour
experiences.description:
Avoid the crowds and visit Capitol Reef on a self-guided audio driving tour with Shaka Guide! With stunning geology and loads of history- this captivating national park has a rightful spot in the Utah Mighty 5. We’ll guide you to petroglyphs, the Scenic Drive, Fruita Orchards and even take you to see the Waterpocket Fold - a 100-mile long wrinkle in the earth’s crust. 

What is Shaka Guide? It’s your personal tour guide, in an app! You get all the benefits of a guided tour with the freedom to explore on your terms. 

Here’s how it works - the app uses GPS to give you directions to popular stops in the park. 

All Shaka Guide Tours...

experiences.title: Candle Pouring Workshop at Paddywax Candle Bar Reston
experiences.description: Reston Town Center is a hub of culture, dining, and entertainment, making your workshop a perfect addition to your plans. experiences.title: Wine Bootcamp - Led by our winemaker

experiences.description:

Create Your Own Signature Candle – A Relaxing and Memorable Experience

Reliable Ground Transportation From the Airport

experiences.title: Intro to the Art of Sushi in DC
experiences.description:
Come and learn how to spread, layer, tuck and roll your way to sushi heaven. In this fun, hands-on social cooking class, you’ll learn all the skills needed to make sushi-rolls at home, including how to prepare sushi rice, select sushi-grade fish, and add additional tasty neta (ingredients) to enhance your dining experience. Your classes are designed to be fun and accessible for everyone, whether you're a sushi enthusiast or a first-timer trying something new. Your station will be fully prepped with supplies, making this an easy and engaging activity for team building, social events, or date night.

We finish with our famous Choco-Vino Challenge final exam.

experiences.title: Chocolate and Wine Pairing in Chantilly
experiences.description: You've been to winery wine tasting, but, have you been to a chocolate factory wine tasting? Welcome to our craft chocolate factory to see how chocolate is made while sipping on perfectly paired wine.

experiences.title: Delicious Pizza & Ice Cream Tour of Richmond
experiences.description:
Hop onto our 14-passenger bus and explore Richmond in the best way possible - though pizza and ice cream! We’ll visit three of our favorite pizza spots AND three incredible ice cream shops for a fun, filling, and (obviously) delicious afternoon.

Highlights include:
- Try pizza made from a naturally-fermented sourdough crust, and taste the difference
- Three different pizzas, three different pizza styles
- Visit an award-winning ice cream maker’s very first scoop shop

We suggest bringing a bottle of water – we’re visiting places with the best pizza and ice cream, not necessarily the places with the largest dining room. This means that sometimes, we’ll visit take-out only spots that won’t seat guests or serve water.

experiences.title: 2 Hour Private Tiki Boat Cruises in Virginia Beach
experiences.description: Cruise the stunning Lynnhaven Inlet on a private tiki boat with Hampton Roads Boat Company, perfect for up to 6 guests. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, bachelorette party, or just enjoying a sunset with friends, our customized tours promise unforgettable moments. With options like half day charters and sunset cruises, your adventure is tailored to your vibe. Enjoy the coastline, relax with your crew, and make memories that last a lifetime.

experiences.title: Lumberjack Axe Throwing Experience in Williamsburg
experiences.description: Axe Republic invites you to unleash your inner lumberjack with a thrilling 75-minute axe-throwing experience in Williamsburg. Perfect for first-timers and groups, this activity begins with a safety briefing and personalized coaching to help you hit the bullseye. Enjoy a lively atmosphere where friendly competition thrives, and don’t forget to wear your flannel to complete the lumberjack vibe. The dedicated Axepert staff ensures a fun and safe experience, making it ideal for parties or team-building events. Grab a drink from the bar to keep your energy up as you aim for your next target.

experiences.title: Brewery Tour of Richmond, VA
experiences.description:
Join Richmond Brewery Tours for an insiders look at Richmond's premier brewery district - Scott's Addition! The beer scene has exploded since landmark brewing legislation in 2012, and we can’t wait to show you the best our city has to offer on our Richmond Brewery Tour.

Highlights include:

- Visit three unique breweries to taste a few of their best beers – plenty included to keep your thirst quenched
- Hear a brief discussion on how beer is made, and how different steps of the process come together to create your beer
- Learn about Richmond’s beer past and present from our expert guides – they know their Richmond beer scene like the back of their hand

Memorable Experience: Combining sensory enjoyment with personal discovery and social interaction makes for a memorable event.

Add-on lunch options are available after reserving your tour. Inquire with our team to learn more, after reserving, to learn about food options and pricing.

experiences.title: Craft Chocolate Tasting
experiences.description: Explore the world of craft chocolate and get to try a selection of chocolates made here at River-Sea! One of our Chocolate Jedi Knights will guide you through the tasting notes of five bars made at our factory. This flight includes five pieces of chocolates per person. Then you'll see the different chocolate production machines and learn about what each one does to make delicious small-batch bean-to-bar chocolate!

experiences.title: Private Charlottesville Area Wine Tour
experiences.description:
Ole Crow Tours warmly invites you to explore the very best that Virginia’s renowned wine region has to offer in comfort and style. Simply sit back, relax, and let us handle all the details, carefully ensuring a seamless and unforgettable experience for you and your guests to truly savor every moment.

On this thoughtfully curated tour, you’ll be enjoying visits to 3 carefully selected wineries located on the scenic eastside of Charlottesville. This journey will take us through the charming Keswick area, once home to Thomas Jefferson’s old stomping grounds, a region rich with history, natural beauty, and timeless elegance.

experiences.title: Downtown Roanoke Food, History & Cultural Tour
experiences.description: Enjoy a walking tour that showcases the tastes and richness of Virginia's Blue Ridge. We'll stroll historic downtown Roanoke and enjoy iconic landmarks, satisfying aromas, and delicious tastings. This tour is ideal for visitors and locals. Discover Roanoke's vibrant food scene and visit the thriving historic downtown area. You will uncover intriguing hidden gems, iconic landmarks, back alleys, and Roanoke's colorful past. This tour is a fun way to showcase the "Star City" to our out-of-town guests.

experiences.title: The Carytown Food Tour with Discover Richmond Tours
experiences.description:
Find additional information and a lower price at Discover Richmond Tours

On this 2.5 to 3 hour walking tour, you’ll explore Carytown and its bustling food scene as you snack and sample from 5 to 6 different restaurants, cafes, and shops. You'll hear how these merchants started their business and learn from the guide about the fun and quirky history of Richmond, Virginia and the neighborhood of Carytown. Come directly to our website for the lowest price!

Please contact us immediately after booking at hello@discoverrichmondtours.com if you have dietary restrictions!

experiences.title: Church Hill Food Tour with Discover Richmond Tours
experiences.description:
Find additional information and pricing at Discover Richmond Tours.

Joining Discover Richmond Tours means exploring Church Hill in a unique way. You will sample delicious food and snacks from up to 5 different restaurants, cafes, and bakeries, possibly including wood-fired pastries, classic Richmond comfort food, authentic Ethiopian Fare, and more! You’ll learn about the birthplace of Richmond and it’s heroes, and hear how our partner merchants got their start. But most of all, we’ll make sure you have fun doing it.

Be sure to bring water and comfortable shoes – we’ll be standing at most of our stops, and we’ll be in and out too quickly for water and other beverages to be served.

Please contact us immediately after booking at (804) 479-8929 or hello@discoverrichmondtours.com so we can provide the meeting location for your specific tour date!

experiences.title: Wine and Culinary Delight Private Tour
experiences.description: If you want to overload your senses, this could be the one. This tour combines two of the area's top vineyards, which not only produce wonderful wine but also provide an unforgettable culinary experience. One of the stops is also recognized for its architectural design, while the other for its architectural ruins.

experiences.title: Arts District Food Tour in Richmond with Discover Richmond
experiences.description:
Find additional information and a lower price at Discover Richmond Tours

Ready to discover downtown Richmond? Richmond’s revitalized Arts District, will capture your imagination with a mix of historically-significant architecture, under-the-radar restaurants, and inspiring art galleries.

Joining Discover Richmond Tours means exploring the neighborhood as an insider. You will sample delicious food and snacks from several amazing spots, meet chefs and business owners to discover their passion for their craft, and hear the stories that make this one of Richmond’s most defining neighborhoods. But most of all, we’ll make sure you have fun doing it.

Highlights include:

- Visit up to 6 establishments to taste one of their best dishes – more than enough food for a meal!
- Learn about Jackson Ward’s unique architecture, about the story behind Grace St., and about the weather indicator that once marked Richmond’s highest point
- Meet the chef’s and owners behind downtown’s food scene

experiences.title: Haunted Alexandria Booze and Boos Ghost Walking Tour
experiences.description:
Unearth the shady and seedy history of Old Town Alexandria on this 2.5-hour guided ghost tour and pub crawl. A costumed guide will lead you through hidden alleyways and tell you tales from the historic places and haunted buildings along the way. During the tour, you will also stop at some historic Old Town pubs to enjoy a beverage before continuing on your way.
*Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
*All guests must be 21+ with Valid ID. Alcohol is not included.

experiences.title: City Cruises Norfolk: Signature Lunch Cruise
experiences.description: Join us on our Norfolk Signature Lunch Cruise for amazing views of the mighty Atlantic Fleet while cruising along the Elizabeth River. Our lunch cruises are casual yet festive, ideal for the whole family or a nice office escape with friends! Dance along to our DJ entertainment, sip on cocktails from our full-bar selection, listen to our live narration, or enjoy interactive games on our skyline deck. This lunch cruise offers something for everyone! Including a 2-hour cruise along the Elizabeth River, a delicious lunch buffet with freshly prepared breakfast, lunch, and dessert dishes, spectacular views of the Navy's mighty Atlantic Fleet with engaging narration, onboard entertainment with DJ music, access to lounge spaces, and interactive games, and unlimited coffee, hot tea, and iced tea.

experiences.title: Alexandria Ghosts Spirits & Spirits Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Take this Alexandria Boos and Booze haunted pub crawl tour and add some fun into your work week! This quick but fun tour will take you to four stops for up to two hours. This tour price does not include tastings or tours of the facilities. This tour will take you to a total of four watering holes in Alexandria, which may be a combination of craft producers in Alexandria, and local bars. There will be a variety of haunted stops in between these already notorious bars and pubs! We'll spend about 15-20 minutes to one hour at each destination. Exact lineup depends on day of week and season. Drinks are not included.

The total duration is approximately 1 hour and 45 minutes. The duration of the tour includes, drinks at the establishments, history and story telling at the historic sites and walking to and from the historic sites.

experiences.title: Scott's Addition Brews & Bites Tour
experiences.description:
Rapidly-evolving Scott’s Addition is quickly becoming Richmond’s go-to for food, drink, and fun. This one-time industrial neighborhood just west of downtown is now home to more breweries, cideries, and entertainment venues that you can count. And we haven’t even started talking about food yet!

Joining Discover Richmond Tours means exploring the neighborhood as an insider. You will visit several top restaurants, markets, and eateries, sampling delicious food and snacks from each. You’ll get a glimpse of the booming craft beverage industry that is bringing the world to Richmond. And you’ll get to discover Scott’s Addition like a true Richmonder.

Highlights include:
- Visit a handful establishments to taste one of their best dishes – more than enough food for a meal!
- Learn about Scott’s Addition’s days as an industrial powerhouse – who exactly is Scott anyway?
- Whet your whistle with a beverage from two local breweries

experiences.title: 5 Hour Historic Thomas Jefferson Wine Tour
experiences.description: We would like to personally invite you to join us on an unforgettable journey through the beautiful countryside of Charlottesville and the surrounding area. As you enjoy tastings of some of Virginia's finest and most celebrated wines, you will be completely immersed in the rich history shaped by Thomas Jefferson’s lasting influence on the region. This experience promises to be both relaxing and enlightening, blending the natural beauty, exquisite flavors, and historical depth unique to this area.

experiences.title: Custom Wine Tour In Black Suburban With Panoramic Sunroof
experiences.description:
Discover Virginia Wine Country the way it was meant to be experienced—privately, comfortably, and entirely on your schedule.

Skip the crowded buses and cookie-cutter itineraries. This fully private experience is designed exclusively for your group, allowing you to explore Charlottesville's renowned wineries, breweries, cideries, and distilleries at your own pace while traveling in a luxury Chevrolet Suburban featuring a panoramic sunroof.

Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, planning a romantic getaway, reconnecting with friends, or simply looking to experience the best of Virginia wine country, our local concierge team helps create a seamless day from start to finish.

100% Private Tour — No strangers, no shared transportation, no fixed schedule.

Customized Itinerary — Visit the wineries, breweries, cideries, & tasting rooms that match your group's preferences.

Local Expertise — Our team knows the region's hidden gems, iconic vineyards, and reservation-only experiences.

experiences.title: Southern Comfort Food & History Tour of Old Town Alexandria
experiences.description: Six stops through 300 years of Old Town Alexandria history with Blue Fern Travel. Cross the Potomac from DC into cobblestone streets connecting Colonial taverns, Civil War sites, and Southern comfort restaurants locals have kept secret for decades. Your guide weaves each bite into the city that shaped American history. Small group, max 8 guests. Every booking gives back to the community we walk through.

experiences.title: Private Colonial Williamsburg Breakfast - Exploring Before and After Restoration
experiences.description:
Relaxed, yet luxurious learning experience about Williamsburg before and after the restoration of Colonial Williamsburg in the late 1920s and early 1930s with photos and stories from either Williamsburg Before and After or Restoring Williamsburg. These photos help visualize and better understand the restoration of the world’s largest history museum. Most of the tour is seated during breakfast for those who enjoy the warmth (or air conditioning) indoors.

This is an easily accessible tour, well suited for those who enjoy a creative culinary experience, breakfast on bad weather days or for any individuals with physical limitations. Our guide will offer an easy tour of some of the grounds including a look at the Golden Horseshoe Golf courses or admire some of the original décor of the hotel and grounds as well as a short walk to the Duke of Gloucester St., the most historic street in America. 

Note: Guests pay for their own breakfast including food, drinks and gratuities to hotel staff.

experiences.title: Old Town Alexandria Food Tour
experiences.description:
This 3.5-hour tour explores parts of the historic and architecturally unique town that has prospered for over two hundred sixty years. Discover locally owned and operated restaurants off the beaten path in this historically rich town. 

On this guided, narrated walking tour, experience and learn about Old Town Alexandria’s significance throughout history. During the tour, stop to sample specially made dishes at unique, family owned restaurants. Enjoy American gastropub dishes, regional seafood, house made Italian food in one of the city's oldest buildings, European inspired dishes from the city's original fusion chef and hand crafted desserts. 

See what makes this former part of town so charming, unique and delicious. All dishes served are included in the tour. Enough food is served that for most participants, dinner afterwards will not be needed. Seating and special service is provided at all restaurants throughout the tour.

experiences.title: Williamsburg Ghosts and Brews Haunted Pub Crawls
experiences.description:
Come on to our Haunted Pub Crawl Tour presented by US Ghost Adventures!

Join this unique pub crawl tour of historic Williamsburg, Virginia. You'll visit 3-4 of the most popular hotspots to enjoy a drink, including the Precarious Beer Project and Amber Ox Public House, among others. Most of these also happen to be haunted, so be prepared to hear some spooky stories as well. You'll also visit and hear the terrifying tales of some of the area's most historic locations between bar stops, such as the Bruton Parish Church and the George Wythe House.

experiences.title: The Murder Tour and Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
The Ghost Tour is Williamsburg's first and only murder-focused tour. Explore areas that other history tours would be afraid to visit. Explore a historic city that conceals a sinister and unsettling past. A netherworld of horrific death and hatred. Accompany your guide on foot to some of our favorite local watering establishments. To help you get ready for what's to come, try a drink with a murder theme or one of the pub's specialty beverages. Then, take a stroll through the dim, peaceful streets of Historic Williamsburg, where you may learn the real stories of the city's most notorious crimes.

There's nothing ghostly about Williamsburg's scariest tour. It has to do with murder.

experiences.title: Private Wine Tours Transportation from 3 People and More
experiences.description:
A very comfortable and stylistic a tour and tasting some of Virginia’s finest vineyards and wines. 

It’s very private and enjoyable for couple looking for an intimate getaway, a small group celebrating a special occasion, a bridal party, or a business team looking for a change of scene. You are making the right choice to experience the natural beauty of Mountains while driving to one of the best winery in historic Charlottesville. It is an exciting time of touring and wine tasting. Your vehicle type will depend on your group size.

experiences.title: Norfolk's Combo Tickets - Virginia Zoo & Battleship Wisconsin
experiences.description:
Come experience the best of Norfolk, Virginia with a combo attraction pass to admission to Norfolk's top attractions! Through these specially-issued passes, you gain admission to the Battleship Wisconsin, Nauticus, and the Virginia Zoo.

Explore Norfolk's Battleship Wisconsin, the world’s largest and last battleship. Uncover the power of the sea and marvel at maritime science and history at the Nauticus. Step inside the Hampton Roads Naval Museum and discover the history of the United States Navy in Coastal Virginia. Go wild at the Virginia Zoo and see tigers, lions, and bears exploring and learning about different habitats and the way animals live in the wild. 

Don’t miss out on great discounts for harbor cruises, food tours, shopping, attractions and much more! Admissions tickets do not have to be used within the same visit day. Tickets are valid until December 31, 2026.

experiences.title: City Cruises Norfolk: Buffet Dinner Cruise
experiences.description:
Celebrate a special occasion, host a group event, or experience a unique date night. Great for parties of all sizes. A Signature Dinner Cruise gives you the chance to dine, dance, and play games in our lounge spaces as well as catch spectacular views of the mighty ships and submarines of the Navy's Atlantic Fleet from our skyline deck. 

Includes
2.5-hour cruise along the Elizabeth River
Delicious dinner buffet with freshly prepared entrees, salads, and desserts
Spectacular views of the Navy's mighty Atlantic Fleet
Onboard entertainment with DJ music, access to lounge spaces, and interactive games
Unlimited coffee, hot tea, and iced tea

experiences.title: Richmond Ghosts Boos and Booze Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.description:
Come on to our Haunted Pub Crawl Tour presented by US Ghost Adventures!
Many of the best clubs and pubs in the area are housed in the historic structures that dot the Shockoe Bottom neighborhood of Richmond. This trip is created to give you a taste of the best Richmond has to offer, like Farmhouse hard cider, as well as a window into the afterlife of some of its people, such as the four ghosts rumored to haunt St. John's Church.

experiences.title: Old Town Alexandria Tour: A Self-Guided Audio Tour
experiences.description:
Are you looking for a way to see Old Town Alexandria without joining a tour group? Explore at your own pace with this affordable walking tour.

• Find out how a banker’s wife hid a portion of the George Washington family fortune in her underwear drawer during a Union raid
• Hear from producer Rick Snider, an award-winning Washington journalist and tour guide
• Do it all in an hour or linger at stops along the way with complete control over when you start and finish
• Get unlimited use before your booking date and after it
• Use the virtual tour option at home

Once you’ve booked, you’ll receive a ticket with instructions and a unique code listed under “Before You Go”. Then simply install the VoiceMap app and enter your code. 

The app displays directions to the starting point, and when you’re in the right place, just pop in your headphones and tap start. VoiceMap has automatic GPS playback, with turn-by-turn directions. It also works offline.

experiences.title: Richmond's Historic Market Food Tour with 5 Authentic Tastings
experiences.description: Discover the heart of Richmond, Virginia through its food on this immersive downtown tour winding from the steps of the Capitol through the cobblestone charm of Shockoe Slip to the vibrant area of Shockoe Bottom. Along the way, you will indulge in the rich tapestry of flavors, from classic Southern staples to global culinary twists. During your experience you will also uncover the stories, history, and hidden gems that makes Richmond a rising star on the Foodie map.

experiences.title: Fried Chicken Capital: A Self-Guided Walking Tour of Gordonsville
experiences.description:
Gordonsville, Virginia has been a crossroads of American life for more than two centuries. On this self-guided walking tour, you'll trace how every shift in transportation – from stagecoach to steam engine to automobile – left its mark on this small town. You'll also discover how the women excluded from its formal economy turned that exclusion into one of the most remarkable entrepreneurial stories in American history.

The tour starts at the Gordonsville Visitor Center on Main Street, where you'll walk north past sixty years of railroad-era architecture – merchant homes with elaborate porches, four historic churches built within thirty years of each other, and a street whose survival owes everything to the town's gradual decline. Along the way, you'll visit the site of Gordon's Tavern, where a historical marker lists Washington, Jefferson, Madison, Monroe, and Lafayette among those who stopped here.

experiences.title: Williamsburg Ghost and Taverns Pub Crawl Activity
experiences.description: An evening of chilling tales and lively atmosphere awaits on the Williamsburg Ghost and Taverns Pub Crawl. This unique adventure combines the thrill of ghost stories with visits to historic taverns, creating a memorable night out in Williamsburg. With your ticket, enjoy a complimentary first drink while immersing yourself in the local history and spooky legends. Perfect for those seeking a blend of fun and fright in a vibrant social setting, this pub crawl is an ideal choice for friends and enthusiasts of the supernatural alike. Join us for an unforgettable night filled with laughter, chills, and camaraderie.

experiences.title: Small Group Brewery & Spirits Tour in Vermont
experiences.description:
Our Vermont Brewery and Spirits Tour is for people who love world-class beer and spirits. This guided tour visits 3 Vermont breweries, 2 distilleries and other local attractions. When booking a hotel for this tour, please choose a location in the Woodstock or Killington, VT areas. We will pick you up right at your door!

PLEASE NOTE: Vermontology Guided Tours has a minimum requirement of at least two guests for a tour to depart. We reserve the right to cancel a tour if we do not meet this minimum. 

Gratuities: Your Brewery and Spirits Tour cost does not include a gratuity for your tour guide/driver.

Available Wednesday – Sunday ONLY

experiences.title: Public Daytime Sailing Cruise
experiences.description:
Experience the beauty of Lake Champlain from a unique perspective aboard classic Friendship Sloops, Friend Ship and Wild Rose. With a maximum of 10 guests, this intimate sailing adventure is perfect for anyone looking to escape the ordinary. Bring your own food and drinks to enhance your journey while our friendly crew ensures a safe and enjoyable trip. Listen to fascinating stories about the region's history as you glide through the stunning landscapes surrounded by mountains. 

- Sail aboard historic Friendship Sloops with intricate craftsmanship
- Maximum of 10 guests for a personal and intimate experience
- Bring your own food and drinks, with amenities provided
- Knowledgeable crew sharing local stories and legends during the cruise

experiences.title: Public Sunset Sailing Cruise on Lake Champlain
experiences.description:
Witness the captivating Burlington sunset while sailing across Lake Champlain on a classic Friendship Sloop. This two-hour cruise offers an unparalleled view of the Adirondack Mountains as you relax and enjoy the charming atmosphere. With a licensed captain and deckhand onboard, safety and enjoyment are top priorities. Guests are encouraged to bring their favorite food and drinks to create a personalized experience. Discover the rich history and unique geological features of Lake Champlain as you sail to different highlights, making each cruise a memorable adventure.

- Duration: 2 hours of scenic sailing on Lake Champlain
- Maximum of 10 guests for an intimate experience
- Bring your own food and drinks; ice water provided
- Explore unique landmarks and enjoy the historical stories from the crew

experiences.title: Small Group Tour in Montpelier & Mad River Valley, Vermont
experiences.description:
This 7-hour tour begins with a trip to Montpelier, Vermont’s capital city—the smallest and least populous state capital in the nation. There, we will enjoy a guided tour of the Vermont State House*, led by a dedicated guide who will share its history and answer questions.
*Guided tours in the Vermont State House are only available from early July through October. The building is closed for visitors on Saturdays and Sundays. Our weekend tours will therefore admire the state house from outside, then explore downtown Montpelier by foot.

While in Montpelier, we will also visit the family-run Morse Farm Maple Sugarworks for a maple syrup tasting. 
Next we will drive scenic VT RT 100 to the villages of Waitsfield and Warren. Popular attractions include an 1833 covered bridge ("The Big Eddy") and Appalachian Gap. Lunch is available for purchase at the Warren Store, a uniquely Vermont experience with great local food. The Warren Store features its own deli, bakery, wine shop, and gift store.

experiences.title: Private Daytime Sailing Cruise on Lake Champlain 12 Passengers
experiences.description: Set sail on Lake Champlain aboard the classic Friendship Sloop, where stunning views of the Adirondack and Green Mountains await. This private two-hour cruise accommodates groups of 2 to 12, allowing you to share the experience with friends or family. Bring your favorite food and drinks to savor while our knowledgeable crew shares tales of the lake's rich history, including shipwrecks and the first lighthouse built in 1825. Enjoy the gentle sway of the boat and the calming waters as you discover the beauty of Vermont from a whole new perspective.

experiences.title: Public Daytime Picnic Boat Cruise
experiences.description:
Discover the beauty of Lake Champlain aboard Buttercup, where every cruise offers a blend of stunning views and captivating stories about the lake's rich history. Enjoy a leisurely outing on the water, perfect for families, couples, or anyone looking to immerse themselves in the scenic landscapes of Vermont. Choose from regular cruises or arrange a private charter for a more personalized experience. Departing from the Burlington Community Boathouse, this is a great way to relax and take in the sights of one of America’s most beautiful lakes.

- Scenic cruises showcasing the stunning landscapes of Lake Champlain
- Hear engaging stories about the lake's history and significance
- Options for private charters or regular cruises available
- Convenient departures from the Burlington Community Boathouse

experiences.title: Public Sunset Picnic Boat Cruise on Lake Champlain
experiences.description:
Set sail on Lake Champlain aboard the charming Buttercup for a two-hour sunset picnic cruise. This unique experience invites you to bring your own food and drinks, all while enjoying stunning waterfront views and the company of up to five friends. The friendly Captain will navigate the waters, allowing you to relax and savor the moments. As you glide across the lake, take in sights like the Champlain Thrust Fault and the first lighthouse built on the lake. This is the perfect chance to unwind after a long day with good food, great views, and memorable conversations.

- Two-hour BYO food and drink cruise on Lake Champlain
- Comfortable seating with canopied protection and restroom on board
- Explore notable sights including shipwrecks and breathtaking mountain views
- Suitable for ages 13 and up, accommodating groups of up to 6 guests

experiences.title: Vermont Bridges and Breweries Private Group Tour
experiences.description:
This tour brings together two iconic Vermont features - craft beer and covered bridges. The pace is relaxing and easy going, with minimal walking required. Enjoy Vermont beer with a built-in designated driver! 

We'll travel in a built-for-back roads Bronco, with a (weather permitting) top-down, open air experience you won't soon forget! As much as possible, we keep off the main routes and stick to dirt roads where traffic doesn't exist, the scenery is breathtaking, and hidden views abound. There will be plenty of opportunities to pause and take it all in! 

Be sure to check out our website for more information on tours and availability!

We'll stop at Long Trail and Harpoon but will tailor the route before, between and after to your preferences... some examples of what we suggest are provided for you. Just reach out after you book with any requests!

experiences.title: Burlington Private Trolley Transport for Special Events
experiences.description:
Elevate your special occasion with a private trolley transportation from us. Ideal for weddings, birthdays, and family gatherings, this classic trolley offers comfortable and flexible transportation tailored to your needs. Customize your experience by choosing your route, schedule, and level of narration while enjoying the journey with up to 32 guests. Bring your decorations, food, and drinks to match your celebration's theme.

- Perfect for weddings, parties, and group celebrations
- Fully customizable with various routes and durations
- Comfortable seating for up to 32 guests
- Enjoy a social atmosphere while traveling together

experiences.title: Small Group Wine & Cider Tour in Vermont
experiences.description:
No matter the occasion—whether it's an anniversary, birthday, corporate event, day out with friends, or a girls' getaway—you'll likely need a designated driver, and that's where we come in.

With a maximum of six customers per tour, this experience is intimate and feels like traveling with a group of friends! We are a small boutique tour company with over decade of experience!

Available in spring and summer only, this guided tour visits three Vermont wineries, one hard cidery, and other local attractions. Most wines in Vermont are crafted from hybrid grape varieties suited to the harsh climate.

When booking a hotel for this tour, please choose a location in either the Burlington, South Burlington or Killington areas. We offer door-to-door pick-up service!

Available Wednesday – Sunday ONLY

experiences.title: Vermont Wayfinders Sampler Guided Tour
experiences.description:
Privately guided 3-4 hour tours give you a bite-sized taste of Vermont’s scenic backroads, charming villages, and local favorites, all in a compact, easygoing experience. Guided by a local, gain insider knowledge of some of the best spots to visit and find even more beautiful routes to explore as you find your way to favorite spots in and around the Connecticut River Valley of Vermont. Various themes for the tour are offered, including 'Bridges and Brews', 'Antiques and Artisans', and 'Ridges and Rivers' and we get started from Woodstock, Ludlow or Springfield Vermont.

Be sure to check out the Vermont Wayfinders website for more information on tours and availability!

It’s the perfect way to explore if you’re short on time, love a good scenic detour, or just want a more budget-friendly private tour. You’ll still get a local expert as your guide, a perfectly planned route, and plenty of time to soak in the sights—just in a smaller, snackable package.

experiences.title: Small Group Tour in Stowe, Vermont
experiences.description:
This 7-hour tour begins with a trip to Waterbury and Stowe, where we will visit a number of popular local attractions. Treat your taste buds at the Ben & Jerry’s Ice Cream Factory and Cold Hollow Cider Mill, then visit the historic von Trapp Family Lodge — the same Von Trapp family that inspired The Sound of Music. Our Vermont tours visit only the most interesting locations, such as a scenic drive to the top of Smugglers’ Notch State Park. You will also have a chance to explore Stowe village.

Join me in exploring Vermont!

Gratuities: Your day tour cost does not include a gratuity for your tour guide/driver.

experiences.title: Burlington Signature Guided Brewery Tour
experiences.description: Learn about Burlington Vermont’s thriving brewpub scene and taste up to 12 types of beer on the Signature Burlington Brew Tour! Get an inside look at how beer is made, and enjoy a delicious snack on us. Visit three local craft breweries to explore artisan beers and Vermont's rich history and culture. Round trip transportation in our air-conditioned, beer-themed van is included.

experiences.title: Signature Vermont Wayfinders Private Guided Tour
experiences.description:
This tour is built just for you! You provide what you'd love to see and do (scenery, farms, photography, food, artisans, etc.) and what you'd rather skip and I'll create a customized itinerary for your day.

We'll travel in a built-for-back roads Bronco, with a (weather permitting) top-down, open air experience you won't soon forget! As much as possible, we keep off the main routes and stick to dirt roads where traffic doesn't exist, the scenery is breathtaking, and hidden views abound. There will be plenty of opportunities to pause and take it all in.

Be sure to check out the Vermont Wayfinders website for more information on tours and availability, including add-on options like heading to the top of Killington or going for a horse-drawn carriage ride.

The places provided listed here are just the start; this truly is a signature tour, tailored to you and your small group.

experiences.title: Scenic Route 100 Vermont Audio Driving Tour Start Wilmington VT
experiences.description:
Route 100 is known as Vermont’s Main Street, offering a scenic journey through charming villages, covered bridges, and stunning waterfalls. This self-guided driving tour begins in Wilmington and leads north through picturesque towns such as Stowe and Waitsfield, showcasing the beauty of the Green Mountains. Along the way, enjoy local highlights like the Vermont Country Store, Moss Glen Falls, and the renowned Ben & Jerry’s Factory. Perfect for families, food lovers, and photographers, this tour provides the ultimate Vermont experience at your own pace, with captivating stories of history and culture throughout the drive.

- Explore classic Vermont villages and local shops
- Visit iconic sites like Moss Glen Falls and covered bridges
- Taste local specialties at Ben & Jerry’s and Cold Hollow Cider Mill
- Ideal for families, photographers, and those seeking scenic drives

experiences.title: The Orcas Project Wine Tasting
experiences.description: The Orcas Project is more than just a tasting, there's a real story behind every wine in your flight. We work with talented winemakers and vineyards across the Pacific Northwest, and each bottle features original artwork from local Orcas Island artists. So when we walk you through your flight, we're not just talking tasting notes we're talking about the vineyard it came from, the people who made it, and the artist who designed the label. It's a pretty cool combination, and there's nothing else quite like it in the region.

experiences.title: Authentic Italian Cooking Class in Seattle (5-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a cozy kitchen in Seattle and discover the elegance of Italian cooking, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, this hands-on workshop with an esteemed pasta chef highlights refined flavors and timeless techniques.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Italian green beans with butter and Parmesan
- Pasta: Handmade pasta with brown butter and sage
- Main: Seafood risotto with scallops, shrimp and peas
- Main: Braised pork shoulder ragù with tomatoes and red wine
- Dessert: Vanilla bean panna cotta

With its intimate format and step-by-step guidance, this class is ideal for couples, families or groups of friends eager to explore authentic Italian cuisine together.

experiences.title: Japanese Sushi Cooking Class in Seattle (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Step into a welcoming Seattle kitchen and explore the fundamentals of Japanese-inspired cooking, hosted through Cozymeal. This hands-on workshop with an esteemed sushi chef guides you through a complete four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Spring rolls with peanut dipping sauce
- Sushi: Salmon avocado roll with wasabi mayo
- Main: Pan-fried Asian garlic noodles with soy, sesame oil and chili flakes
- Dessert: Matcha ice cream float topped with whipped cream

Learn sushi rice preparation, rolling techniques and balanced flavor pairing as you craft each course. With its small-group setting and step-by-step instruction, this class offers an intimate and flavorful journey into Japanese-inspired cuisine.

experiences.title: Small Group Wine Tasting: Explore Diverse Wines and PNW Cuisine
experiences.description:
Immerse yourself in a unique wine tasting experience near Pike Place Market, where you'll sample up to five exceptional wines from diverse wineries. This engaging 90-minute session features expertly prepared cuisine bites, allowing you to savor local flavors alongside your wine selections. Knowledgeable staff will guide you through each wine, sharing fascinating stories about the winemakers and their craft, creating a community atmosphere that feels like home. Perfect for wine enthusiasts and casual drinkers alike, this small group setting ensures a personalized experience.

- Taste up to five wines from various local winemakers
- Enjoy three bites of fresh Pacific Northwest cuisine
- Engage with knowledgeable staff for curated selections and stories
- 90-minute small group experience near Pike Place Market

experiences.title: Private Seattle Cooking Class with a Chef in Her Home
experiences.description:
Born and raised in Seattle and a University of Washington graduate, Brittney is a true Seattleite. She cares deeply about eating local food that is sustainably produced and is excited to share with you what makes Pacific Northwest cuisine unique. Brittney graduated from culinary school and is now a personal chef focused on cooking whole-food, plant-based cuisine that helps prevent diabetes and heart disease. Visit her in her beautifully designed home with a view of Lake Union to learn to cook and enjoy healthy food that tastes great!

• Private cooking class in Seattle with a chef
• Immersive Pacific Northwest culinary and cultural experience
• Gourmet Pacific Northwest meal using local, seasonal and sustainable ingredients
• Vegetarian and vegan options are available, on request

experiences.title: Mad Scientist Cocktail and Mocktail Lab
experiences.description:
lab·o·ra·to·ry | ˈla-b(ə-)rə-ˌtȯr-ē — a place for experimentation, discovery, and invention.

Most cocktail experiences teach you how to make their drinks. This one is designed for you to create your own. Please contact us directly for booking more than 2 people, as most likely we will have availablity for you. 

Rather than following recipes, you’ll explore a fully equipped drink laboratory with hundreds of ingredients and specialized tools rarely available outside professional or experimental settings. It’s a space built for curiosity, where you can test bold ideas, unexpected flavor combinations, and techniques you wouldn’t typically try at home.

The experience is intentionally unscripted after the introduction, so no two sessions—or drinks—are ever the same.

Guidance is always available, but the focus remains on creative freedom, personal expression, and discovery.

Also available as a mobile lab for offsite private events for 13-250 attendees.

experiences.title: Mad Scientist Drink Fusion Lab, A Mocktail Focused Workshop
experiences.description:
Laboratory: a place for experimentation, discovery, and invention.

Most mocktail experiences teach you how to make their drinks. This one is designed for you to create your own.

Rather than following a script, you’ll explore an ever-evolving zero-proof drink lab with hundreds of ingredients—syrups, bitters, teas, spices, fresh citrus, and non-alcoholic spirits—plus specialty tools like smoking guns, test tubes, and shaker sets. It’s a chance to experiment with bold flavors, unexpected combinations, and creative techniques you likely wouldn’t try at home.

After the introduction, the experience becomes intentionally open-ended, so each guest can take a different creative path.

Your host acts as a friendly “head scientist,” offering guidance when needed while keeping the atmosphere playful, welcoming, and judgment-free. 

Contact us directly if you have any large group inquiries for team building, parties, and other group activities.

experiences.title: Silvara Cellars Hillside Wine Tasting Experience with a Sommelier
experiences.description:
Our wine tasting experiences invite guests into a deeper understanding of Washington wine, each crafted to highlight the beauty of our region and the expertise of our team.

A thoughtfully designed progression through a selection of Silvara wines that showcases the character, craftsmanship, and varietal expression of our estate and partner vineyards.

For those seeking a curated journey, our Guided Wine Tasting Tour offers an immersive, educational exploration led by professionally trained hosts with extensive industry experience. Guests enjoy a sensory‑rich tasting and pairing adventure featuring local wines and artisan cheeses, all while learning about Washington’s terroir, wine making, and stylistic diversity.

Both experiences are elevated by sweeping views of the Cascade Mountains and the peaceful natural, creating a memorable and welcoming environment for wine lovers at every level.

experiences.title: Foraging Tour of Edible Plants and Mushrooms in Brinnon
experiences.description: Enjoy the beauty of the Olympic Peninsula forests while learning what, how and when to forage seasonal wild edible and medicinal plants, herbs, lichen and fungi.

experiences.title: French Cooking Class in Seattle (Includes 4-Course Meal)
experiences.description:
Immerse yourself in the elegance of French cuisine in a cozy Seattle kitchen. Limited to a small group, this hands-on class with an esteemed French chef highlights a four-course bistro-style menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Mini croque monsieur with ham, cheese and Dijon mustard
- Main: Chicken fricassee in white wine sauce with roasted root vegetables
 - Side: Savory crêpes with Brie, tomatoes and shrimp
- Dessert: French apple tart with Calvados cream

Learn techniques like sauce making, crêpe folding and elegant plating while building the confidence to recreate these Parisian classics at home.

experiences.title: Fun Dumpling Making Class With a Local Chef in Seattle
experiences.description: Wrappers ready, filling mixed and folding skills loading. You’ll begin by preparing a flavorful Asian-style dumpling filling, then learn how to portion, fold and seal each dumpling by hand. You’ll get practical tips for handling the wrappers and creating secure folds without needing any previous cooking experience. Once your dumplings are shaped, you’ll prepare a dipping sauce designed to bring salty, tangy and aromatic flavors together. You’ll cook the dumplings until tender and juicy, then plate them with the sauce and dig in. Along the way, you’ll learn useful shaping, seasoning and cooking techniques while enjoying a relaxed, social atmosphere.

experiences.title: Fun Gnocchi Making Class at a Trendy Cidery in Seattle
experiences.description:
Your potato is about to have a serious career upgrade. At a casual Ballard cidery, you’ll learn how to transform simple ingredients into soft, tender handmade gnocchi while enjoying a relaxed atmosphere that’s perfect for cooking, sipping and unwinding.

Begin by making the gnocchi dough, learning how to handle the mixture without overworking it. Next, roll the dough into ropes and cut it into individual dumplings, picking up practical techniques for shaping and preparing gnocchi along the way. You’ll then cook your handmade dumplings until they’re perfectly tender before finishing them with a flavorful sauce. Chef Jason makes the process beginner-friendly and hands-on, so you can focus on the satisfying rhythm of making pasta rather than stressing over culinary perfection. Come hungry, leave with new skills and enjoy the bragging rights that only homemade gnocchi can provide.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Brewery in Seattle
experiences.description:
If making fresh pasta has been sitting on your "one day" list, this is the sign to finally cross it off. Join Chef Tissany for a fun, beginner-friendly cooking class at a lively Georgetown brewery in Seattle, where flour, fresh dough and good conversation come together for one seriously satisfying night out. Chef Tissany's warm teaching style and extensive culinary background make every technique feel simple and achievable.

You'll learn how to prepare traditional pasta dough from scratch before mastering the techniques for kneading, rolling and shaping silky homemade pasta by hand. Along the way, Chef Tissany shares professional tips that help transform a few everyday ingredients into a restaurant-worthy Italian meal. After cooking your fresh pasta and pairing it with a flavorful homemade sauce, you'll sit down to enjoy every bite while leaving with practical skills you'll actually want to use the next time pasta night rolls around.

experiences.title: Fun Pasta Making Class at a Trendy Cidery in Seattle
experiences.description: If your idea of “making pasta” usually involves boiling water and hoping for the best, this class is your glow-up. In this beginner-friendly cooking class with Chef Tissany, you’ll get hands-on with fresh pasta dough in a laid-back Ballard cidery vibe that keeps things fun, casual and very low-pressure. You’ll mix flour or semolina with eggs, olive oil and sea salt, then knead the dough until it comes together like kitchen magic. From there, you’ll roll it thin, cut it into beautiful pasta shapes and learn the little tricks behind great texture, tender bite and even cooking. To finish, you’ll pair your handmade pasta with garlic, fresh herbs, juicy tomatoes or seasonal vegetables, building flavor without making anything fussy. You’ll leave with a meal you made yourself, a few chef-approved skills and the quiet confidence of someone who may never look at dried pasta the same way again.

experiences.title: Fun Taco Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Seattle
experiences.description:
If tacos are already your personality, this cooking class with Chef Washington is calling. Hosted at a stylish local venue in Seattle, this interactive experience turns a casual favorite into a full homemade Mexican-inspired feast.

Start by learning how to prepare hearty taco fillings with chorizo, steak, eggs and onions before adding fresh cilantro and lime for the perfect finish. Chef Washington will also show you how to round out the plate with comforting Mexican-style beans and flavorful rice. Expect an easygoing class filled with tasting, laughter and practical cooking tips you can actually use at home. By the end, you’ll be full, happy and fully prepared to host taco night without relying on takeout.

experiences.title: Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Seattle
experiences.description: Trade takeout for flour-covered fun and discover why fresh pasta is always worth the extra few minutes. In this hands-on cooking session at a welcoming local venue, you'll transform simple pantry staples into homemade fettuccine and a velvety chicken Alfredo from scratch. Learn how to combine flour, eggs, olive oil and salt into smooth pasta dough before mastering kneading, rolling and cutting techniques that make fresh noodles feel surprisingly approachable. Next, prepare a creamy Alfredo sauce with milk and Parmesan cheese before coating every strand of freshly cooked pasta. Every step is easy to follow, whether you're trying pasta-making for the first time or brushing up on kitchen skills. You'll leave with practical techniques, a seriously satisfying meal and a new appreciation for just how good homemade Italian comfort food can be.

experiences.title: Savoring the Filipino Cuisine here in Washington state
experiences.description: We will be cooking in a very modern kitchen. Will be making three famous Filipino dishes like lumpia, chicken adobo and Pancit. I will introduce them to different Filipino seasoning that we used in these dishes. After everything is cook, we will sit together and savor the dishes. These dishes are easy to prepare and usually serve on special occasions like birthdays and special family gatherings. You will not only learn to cook but also some Filipino culture

experiences.title: Seattle Coffee Walking Tour Specialty Cafes and Local Stories
experiences.description: Join a local guide for a walking tour of Seattle’s popular Capitol Hill neighborhood - sample three unique coffee drinks, from three of Seattle's favorite independent Cafes. Meet your guide at the historic Oddfellows Building then set out to explore the cafes and stories that have helped define this vibrant neighborhood. Capitol Hill has long been the home of the city's counterculture, night life and it is the heart of Seattle's Specialty Coffee Culture - making it the perfect place to dive in to the drink that has helped shape the city and the modern world. Tasty drinks, great company and superb local stories.

experiences.title: Food Tasting & Arts Tour of Pike Place Market
experiences.description:
This tour is a treat for all senses. First and foremost, we'll try some of the delicious treats only available at Pike Place Market! We will also learn about the history of the Market and view much of the incredible art on display. We'll also take the time to be serenaded by one of the many street performers. Walking through the fascinating labyrinth of the Pike Place is a special treat. Take in breath taking views of Elliot Bay and the surrounding mountains (weather permitting!) and enjoy special attention from your guide due to small group sizes. 
Wander Northwest Walking Tours is permitted and licensed by the Pike Place Market Preservation and Development Authority (PDA) to operate tours in the Pike Place Market Historical District. The PDA requires any business or person conducting paid tours within its properties and in the public areas of the historical district to be pre-approved and to have a license for this activity.

experiences.title: Chef Food Tour of Seattle Space Needle and Seattle Center
experiences.description: The Space Needle Food Tour is the only chef-guided experience that blends Seattle’s culture, history, and flavor in the heart of the city’s most iconic neighborhood. You’ll visit 5 food stops and enjoy 2 beverages, with carefully selected bites that highlight the best of the Pacific Northwest. Along the way, you’ll support small, local food businesses and learn from a chef who brings the area’s food and stories to life. * Please this tour DOES NOT go up in the Space Needle. It is is a food tour in the surrounding area

experiences.title: Seattle Pioneer Square Food Walking Tour
experiences.description:
A brand-new walking food tour in Seattle's oldest neighborhood through its food, culture, and history on this guided walking tour of Pioneer Square. Sample a variety of global flavors from locally owned businesses, including Italian, Turkish, Nigerian, and classic pastry favorites, while exploring the district's historic brick buildings, hidden gems, and iconic landmarks. 

Located near Seattle's waterfront and sports stadiums, this experience combines local cuisine, fascinating stories, and insider recommendations on where to eat, drink, and explore during the rest of your visit. Perfect for first-time visitors, families, solo travelers, and food lovers looking to experience Seattle beyond the typical tourist attractions.

experiences.title: Chuckanut Bay Distillery Tour with 2 Mini Cocktails and Gift Glass
experiences.description:
Chuckanut Bay Distillery is a true grain-to-glass distillery located in a beautiful historic building right in the heart of Bellingham. Our experiential tour takes you behind the scenes to show you how we convert locally grown grains into award-winning Whiskey, Gin, Vodka, and more. Guaranteed to tantalize all your senses! 

Tour is about one hour in length and includes two complimentary "mini" cocktails, a guided tour of the distillery, and a complimentary keepsake Chuckanut Bay Distillery souvenir glass.

experiences.title: Pike Place Market: Insider's Breakfast Tour - Gratuity Included!
experiences.description:
Pike Place Market at 8 am is a different market. The vendors are unhurried, the crowds haven't arrived, and the people who've worked here for years have time to chat with you one on one.

This is the insider's version, a morning food tour led by professional storytellers with deep roots in the market community. You'll chat with a fishmonger who's spent years at Pike Place Market, taste two smoked salmons, and watch the legendary fish toss up close. You'll savor a fresh mini-donut straight off the Daily Dozen donut robot and experience the market the way locals do: early, unhurried, and real.

Three things we do that nobody else does:
- Guide Guarantee. Love your guide or your next tour is on us.
- Tips included. Gratuity is built into your ticket.
- Professional storytellers. Our guides aren't just enthusiastic locals. They're trained professionals who earn All-Star status annually through continual education, rigorous training, and 5-star review achievement.

experiences.title: Pike Place Market: Original Food Tour - Tips Included!
experiences.description:
This isn't just a food tour. It's the bites AND the stories behind them. You'll meet the vendors, learn the history, and discover the quirks that make Pike Place Market unlike anywhere else. 

Savor is the Market's original food tour, led by professional storytellers who know this place like a local. They don't point at things. They invite you to meet the producers and craftspeople who make Pike Place Market what it is.

Three things we do that nobody else does:
- Guide Guarantee. Love your guide or your next tour is on us.

- Tips included. Your gratuity is built into the ticket. No math at the end, just a great experience.

- Professional storytellers. We know a guide makes or breaks your experience and it's why ours aren't just enthusiastic locals. They're trained professionals who earn All-Star status annually through continual education, rigorous training, and 5-star review achievement. 

We are officially authorized to conduct tours inside the Pike Place Historical District.

experiences.title: Street Food Tour of South Lake Union- Area of Amazon Spheres
experiences.description:
Experience the heart of Seattle’s tech center through the lens of a culinary walking tour. Over the last decade, this historical neighborhood has become home to the expansive Amazon and Google campuses—and, consequently, a vibrant street food scene that beckons both tech denizens and Seattleites who crave some of the city’s best noshes—from hand-rolled sourdough bagels at Rubinstein to Korean-Hawaiian fusion Marination to perfectly a balanced beverage from Rachel’s Ginger Beer to Middle Eastern mezze at Mamnoon Street. You stop at six different locations in South Lake Union for tastings and stories behind the distinctive local businesses.

Eat Seattle is permitted and licensed by the Pike Place Market PDA to operate tours in the Pike Place Historical District. The PDA requires any business or person conducting tours within it’s properties and in the public areas of the historical district to be pre-approved and to have a license for this activity

experiences.title: Coffee Crawl & VIP Morning in Pike Place Market
experiences.description:
Our guides are not just ordinary tour guides; they are seasoned chefs with extensive culinary expertise, offering a unique perspective. Their background in the industry gives them a profound appreciation for the small businesses we choose to spotlight during our tours. . Our bites are a medley of breakfast treats, and for those who prefer alternatives to coffee, we've got you covered. The concluding hour of our market tours is a truly magical moment, as it marks the awakening of the market for the day, providing an unforgettable experience for our visitors.

Eat Seattle is permitted and licensed by the Pike Place Market PDA to operate tours in the Pike Place Historical District. The PDA requires any business or person conducting tours within it’s properties and in the public areas of the historical district to be pre-approved and to have a license for this activity.

experiences.title: Seattle Coffee Tour: Capitol Hill Coffee Culture & Tastings
experiences.description: Discover Seattle’s coffee culture on Capitol Hill. Visit local cafés, taste unique brews, and learn the stories behind each cup as you explore one of the city’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.

experiences.title: Seattle's Original Sunset Sail (Est. 1984) - 70ft Boat - BYOB
experiences.description: Our Sunset Sail is one of the most relaxing and affordable activities in Downtown Seattle. The Sunset Sail is powered by the wind, so it is extremally Eco-Friendly. We are one of the only cruises in the area that allow you to bring your own beer, wine, and food onboard (Alcohol only allowed for those 21+). Our sailboats were built for racing across the oceans, making them Seattle's most unique Sunset Sail.

experiences.title: Seattle’s Original Sailing Cruise (Est. 1984) – 70ft Boat - BYOB
experiences.description: This is a boat ride like nothing else in Seattle! Our 70ft custom built sailboats were created to race around the world, and now are perfectly at home on Puget Sound. Sit back and relax as our trained crew hoist the sails and turn off the engine to get great views of the Seattle city skyline and surrounding mountain ranges. Enjoy your own food and drinks while we cruise around under power of the wind.

experiences.title: Seattle's Sweetest Food Tour: Delicious Donuts, Beignets, & More
experiences.description:
We've always had a passion for donuts, but only recently did we realize just how many others do too. And when looking around, we didn't see anything that truly celebrated donuts in all their glory, hence the Underground Donut Tour was born. This tour is for anyone who truly enjoys donuts. At each location, you'll be able to try a curated sample of one of that location's best donuts. Our tours include such favorites as Top Pot Doughnuts, Dahlia Bakery and Daily Dozen Doughnuts in Pike Place Market. 

We also offer much more information about the route, the city, the stops, and more on our website, www.donuttour.com. Check it out today! 

We hope you can join us!

experiences.title: Pike Place Tour with Vegan and Vegetarian Tastings
experiences.description:
For some, Plant-Based is a lifestyle. For others, it is a new way to think about food.

This tour visits restaurants that are selected by a local guide to showcase the best of Seattle and to highlight hidden gems within Pike Place Market.

Good food is good food. We don't let dietary restrictions limit us, so even those who eat everything will be impressed.

Enjoy an intimate glimpse into daily Market life. Along they way, come to understand Washington as a leader in agricultural and Seattle as an artisanal food capital.

Join us and see how good it can be!

experiences.title: Craft Beer Tasting Tour in Ballard Brewery District with Food
experiences.description:
Boats, Bridges, Bakeries and Beer. We've got pretty nice Beaches too.

Whether you're local, new or just passing through, come along to experience Seattle's best brewing neighborhood!

Visit three exceptional breweries like Obec, Fare Isle, and Maritime Pacific while fueling up on Cookies Country Chicken and Maria Luisa's Empanadas.

Between tastings, get the stories behind Ballard's transformation from maritime industrial to craft beer capital.

We hope you'll join us!

Skål!

experiences.title: Chef Guided Food Tour of Pike Place Market
experiences.description:
Eat Seattle Tours chef guides lead this two-hour walking tour of Pike Place Market with nine tastings from sixteen partner vendors. Your guide is a working Seattle chef who shops here and knows the people behind the counters.

Most routes include Beecher's "World's Best" Mac and Cheese. We're the only food tour Beecher's partners with. Other stops include Pike Place Chowder, artisan chocolate, and tacos at Maíz. Skip the lines, learn how chefs pick produce and judge fish, and hear the stories behind the small businesses that make the Market work.

*Tour stops may adjust depending on time of year and guide.

This is a fast-paced walking tour with distance, small hills, stairs, and cobblestones — a market tour rather than a seated restaurant tour. Moderate physical fitness required.

experiences.title: Chef Guided Happy Hour Tour - Cocktails, Bubbles and Bites
experiences.description:
Indulge in a delightful journey through Seattle with our expertly guided happy hour walking tour, led by a seasoned chef. Discover the culinary treasures of the city, savoring a variety of delectable items while forging connections with local small businesses and fellow adventurers. It's the perfect blend of exploration, gastronomy, and camaraderie—a must-do experience for any Seattle enthusiast.
This happy hour crawl involves 4 stops for drinks and paired food. We will be walking to each location. IDs are required and will be checked for those enjoying alcoholic beverages.

experiences.title: Pike Place Market Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Eat your way through Seattle's most celebrated culinary landmark -- Pike Place Market. Go behind the scenes on a walking tour to experience some of the city's favorite market spots. Taste locally made foods and meet our favorite vendors as you learn the colorful history of the Market from your charming and knowledgable guide. 

♦ Show Me Seattle is permitted and licensed by the Pike Place Market Preservation and Development Authority (PDA) to operate tours in the Pike Place Market Historical District. The PDA requires any business or person conducting paid tours within its properties and in the public areas of the historical district to be pre-approved and to have a license for this activity.♦

experiences.title: Early-Bird Tasting Tour of Pike Place Market
experiences.description:
Explore Pike Place Market, Seattle’s top attraction, with an early-bird tasting tour. Discover the market’s many delights as you visit different food vendors for 8+ tastings of fruit, salmon, pastries, international fare, and more. As an early-bird you'll visit merchants before the crowds arrive, and you’ll have a knowledgeable guide to expertly lead you around, entertaining you with stories about the market's history and culture. Explore the greatest hits and hidden gems of the Pike Place market during this experience. 

♦ Show Me Seattle is permitted and licensed by the Pike Place Market Preservation and Development Authority (PDA) to operate tours in the Pike Place Market Historical District. The PDA requires any business or person conducting paid tours within its properties and in the public areas of the historical district to be pre-approved and to have a license for this activity.♦

experiences.title: Mt. Rainier National Park Highlights Tour
experiences.description: On this full-day tour of Washington State’s Mt Rainier, you’ll visit the majestic 14,411-foot (4,392-m) volcano and learn about the area from your informative guide. You’ll also explore local treasures like lakes, old growth forest and waterfalls en-route from Seattle to Mt Rainier. Nature lovers won’t want to miss this! In winter and spring snowshoeing and sledding are included at no extra charge. Hiking will be offered as well PLEASE WEAR appropriate clothes and shoes. Our company picks up at hotels and spends more time in the park than others. a photographers paradise.

experiences.title: Seattle Pike Market Food Tour with 8 Authentic & Local Tastings
experiences.description:
Pike Place Market is one of the oldest and most storied food markets in the US, and this tour takes you through it the right way. Your local guide knows the stalls, the vendors, and the stories behind them, leading you past the crowds and into the parts of the market most visitors never find.
Along the way, you'll taste what makes this place worth the trip: iconic clam chowder, local sweets, and a Secret Dish revealed only on the day. You'll meet the producers behind the food, hear how they work, and understand why this market has been feeding Seattle since 1907.
The tour also takes you downstairs into the Downunder, a quieter stretch beneath the main market floor where the daily rhythm of local life and the traditions of North Pacific fishermen have played out for generations.

experiences.title: Bon Vivant Woodinville Wine Tasting Tour
experiences.description:
Bon Vivant’s popular wine tasting tours are led by professionally wine educated tour guides. Here's what you can expect:
 >Your group's wine preferences will influence tour stop choices for the day
 >From your Lodging location, you'll enjoy a comfortable 30 minute drive from Seattle to Woodinville, crossing beautiful Lake Washington, to Woodinville Wine Country
 >Visiting a flagship winery starts the touring day off big
 >A boutique winery will be next, where you can purchase lunch to enjoy while tasting
 >The afternoon will find you visiting 2 boutique wineries and tasting rooms, we call them hidden gems. (There are 125+ to choose from!) Enroute, your guide will talk about the next winery on your custom tour, the winemaker, their history, etc.
 >You will be returned to your point of departure around 4:30
 >All day long, you will be treated to your tour guide's insights and Washington Wine Country knowledge.
 >And best of all, you will go home with happy memories!

experiences.title: Haunted Seattle Booze and Boos Ghost Walking Tour
experiences.description:
This combination ghost tour and pub crawl that will take you on a walking tour to explore the fascinating history of Seattle and hear some of its most famous and creepy haunted stories. 

A costumed guide will lead tour goers on a 2-2.5 hour journey, offering glimpses into the past and revealing the stories of long-dead phantoms and specters who still call Seattle home. You'll visit several different bars and have time to enjoy a delicious libation (at own expense) as the guide tells you about all the spooky happenings and great history of this amazing town!
*Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
*All guests must be 21+ with Valid ID. Alcohol is not included.

experiences.title: Chocolate Tour in Seattle with Guided Tastings
experiences.description:
Chocolate is a technology 5,300 years in the making. It is currently going through metamorphosis unlike anything it has undergone before.

This tour celebrates chocolate in all its forms; join us to enjoy something unexpected alongside your all-time favorites. 

We visit bakeries, chocolatiers and specialty shops, tasting flavor and styles from across the globe.

But why Seattle?
